======================================================================

- completare e certificare il discovery Transfermarkt B63 in DRY-RUN
  per le 19 squadre Serie A 2026/2027 diverse da Atalanta;
- preservare Atalanta come baseline certificata;
- non effettuare persistence massiva;

- non modificare/cancellare i report FINAL_BACKEND_*.txt;
- non modificare/cancellare backup-before-v34-alignment-20260814.dump;

persisted=false

- configurazioni applicative e profilo dev
- schema DB relativo a seasons, season_clubs, players,
  player_registrations, player_reconciliation_results e
  player_identity_profiles.

E' stato confermato che il discovery seleziona soltanto:
- players.active = TRUE
- player_registrations.registration_status = ACTIVE
- stagione richiesta
- giocatori presenti in player_reconciliation_results

Atalanta continua quindi a richiedere 24 giocatori, escludendo i due
out_of_game/INACTIVE gia' certificati.

======================================================================
4. BASELINE INIZIALE PRIMA DEI FIX
======================================================================

Prima delle modifiche e' stata eseguita una baseline completa dei 19 club.
I principali problemi osservati erano:

- abbreviazioni Fantacalcio come Mas., Se., Ju., Je., Hj.;
- surnames/display name brevi che producevano omonimi storici;
- matcher che ignorava nome canonico, data di nascita e ID Transfermarkt
  gia' presenti in player_identity_profiles;
- club Transfermarkt trattato come requisito rigido anche con identita'
  forte, in contrasto con la distinzione identityVerified/rosterConfirmed;
- URL diretto Transfermarkt non affidabile se lo slug non coincideva con
  lo slug effettivamente usato dal sito;
- alcune risposte remote incomplete/HTTP 403 durante sequenze lunghe,
  compatibili con rate limiting temporaneo.

La baseline Atalanta, con accesso di rete autorizzato, era:

requested=24, matched=24, review=0, notFound=0, failed=0,
persisted=false

======================================================================
5. MODIFICHE IMPLEMENTATE
======================================================================

File modificato:

backend/src/main/java/it/fantacalciointelligence/backend/identity/
enrichment/transfermarkt/TransfermarktDiscoveryService.java

Modifiche effettuate:

1. La query dei giocatori operativi carica anche da
   player_identity_profiles:
   - canonical_full_name
   - birth_date
   - transfermarkt_player_id

2. Se esiste un transfermarkt_player_id locale gia' noto, viene costruito
   un candidato per quello stesso ID invece di affidarsi soltanto alla
   ricerca testuale del display name abbreviato.

3. Lo scoring usa il nome canonico quando disponibile.

4. Se l'URL sintetico con ID non produce un profilo verificabile, viene
   eseguito un fallback di ricerca usando:
   - nome canonico;
   - display name Fantacalcio;
   - query semplificata senza suffisso abbreviato.

5. Il fallback accetta soltanto il candidato con lo stesso identico
   transfermarkt_player_id locale. Non viene sostituito con un candidato
   dal nome meramente simile.

6. E' stata separata la forza dell'identita' dalla conferma del roster:
   un'identita' con ID Transfermarkt, nome compatibile e data di nascita
   coincidente puo' essere MATCHED_VERIFIED anche se il club Transfermarkt
   e' momentaneamente diverso o non leggibile.

7. Una data di nascita Transfermarkt diversa da quella del profilo locale
   produce sempre NOT_FOUND.

8. Le iniziali Fantacalcio continuano a disambiguare gli omonimi.
   Esempio verificato dai test:
   - Paul Mendy non puo' essere verificato come Benjamin Mendy.

9. E' stato supportato il caso generico dei nomi professionali abbreviati,
   come Ederson rispetto al nome anagrafico completo, senza introdurre una
   eccezione hardcoded per il singolo giocatore.

10. Non sono stati aggiunti nuovi fix Unicode al parser.
    repairMojibake() e' rimasto il meccanismo esistente.

DO $$
DECLARE
    row_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO row_count
    FROM b65_preferred_foot;

    IF row_count <> 20 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Attesi 20 preferred foot, trovati %',
            row_count;

UPDATE player_identity_profiles ip
SET preferred_foot = b.preferred_foot,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM b65_preferred_foot b
WHERE ip.player_id = b.player_id
  AND ip.transfermarkt_player_id = b.transfermarkt_player_id
  AND (
      ip.preferred_foot IS NULL
      OR TRIM(ip.preferred_foot) = ''
  );

INSERT INTO player_identity_provenance (
    player_id,
    field_name,
    source,
    source_external_id,
    source_url,
    confidence,
    evidence
)
SELECT
    b.player_id,
    'PREFERRED_FOOT',
    'TRANSFERMARKT',
    b.transfermarkt_player_id,
    b.source_url,
    'HIGH',
    jsonb_build_object(
        'reason',
        'Preferred foot verificato sul profilo Transfermarkt durante B65'
    )
FROM b65_preferred_foot b
ON CONFLICT (
    player_id,
    field_name,
    source,
    source_external_id
)
DO UPDATE SET
    source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url,
    confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence,
    evidence = EXCLUDED.evidence,
    imported_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

DO $$
DECLARE
    remaining INTEGER;
BEGIN
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO remaining
    FROM b65_preferred_foot b
    JOIN player_identity_profiles ip
      ON ip.player_id = b.player_id
    WHERE ip.preferred_foot IS NULL
       OR TRIM(ip.preferred_foot) = '';

    IF remaining <> 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Restano % preferred foot mancanti',
            remaining;
    END IF;
END
$$;

COMMIT;

\pset pager off

SELECT
    version,
    status,
    model_decision
FROM player_performance_algorithms
WHERE version IN (
    'B49_FEATURES_V1',
    'B66_FEATURES_V1',
    'B66_FEATURES_V2'
)
ORDER BY version;

SELECT
    algorithm_version,
    count(*) AS profiles,
    count(*) FILTER (
        WHERE source_mix = 'NO_HISTORY'
    ) AS no_history,
    min(history_seasons_available) AS min_history,
    max(history_seasons_available) AS max_history
FROM player_performance_feature_profiles
WHERE algorithm_version IN (
    'B66_FEATURES_V1',
    'B66_FEATURES_V2'
)
GROUP BY algorithm_version
ORDER BY algorithm_version;

SELECT
    p.id,
    p.display_name,
    pf.source_mix,
    pf.history_seasons_available,
    pf.latest_history_season,
    pf.data_confidence_score
FROM player_performance_feature_profiles pf
JOIN players p
  ON p.id = pf.player_id
WHERE pf.algorithm_version = 'B66_FEATURES_V2'
  AND pf.source_mix = 'NO_HISTORY';

SELECT
    count(*) AS transfermarkt_statistics
FROM player_competition_season_statistics
WHERE source = 'TRANSFERMARKT';

SELECT
    count(DISTINCT player_id)
        FILTER (
            WHERE player_id IN (
                1032,1033,1034,1035,
                1036,1037,1038,1111
            )
        ) AS recovered_players
FROM player_competition_season_statistics
WHERE source = 'TRANSFERMARKT';

SELECT
    competition_code,
    competition_type,
    count(*) AS rows
FROM player_competition_season_statistics
WHERE source = 'TRANSFERMARKT'
  AND competition_code IN (
      'CS','FRC','POPO'
  )
GROUP BY
    competition_code,
    competition_type
ORDER BY competition_code;

JOIN players p
  ON p.id=pf.player_id
WHERE pf.algorithm_version='B66_FEATURES_V3'
ORDER BY
    pf.role_code,
    pf.data_confidence_score DESC,
    pf.player_id
LIMIT 20;

D02.9 - SYSTEM STATUS RUNTIME ENVIRONMENT FIX REPORT
Generated: 2026-08-24 Europe/Rome

ROOT CAUSE
The Flyway V1 seed inserts system_information.environment as the static value
"development". SystemStatusService previously read that persisted seed value and
returned it from GET /api/v1/system/status, even when Spring was running with the
prod profile. The database value therefore described migration-time seed data,
not the current runtime environment.

FILES ANALYZED
- src/main/java/it/fantacalciointelligence/backend/system/SystemStatusController.java
- src/main/java/it/fantacalciointelligence/backend/system/SystemStatusService.java
- src/main/java/it/fantacalciointelligence/backend/system/SystemStatusResponse.java
- src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__create_system_information.sql
- src/main/resources/application.properties
- src/main/resources/application-dev.properties
- src/main/resources/application-prod.properties
- src/test/resources/application.properties
- existing tests/references related to system/status (none existed before this change)

FILES MODIFIED/ADDED
- MODIFIED: src/main/java/it/fantacalciointelligence/backend/system/SystemStatusService.java
- ADDED: src/test/java/it/fantacalciointelligence/backend/system/SystemStatusServiceTest.java
- ADDED: d02-9-system-environment-fix-report.txt
- NOT MODIFIED: frontend
- NOT MODIFIED: src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__create_system_information.sql
- No new Flyway migration was added.

IMPLEMENTED SOLUTION
SystemStatusService now receives Spring Environment and derives the response field
"environment" from the runtime profiles. The database query still supplies the
unchanged application name and version, but no longer reads the seeded environment
column. Status remains "UP" and checkedAt remains generated with OffsetDateTime.now().

Profile resolution is deterministic:
- If prod is among the active profiles, return "production".
- Otherwise, if dev is among the active profiles, return "development".
- Otherwise, if another profile is active, return the first active profile name.
- If no profile is active, return Spring's first default profile (normally "default").

WHY V1 WAS NOT MODIFIED
V1 is an already-applied Flyway migration. Editing it would invalidate migration
checksums and violate migration immutability. Setting its seed to "production" (or
adding a migration that always writes "production") would also be semantically
wrong because the same migration history is used in dev and test. The fix belongs
at runtime, where Spring knows the active environment.

RUNTIME BEHAVIOR
- dev: active profile "dev" -> API environment "development".
- prod: active profile "prod" -> API environment "production".
- default/test: with no active profile, the API reports Spring's default profile,
  normally "default". If an explicit "test" profile is active, the generic profile
  rule reports "test". This does not invent a dev/prod classification.
- In mixed profiles, prod takes precedence over dev to avoid misreporting a production
  runtime; dev takes precedence over other custom profiles.

TESTS ADDED/MODIFIED
Added SystemStatusServiceTest with 3 focused automatic tests:
- prod profile resolves to "production".
- dev profile resolves to "development".
- no active profile resolves to Spring default "default".

VERIFICATION
Command executed from backend:
  .\mvnw.cmd clean test

The environment required JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-Duser.home=C:\Users\user so Maven could
use the existing user-local dependency cache. This changes no repository file and
does not affect application behavior.

Total tests: 623
Failures: 0
Errors: 0
Skipped: 4
Result: BUILD SUCCESS

The total is the certified baseline of 620 plus the 3 new focused tests.
Surefire aggregate was independently confirmed from 125 TEST-*.xml reports:
tests=623, failures=0, errors=0, skipped=4.

BACKEND API COMPATIBILITY
No breaking API change. Endpoint, HTTP method, authentication behavior, response
record, JSON field names and field types are unchanged. application, version,
status and checkedAt retain their previous sources/behavior. Only the semantics of
environment are corrected to reflect the runtime profile instead of seed data.

SECRET-SAFETY VERIFICATION
The implementation adds no logging and does not read or print datasource/security
credentials. Test/build output was reviewed for this change; no secret was printed
by the new code or tests.

RESIDUAL RISKS
- The legacy system_information.environment column remains in the schema and may
  still contain historical seed data, but System Status intentionally ignores it.
- For custom or multiple profiles, the deterministic precedence documented above
  applies. Profile names outside prod/dev are exposed verbatim as the runtime label.
- The API still requires the system_information row for application name/version,
  matching existing behavior and scope.

### Maven Parent overrides

Due to Maven's design, elements are inherited from the parent POM to the project POM.
While most of the inheritance is fine, it also inherits unwanted elements like `<license>` and `<developers>` from the parent.
To prevent this, the project POM contains empty overrides for these elements.
If you manually switch to a different parent and actually want the inheritance, you need to remove those overrides.

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class AuctionApiPriceService {

    private final B67AuctionPriceModelService modelService;

    public AuctionApiPriceService(
            B67AuctionPriceModelService modelService
    ) {
        this.modelService = modelService;
    }

    /**
     * Public Auction API adapter.
     *
     * B67 is the current read model.
     * B51 remains immutable historical evidence.
     *
     * Public GET endpoints remain read-only and have no
     * persistence side effects.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public AuctionPriceResponse calculate(
            Long playerId,
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {

        B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result =
                modelService.calculateAll(
                                seasonCode,
                                budget,
                                teams,
                                defenseModifier
                        )
                        .stream()
                        .filter(item ->
                                item.playerId().equals(
                                        playerId
                                )
                        )
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow(() ->
                                new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                        "Giocatore non trovato"
                                )
                        );

        if (!"PRICED".equals(result.pricingStatus())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Prezzo asta non disponibile: evidenza insufficiente"
            );
        }

        return toResponse(
                result,
                teams,
                budget,
                defenseModifier
        );
    }

    /**
     * Calculates the complete current B67 auction market once.
     * Used by ranking and downstream intelligence.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<AuctionPriceResponse> calculateAll(
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {

        return modelService.calculateAll(
                        seasonCode,
                        budget,
                        teams,
                        defenseModifier
                )
                .stream()
                .filter(result ->
                        "PRICED".equals(
                                result.pricingStatus()
                        )
                )
                .map(result ->
                        toResponse(
                                result,
                                teams,
                                budget,
                                defenseModifier
                        )
                )
                .toList();
    }

    private AuctionPriceResponse toResponse(
            B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result,
            int teams,
            int budget,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {

        BigDecimal calculationScore =
                BigDecimal
                        .valueOf(
                                result.auctionScore()
                        )
                        .setScale(
                                2,
                                RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                        );

        String explanation =
                String.format(
                        "Prezzo calcolato con %s. "
                                + "Score asta %.2f/100, "
                                + "rank ruolo %d, "
                                + "percentile ruolo %.2f/100, "
                                + "evidenza %s.",
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION,
                        result.auctionScore(),
                        result.auctionRoleRank(),
                        result.auctionRolePercentile(),
                        result.evidenceTier()
                );

        return new AuctionPriceResponse(
                result.playerId(),
                result.playerName(),
                result.club(),
                result.role(),
                teams,
                budget,
                defenseModifier,
                result.minimumPrice(),
                result.recommendedPrice(),
                result.maximumPrice(),
                result.budgetPercentage(),
                calculationScore,
                result.pricingStatus(),
                explanation
        );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/auction")
public class AuctionPriceController {

    private final AuctionApiPriceService auctionApiPriceService;
    private final AuctionRankingService auctionRankingService;

    public AuctionPriceController(
            AuctionApiPriceService auctionApiPriceService,
            AuctionRankingService auctionRankingService
    ) {
        this.auctionApiPriceService = auctionApiPriceService;
        this.auctionRankingService = auctionRankingService;
    }

    @GetMapping("/prices/{playerId}")
    public AuctionPriceResponse calculatePrice(
            @PathVariable Long playerId,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "#{@currentSeasonResolver.resolve()}")
            String season,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1000")
            int budget,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "8")
            int teams,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "true")
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        return auctionApiPriceService.calculate(
                playerId,
                season,
                budget,
                teams,
                defenseModifier
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/rankings")
    public List<AuctionRankingResponse> calculateRanking(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "#{@currentSeasonResolver.resolve()}")
            String season,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1000")
            int budget,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "8")
            int teams,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "true")
            boolean defenseModifier,

            @RequestParam(required = false)
            String role,

            @RequestParam(required = false)
            String club,

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "100")
            int limit
    ) {
        return auctionRankingService.calculateRanking(
                season,
                budget,
                teams,
                defenseModifier,
                role,
                club,
                limit
        );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class AuctionPriceModelService {

    public static final String ALGORITHM_VERSION =
            "B51_AUCTION_PRICE_V1";

    public static final String B50_VERSION =
            "B50_FANTASY_VALUE_V1";

    private static final double MARKET_PERCENTILE_WEIGHT = 0.50;
    private static final double MARKET_STRENGTH_WEIGHT = 0.50;

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public AuctionPriceModelService(JdbcClient jdbcClient) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    public List<AuctionPriceModelResult> calculateAll(
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        validateConfiguration(
                budget,
                teams
        );

        List<PlayerInput> players =
                loadPlayers(seasonCode);

        if (players.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Nessun giocatore disponibile per la stagione "
                            + seasonCode
            );
        }

        Map<String, List<PlayerInput>> byRole =
                groupByRole(players);

        List<AuctionPriceModelResult> results =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (String role : List.of("P", "D", "C", "A")) {

            List<PlayerInput> rolePlayers =
                    byRole.getOrDefault(
                            role,
                            List.of()
                    );

            if (rolePlayers.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            results.addAll(
                    calculateRole(
                            role,
                            rolePlayers,
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier
                    )
            );
        }

        return results;
    }

    private List<AuctionPriceModelResult> calculateRole(
            String role,
            List<PlayerInput> players,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        List<PlayerInput> rankedPlayers =
                players.stream()
                        .filter(player ->
                                "RANKED".equals(
                                        player.rankingStatus()
                                )
                        )
                        .filter(player ->
                                player.b50RolePercentile()
                                        != null
                        )
                        .toList();

        List<PlayerInput> insufficientPlayers =
                players.stream()
                        .filter(player ->
                                !"RANKED".equals(
                                        player.rankingStatus()
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        Map<Long, Double> fvmPercentiles =
                calculateFvmPercentiles(
                        rankedPlayers
                );

        Double maxFvm =
                rankedPlayers.stream()
                        .map(PlayerInput::fantasyMarketValue)
                        .filter(value ->
                                value != null
                        )
                        .max(Double::compareTo)
                        .orElse(null);

        List<ScoredPlayer> scored =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (PlayerInput player : rankedPlayers) {

            Double fvmPercentile =
                    fvmPercentiles.get(
                            player.playerId()
                    );

            Double fvmStrength = null;
            Double marketSignal = null;

            double auctionScore;

            if (
                    player.fantasyMarketValue() == null
                    || maxFvm == null
            ) {
                auctionScore =
                        player.b50RolePercentile();

            } else {
                /*
                 * Important:
                 *
                 * FVM = 0 is VALID market evidence.
                 * It is NOT equivalent to NULL.
                 */
                fvmStrength =
                        maxFvm > 0
                                ? (
                                        Math.log1p(
                                                player.fantasyMarketValue()
                                        )
                                        / Math.log1p(maxFvm)
                                        * 100.0
                                )
                                : 0.0;

                marketSignal =
                        fvmPercentile
                                * MARKET_PERCENTILE_WEIGHT
                                + fvmStrength
                                * MARKET_STRENGTH_WEIGHT;

                double b50Weight =
                        b50Weight(role);

                double marketWeight =
                        1.0 - b50Weight;

                auctionScore =
                        player.b50RolePercentile()
                                * b50Weight
                                + marketSignal
                                * marketWeight;
            }

            scored.add(
                    new ScoredPlayer(
                            player,
                            round2(fvmPercentile),
                            round2(fvmStrength),
                            round2(marketSignal),
                            auctionScore
                    )
            );
        }

        scored.sort(
                Comparator
                        .comparing(
                                ScoredPlayer::auctionScore
                        )
                        .reversed()
                        .thenComparing(
                                item ->
                                        item.player()
                                                .playerId()
                        )
        );

        int marketSlots =
                teams * roleSlots(role);

        List<ScoredPlayer> contenders =
                scored.stream()
                        .limit(marketSlots)
                        .toList();

        double leagueRoleBudget =
                budget
                        * teams
                        * roleAllocation(
                                role,
                                defenseModifier
                        );

        double budgetFactor =
                budget / 1000.0;

        double teamFactor =
                1.0
                        + (
                                (teams - 8)
                                        * 0.05
                        );

        Map<Long, Double> provisionalPrices =
                new HashMap<>();

        for (ScoredPlayer player : contenders) {

            double rawPrice =
                    interpolatePrice(
                            role,
                            player.auctionScore()
                    );

            rawPrice *= budgetFactor;
            rawPrice *= teamFactor;

            provisionalPrices.put(
                    player.player()
                            .playerId(),
                    Math.max(
                            1.0,
                            rawPrice
                    )
            );
        }

        double provisionalTotal =
                provisionalPrices
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue)
                        .sum();

        boolean budgetCapApplied =
                provisionalTotal > leagueRoleBudget;

        if (budgetCapApplied) {

            int floors =
                    provisionalPrices.size();

            double distributableBudget =
                    Math.max(
                            0,
                            leagueRoleBudget
                                    - floors
                    );

            double rawExtra =
                    provisionalPrices
                            .values()
                            .stream()
                            .mapToDouble(price ->
                                    Math.max(
                                            0,
                                            price - 1
                                    )
                            )
                            .sum();

            double scale =
                    rawExtra > 0
                            ? distributableBudget
                                    / rawExtra
                            : 0;

            provisionalPrices.replaceAll(
                    (playerId, price) ->
                            1
                                    + Math.max(
                                            0,
                                            price - 1
                                    )
                                    * scale
            );
        }

        Map<Long, Integer> recommendedPrices =
                new HashMap<>();

        /*
         * Players outside the auction-market slots still receive
         * the minimum actionable price of 1 credit.
         */
        for (ScoredPlayer scoredPlayer : scored) {
            recommendedPrices.put(
                    scoredPlayer.player()
                            .playerId(),
                    1
            );
        }

        if (budgetCapApplied) {

            int integerBudgetTarget =
                    (int) Math.floor(
                            leagueRoleBudget
                                    + 0.000000001
                    );

            List<PriceRemainder> remainders =
                    new ArrayList<>();

            int assignedCredits = 0;

            for (ScoredPlayer contender : contenders) {

                Long playerId =
                        contender.player()
                                .playerId();

                double exactPrice =
                        provisionalPrices.get(
                                playerId
                        );

                int floorPrice =
                        Math.max(
                                1,
                                (int) Math.floor(
                                        exactPrice
                                )
                        );

                recommendedPrices.put(
                        playerId,
                        floorPrice
                );

                assignedCredits += floorPrice;

                remainders.add(
                        new PriceRemainder(
                                playerId,
                                exactPrice
                                        - floorPrice,
                                contender.auctionScore()
                        )
                );
            }

            int creditsToDistribute =
                    Math.max(
                            0,
                            integerBudgetTarget
                                    - assignedCredits
                    );

            remainders.sort(
                    Comparator
                            .comparing(
                                    PriceRemainder::fraction
                            )
                            .reversed()
                            .thenComparing(
                                    PriceRemainder::auctionScore,
                                    Comparator.reverseOrder()
                            )
                            .thenComparing(
                                    PriceRemainder::playerId
                            )
            );

            int distributableCredits =
                    Math.min(
                            creditsToDistribute,
                            remainders.size()
                    );

            for (
                    int index = 0;
                    index < distributableCredits;
                    index++
            ) {
                Long playerId =
                        remainders.get(index)
                                .playerId();

                recommendedPrices.computeIfPresent(
                        playerId,
                        (ignored, currentPrice) ->
                                currentPrice + 1
                );
            }

        } else {

            for (ScoredPlayer contender : contenders) {

                Long playerId =
                        contender.player()
                                .playerId();

                int roundedPrice =
                        Math.max(
                                1,
                                (int) Math.round(
                                        provisionalPrices.get(
                                                playerId
                                        )
                                )
                        );

                recommendedPrices.put(
                        playerId,
                        roundedPrice
                );
            }
        }

        List<AuctionPriceModelResult> results =
                new ArrayList<>();

        int position = 0;
        int auctionRank = 0;
        Double previousAuctionScore = null;

        for (ScoredPlayer scoredPlayer : scored) {

            position++;

            if (
                    previousAuctionScore == null
                    || Double.compare(
                            scoredPlayer.auctionScore(),
                            previousAuctionScore
                    ) != 0
            ) {
                auctionRank = position;
            }

            previousAuctionScore =
                    scoredPlayer.auctionScore();

            PlayerInput player =
                    scoredPlayer.player();

            int recommendedPrice =
                    recommendedPrices.getOrDefault(
                            player.playerId(),
                            1
                    );

            PriceRange range =
                    calculateRange(
                            recommendedPrice,
                            player.dataConfidenceScore(),
                            player.fantasyMarketValue()
                                    != null
                    );

            double auctionPercentile =
                    competitionPercentile(
                            auctionRank,
                            scored.size()
                    );

            results.add(
                    new AuctionPriceModelResult(
                            player.playerId(),
                            player.playerName(),
                            player.club(),
                            player.role(),
                            player.b50RoleRank(),
                            round2(
                                    player.b50RolePercentile()
                            ),
                            round2(
                                    player.dataConfidenceScore()
                            ),
                            player.quotation(),
                            player.fantasyMarketValue(),
                            scoredPlayer.fvmRolePercentile(),
                            scoredPlayer.fvmStrength(),
                            scoredPlayer.marketSignal(),
                            round2(
                                    scoredPlayer.auctionScore()
                            ),
                            auctionRank,
                            round2(
                                    auctionPercentile
                            ),
                            "PRICED",
                            range.minimumPrice(),
                            recommendedPrice,
                            range.maximumPrice(),
                            BigDecimal.valueOf(
                                            recommendedPrice
                                                    * 100.0
                                                    / budget
                                    )
                                    .setScale(
                                            3,
                                            RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                                    )
                    )
            );

        }

        for (PlayerInput player : insufficientPlayers) {

            results.add(
                    new AuctionPriceModelResult(
                            player.playerId(),
                            player.playerName(),
                            player.club(),
                            player.role(),
                            null,
                            null,
                            round2(
                                    player.dataConfidenceScore()
                            ),
                            player.quotation(),
                            player.fantasyMarketValue(),
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
                            null,
                            null,
                            null,
                            null
                    )
            );
        }

        return results;
    }

    private List<PlayerInput> loadPlayers(
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    player.id AS player_id,
                    player.display_name,
                    club.name AS club_name,
                    role.fantasy_role,

                    value_profile.role_rank,
                    value_profile.role_percentile,
                    value_profile.data_confidence_score,
                    value_profile.ranking_status,

                    market.quotation,
                    market.fantasy_market_value

                FROM player_value_profiles value_profile

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                        value_profile.reference_season_id

                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id =
                        value_profile.player_id

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND registration.season_id =
                        season.id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id =
                        registration.club_id

                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = season.id
                    AND season_club.club_id = club.id

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND role.season_id =
                        season.id
                    AND role.source =
                        'FANTACALCIO'

                LEFT JOIN player_market_values market
                    ON market.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND market.season_id =
                        season.id
                    AND market.source =
                        'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE season.code = :seasonCode

                  AND value_profile.algorithm_version =
                        :b50Version

                  AND player.active = TRUE

                ORDER BY
                    role.fantasy_role,
                    value_profile.role_rank NULLS LAST,
                    player.id
                """)
                .param(
                        "seasonCode",
                        seasonCode
                )
                .param(
                        "b50Version",
                        B50_VERSION
                )
                .query(
                        (rs, rowNumber) ->
                                new PlayerInput(
                                        rs.getLong(
                                                "player_id"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "display_name"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "club_name"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "fantasy_role"
                                        ),
                                        integerOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "role_rank"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "role_percentile"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "data_confidence_score"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "ranking_status"
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "quotation"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "fantasy_market_value"
                                                )
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private Map<String, List<PlayerInput>> groupByRole(
            List<PlayerInput> players
    ) {
        Map<String, List<PlayerInput>> result =
                new HashMap<>();

        for (PlayerInput player : players) {
            result
                    .computeIfAbsent(
                            player.role(),
                            ignored ->
                                    new ArrayList<>()
                    )
                    .add(player);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private Map<Long, Double> calculateFvmPercentiles(
            List<PlayerInput> players
    ) {
        List<Double> values =
                players.stream()
                        .map(
                                PlayerInput
                                        ::fantasyMarketValue
                        )
                        .filter(value ->
                                value != null
                        )
                        .sorted()
                        .toList();

        Map<Long, Double> percentiles =
                new HashMap<>();

        int n = values.size();

        if (n == 0) {
            return percentiles;
        }

        for (PlayerInput player : players) {

            Double value =
                    player.fantasyMarketValue();

            if (value == null) {
                continue;
            }

            long lower =
                    values.stream()
                            .filter(item ->
                                    item < value
                            )
                            .count();

            long equal =
                    values.stream()
                            .filter(item ->
                                    Double.compare(
                                            item,
                                            value
                                    ) == 0
                            )
                            .count();

            double percentile;

            if (n == 1) {
                percentile = 100.0;

            } else {
                double averageRankZeroBased =
                        lower
                                + (
                                        equal - 1
                                ) / 2.0;

                percentile =
                        averageRankZeroBased
                                / (n - 1)
                                * 100.0;
            }

            percentiles.put(
                    player.playerId(),
                    percentile
            );
        }

        return percentiles;
    }

    private double b50Weight(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.55;
            case "D", "C", "A" -> 0.65;
            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido: "
                                    + role
                    );
        };
    }

    private double roleAllocation(
            String role,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        if (defenseModifier) {
            return switch (role) {
                case "P" -> 0.07;
                case "D" -> 0.15;
                case "C" -> 0.23;
                case "A" -> 0.55;
                default ->
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Ruolo non valido"
                        );
            };
        }

        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.06;
            case "D" -> 0.10;
            case "C" -> 0.25;
            case "A" -> 0.59;
            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido"
                    );
        };
    }

    private int roleSlots(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 3;
            case "D" -> 8;
            case "C" -> 8;
            case "A" -> 6;
            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido"
                    );
        };
    }

    private double interpolatePrice(
            String role,
            double percentile
    ) {
        double[][] anchors =
                priceAnchors(role);

        if (percentile >= anchors[0][0]) {
            return anchors[0][1];
        }

        if (
                percentile
                        <= anchors[anchors.length - 1][0]
        ) {
            return anchors[
                    anchors.length - 1
            ][1];
        }

        for (int index = 0;
                index < anchors.length - 1;
                index++) {

            double highPercentile =
                    anchors[index][0];

            double highPrice =
                    anchors[index][1];

            double lowPercentile =
                    anchors[index + 1][0];

            double lowPrice =
                    anchors[index + 1][1];

            if (
                    percentile <= highPercentile
                    && percentile >= lowPercentile
            ) {
                double span =
                        highPercentile
                                - lowPercentile;

                if (span == 0) {
                    return highPrice;
                }

                double position =
                        (
                                percentile
                                        - lowPercentile
                        ) / span;

                return lowPrice
                        + position
                        * (
                                highPrice
                                        - lowPrice
                        );
            }
        }

        return 1.0;
    }

    private double[][] priceAnchors(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 70},
                    {97, 58},
                    {95, 50},
                    {90, 38},
                    {80, 22},
                    {70, 12},
                    {50, 5},
                    {30, 2},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            case "D" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 180},
                    {98, 145},
                    {95, 105},
                    {90, 65},
                    {80, 30},
                    {70, 15},
                    {50, 6},
                    {30, 2},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            case "C" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 500},
                    {98, 420},
                    {95, 330},
                    {90, 190},
                    {85, 95},
                    {80, 42},
                    {70, 12},
                    {60, 4},
                    {50, 2},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            case "A" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 340},
                    {98, 310},
                    {95, 270},
                    {90, 220},
                    {80, 150},
                    {70, 95},
                    {50, 40},
                    {30, 12},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido"
                    );
        };
    }

    private PriceRange calculateRange(
            double price,
            double confidence,
            boolean hasFvm
    ) {
        double lowFactor;
        double highFactor;

        if (confidence >= 90) {
            lowFactor = 0.90;
            highFactor = 1.10;

        } else if (confidence >= 80) {
            lowFactor = 0.85;
            highFactor = 1.15;

        } else if (confidence >= 70) {
            lowFactor = 0.80;
            highFactor = 1.20;

        } else {
            lowFactor = 0.72;
            highFactor = 1.28;
        }

        if (!hasFvm) {
            lowFactor -= 0.05;
            highFactor += 0.05;
        }

        int minimum =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        (int) Math.round(
                                price * lowFactor
                        )
                );

        int maximum =
                Math.max(
                        (int) Math.round(price),
                        (int) Math.round(
                                price * highFactor
                        )
                );

        return new PriceRange(
                minimum,
                maximum
        );
    }

    private double competitionPercentile(
            int rank,
            int total
    ) {
        if (total <= 1) {
            return 100.0;
        }

        return (
                (total - rank)
                        * 100.0
                        / (total - 1)
        );
    }

    private void validateConfiguration(
            int budget,
            int teams
    ) {
        if (
                budget < 150
                || budget > 1000
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Il budget deve essere compreso tra 150 e 1000"
            );
        }

        if (
                teams < 6
                || teams > 12
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Le squadre devono essere comprese tra 6 e 12"
            );
        }
    }

    private static Integer integerOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {
        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.intValue();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static Double doubleOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {
        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.doubleValue();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static Double round2(
            Double value
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return BigDecimal
                .valueOf(value)
                .setScale(
                        2,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                )
                .doubleValue();
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

@Service
public class AuctionPricePersistenceService {

    private static final String MODEL_FAMILY =
            "B50_MARKET_BLEND_AUCTION_PRICE";

    private static final BigDecimal GOALKEEPER_B50_WEIGHT =
            new BigDecimal("0.5500");

    private static final BigDecimal OUTFIELD_B50_WEIGHT =
            new BigDecimal("0.6500");

    private static final BigDecimal MARKET_PERCENTILE_WEIGHT =
            new BigDecimal("0.5000");

    private static final BigDecimal MARKET_STRENGTH_WEIGHT =
            new BigDecimal("0.5000");

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final AuctionPriceModelService modelService;

    public AuctionPricePersistenceService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            AuctionPriceModelService modelService
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.modelService = modelService;
    }

    @Transactional
    public PersistResult generateAndPersist(
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        Long seasonId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM seasons
                        WHERE code = :seasonCode
                        """)
                        .param("seasonCode", seasonCode)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .optional()
                        .orElseThrow(() ->
                                new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Stagione non trovata: "
                                                + seasonCode
                                )
                        );

        verifyB50Algorithm(seasonId);

        String definitionPayload =
                """
                {
                  "version":"B51_AUCTION_PRICE_V1",
                  "b50_version":"B50_FANTASY_VALUE_V1",
                  "goalkeeper_b50_weight":0.55,
                  "outfield_b50_weight":0.65,
                  "market_percentile_weight":0.50,
                  "market_strength_weight":0.50,
                  "fvm_strength":"log1p(fvm)/log1p(role_max_fvm)",
                  "null_fvm":"renormalize_to_b50",
                  "zero_fvm":"valid_minimum_market_signal",
                  "confidence":"range_only",
                  "role_allocations_no_modifier":{
                    "P":0.06,
                    "D":0.10,
                    "C":0.25,
                    "A":0.59
                  },
                  "role_allocations_modifier":{
                    "P":0.07,
                    "D":0.15,
                    "C":0.23,
                    "A":0.55
                  }
                }
                """.replaceAll("\\s+", "");

        String definitionFingerprint =
                sha256(definitionPayload);

        registerAlgorithm(
                seasonId,
                definitionPayload,
                definitionFingerprint
        );

        List<AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult>
                results =
                modelService.calculateAll(
                        seasonCode,
                        budget,
                        teams,
                        defenseModifier
                );

        int inserted = 0;
        int unchanged = 0;

        for (
                AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result :
                results
        ) {
            String evidence =
                    buildEvidenceJson(result);

            String inputFingerprint =
                    buildInputFingerprint(
                            seasonCode,
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier,
                            result
                    );

            ExistingProfile existing =
                    findExistingProfile(
                            result.playerId(),
                            seasonId,
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier
                    );

            if (existing != null) {
                if (
                        !existing.inputFingerprint()
                                .equals(inputFingerprint)
                ) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "Conflitto profilo B51 immutabile per player_id="
                                    + result.playerId()
                    );
                }

                unchanged++;
                continue;
            }

            insertProfile(
                    result,
                    seasonId,
                    budget,
                    teams,
                    defenseModifier,
                    evidence,
                    inputFingerprint
            );

            inserted++;
        }

        return new PersistResult(
                AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION,
                results.size(),
                inserted,
                unchanged
        );
    }

    private void verifyB50Algorithm(
            Long seasonId
    ) {
        Integer count =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_value_algorithms
                        WHERE version = :version
                          AND reference_season_id = :seasonId
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "version",
                                AuctionPriceModelService.B50_VERSION
                        )
                        .param(
                                "seasonId",
                                seasonId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        if (count != 1) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Algoritmo B50 richiesto non disponibile"
            );
        }
    }

    private void registerAlgorithm(
            Long seasonId,
            String payload,
            String fingerprint
    ) {
        Map<String, Object> existing =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            reference_season_id,
                            b50_algorithm_version,
                            definition_fingerprint
                        FROM auction_price_algorithms
                        WHERE version = :version
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "version",
                                AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION
                        )
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows()
                        .stream()
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElse(null);

        if (existing != null) {
            Long existingSeasonId =
                    ((Number) existing.get(
                            "reference_season_id"
                    )).longValue();

            String existingB50 =
                    existing.get(
                            "b50_algorithm_version"
                    ).toString();

            String existingFingerprint =
                    existing.get(
                            "definition_fingerprint"
                    ).toString();

            if (
                    !existingSeasonId.equals(seasonId)
                    || !AuctionPriceModelService.B50_VERSION
                            .equals(existingB50)
                    || !fingerprint.equals(
                            existingFingerprint
                    )
            ) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Conflitto definizione algoritmo B51 immutabile"
                );
            }

            return;
        }

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO auction_price_algorithms (
                    version,
                    reference_season_id,
                    b50_algorithm_version,
                    status,
                    model_family,
                    goalkeeper_b50_weight,
                    outfield_b50_weight,
                    market_percentile_weight,
                    market_strength_weight,
                    definition_payload,
                    definition_fingerprint
                )
                VALUES (
                    :version,
                    :seasonId,
                    :b50Version,
                    'ACTIVE',
                    :modelFamily,
                    :goalkeeperWeight,
                    :outfieldWeight,
                    :marketPercentileWeight,
                    :marketStrengthWeight,
                    CAST(:payload AS jsonb),
                    :fingerprint
                )
                """)
                .param(
                        "version",
                        AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "b50Version",
                        AuctionPriceModelService.B50_VERSION
                )
                .param(
                        "modelFamily",
                        MODEL_FAMILY
                )
                .param(
                        "goalkeeperWeight",
                        GOALKEEPER_B50_WEIGHT
                )
                .param(
                        "outfieldWeight",
                        OUTFIELD_B50_WEIGHT
                )
                .param(
                        "marketPercentileWeight",
                        MARKET_PERCENTILE_WEIGHT
                )
                .param(
                        "marketStrengthWeight",
                        MARKET_STRENGTH_WEIGHT
                )
                .param(
                        "payload",
                        payload
                )
                .param(
                        "fingerprint",
                        fingerprint
                )
                .update();
    }

    private ExistingProfile findExistingProfile(

                  AND algorithm_version = :algorithmVersion
                  AND league_teams = :teams

                .param("playerId", playerId)

    private String buildEvidenceJson(
            AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result
    ) {
        return """
                {
                  "b50_algorithm_version":"%s",
                  "pricing_algorithm_version":"%s",
                  "market_source":"FANTACALCIO",
                  "role":"%s",
                  "pricing_status":"%s"
                }
                """.formatted(
                        AuctionPriceModelService.B50_VERSION,
                        AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION,
                        result.role(),
                        result.pricingStatus()
                ).replaceAll("\\s+", "");
    }

    private String buildInputFingerprint(
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier,
            AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result
    ) {
        String canonical =
                String.join(
                        "|",
                        AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION,
                        AuctionPriceModelService.B50_VERSION,
                        seasonCode,
                        Integer.toString(budget),
                        Integer.toString(teams),
                        Boolean.toString(defenseModifier),
                        result.playerId().toString(),
                        safe(result.role()),
                        safe(result.b50RoleRank()),
                        safe(result.b50RolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.dataConfidenceScore()),
                        safe(result.quotation()),
                        safe(result.fantasyMarketValue()),
                        safe(result.fvmRolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.fvmStrength()),
                        safe(result.marketSignal()),
                        safe(result.auctionScore()),
                        safe(result.auctionRoleRank()),
                        safe(result.auctionRolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.pricingStatus()),
                        safe(result.minimumPrice()),
                        safe(result.recommendedPrice()),
                        safe(result.maximumPrice())
                );

        return sha256(canonical);
    }

    private String safe(
            Object value
    ) {
        return value == null
                ? "NULL"
                : value.toString();
    }

    private String sha256(
            String value
    ) {
        try {
            MessageDigest digest =
                    MessageDigest.getInstance(
                            "SHA-256"
                    );

            byte[] hash =
                    digest.digest(
                            value.getBytes(
                                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                            )
                    );

            return HexFormat
                    .of()
                    .formatHex(hash);

        } catch (
                NoSuchAlgorithmException exception
        ) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "SHA-256 non disponibile",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    private record ExistingProfile(
            String inputFingerprint
