package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class AuctionPriceService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public AuctionPriceService(JdbcClient jdbcClient) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional
    public AuctionPriceResponse calculate(
            Long playerId,
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        validateConfiguration(budget, teams);

        Map<String, Object> data = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    p.id,
                    p.display_name,
                    c.name AS club_name,
                    s.id AS season_id,

                    role.fantasy_role,

                    evaluation.projected_fantasy_average,
                    evaluation.projected_appearances,
                    evaluation.projected_starts,
                    evaluation.projected_goals,
                    evaluation.projected_assists,
                    evaluation.reliability_score,
                    evaluation.potential_score,
                    evaluation.risk_score,
                    evaluation.value_score,

                    tactical.starter_probability,
                    tactical.attacking_involvement,
                    tactical.penalty_taker,
                    tactical.set_piece_taker,

                    market.quotation,
                    market.fantasy_market_value

                FROM players p

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = p.id

                JOIN seasons s
                    ON s.id = registration.season_id

                JOIN clubs c
                    ON c.id = registration.club_id

                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = s.id
                    AND season_club.club_id = c.id

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id = p.id
                    AND role.season_id = s.id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                LEFT JOIN player_evaluations evaluation
                    ON evaluation.player_id = p.id
                    AND evaluation.season_id = s.id

                LEFT JOIN player_tactical_profiles tactical
                    ON tactical.player_id = p.id
                    AND tactical.season_id = s.id

                LEFT JOIN player_market_values market
                    ON market.player_id = p.id
                    AND market.season_id = s.id
                    AND market.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE p.id = :playerId
                  AND s.code = :seasonCode
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonCode", seasonCode)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Giocatore non trovato"
                        )
                );

        String role = stringValue(data, "fantasy_role");

        double quotation = number(
                data,
                "quotation",
                0
        );

        double fantasyMarketValue = number(
                data,
                "fantasy_market_value",
                0
        );

        double reliability = number(data, "reliability_score", 50);
        double potential = number(data, "potential_score", 50);
        double risk = number(data, "risk_score", 50);
        double value = number(data, "value_score", 50);

        double fantasyAverage = number(
                data,
                "projected_fantasy_average",
                6
        );

        double starterProbability = number(
                data,
                "starter_probability",
                50
        );

        double attackingInvolvement = number(
                data,
                "attacking_involvement",
                50
        );

        double projectedGoals = number(
                data,
                "projected_goals",
                0
        );

        double projectedAssists = number(
                data,
                "projected_assists",
                0
        );

        boolean penaltyTaker = booleanValue(
                data,
                "penalty_taker"
        );

        boolean setPieceTaker = booleanValue(
                data,
                "set_piece_taker"
        );

        double score =
                reliability * 0.18
                + potential * 0.22
                + value * 0.25
                + (100 - risk) * 0.15
                + starterProbability * 0.12
                + Math.min(attackingInvolvement, 100) * 0.08;

        score += Math.max(0, fantasyAverage - 6) * 8;
        score += projectedGoals * goalWeight(role);
        score += projectedAssists * assistWeight(role);

        if (penaltyTaker) {
            score += 7;
        }

        if (setPieceTaker) {
            score += 3;
        }

        double marketReference =
                maximumAllowedForRole(
                        1000,
                        role,
                        defenseModifier
                );

        double marketStrength = 0;

        if (fantasyMarketValue > 0
                && marketReference > 0) {

            marketStrength = Math.min(
                    100,
                    fantasyMarketValue
                            * 100
                            / marketReference
            );

            score =
                    score * 0.45
                    + marketStrength * 0.55;

        } else if (quotation > 0) {

            double quotationReference =
                    quotationReference(role);

            marketStrength = Math.min(
                    100,
                    quotation
                            * 100
                            / quotationReference
            );

            score =
                    score * 0.60
                    + marketStrength * 0.40;
        }

        score = Math.max(0, Math.min(score, 100));

        double roleAllocation = roleAllocation(
                role,
                defenseModifier
        );

        int roleSlots = roleSlots(role);

        double roleBudget = budget * roleAllocation;
        double slotBasePrice = roleBudget / roleSlots;

        double strengthMultiplier =
                0.40 + (score / 60.0);

        double leagueMultiplier =
                0.82 + (teams / 8.0) * 0.18;

        double scarcityMultiplier =
                scarcityMultiplier(role, teams);

        double calculatedPrice =
                slotBasePrice
                * strengthMultiplier
                * leagueMultiplier
                * scarcityMultiplier;

        if (fantasyMarketValue > 0) {
            double officialMarketPrice =
                    fantasyMarketValue
                    * budget
                    / 1000.0;

            calculatedPrice =
                    officialMarketPrice * 0.75
                    + calculatedPrice * 0.25;
        }

        int recommendedPrice = clamp(
                (int) Math.round(calculatedPrice),
                1,
                budget
        );

        double minimumFactor =
                risk >= 65 ? 0.68 : 0.78;

        double maximumFactor =
                score >= 95 ? 1.25 : 1.16;

        int minimumPrice = Math.max(
                1,
                (int) Math.round(
                        recommendedPrice * minimumFactor
                )
        );

        int maximumPrice = Math.max(
                recommendedPrice,
                (int) Math.round(
                        recommendedPrice * maximumFactor
                )
        );

        maximumPrice = Math.min(
                maximumPrice,
                maximumAllowedForRole(
                        budget,
                        role,
                        defenseModifier
                )
        );

        recommendedPrice = Math.min(
                recommendedPrice,
                maximumPrice
        );

        minimumPrice = Math.min(
                minimumPrice,
                recommendedPrice
        );

        BigDecimal budgetPercentage = BigDecimal
                .valueOf(
                        recommendedPrice * 100.0 / budget
                )
                .setScale(3, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);

        BigDecimal calculationScore = BigDecimal
                .valueOf(score)
                .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);

        String recommendation = recommendation(
                score,
                risk,
                value
        );

        String explanation = explanation(
                role,
                score,
                starterProbability,
                projectedGoals,
                projectedAssists,
                risk,
                penaltyTaker,
                quotation,
                fantasyMarketValue
        );

        Long seasonId =
                ((Number) data.get("season_id")).longValue();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO auction_price_snapshots (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    league_teams,
                    total_budget,
                    defense_modifier,
                    fantasy_role,
                    minimum_price,
                    recommended_price,
                    maximum_price,
                    budget_percentage,
                    calculation_score
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :teams,
                    :budget,
                    :defenseModifier,
                    :role,
                    :minimumPrice,
                    :recommendedPrice,
                    :maximumPrice,
                    :budgetPercentage,
                    :calculationScore
                )
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("teams", teams)
                .param("budget", budget)
                .param("defenseModifier", defenseModifier)
                .param("role", role)
                .param("minimumPrice", minimumPrice)
                .param("recommendedPrice", recommendedPrice)
                .param("maximumPrice", maximumPrice)
                .param("budgetPercentage", budgetPercentage)
                .param("calculationScore", calculationScore)
                .update();

        return new AuctionPriceResponse(
                playerId,
                stringValue(data, "display_name"),
                stringValue(data, "club_name"),
                role,
                teams,
                budget,
                defenseModifier,
                minimumPrice,
                recommendedPrice,
                maximumPrice,
                budgetPercentage,
                calculationScore,
                recommendation,
                explanation
        );
    }

    private void validateConfiguration(
            int budget,
            int teams
    ) {
        if (budget < 150 || budget > 1000) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Il budget deve essere compreso tra 150 e 1000"
            );
        }

        if (teams < 6 || teams > 12) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Le squadre devono essere comprese tra 6 e 12"
            );
        }
    }

    private double roleAllocation(
            String role,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.08;
            case "D" -> defenseModifier ? 0.22 : 0.17;
            case "C" -> defenseModifier ? 0.27 : 0.30;
            case "A" -> defenseModifier ? 0.43 : 0.45;
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Ruolo non valido"
            );
        };
    }

    private int roleSlots(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 3;
            case "D" -> 8;
            case "C" -> 8;
            case "A" -> 6;
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Ruolo non valido"
            );
        };
    }

    private double scarcityMultiplier(
            String role,
            int teams
    ) {
        double teamImpact = 1 + ((teams - 8) * 0.035);

        double roleImpact = switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.90;
            case "D" -> 0.95;
            case "C" -> 1.02;
            case "A" -> 1.12;
            default -> 1;
        };

        return teamImpact * roleImpact;
    }

    private int maximumAllowedForRole(
            int budget,
            String role,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        double maximumPercentage = switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.09;
            case "D" -> defenseModifier ? 0.13 : 0.09;
            case "C" -> 0.20;
            case "A" -> 0.38;
            default -> 1;
        };

        return Math.max(
                1,
                (int) Math.round(
                        budget * maximumPercentage
                )
        );
    }

    private double quotationReference(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 20;
            case "D" -> 30;
            case "C" -> 40;
            case "A" -> 50;
            default -> 50;
        };
    }

    private double goalWeight(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.8;
            case "D" -> 2.2;
            case "C" -> 1.4;
            case "A" -> 1.1;
            default -> 1;
        };
    }

    private double assistWeight(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.7;
            case "D" -> 1.3;
            case "C" -> 1.2;
            case "A" -> 0.9;
            default -> 1;
        };
    }

    private String recommendation(
            double score,
            double risk,
            double value
    ) {
        if (score >= 92 && value >= 75 && risk <= 45) {
            return "PRIORITÃ€ ALTA";
        }

        if (score >= 75 && risk <= 60) {
            return "CONSIGLIATO";
        }

        if (score >= 60) {
            return "DA VALUTARE";
        }

        return "ACQUISTO RISCHIOSO";
    }

    private String explanation(
            String role,
            double score,
            double starterProbability,
            double goals,
            double assists,
            double risk,
            boolean penaltyTaker,
            double quotation,
            double fantasyMarketValue
    ) {
        String penalties = penaltyTaker
                ? " Ãˆ inoltre indicato come possibile rigorista."
                : "";

        String marketInformation =
                fantasyMarketValue > 0
                        ? String.format(
                                " Quotazione %.0f, FVM %.0f.",
                                quotation,
                                fantasyMarketValue
                        )
                        : "";

        return String.format(
                "Valutazione %.1f/100, titolarita prevista %.0f%%, "
                        + "%.0f gol e %.0f assist stimati. "
                        + "Rischio %.0f/100. Ruolo di listone %s.%s%s",
                score,
                starterProbability,
                goals,
                assists,
                risk,
                role,
                penalties,
                marketInformation
        );
    }

    private int clamp(
            int value,
            int minimum,
            int maximum
    ) {
        return Math.max(
                minimum,
                Math.min(value, maximum)
        );
    }

    private String stringValue(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = row.get(key);
        return value == null ? null : value.toString();
    }

    private double number(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key,
            double defaultValue
    ) {
        Object value = row.get(key);

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.doubleValue();
        }

        return defaultValue;
    }

    private boolean booleanValue(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = row.get(key);

        return value instanceof Boolean
                && (Boolean) value;
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class AuctionRankingService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final AuctionApiPriceService auctionApiPriceService;

    public AuctionRankingService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            AuctionApiPriceService auctionApiPriceService
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.auctionApiPriceService = auctionApiPriceService;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<AuctionRankingResponse> calculateRanking(
            String season,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier,
            String role,
            String club,
            int limit
    ) {
        int safeLimit = Math.min(
                Math.max(limit, 1),
                500
        );

        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    p.id
                FROM players p

                JOIN player_reconciliation_results reconciliation
                    ON reconciliation.player_id = p.id

                JOIN seasons s
                    ON s.id = reconciliation.season_id

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = p.id
                    AND registration.season_id = s.id

                JOIN clubs c
                    ON c.id = registration.club_id

                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = s.id
                    AND season_club.club_id = c.id

                JOIN player_roles player_role
                    ON player_role.player_id = p.id
                    AND player_role.season_id = s.id
                    AND player_role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE s.code = :season
                  AND p.active = TRUE
                  AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'

                """);

        if (role != null && !role.isBlank()) {
            sql.append("""
                    AND player_role.fantasy_role = :role
                    """);
        }

        if (club != null && !club.isBlank()) {
            sql.append("""
                    AND (
                        LOWER(c.slug) = LOWER(:club)
                        OR LOWER(c.name) = LOWER(:club)
                    )
                    """);
        }

        sql.append("""
                ORDER BY p.id
                """);

        var query = jdbcClient
                .sql(sql.toString())
                .param("season", season);

        if (role != null && !role.isBlank()) {
            query = query.param(
                    "role",
                    role.trim().toUpperCase()
            );
        }

        if (club != null && !club.isBlank()) {
            query = query.param(
                    "club",
                    club.trim()
            );
        }

        Set<Long> allowedPlayerIds =
                new HashSet<>(
                        query
                                .query(Long.class)
                                .list()
                );

        if (allowedPlayerIds.isEmpty()) {
            return List.of();
        }

        List<AuctionPriceResponse> prices =
                auctionApiPriceService.calculateAll(
                                season,
                                budget,
                                teams,
                                defenseModifier
                        )
                        .stream()
                        .filter(price ->
                                allowedPlayerIds.contains(
                                        price.playerId()
                                )
                        )
                        .sorted(
                                Comparator
                                        .comparing(
                                                AuctionPriceResponse
                                                        ::calculationScore
                                        )
                                        .reversed()
                                        .thenComparing(
                                                AuctionPriceResponse
                                                        ::recommendedPrice,
                                                Comparator.reverseOrder()
                                        )
                                        .thenComparing(
                                                AuctionPriceResponse
                                                        ::playerName
                                        )
                        )
                        .limit(safeLimit)
                        .toList();

        return java.util.stream.IntStream
                .range(
                        0,
                        prices.size()
                )
                .mapToObj(index -> {
                    AuctionPriceResponse price =
                            prices.get(index);

                    return new AuctionRankingResponse(
                            index + 1,
                            price.playerId(),
                            price.playerName(),
                            price.club(),
                            price.role(),
                            price.minimumPrice(),
                            price.recommendedPrice(),
                            price.maximumPrice(),
                            price.budgetPercentage(),
                            price.calculationScore(),
                            price.recommendation()
                    );
                })
                .toList();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Function;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class B67AuctionPriceModelService {

    public static final String ALGORITHM_VERSION =
            "B67_AUCTION_PRICE_V1";

    public static final String PERFORMANCE_VERSION =
            "B66_FEATURES_V3";

    public static final String MODEL_FAMILY =
            "B66_MARKET_ROLE_RELATIVE_AUCTION_PRICE";

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final B67AuctionValueScorer valueScorer;

    public B67AuctionPriceModelService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            B67AuctionValueScorer valueScorer
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.valueScorer = valueScorer;
    }

    public List<AuctionPriceModelResult> calculateAll(
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        validateConfiguration(
                budget,
                teams
        );

        List<PlayerInput> players =
                loadPlayers(seasonCode);

        if (players.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Nessun giocatore operativo B67 disponibile per la stagione "
                            + seasonCode
            );
        }

        Map<String, List<PlayerInput>> byRole =
                groupByRole(players);

        List<AuctionPriceModelResult> results =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (String role : List.of("P", "D", "C", "A")) {

            List<PlayerInput> rolePlayers =
                    byRole.getOrDefault(
                            role,
                            List.of()
                    );

            if (rolePlayers.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            results.addAll(
                    calculateRole(
                            role,
                            rolePlayers,
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier
                    )
            );
        }

        return results;
    }

    private List<AuctionPriceModelResult> calculateRole(
            String role,
            List<PlayerInput> players,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {

        Map<Long, Double> fvmPercentiles =
                calculatePercentiles(
                        players,
                        PlayerInput::fantasyMarketValue
                );

        Map<Long, Double> quotationPercentiles =
                calculatePercentiles(
                        players,
                        PlayerInput::quotation
                );

        List<ScoredPlayer> scored =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (PlayerInput player : players) {

            Double fvmPercentile =
                    fvmPercentiles.get(
                            player.playerId()
                    );

            Double quotationPercentile =
                    quotationPercentiles.get(
                            player.playerId()
                    );

            B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult scoreResult =
                    valueScorer.score(
                            role,
                            fvmPercentile,
                            quotationPercentile,
                            player.fantasyAverageRolePercentile(),
                            player.usageRolePercentile(),
                            player.goalRateRolePercentile(),
                            player.assistRateRolePercentile()
                    );

            if (scoreResult.auctionValueScore() == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "B67 senza evidenza reale per player_id="
                                + player.playerId()
                );
            }

            Double marketSignal =
                    valueScorer.marketSignal(
                            fvmPercentile,
                            quotationPercentile
                    );

            String evidenceTier =
                    evidenceTier(
                            player,
                            scoreResult.performanceSignalCount()
                    );

            scored.add(
                    new ScoredPlayer(
                            player,
                            round2(fvmPercentile),
                            round2(quotationPercentile),
                            round2(marketSignal),
                            round2(scoreResult.auctionValueScore()),
                            scoreResult.performanceSignalCount(),
                            evidenceTier
                    )
            );
        }

        scored.sort(
                Comparator
                        .comparing(
                                ScoredPlayer::auctionScore
                        )
                        .reversed()
                        .thenComparing(
                                item ->
                                        item.player().playerId()
                        )
        );

        int marketSlots =
                teams * roleSlots(role);

        List<ScoredPlayer> contenders =
                scored.stream()
                        .limit(marketSlots)
                        .toList();

        double leagueRoleBudget =
                budget
                        * teams
                        * roleAllocation(
                                role,
                                defenseModifier
                        );

        double budgetFactor =
                budget / 1000.0;

        double teamFactor =
                1.0
                        + (
                                (teams - 8)
                                        * 0.05
                        );

        Map<Long, Double> provisionalPrices =
                new HashMap<>();

        for (ScoredPlayer player : contenders) {

            double rawPrice =
                    interpolatePrice(
                            role,
                            player.auctionScore()
                    );

            rawPrice *= budgetFactor;
            rawPrice *= teamFactor;

            provisionalPrices.put(
                    player.player().playerId(),
                    Math.max(
                            1.0,
                            rawPrice
                    )
            );
        }

        double provisionalTotal =
                provisionalPrices
                        .values()
                        .stream()
                        .mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue)
                        .sum();

        boolean budgetCapApplied =
                provisionalTotal > leagueRoleBudget;

        if (budgetCapApplied) {

            int floors =
                    provisionalPrices.size();

            double distributableBudget =
                    Math.max(
                            0,
                            leagueRoleBudget - floors
                    );

            double rawExtra =
                    provisionalPrices
                            .values()
                            .stream()
                            .mapToDouble(
                                    price ->
                                            Math.max(
                                                    0,
                                                    price - 1
                                            )
                            )
                            .sum();

            double scale =
                    rawExtra > 0
                            ? distributableBudget / rawExtra
                            : 0;

            provisionalPrices.replaceAll(
                    (playerId, price) ->
                            1
                                    + Math.max(
                                            0,
                                            price - 1
                                    )
                                    * scale
            );
        }

        Map<Long, Integer> recommendedPrices =
                new HashMap<>();

        /*
         * Every operational Fantacalcio player receives
         * an actionable market price.
         *
         * Players outside the active market slots are priced at 1.
         */
        for (ScoredPlayer scoredPlayer : scored) {
            recommendedPrices.put(
                    scoredPlayer.player().playerId(),
                    1
            );
        }

        if (budgetCapApplied) {

            int integerBudgetTarget =
                    (int) Math.floor(
                            leagueRoleBudget
                                    + 0.000000001
                    );

            List<PriceRemainder> remainders =
                    new ArrayList<>();

            int assignedCredits = 0;

            for (ScoredPlayer contender : contenders) {

                Long playerId =
                        contender.player().playerId();

                double exactPrice =
                        provisionalPrices.get(
                                playerId
                        );

                int floorPrice =
                        Math.max(
                                1,
                                (int) Math.floor(
                                        exactPrice
                                )
                        );

                recommendedPrices.put(
                        playerId,
                        floorPrice
                );

                assignedCredits += floorPrice;

                remainders.add(
                        new PriceRemainder(
                                playerId,
                                exactPrice - floorPrice,
                                contender.auctionScore()
                        )
                );
            }

            int creditsToDistribute =
                    Math.max(
                            0,
                            integerBudgetTarget
                                    - assignedCredits
                    );

            remainders.sort(
                    Comparator
                            .comparing(
                                    PriceRemainder::fraction
                            )
                            .reversed()
                            .thenComparing(
                                    PriceRemainder::auctionScore,
                                    Comparator.reverseOrder()
                            )
                            .thenComparing(
                                    PriceRemainder::playerId
                            )
            );

            int distributableCredits =
                    Math.min(
                            creditsToDistribute,
                            remainders.size()
                    );

            for (
                    int index = 0;
                    index < distributableCredits;
                    index++
            ) {
                Long playerId =
                        remainders
                                .get(index)
                                .playerId();

                recommendedPrices.computeIfPresent(
                        playerId,
                        (ignored, currentPrice) ->
                                currentPrice + 1
                );
            }

        } else {

            for (ScoredPlayer contender : contenders) {

                Long playerId =
                        contender.player().playerId();

                int roundedPrice =
                        Math.max(
                                1,
                                (int) Math.round(
                                        provisionalPrices.get(
                                                playerId
                                        )
                                )
                        );

                recommendedPrices.put(
                        playerId,
                        roundedPrice
                );
            }
        }

        List<AuctionPriceModelResult> results =
                new ArrayList<>();

        int position = 0;
        int auctionRank = 0;
        Double previousAuctionScore = null;

        for (ScoredPlayer scoredPlayer : scored) {

            position++;

            if (
                    previousAuctionScore == null
                    || Double.compare(
                            scoredPlayer.auctionScore(),
                            previousAuctionScore
                    ) != 0
            ) {
                auctionRank = position;
            }

            previousAuctionScore =
                    scoredPlayer.auctionScore();

            PlayerInput player =
                    scoredPlayer.player();

            int recommendedPrice =
                    recommendedPrices.getOrDefault(
                            player.playerId(),
                            1
                    );

            PriceRange range =
                    calculateRange(
                            recommendedPrice,
                            player.dataConfidenceScore(),
                            player.fantasyMarketValue() != null
                    );

            double auctionPercentile =
                    competitionPercentile(
                            auctionRank,
                            scored.size()
                    );

            results.add(
                    new AuctionPriceModelResult(
                            player.playerId(),
                            player.playerName(),
                            player.club(),
                            player.role(),
                            round2(
                                    player.dataConfidenceScore()
                            ),
                            player.historySeasonsAvailable(),
                            player.sourceMix(),
                            player.quotation(),
                            player.fantasyMarketValue(),
                            scoredPlayer.fvmRolePercentile(),
                            scoredPlayer.quotationRolePercentile(),
                            round2(
                                    player.fantasyAverageRolePercentile()
                            ),
                            round2(
                                    player.usageRolePercentile()
                            ),
                            round2(
                                    player.goalRateRolePercentile()
                            ),
                            round2(
                                    player.assistRateRolePercentile()
                            ),
                            scoredPlayer.marketSignal(),
                            scoredPlayer.performanceSignalCount(),
                            scoredPlayer.evidenceTier(),
                            scoredPlayer.auctionScore(),
                            auctionRank,
                            round2(
                                    auctionPercentile
                            ),
                            "PRICED",
                            range.minimumPrice(),
                            recommendedPrice,
                            range.maximumPrice(),
                            BigDecimal
                                    .valueOf(
                                            recommendedPrice
                                                    * 100.0
                                                    / budget
                                    )
                                    .setScale(
                                            3,
                                            RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                                    )
                    )
            );
        }

        return results;
    }

    private List<PlayerInput> loadPlayers(
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    player.id AS player_id,
                    player.display_name,
                    club.name AS club_name,
                    role.fantasy_role,

                    performance.history_seasons_available,
                    performance.source_mix,
                    performance.data_confidence_score,

                    (
                        performance.feature_values
                            ->> 'fantasy_average_role_percentile'
                    )::double precision
                        AS fantasy_average_role_percentile,

                    (
                        performance.feature_values
                            ->> 'usage_role_percentile'
                    )::double precision
                        AS usage_role_percentile,

                    (
                        performance.feature_values
                            ->> 'goal_rate_role_percentile'
                    )::double precision
                        AS goal_rate_role_percentile,

                    (
                        performance.feature_values
                            ->> 'assist_rate_role_percentile'
                    )::double precision
                        AS assist_rate_role_percentile,

                    market.quotation,
                    market.fantasy_market_value

                FROM seasons season

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.season_id = season.id
                    AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'

                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id = registration.player_id
                    AND player.active = TRUE

                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id = registration.club_id

                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = season.id
                    AND season_club.club_id = club.id

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id = player.id
                    AND role.season_id = season.id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                JOIN player_performance_feature_profiles performance
                    ON performance.player_id = player.id
                    AND performance.reference_season_id = season.id
                    AND performance.algorithm_version =
                        :performanceVersion

                LEFT JOIN player_market_values market
                    ON market.player_id = player.id
                    AND market.season_id = season.id
                    AND market.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE season.code = :seasonCode

                ORDER BY
                    role.fantasy_role,
                    player.id
                """)
                .param(
                        "seasonCode",
                        seasonCode
                )
                .param(
                        "performanceVersion",
                        PERFORMANCE_VERSION
                )
                .query(
                        (rs, rowNumber) ->
                                new PlayerInput(
                                        rs.getLong(
                                                "player_id"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "display_name"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "club_name"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "fantasy_role"
                                        ),
                                        integerOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "history_seasons_available"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "source_mix"
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "data_confidence_score"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(
                                                rs.getObject(
                                                        "fantasy_average_role_percentile"
                                                )
                                        ),
                                        doubleOrNull(

    private Map<String, List<PlayerInput>> groupByRole(
            List<PlayerInput> players
    ) {
        Map<String, List<PlayerInput>> result =
                new HashMap<>();

        for (PlayerInput player : players) {
            result
                    .computeIfAbsent(
                            player.role(),
                            ignored ->
                                    new ArrayList<>()
                    )
                    .add(player);
        }

        return result;
    }

    private Map<Long, Double> calculatePercentiles(
            List<PlayerInput> players,
            Function<PlayerInput, Double> extractor
    ) {

        List<Double> values =
                players.stream()
                        .map(extractor)
                        .filter(value -> value != null)
                        .sorted()
                        .toList();

        Map<Long, Double> percentiles =
                new HashMap<>();

        int n = values.size();

        if (n == 0) {
            return percentiles;
        }

        for (PlayerInput player : players) {

            Double value =
                    extractor.apply(player);

            if (value == null) {
                continue;
            }

            long lower =
                    values.stream()
                            .filter(item ->
                                    item < value
                            )
                            .count();

            long equal =
                    values.stream()
                            .filter(item ->
                                    Double.compare(
                                            item,
                                            value
                                    ) == 0
                            )
                            .count();

            double percentile;

            if (n == 1) {
                percentile = 100.0;

            } else {

                double averageRankZeroBased =
                        lower
                                + (
                                        equal - 1
                                ) / 2.0;

                percentile =
                        averageRankZeroBased
                                / (n - 1)
                                * 100.0;
            }

            percentiles.put(
                    player.playerId(),
                    percentile
            );
        }

        return percentiles;
    }

    private String evidenceTier(
            PlayerInput player,
            int performanceSignalCount
    ) {

        if (
                player.historySeasonsAvailable() != null
                && player.historySeasonsAvailable() == 0
        ) {
            return "MARKET_ONLY";
        }

        double confidence =
                player.dataConfidenceScore() == null
                        ? 0
                        : player.dataConfidenceScore();

        if (
                confidence >= 80
                && performanceSignalCount >= 3
        ) {
            return "HIGH_EVIDENCE";
        }

        if (
                confidence >= 70
                && performanceSignalCount >= 1
        ) {
            return "MEDIUM_EVIDENCE";
        }

        return "LOW_EVIDENCE";
    }

    private double roleAllocation(
            String role,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        if (defenseModifier) {
            return switch (role) {
                case "P" -> 0.07;
                case "D" -> 0.15;
                case "C" -> 0.23;
                case "A" -> 0.55;
                default ->
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Ruolo non valido"
                        );
            };
        }

        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 0.06;
            case "D" -> 0.10;
            case "C" -> 0.25;
            case "A" -> 0.59;
            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido"
                    );
        };
    }

    private int roleSlots(String role) {
        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 3;
            case "D" -> 8;
            case "C" -> 8;
            case "A" -> 6;
            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido"
                    );
        };
    }

    /*
     * Price curve inherited from certified B51.
     *
     * B67 changes the upstream value evidence, not the
     * already-tested conversion between role-relative value
     * and auction credits.
     */
    private double interpolatePrice(
            String role,
            double percentile
    ) {

        double[][] anchors =
                priceAnchors(role);

        if (percentile >= anchors[0][0]) {
            return anchors[0][1];
        }

        if (
                percentile
                        <= anchors[
                                anchors.length - 1
                        ][0]
        ) {
            return anchors[
                    anchors.length - 1
            ][1];
        }

        for (
                int index = 0;
                index < anchors.length - 1;
                index++
        ) {

            double highPercentile =
                    anchors[index][0];

            double highPrice =
                    anchors[index][1];

            double lowPercentile =
                    anchors[index + 1][0];

            double lowPrice =
                    anchors[index + 1][1];

            if (
                    percentile <= highPercentile
                    && percentile >= lowPercentile
            ) {

                double span =
                        highPercentile
                                - lowPercentile;

                if (span == 0) {
                    return highPrice;
                }

                double position =
                        (
                                percentile
                                        - lowPercentile
                        ) / span;

                return lowPrice
                        + position
                        * (
                                highPrice
                                        - lowPrice
                        );
            }
        }

        return 1.0;
    }

    private double[][] priceAnchors(String role) {
        return switch (role) {

            case "P" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 70},
                    {97, 58},
                    {95, 50},
                    {90, 38},
                    {80, 22},
                    {70, 12},
                    {50, 5},
                    {30, 2},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            case "D" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 180},
                    {98, 145},
                    {95, 105},
                    {90, 65},
                    {80, 30},
                    {70, 15},
                    {50, 6},
                    {30, 2},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            case "C" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 500},
                    {98, 420},
                    {95, 330},
                    {90, 190},
                    {85, 95},
                    {80, 42},
                    {70, 12},
                    {60, 4},
                    {50, 2},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            case "A" -> new double[][] {
                    {100, 340},
                    {98, 310},
                    {95, 270},
                    {90, 220},
                    {80, 150},
                    {70, 95},
                    {50, 40},
                    {30, 12},
                    {0, 1}
            };

            default ->
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Ruolo non valido"
                    );
        };
    }

    private PriceRange calculateRange(
            double price,
            double confidence,
            boolean hasFvm
    ) {

        double lowFactor;
        double highFactor;

        if (confidence >= 90) {
            lowFactor = 0.90;
            highFactor = 1.10;

        } else if (confidence >= 80) {
            lowFactor = 0.85;
            highFactor = 1.15;

        } else if (confidence >= 70) {
            lowFactor = 0.80;
            highFactor = 1.20;

        } else {
            lowFactor = 0.72;
            highFactor = 1.28;
        }

        if (!hasFvm) {
            lowFactor -= 0.05;
            highFactor += 0.05;
        }

        int minimum =
                Math.max(
                        1,
                        (int) Math.round(
                                price * lowFactor
                        )
                );

        int maximum =
                Math.max(
                        (int) Math.round(price),
                        (int) Math.round(
                                price * highFactor
                        )
                );

        return new PriceRange(
                minimum,
                maximum
        );
    }

    private double competitionPercentile(
            int rank,
            int total
    ) {

        if (total <= 1) {
            return 100.0;
        }

        return (
                (total - rank)
                        * 100.0
                        / (total - 1)
        );
    }

    private void validateConfiguration(
            int budget,
            int teams
    ) {

        if (
                budget < 150
                || budget > 1000
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Il budget deve essere compreso tra 150 e 1000"
            );
        }

        if (
                teams < 6
                || teams > 12
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Le squadre devono essere comprese tra 6 e 12"
            );
        }
    }

    private static Integer integerOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {
        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.intValue();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static Double doubleOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {
        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.doubleValue();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static Double round2(
            Double value
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return BigDecimal
                .valueOf(value)
                .setScale(
                        2,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                )
                .doubleValue();
    }

    @Transactional
    public PersistResult generateAndPersist(
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {

        Long seasonId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM seasons
                        WHERE code = :seasonCode
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "seasonCode",
                                seasonCode
                        )
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .optional()
                        .orElseThrow(() ->
                                new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Stagione non trovata: "
                                                + seasonCode
                                )
                        );

        verifyB66Algorithm(seasonId);

        String definitionPayload =
                """
                {
                  "version":"B67_AUCTION_PRICE_V1",
                  "model_family":"B66_MARKET_ROLE_RELATIVE_AUCTION_PRICE",
                  "performance_version":"B66_FEATURES_V3",
                  "catalogue":"CURRENT_OPERATIONAL_FANTACALCIO",
                  "market_source":"FANTACALCIO",
                  "score_aggregation":"MEDIAN_AVAILABLE_ROLE_RELATIVE_SIGNALS",
                  "market_signals":[
                    "fvm_role_percentile",
                    "quotation_role_percentile"
                  ],
                  "outfield_performance_signals":[
                    "fantasy_average_role_percentile",
                    "usage_role_percentile",
                    "goal_rate_role_percentile",
                    "assist_rate_role_percentile"
                  ],
                  "goalkeeper_performance_signals":[
                    "fantasy_average_role_percentile",
                    "usage_role_percentile"
                  ],
                  "null_policy":"NULL_STAYS_NULL_AND_SIGNAL_OMITTED",
                  "zero_policy":"ZERO_IS_REAL_EVIDENCE",
                  "confidence_policy":"RANGE_AND_EVIDENCE_ONLY",
                  "no_history_policy":"MARKET_ONLY_PRICING_ALLOWED",
                  "price_curve":"INHERITED_FROM_B51",
                  "role_allocations_no_modifier":{
                    "P":0.06,
                    "D":0.10,
                    "C":0.25,
                    "A":0.59
                  },
                  "role_allocations_modifier":{
                    "P":0.07,
                    "D":0.15,
                    "C":0.23,
                    "A":0.55
                  }
                }
                """.replaceAll("\\s+", "");

        String definitionFingerprint =
                sha256(definitionPayload);

        registerAlgorithm(
                seasonId,
                definitionPayload,
                definitionFingerprint
        );

        List<B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult>
                results =
                modelService.calculateAll(
                        seasonCode,
                        budget,
                        teams,
                        defenseModifier
                );

        int inserted = 0;
        int unchanged = 0;

        for (
                B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result :
                results
        ) {

            String evidence =
                    buildEvidenceJson(result);

            String inputFingerprint =
                    buildInputFingerprint(
                            seasonCode,
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier,
                            result
                    );

            ExistingProfile existing =
                    findExistingProfile(
                            result.playerId(),
                            seasonId,
                            budget,
                            teams,
                            defenseModifier
                    );

            if (existing != null) {

                if (
                        !existing.inputFingerprint()
                                .equals(inputFingerprint)
                ) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "Conflitto profilo B67 immutabile per player_id="
                                    + result.playerId()
                    );
                }

                unchanged++;
                continue;
            }

            insertProfile(
                    result,
                    seasonId,
                    budget,
                    teams,
                    defenseModifier,
                    evidence,
                    inputFingerprint
            );

            inserted++;
        }

        return new PersistResult(
                B67AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION,
                results.size(),
                inserted,
                unchanged
        );
    }

    private void verifyB66Algorithm(
            Long seasonId
    ) {

        Integer count =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_performance_algorithms
                        WHERE version = :version
                          AND reference_season_id = :seasonId
                          AND status = 'ACTIVE'
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "version",
                                B67AuctionPriceModelService.PERFORMANCE_VERSION
                        )
                        .param(
                                "seasonId",
                                seasonId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        if (count != 1) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "B66_FEATURES_V3 ACTIVE richiesto per B67"
            );
        }
    }

    private void registerAlgorithm(
            Long seasonId,
            String payload,
            String fingerprint
    ) {

        Map<String, Object> existing =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            reference_season_id,
                            performance_algorithm_version,
                            definition_fingerprint
                        FROM auction_price_algorithms
                        WHERE version = :version
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "version",
                                B67AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION
                        )
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows()
                        .stream()
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElse(null);

        if (existing != null) {

            Long existingSeasonId =
                    ((Number) existing.get(
                            "reference_season_id"
                    )).longValue();

            String existingPerformanceVersion =
                    existing.get(
                            "performance_algorithm_version"
                    ).toString();

            String existingFingerprint =
                    existing.get(
                            "definition_fingerprint"
                    ).toString();

            if (
                    !existingSeasonId.equals(seasonId)
                    || !B67AuctionPriceModelService.PERFORMANCE_VERSION
                            .equals(existingPerformanceVersion)
                    || !fingerprint.equals(
                            existingFingerprint
                    )
            ) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Conflitto definizione algoritmo B67 immutabile"
                );
            }

            return;
        }

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO auction_price_algorithms (
                    version,
                    reference_season_id,
                    b50_algorithm_version,
                    performance_algorithm_version,
                    status,
                    model_family,
                    goalkeeper_b50_weight,
                    outfield_b50_weight,
                    market_percentile_weight,
                    market_strength_weight,
                    definition_payload,
                    definition_fingerprint
                )
                VALUES (
                    :version,
                    :seasonId,
                    NULL,
                    :performanceVersion,
                    'CANDIDATE',
                    :modelFamily,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    CAST(:payload AS jsonb),

                )

                .param(

                )

                )

                )
                .update();
    }

    private String buildEvidenceJson(
            B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result
    ) {

        return """
                {
                  "performance_algorithm_version":"%s",
                  "pricing_algorithm_version":"%s",
                  "market_source":"FANTACALCIO",
                  "role":"%s",
                  "source_mix":"%s",
                  "evidence_tier":"%s",
                  "performance_signal_count":%d,
                  "pricing_status":"%s"
                }
                """.formatted(
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService.PERFORMANCE_VERSION,
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION,
                        result.role(),
                        safeJson(result.sourceMix()),
                        result.evidenceTier(),
                        result.performanceSignalCount(),
                        result.pricingStatus()
                ).replaceAll("\\s+", "");
    }

    private String buildInputFingerprint(
            String seasonCode,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier,
            B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult result
    ) {

        String canonical =
                String.join(
                        "|",
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION,
                        B67AuctionPriceModelService.PERFORMANCE_VERSION,
                        seasonCode,
                        Integer.toString(budget),
                        Integer.toString(teams),
                        Boolean.toString(defenseModifier),

                        safe(result.playerId()),
                        safe(result.role()),
                        safe(result.dataConfidenceScore()),
                        safe(result.historySeasonsAvailable()),
                        safe(result.sourceMix()),

                        safe(result.quotation()),
                        safe(result.fantasyMarketValue()),

                        safe(result.fvmRolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.quotationRolePercentile()),

                        safe(result.fantasyAverageRolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.usageRolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.goalRateRolePercentile()),
                        safe(result.assistRateRolePercentile()),

                        safe(result.marketSignal()),
                        safe(result.performanceSignalCount()),
                        safe(result.evidenceTier()),

                        safe(result.auctionScore()),
                        safe(result.auctionRoleRank()),
                        safe(result.auctionRolePercentile()),

                        safe(result.minimumPrice()),
                        safe(result.recommendedPrice()),
                        safe(result.maximumPrice())
                );

        return sha256(canonical);
    }

    private String safe(Object value) {
        return value == null
                ? "NULL"
                : value.toString();
    }

    private String safeJson(String value) {

        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }

        return value
                .replace("\\", "\\\\")
                .replace("\"", "\\\"");
    }

    private String sha256(String value) {

        try {

            MessageDigest digest =
                    MessageDigest.getInstance(
                            "SHA-256"
                    );

            byte[] hash =
                    digest.digest(
                            value.getBytes(
                                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                            )
                    );

            return HexFormat
                    .of()
                    .formatHex(hash);

        } catch (
                NoSuchAlgorithmException exception
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "SHA-256 non disponibile",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

            String inputFingerprint
    ) {
    }

    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class B67AuctionValueScorer {

    public ScoreResult score(
            String role,
            Double fvmRolePercentile,
            Double quotationRolePercentile,
            Double fantasyAverageRolePercentile,
            Double usageRolePercentile,
            Double goalRateRolePercentile,
            Double assistRateRolePercentile
    ) {

        List<Double> marketSignals = new ArrayList<>();

        addIfPresent(
                marketSignals,
                fvmRolePercentile
        );

        addIfPresent(
                marketSignals,
                quotationRolePercentile
        );

        List<Double> performanceSignals = new ArrayList<>();

        addIfPresent(
                performanceSignals,
                fantasyAverageRolePercentile
        );

        addIfPresent(
                performanceSignals,
                usageRolePercentile
        );

        if (!"P".equals(role)) {

            addIfPresent(
                    performanceSignals,
                    goalRateRolePercentile
            );

            addIfPresent(
                    performanceSignals,
                    assistRateRolePercentile
            );
        }

        Double marketScore =
                medianOrNull(
                        marketSignals
                );

        Double performanceScore =
                medianOrNull(
                        performanceSignals
                );

        Double auctionValueScore;

        if (
                marketScore != null
                && performanceScore != null
        ) {

            /*
             * Deliberately equal DOMAIN weighting.
             *
             * The number of individual historical features must not
             * silently give the performance domain more influence
             * than Fantacalcio market evidence.
             */
            auctionValueScore =
                    (
                            marketScore
                            + performanceScore
                    ) / 2.0;

        } else if (marketScore != null) {

            auctionValueScore =
                    marketScore;

        } else {

            auctionValueScore =
                    performanceScore;
        }

        return new ScoreResult(
                auctionValueScore,
                performanceSignals.size(),
                marketSignals.size()
                        + performanceSignals.size()
        );
    }

    public Double marketSignal(
            Double fvmRolePercentile,
            Double quotationRolePercentile
    ) {

        List<Double> values =
                new ArrayList<>();

        addIfPresent(
                values,
                fvmRolePercentile
        );

        addIfPresent(
                values,
                quotationRolePercentile
        );

        return medianOrNull(values);
    }

    private void addIfPresent(
            List<Double> values,
            Double value
    ) {

        if (value != null) {
            values.add(value);
        }
    }

    private Double medianOrNull(
            List<Double> values
    ) {

        if (values.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        values.sort(
                Comparator.naturalOrder()
        );

        int size =
                values.size();

        if (size % 2 == 1) {
            return values.get(
                    size / 2
            );
        }

        return (
                values.get(
                        size / 2 - 1
                )
                + values.get(
                        size / 2
                )
        ) / 2.0;
    }

    public record ScoreResult(
            Double auctionValueScore,
            int performanceSignalCount,
            int totalSignalCount
    ) {
    }
}
