import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.SecretSanitizer;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer.TextNormalizer;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer.CsvImportPayload;
import tools.jackson.core.JacksonException;
import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;

@Service
public class FixtureImportService {

    private static final Set<String> REQUIRED_COLUMNS =
            Set.of(
                    "matchday",
                    "home_club",
                    "away_club"
            );

    private static final Set<String> VALID_STATUSES =
            Set.of(
                    "SCHEDULED",
                    "LIVE",
                    "FINISHED",
                    "POSTPONED",
                    "CANCELLED"
            );

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final TextNormalizer textNormalizer;
    private final JsonMapper jsonMapper;
    private final TransactionTemplate transactionTemplate;
    private final TransactionTemplate requiresNewTransaction;

    public FixtureImportService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            TextNormalizer textNormalizer,
            JsonMapper jsonMapper,
            PlatformTransactionManager transactionManager
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.textNormalizer = textNormalizer;
        this.jsonMapper = jsonMapper;

        this.transactionTemplate =
                new TransactionTemplate(
                        transactionManager
                );

        this.requiresNewTransaction =
                new TransactionTemplate(
                        transactionManager
                );

        this.requiresNewTransaction
                .setPropagationBehavior(
                        TransactionDefinition
                                .PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW
                );
    }

    public FixtureImportResponse importCsv(
            String source,
            String seasonCode,
            MultipartFile file
    ) {
        return importPayload(source,seasonCode,CsvImportPayload.from(file,"fixtures.csv"));
    }

    public FixtureImportResponse importPayload(String source,String seasonCode,CsvImportPayload file) {
        String normalizedSource =
                normalizeRequired(
                        source,
                        "Fonte obbligatoria"
                )
                        .toUpperCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        );

        String normalizedSeason =
                normalizeRequired(
                        seasonCode,
                        "Stagione obbligatoria"
                );

        validateFile(file);

        Long seasonId =
                findSeasonId(
                        normalizedSeason
                );

        String filename =
                resolveFilename(file);

        Long batchId =
                createBatch(
                        seasonId,
                        normalizedSource,
                        filename
                );

        try {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(
                    transactionTemplate.execute(
                            status ->
                                    processImport(
                                            batchId,
                                            seasonId,
                                            normalizedSource,
                                            normalizedSeason,
                                            filename,
                                            file
                                    )
                    )
            );
        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
            String errorMessage =
                    readableMessage(exception);

            markBatchFailed(
                    batchId,
                    errorMessage
            );

            if (exception instanceof BadRequestException) {
                throw exception;
            }

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Import calendario fallito: "
                            + errorMessage,
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    private FixtureImportResponse processImport(
            Long batchId,
            Long seasonId,
            String source,
            String seasonCode,
            String filename,
            CsvImportPayload file
    ) {
        int totalRows = 0;
        int validRows = 0;
        int invalidRows = 0;
        int importedFixtures = 0;

        Set<String> fixtureKeys =
                new HashSet<>();

        try (
                BufferedReader reader =
                        new BufferedReader(
                                new InputStreamReader(
                                        file.openStream(),
                                        StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                                )
                        );

                CSVParser parser =
                        CSVFormat.DEFAULT.builder()
                                .setHeader()
                                .setSkipHeaderRecord(true)
                                .setIgnoreEmptyLines(true)
                                .setIgnoreSurroundingSpaces(true)
                                .setTrim(true)
                                .get()
                                .parse(reader)
        ) {
            validateHeaders(
                    parser.getHeaderNames()
            );

            for (CSVRecord record : parser) {
                totalRows++;

                ParsedFixtureRow row =
                        parseRow(
                                parser,
                                record,
                                totalRows,
                                fixtureKeys
                        );

                saveImportRow(
                        batchId,
                        row
                );

                if (!row.valid()) {
                    invalidRows++;
                    continue;
                }

                Long homeClubId =
                        findClubId(
                                seasonId,
                                row.normalizedHomeClub()
                        );

                Long awayClubId =
                        findClubId(
                                seasonId,
                                row.normalizedAwayClub()
                        );

                if (homeClubId == null
                        || awayClubId == null) {

                    String error =
                            missingClubError(
                                    row,
                                    homeClubId,
                                    awayClubId
                            );

                    markRowInvalid(
                            batchId,
                            row.rowNumber(),
                            error
                    );

                    invalidRows++;
                    continue;
                }

                upsertFixture(
                        seasonId,
                        row,
                        homeClubId,
                        awayClubId
                );

                validRows++;
                importedFixtures++;
            }
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Impossibile leggere il file CSV",
                    exception
            );
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Formato CSV non valido: "
                            + readableMessage(exception),
                    exception
            );
        }

        if (totalRows == 0) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Il file CSV non contiene righe dati"
            );
        }

        completeBatch(
                batchId,
                totalRows,
                validRows,
                invalidRows,
                importedFixtures
        );

        return new FixtureImportResponse(
                batchId,
                source,
                seasonCode,
                filename,
                totalRows,
                validRows,
                invalidRows,
                importedFixtures,
                "COMPLETED",
                null
        );
    }

    private ParsedFixtureRow parseRow(
            CSVParser parser,
            CSVRecord record,
            int rowNumber,
            Set<String> fixtureKeys
    ) {
        List<String> errors =
                new ArrayList<>();

        Integer matchday =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "matchday"),
                        "Giornata",
                        errors
                );

        String homeClub =
                value(record, "home_club");

        String awayClub =
                value(record, "away_club");

        String normalizedHomeClub =
                textNormalizer.normalize(
                        homeClub
                );

        String normalizedAwayClub =
                textNormalizer.normalize(
                        awayClub
                );

        OffsetDateTime kickoffAt =
                parseKickoff(
                        value(record, "kickoff_at"),
                        errors
                );

        String status =
                normalizeStatus(
                        value(record, "status"),
                        errors
                );

        Integer homeGoals =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "home_goals"),
                        "Gol casa",
                        errors
                );

        Integer awayGoals =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "away_goals"),
                        "Gol trasferta",
                        errors
                );

        if (matchday == null) {
            errors.add(
                    "Giornata mancante"
            );
        } else if (matchday < 1 || matchday > 38) {
            errors.add(
                    "Giornata non valida: "
                            + matchday
            );
        }

        if (homeClub == null) {
            errors.add(
                    "Squadra di casa mancante"
            );
        }

        if (awayClub == null) {
            errors.add(
                    "Squadra ospite mancante"
            );
        }

        if (
                !normalizedHomeClub.isBlank()
                && normalizedHomeClub.equals(
                        normalizedAwayClub
                )
        ) {
            errors.add(
                    "La squadra di casa e quella ospite coincidono"
            );
        }

        if (homeGoals != null && homeGoals < 0) {
            errors.add(
                    "Gol casa non validi"
            );
        }

        if (awayGoals != null && awayGoals < 0) {
            errors.add(
                    "Gol trasferta non validi"
            );
        }

        if ("FINISHED".equals(status)
                && (
                    homeGoals == null
                    || awayGoals == null
                )) {

            errors.add(
                    "Una partita terminata deve avere entrambi i risultati"
            );
        }

        if (
                matchday != null
                && !normalizedHomeClub.isBlank()
                && !normalizedAwayClub.isBlank()
        ) {
            String fixtureKey =
                    matchday
                            + "|"
                            + normalizedHomeClub
                            + "|"
                            + normalizedAwayClub;

            if (!fixtureKeys.add(fixtureKey)) {
                errors.add(
                        "Partita duplicata nel file"
                );
            }
        }

        return new ParsedFixtureRow(
                rowNumber,
                matchday,
                homeClub,
                normalizedHomeClub,
                awayClub,
                normalizedAwayClub,
                kickoffAt,
                status,
                homeGoals,
                awayGoals,
                errors.isEmpty(),
                errors.isEmpty()
                        ? null
                        : String.join(
                                "; ",
                                errors
                        ),
                toJson(
                        rawData(
                                parser,
                                record
                        )
                )
        );
    }

    private void upsertFixture(
            Long seasonId,
            ParsedFixtureRow row,
            Long homeClubId,
            Long awayClubId
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fixtures (
                    season_id,
                    matchday,
                    home_club_id,
                    away_club_id,
                    kickoff_at,
                    status,
                    home_goals,
                    away_goals
                )
                VALUES (
                    :seasonId,
                    :matchday,
                    :homeClubId,
                    :awayClubId,
                    :kickoffAt,
                    :status,
                    :homeGoals,
                    :awayGoals
                )

                ON CONFLICT (
                    season_id,
                    matchday,
                    home_club_id,
                    away_club_id
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    kickoff_at =
                        EXCLUDED.kickoff_at,

                    status =
                        EXCLUDED.status,

                    home_goals =
                        EXCLUDED.home_goals,

                    away_goals =
                        EXCLUDED.away_goals,

                    updated_at =
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                """)
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "matchday",
                        row.matchday()
                )
                .param(
                        "homeClubId",
                        homeClubId
                )
                .param(
                        "awayClubId",
                        awayClubId
                )
                .param(
                        "kickoffAt",
                        row.kickoffAt(),
                        Types.TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE
                )
                .param(
                        "status",
                        row.status()
                )
                .param(
                        "homeGoals",
                        row.homeGoals(),
                        Types.INTEGER
                )
                .param(
                        "awayGoals",
                        row.awayGoals(),
                        Types.INTEGER
                )
                .update();
    }

    private void saveImportRow(
            Long batchId,
            ParsedFixtureRow row
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fixture_import_rows (
                    batch_id,
                    row_number,
                    matchday,
                    home_club_name,
                    normalized_home_club,
                    away_club_name,
                    normalized_away_club,
                    kickoff_at,
                    fixture_status,
                    home_goals,
                    away_goals,
                    valid,
                    validation_error,
                    raw_data
                )
                VALUES (
                    :batchId,
                    :rowNumber,
                    :matchday,
                    :homeClubName,
                    :normalizedHomeClub,
                    :awayClubName,
                    :normalizedAwayClub,
                    :kickoffAt,
                    :status,
                    :homeGoals,
                    :awayGoals,
                    :valid,
                    :validationError,
                    CAST(:rawData AS JSONB)
                )
                """)
                .param("batchId", batchId)
                .param("rowNumber", row.rowNumber())
                .param(
                        "matchday",
                        row.matchday(),
                        Types.INTEGER
                )
                .param(
                        "homeClubName",
                        row.homeClubName(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "normalizedHomeClub",
                        row.normalizedHomeClub(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "awayClubName",
                        row.awayClubName(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "normalizedAwayClub",
                        row.normalizedAwayClub(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "kickoffAt",
                        row.kickoffAt(),
                        Types.TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE
                )
                .param(
                        "status",
                        row.status(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "homeGoals",
                        row.homeGoals(),
                        Types.INTEGER
                )
                .param(
                        "awayGoals",
                        row.awayGoals(),
                        Types.INTEGER
                )
                .param("valid", row.valid())
                .param(
                        "validationError",
                        row.validationError(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param("rawData", row.rawData())
                .update();
    }

    private void markRowInvalid(
            Long batchId,
            int rowNumber,
            String error
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE fixture_import_rows
                SET valid = FALSE,
                    validation_error = :error
                WHERE batch_id = :batchId
                  AND row_number = :rowNumber
                """)
                .param("error", error)
                .param("batchId", batchId)
                .param("rowNumber", rowNumber)
                .update();
    }

    private Long findClubId(
            Long seasonId,
            String normalizedClub
    ) {
        if (
                normalizedClub == null
                || normalizedClub.isBlank()
        ) {
            return null;
        }

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT club.id
                FROM season_clubs season_club
                JOIN clubs club ON club.id = season_club.club_id
                WHERE season_club.season_id = :seasonId
                  AND (
                      LOWER(club.slug) = LOWER(:club)
                      OR LOWER(club.name) = LOWER(:club)
                      OR LOWER(club.short_name) = LOWER(:club)
                  )
                ORDER BY id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("club", normalizedClub)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElse(null);
    }

    private Long findSeasonId(
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = :seasonCode
                """)
                .param("seasonCode", seasonCode)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Stagione non trovata: "
                                        + seasonCode
                        )
                );
    }

    private Long createBatch(
            Long seasonId,
            String source,
            String filename
    ) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(
                requiresNewTransaction.execute(
                        status ->
                                jdbcClient.sql("""
                                        INSERT INTO fixture_import_batches (
                                            season_id,
                                            source,
                                            original_filename,
                                            status
                                        )
                                        VALUES (
                                            :seasonId,
                                            :source,
                                            :filename,
                                            'PROCESSING'
                                        )
                                        RETURNING id
                                        """)
                                        .param(
                                                "seasonId",
                                                seasonId
                                        )
                                        .param(
                                                "source",
                                                source
                                        )
                                        .param(
                                                "filename",
                                                filename
                                        )
                                        .query(Long.class)
                                        .single()
                )
        );
    }

    private void completeBatch(
            Long batchId,
            int totalRows,
            int validRows,
            int invalidRows,
            int importedFixtures
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE fixture_import_batches
                SET status = 'COMPLETED',
                    total_rows = :totalRows,
                    valid_rows = :validRows,
                    invalid_rows = :invalidRows,
                    imported_fixtures = :importedFixtures,
                    error_message = NULL,
                    completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = :batchId
                """)
                .param("totalRows", totalRows)
                .param("validRows", validRows)
                .param("invalidRows", invalidRows)
                .param(
                        "importedFixtures",
                        importedFixtures
                )
                .param("batchId", batchId)
                .update();
    }

    private void markBatchFailed(
            Long batchId,
            String errorMessage
    ) {
        requiresNewTransaction.executeWithoutResult(
                status ->
                        jdbcClient.sql("""
                                UPDATE fixture_import_batches
                                SET status = 'FAILED',
                                    error_message = :errorMessage,
                                    completed_at =
                                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                                WHERE id = :batchId
                                """)
                                .param(
                                        "errorMessage",
                                        truncate(
                                                errorMessage,
                                                2000
                                        )
                                )
                                .param("batchId", batchId)
                                .update()
        );
    }

    private void validateHeaders(
            List<String> headers
    ) {
        Set<String> normalizedHeaders =
                new HashSet<>();

        for (String header : headers) {
            if (header != null) {
                normalizedHeaders.add(
                        header.trim()
                                .toLowerCase(
                                        Locale.ROOT
                                )
                );
            }
        }

        List<String> missingColumns =
                REQUIRED_COLUMNS.stream()
                        .filter(column ->
                                !normalizedHeaders.contains(
                                        column
                                )
                        )
                        .sorted()
                        .toList();

        if (!missingColumns.isEmpty()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Colonne obbligatorie mancanti: "
                            + String.join(
                                    ", ",
                                    missingColumns
                            )
            );
        }
    }

    private String normalizeStatus(
            String status,
            List<String> errors
    ) {
        if (status == null || status.isBlank()) {
            return "SCHEDULED";
        }

        String normalized =
                status.trim()
                        .toUpperCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        );

        if (!VALID_STATUSES.contains(normalized)) {
            errors.add(
                    "Stato partita non valido: "
                            + status
            );

            return null;
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private OffsetDateTime parseKickoff(
            String value,
            List<String> errors
    ) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return OffsetDateTime.parse(value);
        } catch (DateTimeParseException exception) {
            errors.add(
                    "Data e ora non valide: "
                            + value
                            + ". Usare formato ISO, esempio "
                            + "2026-08-22T18:00:00+02:00"
            );

            return null;
        }
    }

    private Integer parseInteger(
            String value,
            String field,
            List<String> errors
    ) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return Integer.valueOf(value);
        } catch (NumberFormatException exception) {
            errors.add(
                    field
                            + " non valido: "
                            + value
            );

            return null;
        }
    }

    private String missingClubError(
            ParsedFixtureRow row,
            Long homeClubId,
            Long awayClubId
    ) {
        List<String> errors =
                new ArrayList<>();

        if (homeClubId == null) {
            errors.add(
                    "Squadra di casa non trovata: "
                            + row.homeClubName()
            );
        }

        if (awayClubId == null) {
            errors.add(
                    "Squadra ospite non trovata: "
                            + row.awayClubName()
            );
        }

        return String.join(
                "; ",
                errors
        );
    }

    private Map<String, String> rawData(
            CSVParser parser,
            CSVRecord record
    ) {
        Map<String, String> result =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (String header : parser.getHeaderNames()) {
            result.put(
                    header,
                    record.isMapped(header)
                            ? record.get(header)
                            : null
            );
        }

        return result;
    }

    private String toJson(
            Map<String, String> data
    ) {
        try {
            return jsonMapper.writeValueAsString(
                    data
            );
        } catch (JacksonException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Impossibile convertire la riga in JSON",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    private String value(
            CSVRecord record,
            String column
    ) {
        if (!record.isMapped(column)) {
            return null;
        }

        String value = record.get(column);

        return value == null || value.isBlank()
                ? null
                : value.trim();
    }

    private void validateFile(
            CsvImportPayload file
    ) {
        if (file == null || file.empty()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "File CSV obbligatorio"
            );
        }
    }

    private String resolveFilename(
            CsvImportPayload file
    ) {
        String filename =
                file.filename();

        if (filename == null || filename.isBlank()) {
            return "fixtures.csv";
        }

        filename =
                filename.replace("\\", "/");

        int separator =
                filename.lastIndexOf('/');

        if (separator >= 0) {
            filename =
                    filename.substring(
                            separator + 1
                    );
        }

        return truncate(
                filename,
                255
        );
    }

    private String normalizeRequired(
            String value,
            String errorMessage
    ) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    errorMessage
            );
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    private String readableMessage(
            Throwable exception
    ) {
        return SecretSanitizer.sanitize(exception);
    }

    private String truncate(
            String value,
            int maximumLength
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (value.length() <= maximumLength) {
            return value;
        }

        return value.substring(
                0,
                maximumLength
        );
    }

    private record ParsedFixtureRow(
            int rowNumber,
            Integer matchday,
            String homeClubName,
            String normalizedHomeClub,
            String awayClubName,
            String normalizedAwayClub,
            OffsetDateTime kickoffAt,
            String status,
            Integer homeGoals,
            Integer awayGoals,
            boolean valid,
            String validationError,
            String rawData
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.strength;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/admin/club-strength")
public class ClubStrengthGenerationController {

    private final ClubStrengthGenerationService service;

    public ClubStrengthGenerationController(
            ClubStrengthGenerationService service
    ) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    @PostMapping("/generate")
    public ClubStrengthGenerationResponse generate(
            @RequestParam(
                    defaultValue = "#{@currentSeasonResolver.resolve()}"
            )
            String season
    ) {
        return service.generate(season);
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.strength;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class ClubStrengthGenerationService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public ClubStrengthGenerationService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional
    public ClubStrengthGenerationResponse generate(
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        Long seasonId = findSeasonId(seasonCode);

        int eligiblePlayers =
                countEligiblePlayers(seasonId);

        if (eligiblePlayers == 0) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Nessuna valutazione giocatore disponibile "
                            + "per generare i rating della stagione "
                            + seasonCode
            );
        }

        int eligibleClubs =
                countEligibleClubs(seasonId);

        int generatedRatings =
                generateRatings(seasonId);

        return new ClubStrengthGenerationResponse(
                seasonCode,
                eligiblePlayers,
                eligibleClubs,
                generatedRatings,
                "COMPLETED"
        );
    }

    private Long findSeasonId(
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = :seasonCode
                """)
                .param("seasonCode", seasonCode)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Stagione non trovata: "
                                        + seasonCode
                        )
                );
    }

    private int countEligiblePlayers(
            Long seasonId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT evaluation.player_id)

                FROM player_evaluations evaluation

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id =
                        evaluation.player_id
                    AND registration.season_id =
                        evaluation.season_id

                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                    ON season_club.season_id = evaluation.season_id
                    AND season_club.club_id = registration.club_id

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id =
                        evaluation.player_id
                    AND role.season_id =
                        evaluation.season_id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                JOIN player_reconciliation_results reconciliation
                    ON reconciliation.player_id =
                        evaluation.player_id
                    AND reconciliation.season_id =
                        evaluation.season_id

                WHERE evaluation.season_id = :seasonId
                  AND role.fantasy_role IS NOT NULL
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }

    private int countEligibleClubs(

    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""

                FROM player_evaluations evaluation

    private int generateRatings(
            Long seasonId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                WITH eligible_players AS (
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        registration.club_id,
                        evaluation.player_id,
                        role.fantasy_role,

                        COALESCE(
                            evaluation.reliability_score,
                            50
                        ) AS reliability_score,

                        COALESCE(
                            evaluation.potential_score,
                            50
                        ) AS potential_score,

                        COALESCE(
                            evaluation.risk_score,
                            50
                        ) AS risk_score,

                        COALESCE(
                            evaluation.value_score,
                            50
                        ) AS value_score,

                        COALESCE(
                            evaluation.projected_goals,
                            0
                        ) AS projected_goals,

                        COALESCE(
                            evaluation.projected_assists,
                            0
                        ) AS projected_assists,

                        COALESCE(
                            evaluation.projected_starts,
                            0
                        ) AS projected_starts

                    FROM player_evaluations evaluation

                    JOIN player_registrations registration
                        ON registration.player_id =
                            evaluation.player_id
                        AND registration.season_id =
                            evaluation.season_id

                    JOIN season_clubs season_club
                        ON season_club.season_id = evaluation.season_id
                        AND season_club.club_id = registration.club_id

                    JOIN player_roles role
                        ON role.player_id =
                            evaluation.player_id
                        AND role.season_id =
                            evaluation.season_id
                        AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                    JOIN player_reconciliation_results reconciliation
                        ON reconciliation.player_id =
                            evaluation.player_id
                        AND reconciliation.season_id =
                            evaluation.season_id

                    WHERE evaluation.season_id = :seasonId
                      AND role.fantasy_role IS NOT NULL
                ),

                player_scores AS (
                    SELECT
                        eligible_players.*,

                        LEAST(
                            100,
                            GREATEST(
                                0,
                                reliability_score * 0.35
                                + potential_score * 0.25
                                + value_score * 0.20
                                + (
                                    100 - risk_score
                                ) * 0.20
                            )
                        ) AS player_quality,

                        CASE fantasy_role
                            WHEN 'A' THEN 1.00
                            WHEN 'C' THEN 0.65
                            WHEN 'D' THEN 0.20
                            WHEN 'P' THEN 0.05
                            ELSE 0.10
                        END AS attacking_weight,

                        CASE fantasy_role
                            WHEN 'P' THEN 1.00
                            WHEN 'D' THEN 0.85
                            WHEN 'C' THEN 0.35
                            WHEN 'A' THEN 0.10
                            ELSE 0.10
                        END AS defensive_weight

                    FROM eligible_players
                ),

                ranked_players AS (
                    SELECT
                        player_scores.*,

                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                            PARTITION BY club_id
                            ORDER BY
                                player_quality DESC,
                                projected_starts DESC,
                                player_id
                        ) AS club_position

                    FROM player_scores
                ),

                club_scores AS (
                    SELECT
                        club_id,

                        COUNT(*) AS players_count,

                        AVG(player_quality)
                            FILTER (
                                WHERE club_position <= 18
                            ) AS overall_score,

                        SUM(
                            (
                                player_quality
                                + LEAST(
                                    projected_goals * 1.50
                                    + projected_assists * 0.80,
                                    18
                                )
                            )
                            * attacking_weight
                        )
                        FILTER (
                            WHERE club_position <= 18
                        )
                        /
                        NULLIF(
                            SUM(attacking_weight)
                            FILTER (
                                WHERE club_position <= 18
                            ),
                            0
                        ) AS attacking_score,

                        SUM(
                            (
                                player_quality
                                + CASE fantasy_role
                                    WHEN 'P' THEN 5
                                    WHEN 'D' THEN 3
                                    ELSE 0
                                  END
                            )
                            * defensive_weight
                        )
                        FILTER (
                            WHERE club_position <= 18
                        )
                        /
                        NULLIF(
                            SUM(defensive_weight)
                            FILTER (
                                WHERE club_position <= 18
                            ),
                            0
                        ) AS defensive_score

                    FROM ranked_players

                    GROUP BY club_id
                ),

                normalized_scores AS (
                    SELECT
                        club.id AS club_id,

                        COALESCE(
                            club_scores.overall_score,
                            50
                        ) AS overall_score,

                        COALESCE(
                            club_scores.attacking_score,
                            club_scores.overall_score,
                            50
                        ) AS attacking_score,

                        COALESCE(
                            club_scores.defensive_score,
                            club_scores.overall_score,
                            50
                        ) AS defensive_score,

                        COALESCE(
                            club_scores.players_count,
                            0
                        ) AS players_count

                    FROM season_clubs season_club

                    JOIN clubs club
                        ON club.id = season_club.club_id

                    LEFT JOIN club_scores
                        ON club_scores.club_id = club.id

                    WHERE season_club.season_id = :seasonId
                ),

                final_scores AS (
                    SELECT
                        club_id,

                        LEAST(
                            100,
                            GREATEST(
                                35,
                                ROUND(
                                    overall_score
                                    + LEAST(
                                        players_count,
                                        20
                                    ) * 0.35
                                )
                            )
                        )::INTEGER AS overall_rating,

                        LEAST(
                            100,
                            GREATEST(
                                35,
                                ROUND(attacking_score)
                            )
                        )::INTEGER AS attacking_rating,

                        LEAST(
                            100,
                            GREATEST(
                                35,
                                ROUND(defensive_score)
                            )
                        )::INTEGER AS defensive_rating

                    FROM normalized_scores
                )

                INSERT INTO club_strength_ratings (
                    club_id,
                    season_id,
                    overall_rating,
                    attacking_rating,
                    defensive_rating,
                    home_rating,
                    away_rating
                )

                SELECT
                    club_id,
                    :seasonId,
                    overall_rating,
                    attacking_rating,
                    defensive_rating,

                    LEAST(
                        100,
                        GREATEST(
                            35,
                            ROUND(
                                overall_rating * 0.55
                                + attacking_rating * 0.20
                                + defensive_rating * 0.25
                                + 4
                            )
                        )
                    )::INTEGER AS home_rating,

                    LEAST(
                        100,
                        GREATEST(
                            35,
                            ROUND(
                                overall_rating * 0.55
                                + attacking_rating * 0.20
                                + defensive_rating * 0.25
                                - 4
                            )
                        )
                    )::INTEGER AS away_rating

                FROM final_scores

                ON CONFLICT (
                    club_id,
                    season_id
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    overall_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.overall_rating,

                    attacking_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.attacking_rating,

                    defensive_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.defensive_rating,

                    home_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.home_rating,

                    away_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.away_rating,

                    updated_at =
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.freshness;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class DataFreshnessService {

    private static final List<String> SOURCES =
            List.of(
                    "FANTACALCIO",
                    "GAZZETTA",
                    "FANTAMARKT"
            );

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final Clock clock;

    public DataFreshnessService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            Clock clock
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public DataFreshnessResponse evaluate(
            String seasonCode
    ) {

        requireSeason(seasonCode);

        OffsetDateTime evaluatedAt =
                OffsetDateTime.now(clock);

        List<SourceFreshnessResponse> sources =
                new ArrayList<>();

        List<String> blockers =
                new ArrayList<>();

        List<String> warnings =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (String source : SOURCES) {

            Policy policy =
                    loadPolicy(source);

            BatchSnapshot batch =
                    latestProductionBatch(
                            seasonCode,
                            source
                    );

            SourceFreshnessResponse response =
                    classify(
                            source,
                            policy,
                            batch,
                            evaluatedAt
                    );

            sources.add(response);

            addMessages(
                    response,
                    blockers,
                    warnings
            );
        }

        String overallStatus;

        if (!blockers.isEmpty()) {
            overallStatus = "BLOCKED";
        } else if (!warnings.isEmpty()) {
            overallStatus = "WARNING";
        } else {
            overallStatus = "READY";
        }

        return new DataFreshnessResponse(
                seasonCode,
                evaluatedAt,
                overallStatus,
                List.copyOf(sources),
                List.copyOf(blockers),
                List.copyOf(warnings)
        );
    }

    private SourceFreshnessResponse classify(
            String source,
            Policy policy,
            BatchSnapshot batch,
            OffsetDateTime evaluatedAt
    ) {

        if (batch == null) {
            return new SourceFreshnessResponse(
                    source,
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    policy.freshMaxHours(),
                    policy.staleAfterHours(),
                    policy.requiredForRefresh(),
                    FreshnessStatus.MISSING.name()
            );
        }

        long ageHours =
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        Duration.between(
                                batch.observedAt(),
                                evaluatedAt
                        ).toHours()
                );

        FreshnessStatus status;

        if (ageHours
                <= policy.freshMaxHours()) {

            status = FreshnessStatus.FRESH;

        } else if (ageHours
                <= policy.staleAfterHours()) {

            status = FreshnessStatus.AGING;

        } else {
            status = FreshnessStatus.STALE;
        }

        return new SourceFreshnessResponse(
                source,
                batch.id(),
                batch.observedAt(),
                ageHours,
                policy.freshMaxHours(),
                policy.staleAfterHours(),
                policy.requiredForRefresh(),
                status.name()
        );
    }

    private void addMessages(
            SourceFreshnessResponse source,
            List<String> blockers,
            List<String> warnings
    ) {

        String status =
                source.status();

        if ("FRESH".equals(status)) {
            return;
        }

        if ("AGING".equals(status)) {
            warnings.add(
                    source.source()
                            + " Ã¨ AGING: snapshot di "
                            + source.ageHours()
                            + " ore"
            );
            return;
        }

        String message;

        if ("MISSING".equals(status)) {
            message =
                    source.source()
                            + " Ã¨ MISSING: nessun batch "
                            + "COMPLETED di produzione";
        } else {
            message =
                    source.source()
                            + " Ã¨ STALE: snapshot di "
                            + source.ageHours()
                            + " ore";
        }

        if (source.requiredForRefresh()) {
            blockers.add(message);
        } else {
            warnings.add(message);
        }
    }

    private void requireSeason(
            String seasonCode
    ) {

        boolean exists =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1
                            FROM seasons
                            WHERE code = :season
                        )
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "season",
                                seasonCode
                        )
                        .query(Boolean.class)
                        .single();

        if (!exists) {
            throw new ResourceNotFoundException(
                    "Stagione non trovata: "
                            + seasonCode
            );
        }
    }

    private Policy loadPolicy(
            String source
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    fresh_max_hours,
                    stale_after_hours,
                    required_for_refresh

                FROM data_source_freshness_policies

                WHERE source = :source
                """)
                .param("source", source)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new Policy(
                                resultSet.getInt(
                                        "fresh_max_hours"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getInt(
                                        "stale_after_hours"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBoolean(
                                        "required_for_refresh"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new IllegalStateException(
                                "Policy freshness mancante per "
                                        + source
                        )
                );
    }

    private BatchSnapshot latestProductionBatch(
            String seasonCode,
            String source
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    batch.id,

                    COALESCE(
                        batch.source_observed_at,
                        batch.completed_at,
                        batch.started_at
                    ) AS observed_at

                FROM import_batches batch

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                        batch.season_id

                WHERE season.code = :season
                  AND batch.source = :source
                  AND batch.status = 'COMPLETED'
                  AND LOWER(batch.original_filename)
                        NOT LIKE '%test%'

                ORDER BY
                    COALESCE(
                        batch.source_observed_at,
                        batch.completed_at,
                        batch.started_at
                    ) DESC,
                    batch.id DESC

                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param(
                        "season",
                        seasonCode
                )
                .param(
                        "source",
                        source
                )
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new BatchSnapshot(
                                resultSet.getLong("id"),
                                resultSet.getObject(
                                        "observed_at",
                                        OffsetDateTime.class
                                )
                        )
                )
                .optional()
                .orElse(null);
    }

    private record Policy(
            int freshMaxHours,
            int staleAfterHours,
            boolean requiredForRefresh
    ) {
    }

    private record BatchSnapshot(
            Long id,
            OffsetDateTime observedAt
    ) {
    }
}
