package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.sql.Types;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;

import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVFormat;
import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVRecord;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

@Service
public class IdentityEnrichmentImportService {

    private static final Set<String> STATUSES = Set.of(
            "VERIFIED_COMPLETE",
            "VERIFIED_PARTIAL",
            "NO_SERIE_A_HISTORY_EXPECTED",
            "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
            "DATA_SOURCE_MISSING"
    );

    private static final Set<String> CONFIDENCES = Set.of(
            "HIGH",
            "MEDIUM",
            "LOW",
            "NONE"
    );

    private static final Set<String> SOURCES = Set.of(
            "WIKIDATA",
            "FANTACALCIO",
            "TRANSFERMARKT",
            "UEFA",
            "FIGC",
            "LEGA_SERIE_A",
            "OFFICIAL_CLUB",
            "MANUAL_VERIFIED"
    );

    private static final Set<String> FEET = Set.of(
            "RIGHT",
            "LEFT",
            "BOTH"
    );

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public IdentityEnrichmentImportService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional
    public IdentityEnrichmentImportResponse importCsv(
            MultipartFile file
    ) {

        if (file == null || file.isEmpty()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "File identity CSV obbligatorio"
            );
        }

        int total = 0;
        int imported = 0;
        int complete = 0;
        int partial = 0;
        int noHistory = 0;
        int review = 0;
        int missing = 0;

        try (
                var reader = new BufferedReader(
                        new InputStreamReader(
                                file.getInputStream(),
                                StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                        )
                );

                var parser = CSVFormat.DEFAULT
                        .builder()
                        .setHeader()
                        .setSkipHeaderRecord(true)
                        .setTrim(true)
                        .setIgnoreEmptyLines(true)
                        .get()
                        .parse(reader)
        ) {

            requireHeaders(
                    parser.getHeaderNames()
            );

            for (CSVRecord record : parser) {

                total++;

                Row row = parse(record);

                validate(row);

                upsert(row);

                imported++;

                switch (row.status()) {
                    case "VERIFIED_COMPLETE" ->
                            complete++;
                    case "VERIFIED_PARTIAL" ->
                            partial++;
                    case "NO_SERIE_A_HISTORY_EXPECTED" ->
                            noHistory++;
                    case "REVIEW_REQUIRED" ->
                            review++;
                    default ->
                            missing++;
                }
            }

        }
        catch (BadRequestException exception) {
            throw exception;
        }
        catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Import identity enrichment fallito: "
                            + exception.getMessage(),
                    exception
            );
        }

        return new IdentityEnrichmentImportResponse(
                total,
                imported,
                complete,
                partial,
                noHistory,
                review,
                missing
        );
    }

    private void requireHeaders(
            List<String> headers
    ) {

        Set<String> required = Set.of(
                "player_id",
                "canonical_full_name",
                "first_name",
                "last_name",
                "birth_date",
                "nationality",
                "nationality_code",
                "height_cm",
                "preferred_foot",
                "transfermarkt_player_id",
                "identity_status",
                "confidence",
                "source",
                "source_external_id",
                "source_url",
                "evidence"
        );

        List<String> missing = required
                .stream()
                .filter(column ->
                        !headers.contains(column)
                )
                .sorted()
                .toList();

        if (!missing.isEmpty()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Colonne identity mancanti: "
                            + String.join(", ", missing)
            );
        }
    }

    private Row parse(
            CSVRecord record
    ) {

        try {
            return new Row(
                    Long.valueOf(
                            value(
                                    record,
                                    "player_id"
                            )
                    ),
                    value(
                            record,
                            "canonical_full_name"
                    ),
                    value(
                            record,
                            "first_name"
                    ),
                    value(
                            record,
                            "last_name"
                    ),
                    date(
                            value(
                                    record,
                                    "birth_date"
                            )
                    ),
                    NationalityNormalizer.normalizeNationality(
                            value(
                                    record,
                                    "nationality"
                            ),
                            value(
                                    record,
                                    "transfermarkt_player_id"
                            )
                    ),
                    NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                            value(
                                    record,
                                    "nationality"
                            ),
                            value(
                                    record,
                                    "nationality_code"
                            ),
                            value(
                                    record,
                                    "transfermarkt_player_id"
                            )
                    ),
                    integer(
                            value(
                                    record,
                                    "height_cm"
                            )
                    ),
                    upper(
                            value(
                                    record,
                                    "preferred_foot"
                            )
                    ),
                    upper(
                            value(
                                    record,
                                    "identity_status"
                            )
                    ),
                    upper(
                            value(
                                    record,
                                    "confidence"
                            )
                    ),
                    upper(
                            value(
                                    record,
                                    "source"
                            )
                    ),
                    value(
                            record,
                            "transfermarkt_player_id"
                    ),
                    value(
                            record,
                            "source_external_id"
                    ),
                    value(
                            record,
                            "source_url"
                    ),
                    value(
                            record,
                            "evidence"
                    )
            );
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Riga identity non valida "
                            + record.getRecordNumber()
                            + ": "
                            + exception.getMessage()
            );
        }
    }

    private void validate(
            Row row
    ) {

        if (
                !STATUSES.contains(row.status())
                || !CONFIDENCES.contains(
                        row.confidence()
                )
        ) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Stato/confidence identity non valido "
                            + "per player "
                            + row.playerId()
            );
        }

        if (!SOURCES.contains(row.source())) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Fonte enrichment non approvata: "
                            + row.source()
            );
        }

        boolean verified =
                isVerified(row);

        if (
                verified
                && (
                        !"HIGH".equals(
                                row.confidence()
                        )
                        || row.canonicalName() == null
                        || row.birthDate() == null
                        || (
                                row.sourceExternalId() == null
                                && row.sourceUrl() == null
                        )
                )
        ) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Profilo verified incompleto "
                            + "per player "
                            + row.playerId()
            );
        }

        if (
                row.nationalityCode() != null
                && row.nationalityCode()
                        .length() != 2
        ) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Country code non ISO-2 "
                            + "per player "
                            + row.playerId()
            );
        }

        if (
                row.heightCm() != null
                && (
                        row.heightCm() < 140
                        || row.heightCm() > 220
                )
        ) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Altezza non valida "
                            + "per player "
                            + row.playerId()
            );
        }

        if (
                row.preferredFoot() != null
                && !FEET.contains(
                        row.preferredFoot()
                )
        ) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Piede preferito non valido "
                            + "per player "
                            + row.playerId()
            );
        }

        if (
                row.transfermarktPlayerId() != null
                && !row.transfermarktPlayerId()
                        .matches("[1-9][0-9]*")
        ) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Transfermarkt ID non valido "
                            + "per player "
                            + row.playerId()
            );
        }

        if (
                row.transfermarktPlayerId() != null
                && !"TRANSFERMARKT".equals(
                        row.source()
                )
        ) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Transfermarkt ID privo "
                            + "di provenance Transfermarkt"
            );
        }

        Map<String, Object> existingPlayer =
                jdbcClient
                        .sql("""
                                SELECT
                                    first_name,
                                    birth_date,
                                    nationality_code,
                                    height_cm,
                                    preferred_foot
                                FROM players
                                WHERE id = :playerId
                                """)
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                row.playerId()
                        )
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows()
                        .stream()
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow(() ->
                                new BadRequestException(
                                        "Player inesistente: "
                                                + row.playerId()
                                )
                        );

        if (verified) {

            rejectConflict(
                    existingPlayer,
                    "first_name",
                    row.firstName(),
                    row.playerId()
            );

            rejectConflict(
                    existingPlayer,
                    "birth_date",
                    row.birthDate(),
                    row.playerId()
            );

            rejectConflict(
                    existingPlayer,
                    "nationality_code",
                    row.nationalityCode(),
                    row.playerId()
            );

            rejectConflict(
                    existingPlayer,
                    "height_cm",
                    row.heightCm(),
                    row.playerId()
            );

            rejectConflict(
                    existingPlayer,
                    "preferred_foot",
                    row.preferredFoot(),
                    row.playerId()
            );

            validateExistingProfileConflicts(row);
        }

        validateTransfermarktIdentity(row);
    }

    private void validateExistingProfileConflicts(
            Row row
    ) {

        Map<String, Object> existingProfile =
                jdbcClient
                        .sql("""
                                SELECT
                                    birth_date,
                                    nationality_code,
                                    height_cm,
                                    preferred_foot,
                                    transfermarkt_player_id
                                FROM player_identity_profiles
                                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                                """)
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                row.playerId()
                        )
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows()
                        .stream()
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElse(null);

        if (existingProfile == null) {
            return;
        }

        rejectConflict(
                existingProfile,
                "birth_date",
                row.birthDate(),
                row.playerId()
        );

        rejectConflict(
                existingProfile,
                "nationality_code",
                row.nationalityCode(),
                row.playerId()
        );

        rejectConflict(
                existingProfile,
                "height_cm",
                row.heightCm(),
                row.playerId()
        );

        rejectConflict(
                existingProfile,
                "preferred_foot",
                row.preferredFoot(),
                row.playerId()
        );


    }

    private void validateTransfermarktIdentity(
            Row row
    ) {

        if (row.transfermarktPlayerId() == null) {
            return;
        }

        String currentId =
                jdbcClient
                        .sql("""
                                SELECT transfermarkt_player_id
                                FROM player_identity_profiles
                                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                                """)
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                row.playerId()
                        )
                        .query(String.class)
                        .optional()
                        .orElse(null);

        if (
                currentId != null
                && !currentId.equals(
                        row.transfermarktPlayerId()
                )
        ) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Conflitto Transfermarkt ID "
                            + "per player "
                            + row.playerId()
            );
        }

        boolean usedElsewhere =
                jdbcClient
                        .sql("""
                                SELECT EXISTS (
                                    SELECT 1
                                    FROM player_identity_profiles
                                    WHERE transfermarkt_player_id =
                                          :externalId
                                      AND player_id <> :playerId
                                )
                                """)
                        .param(
                                "externalId",
                                row.transfermarktPlayerId()
                        )
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                row.playerId()
                        )
                        .query(Boolean.class)
                        .single();

        if (usedElsewhere) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Transfermarkt ID giÃ  collegato "
                            + "a un altro player"
            );
        }
    }

    private void rejectConflict(
            Map<String, Object> existing,
            String field,
            Object incoming,
            Long playerId
    ) {

        if (incoming == null) {
            return;
        }

        Object current = existing.get(field);

        if (current == null) {
            return;
        }

        if (
                !normalizedValue(current)
                        .equals(
                                normalizedValue(incoming)
                        )
        ) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Conflitto "
                            + field
                            + " per player "
                            + playerId
            );
        }
    }

    private String normalizedValue(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }

        return Objects
                .toString(value)
                .trim();
    }

    private void upsert(
            Row row
    ) {

        jdbcClient
                .sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_identity_profiles (
                            player_id,
                            canonical_full_name,
                            first_name,
                            last_name,
                            birth_date,
                            nationality,
                            nationality_code,
                            height_cm,
                            preferred_foot,
                            transfermarkt_player_id,
                            identity_status,
                            confidence
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :playerId,
                            :canonicalName,
                            :firstName,
                            :lastName,
                            :birthDate,
                            :nationality,
                            :nationalityCode,
                            :heightCm,
                            :preferredFoot,
                            :transfermarktPlayerId,
                            :status,
                            :confidence
                        )

                        ON CONFLICT (player_id)
                        DO UPDATE SET

                            canonical_full_name =
                                COALESCE(
                                    player_identity_profiles.canonical_full_name,
                                    EXCLUDED.canonical_full_name
                                ),

                            first_name =
                                COALESCE(
                                    player_identity_profiles.first_name,
                                    EXCLUDED.first_name
                                ),

                            last_name =
                                COALESCE(
                                    player_identity_profiles.last_name,
                                    EXCLUDED.last_name
                                ),

                            birth_date =
                                COALESCE(
                                    player_identity_profiles.birth_date,
                                    EXCLUDED.birth_date
                                ),

                            nationality =
                                COALESCE(
                                    player_identity_profiles.nationality,
                                    EXCLUDED.nationality
                                ),

                            nationality_code =
                                COALESCE(
                                    player_identity_profiles.nationality_code,
                                    EXCLUDED.nationality_code
                                ),

                            height_cm =
                                COALESCE(
                                    player_identity_profiles.height_cm,
                                    EXCLUDED.height_cm
                                ),

                            preferred_foot =
                                COALESCE(
                                    player_identity_profiles.preferred_foot,
                                    EXCLUDED.preferred_foot
                                ),

                            transfermarkt_player_id =
                                COALESCE(
                                    player_identity_profiles.transfermarkt_player_id,
                                    EXCLUDED.transfermarkt_player_id
                                ),

                            identity_status =
                                CASE
                                    WHEN
                                        player_identity_profiles.identity_status
                                            = 'VERIFIED_COMPLETE'
                                        AND player_identity_profiles.confidence =
                                            'HIGH'
                                    THEN
                                        player_identity_profiles.identity_status

                                    WHEN
                                        player_identity_profiles.identity_status
                                            = 'VERIFIED_PARTIAL'
                                        AND player_identity_profiles.confidence =
                                            'HIGH'
                                        AND EXCLUDED.identity_status
                                            = 'VERIFIED_COMPLETE'
                                        AND EXCLUDED.confidence = 'HIGH'
                                    THEN
                                        EXCLUDED.identity_status

                                    WHEN
                                        player_identity_profiles.identity_status
                                            = 'VERIFIED_PARTIAL'
                                        AND player_identity_profiles.confidence =
                                            'HIGH'
                                    THEN
                                        player_identity_profiles.identity_status

                                    WHEN
                                        EXCLUDED.identity_status
                                            IN (
                                                'VERIFIED_COMPLETE',
                                                'VERIFIED_PARTIAL'
                                            )
                                        AND EXCLUDED.confidence = 'HIGH'
                                    THEN
                                        EXCLUDED.identity_status

                                    ELSE
                                        EXCLUDED.identity_status
                                END,

                            confidence =
                                CASE
                                    WHEN
                                        player_identity_profiles.identity_status
                                            IN (
                                                'VERIFIED_COMPLETE',
                                                'VERIFIED_PARTIAL'
                                            )
                                        AND player_identity_profiles.confidence =
                                            'HIGH'
                                    THEN
                                        player_identity_profiles.confidence

                                    WHEN
                                        EXCLUDED.identity_status
                                            IN (
                                                'VERIFIED_COMPLETE',
                                                'VERIFIED_PARTIAL'
                                            )
                                        AND EXCLUDED.confidence = 'HIGH'
                                    THEN
                                        EXCLUDED.confidence

                                    ELSE
                                        EXCLUDED.confidence
                                END,

                            updated_at =
                                CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                        """)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        row.playerId()
                )
                .param(
                        "canonicalName",
                        row.canonicalName(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "firstName",
                        row.firstName(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "lastName",
                        row.lastName(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "birthDate",
                        row.birthDate(),
                        Types.DATE
                )
                .param(
                        "nationality",
                        row.nationality(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(

                )
                .param(

                        row.heightCm(),
                        Types.SMALLINT
                )
                .param(

                        row.preferredFoot(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "transfermarktPlayerId",
                        row.transfermarktPlayerId(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "status",
                        row.status()
                )
                .param(
                        "confidence",
                        row.confidence()
                )
                .update();

        if (isVerified(row)) {

            jdbcClient
                    .sql("""
                            UPDATE players
                            SET
                                first_name =
                                    COALESCE(
                                        first_name,
                                        :firstName
                                    ),
                                birth_date =
                                    COALESCE(
                                        birth_date,
                                        :birthDate
                                    ),
                                nationality_code =
                                    COALESCE(
                                        nationality_code,
                                        :nationalityCode
                                    ),
                                height_cm =
                                    COALESCE(
                                        height_cm,
                                        :heightCm
                                    ),
                                preferred_foot =
                                    COALESCE(
                                        preferred_foot,
                                        :preferredFoot
                                    ),
                                updated_at =
                                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                            WHERE id = :playerId
                            """)
                    .param(
                            "firstName",
                            row.firstName(),
                            Types.VARCHAR
                    )
                    .param(
                            "birthDate",
                            row.birthDate(),
                            Types.DATE
                    )
                    .param(
                            "nationalityCode",

                    )
                    .param(

                    )
                    .update();

            savePopulatedVerifiedProvenance(row);
        }

        if (
                row.sourceExternalId() != null
                || row.sourceUrl() != null
        ) {
            saveProvenance(
                    row,
                    "IDENTITY_STATUS"
            );
        }
    }

    private void savePopulatedVerifiedProvenance(
            Row row
    ) {

        if (row.canonicalName() != null) {
            saveProvenance(
                    row,
                    "CANONICAL_FULL_NAME"
            );
        }

        if (row.firstName() != null) {
            saveProvenance(
                    row,
                    "FIRST_NAME"
            );
        }

        if (row.lastName() != null) {
            saveProvenance(
                    row,
                    "LAST_NAME"
            );
        }

        if (row.birthDate() != null) {
            saveProvenance(
                    row,
                    "BIRTH_DATE"
            );
        }

        if (row.nationality() != null) {
            saveProvenance(
                    row,
                    "NATIONALITY"
            );
        }

        if (row.nationalityCode() != null) {
            saveProvenance(
                    row,
                    "NATIONALITY_CODE"
            );
        }

        if (row.heightCm() != null) {
            saveProvenance(
                    row,
                    "HEIGHT_CM"
            );
        }

        if (row.preferredFoot() != null) {
            saveProvenance(
                    row,
                    "PREFERRED_FOOT"
            );
        }

        if (row.transfermarktPlayerId() != null) {
            saveProvenance(
                    row,
                    "TRANSFERMARKT_PLAYER_ID"
            );
        }
    }

    private void saveProvenance(
            Row row,
            String field
    ) {

        jdbcClient
                .sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_identity_provenance (
                            player_id,
                            field_name,
                            source,
                            source_external_id,
                            source_url,
                            confidence,
                            evidence
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :playerId,
                            :field,
                            :source,
                            :externalId,
                            :sourceUrl,
                            :confidence,
                            CAST(:evidence AS JSONB)
                        )

                        ON CONFLICT (
                            player_id,
                            field_name,
                            source,
                            source_external_id
                        )
                        DO UPDATE SET
                            source_url =
                                EXCLUDED.source_url,
                            confidence =
                                EXCLUDED.confidence,
                            evidence =
                                EXCLUDED.evidence,
                            imported_at =
                                CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                        """)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        row.playerId()
                )
                .param(
                        "field",
                        field
                )
                .param(
                        "source",
                        row.source()
                )
                .param(
                        "externalId",
                        row.sourceExternalId(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "sourceUrl",
                        row.sourceUrl(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "confidence",
                        "NONE".equals(
                                row.confidence()
                        )
                                ? "LOW"
                                : row.confidence()
                )
                .param(
                        "evidence",
                        row.evidence() == null
                                ? "{}"
                                : row.evidence()
                )
                .update();
    }

    private boolean isVerified(
            Row row
    ) {
        return row.status()
                .startsWith("VERIFIED_");
    }

    private String value(
            CSVRecord record,
            String field
    ) {

        String value =
                record.get(field);

        return value == null
                || value.isBlank()
                        ? null
                        : value.trim();
    }

    private String upper(
            String value
    ) {
        return value == null
                ? null
                : value.toUpperCase();
    }

    private LocalDate date(
            String value
    ) {
        return value == null
                ? null
                : LocalDate.parse(value);
    }

    private Integer integer(
            String value
    ) {
        return value == null
                ? null
                : Integer.valueOf(value);
    }

    private record Row(
            Long playerId,
            String canonicalName,
            String firstName,
            String lastName,
            LocalDate birthDate,
            String nationality,
            String nationalityCode,
            Integer heightCm,
            String preferredFoot,
            String status,
            String confidence,
            String source,
            String transfermarktPlayerId,
            String sourceExternalId,
            String sourceUrl,
            String evidence
    ) {
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment;

import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class IdentityEnrichmentReadinessService {
    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public IdentityEnrichmentReadinessService(JdbcClient jdbcClient) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    public IdentityEnrichmentReadinessResponse evaluate(String season) {
        Map<String, Object> row = jdbcClient.sql("""
                WITH operational AS (
                    SELECT DISTINCT p.id
                    FROM player_reconciliation_results result
                    JOIN seasons s ON s.id = result.season_id AND s.code = :season
                    JOIN players p ON p.id = result.player_id AND p.active = TRUE
                    JOIN player_registrations registration
                      ON registration.player_id = p.id AND registration.season_id = s.id
                     AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                )
                SELECT COUNT(*) AS operational, COUNT(ip.player_id) AS profiled,
                       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ip.identity_status = 'VERIFIED_COMPLETE') AS complete,
                       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ip.identity_status = 'VERIFIED_PARTIAL') AS partial,
                       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ip.identity_status = 'NO_SERIE_A_HISTORY_EXPECTED') AS no_history,
                       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ip.identity_status = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED') AS review,
                       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ip.identity_status = 'DATA_SOURCE_MISSING' OR ip.player_id IS NULL) AS missing,
                       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ip.canonical_full_name IS NOT NULL) AS names,
                       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ip.birth_date IS NOT NULL) AS births,
                       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ip.nationality IS NOT NULL) AS nationalities
                FROM operational op LEFT JOIN player_identity_profiles ip ON ip.player_id = op.id
                """).param("season", season).query().singleRow();
        int operational = number(row, "operational");
        int profiled = number(row, "profiled");
        int review = number(row, "review");
        int missing = number(row, "missing");
        String status = review == 0 && missing == 0 && profiled == operational
                ? "READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW" : "BLOCKED_DATA_SOURCE";
        return new IdentityEnrichmentReadinessResponse(status, operational, profiled,
                number(row, "complete"), number(row, "partial"), number(row, "no_history"),
                review, missing, number(row, "names"), number(row, "births"), number(row, "nationalities"));
    }

    private int number(Map<String, Object> row, String key) {
        return ((Number) row.get(key)).intValue();
    }
}

    private static final Map<String, String> VERIFIED_NATIONALITY_OVERRIDES =
            Map.of(
                    "1131161", "Francia, Guinea-Bissau",
                    "992569", "Italia"
            );

    private NationalityNormalizer() {
    }

    public static String normalizeNationality(
            String nationality,
            String transfermarktPlayerId
    ) {
        String tmId = clean(transfermarktPlayerId);

        if (tmId != null) {
            String override =
                    VERIFIED_NATIONALITY_OVERRIDES.get(tmId);

            if (override != null) {
                return override;
            }
        }

        return clean(nationality);
    }

    public static String resolveCode(
            String nationality,
            String explicitCode,
            String transfermarktPlayerId
    ) {
        String normalizedNationality =
                normalizeNationality(
                        nationality,
                        transfermarktPlayerId
                );

        String mapped =
                codeForNationality(normalizedNationality);

        if (mapped != null) {
            return mapped;
        }

        String explicit = clean(explicitCode);

        return explicit == null
                ? null
                : explicit.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    public static String codeForNationality(
            String nationality
    ) {
        String value = clean(nationality);

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String primary =
                value.split(",", 2)[0]
                        .trim()
                        .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        return CODES.get(primary);
    }

    private static String clean(
            String value
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String cleaned = value.trim();

        return cleaned.isEmpty()
                ? null
                : cleaned;
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import java.time.Duration;

import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "app.identity-enrichment.automation")
public class IdentityAutomationProperties {

    private boolean enabled = false;

    private int batchLimit = 10;

    private Duration failedRetry =
            Duration.ofDays(1);

    private Duration unresolvedRetry =
            Duration.ofDays(7);

    private Duration matchedRetry =
            Duration.ofDays(30);

    public void validateEnabledConfiguration() {

        if (!enabled) {
            return;
        }

        if (batchLimit < 1 || batchLimit > 50) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "app.identity-enrichment.automation.batch-limit deve essere compreso tra 1 e 50"
            );
        }

        validateDuration(
                failedRetry,
                "failed-retry"
        );

        validateDuration(
                unresolvedRetry,
                "unresolved-retry"
        );

        validateDuration(
                matchedRetry,
                "matched-retry"
        );
    }

    private void validateDuration(
            Duration duration,
            String property
    ) {

        if (
                duration == null
                        || duration.isZero()
                        || duration.isNegative()
        ) {

            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "app.identity-enrichment.automation."
                            + property
                            + " deve essere maggiore di zero"
            );
        }
    }

    public boolean isEnabled() {
        return enabled;
    }

    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
        this.enabled = enabled;
    }

    public int getBatchLimit() {
        return batchLimit;
    }

    public void setBatchLimit(int batchLimit) {
        this.batchLimit = batchLimit;
    }

    public Duration getFailedRetry() {
        return failedRetry;
    }

    public void setFailedRetry(Duration failedRetry) {
        this.failedRetry = failedRetry;
    }

    public Duration getUnresolvedRetry() {
        return unresolvedRetry;
    }

    public void setUnresolvedRetry(
            Duration unresolvedRetry
    ) {
        this.unresolvedRetry = unresolvedRetry;
    }

    public Duration getMatchedRetry() {
        return matchedRetry;
    }

    public void setMatchedRetry(
            Duration matchedRetry
    ) {
        this.matchedRetry = matchedRetry;
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import java.sql.Types;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class SelectiveIdentityEnrichmentService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbc;
    private final IdentityAutomationProperties properties;
    private final TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties discoveryProperties;
    private final TransfermarktDiscoveryService discoveryService;
    private final TransfermarktProvenancePersistenceService persistenceService;

    public SelectiveIdentityEnrichmentService(
            JdbcClient jdbc,
            IdentityAutomationProperties properties,
            TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties discoveryProperties,
            TransfermarktDiscoveryService discoveryService,
            TransfermarktProvenancePersistenceService persistenceService
    ) {

        this.jdbc = jdbc;
        this.properties = properties;
        this.discoveryProperties = discoveryProperties;
        this.discoveryService = discoveryService;
        this.persistenceService = persistenceService;
    }

    public IdentityAutomationResponse runScheduled(
            String season
    ) {

        if (!properties.isEnabled()) {
            return IdentityAutomationResponse.disabled(
                    season
            );
        }

        properties.validateEnabledConfiguration();

        if (!discoveryProperties.isEnabled()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Identity enrichment automation abilitata ma Transfermarkt discovery disabilitata"
            );
        }

        discoveryProperties.validateEnabledConfiguration();

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse discovery =
                discoveryService.discoverIncomplete(
                        season,
                        properties.getBatchLimit()
                );

        /*
         * Existing persistence is deliberately authoritative here:
         * it accepts only MATCHED_VERIFIED rows and ignores all unresolved
         * statuses.
         */
        int persistedFields =
                persistenceService.persist(
                        season,
                        discovery
                );

        /*
         * Attempts are written only after persistence succeeds.
         *
         * Therefore a database/persistence failure causes the surrounding
         * refresh to fail and the remote results remain retryable later,
         * rather than falsely recording a completed automatic pass.
         */
        for (
                TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery player
                : discovery.players()
        ) {

            recordAttempt(
                    season,
                    player
            );
        }

        return new IdentityAutomationResponse(
                season,
                "COMPLETED",
                discovery.requestedPlayers(),
                discovery.matchedVerified(),
                discovery.reviewRequired(),
                discovery.notFound(),
                discovery.failed(),
                persistedFields
        );
    }

    private void recordAttempt(
            String season,
            TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery player
    ) {

        OffsetDateTime now =
                OffsetDateTime.now();

        OffsetDateTime nextRetry =
                now.plus(
                        retryFor(
                                player.status()
                        )
                );

        jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO identity_enrichment_automation_attempts (
                    season_id,
                    player_id,
                    last_status,
                    attempt_count,
                    last_score,
                    transfermarkt_player_id,
                    last_reason,
                    last_attempt_at,
                    next_retry_at
                )
                SELECT
                    season.id,
                    :playerId,
                    :status,
                    1,
                    :score,
                    :transfermarktPlayerId,
                    :reason,
                    :attemptedAt,
                    :nextRetryAt
                FROM seasons season
                WHERE season.code = :season
                ON CONFLICT (
                    season_id,
                    player_id
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    last_status = EXCLUDED.last_status,
                    attempt_count =
                        identity_enrichment_automation_attempts.attempt_count + 1,
                    last_score = EXCLUDED.last_score,
                    transfermarkt_player_id =
                        EXCLUDED.transfermarkt_player_id,
                    last_reason = EXCLUDED.last_reason,
                    last_attempt_at = EXCLUDED.last_attempt_at,
                    next_retry_at = EXCLUDED.next_retry_at,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                """)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        player.playerId()
                )
                .param(
                        "status",
                        normalizedStatus(
                                player.status()
                        )
                )
                .param(
                        "score",
                        Math.max(
                                0,
                                Math.min(
                                        100,
                                        player.score()
                                )
                        )
                )
                .param(
                        "transfermarktPlayerId",
                        clean(
                                player.transfermarktPlayerId()
                        ),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "reason",
                        truncate(
                                clean(player.reason()),
                                500
                        ),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "attemptedAt",
                        now
                )
                .param(
                        "nextRetryAt",
                        nextRetry
                )
                .param(
                        "season",
                        season
                )
                .update();
    }

    private Duration retryFor(
            String status
    ) {

        return switch (
                normalizedStatus(status)
        ) {
            case "MATCHED_VERIFIED" ->
                    properties.getMatchedRetry();

            case "FAILED" ->
                    properties.getFailedRetry();

            default ->
                    properties.getUnresolvedRetry();
        };
    }

    private String normalizedStatus(
            String status
    ) {

        if ("MATCHED_VERIFIED".equals(status)) {
            return "MATCHED_VERIFIED";
        }

        if ("REVIEW_REQUIRED".equals(status)) {
            return "REVIEW_REQUIRED";
        }

        if ("FAILED".equals(status)) {
            return "FAILED";
        }

        return "NOT_FOUND";
    }

    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String cleaned =
                value.trim();

        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;
    }

    private String truncate(
            String value,
            int maximum
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return value.length() <= maximum
                ? value
                : value.substring(
                        0,
                        maximum
                );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import java.text.Normalizer;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class TransfermarktCandidateMatcher {

        public MatchResult match(
                        String playerName,
                        String club,
                        List<TransfermarktCandidate> candidates) {
                if (candidates == null || candidates.isEmpty()) {
                        return new MatchResult(
                                        "NOT_FOUND",
                                        0,
                                        null,
                                        "Nessun candidato Transfermarkt");
                }

                List<ScoredCandidate> scored = candidates.stream()
                                .map(candidate -> new ScoredCandidate(
                                                candidate,
                                                score(
                                                                playerName,
                                                                club,
                                                                candidate)))
                                .sorted(
                                                Comparator.comparingInt(
                                                                ScoredCandidate::score).reversed())
                                .toList();

                ScoredCandidate best = scored.getFirst();

                if (best.score() < 55) {
                        return new MatchResult(
                                        "NOT_FOUND",
                                        best.score(),
                                        best.candidate(),
                                        "Nessun candidato raggiunge la soglia minima");
                }

                long sameBest = scored.stream()
                                .filter(item -> item.score() == best.score())
                                .count();

                if (sameBest > 1) {
                        return new MatchResult(
                                        "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
                                        best.score(),
                                        best.candidate(),
                                        "Piu candidati con lo stesso punteggio");
                }

                return new MatchResult(
                                "PROFILE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED",
                                best.score(),
                                best.candidate(),
                                best.score() >= 80
                                                ? "Candidato forte; verificare profilo"
                                                : "Candidato compatibile; verificare profilo");
        }

        int score(
                        String playerName,
                        String club,
                        TransfermarktCandidate candidate) {
                String expectedName = normalize(playerName);

                String candidateName = normalize(candidate.name());

                int score = 0;

                if (!expectedName.isBlank()
                                && expectedName.equals(candidateName)) {
                        score += 80;
                } else if (surnameCompatible(
                                expectedName,
                                candidateName)) {
                        score += 55;
                }

                String normalizedClub = normalize(club);

                String context = normalize(candidate.context());

                if (!normalizedClub.isBlank()
                                && context.contains(normalizedClub)) {
                        score += 20;
                }

                return Math.min(score, 100);
        }

        boolean surnameCompatible(
                        String expected,
                        String candidate) {
                if (expected.isBlank()
                                || candidate.isBlank()) {
                        return false;
                }

                Set<String> expectedTokens = significantTokens(expected);

                Set<String> candidateTokens = significantTokens(candidate);

                if (expectedTokens.isEmpty()
                                || candidateTokens.isEmpty()) {
                        return false;
                }

                return candidateTokens.containsAll(
                                expectedTokens);
        }

        private Set<String> significantTokens(
                        String normalized) {
                return Arrays.stream(
                                normalized.split(" "))
                                .filter(token -> token.length() >= 2)
                                .filter(token -> !token.equals("ds"))
                                .collect(
                                                Collectors.toSet());
        }

        static String normalize(String value) {
                if (value == null) {
                        return "";
                }

                /*
                 * Some Latin letters are not decomposed by Unicode NFD.
                 *
                 * Apostrophes inside names are removed instead of becoming
                 * separators:
                 *
                 * N'Dicka -> ndicka
                 * Nâ€™Dicka -> ndicka
                 */
                String transliterated = value
                                .replace("'", "")
                                .replace("\u2019", "")
                                .replace("\u2018", "")
                                .replace('\u0131', 'i') // Ä±
                                .replace('\u0130', 'I') // Ä°
                                .replace('\u00F8', 'o') // Ã¸
                                .replace('\u00D8', 'O') // Ã˜
                                .replace('\u0142', 'l') // Å‚
                                .replace('\u0141', 'L') // Å
                                .replace("\u00DF", "ss") // ÃŸ
                                .replace("\u00E6", "ae") // Ã¦
                                .replace("\u00C6", "AE") // Ã†
                                .replace("\u0153", "oe") // Å“
                                .replace("\u0152", "OE"); // Å’

                return Normalizer.normalize(
                                transliterated,
                                Normalizer.Form.NFD)
                                .replaceAll("\\p{M}+", "")
                                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
                                .replaceAll("[^a-z0-9]+", " ")
                                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                                .trim();
        }

        public record MatchResult(
                        String status,
                        int score,
                        TransfermarktCandidate candidate,
                        String reason) {
        }

        private record ScoredCandidate(
                        TransfermarktCandidate candidate,
                        int score) {
        }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@Component
public class TransfermarktDiscoveryClient {

    private final TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties properties;
    private final HttpClient client;

    private long lastRequestAt;

    public TransfermarktDiscoveryClient(
            TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties properties
    ) {
        this.properties = properties;
        this.client = HttpClient.newBuilder()
                .connectTimeout(
                        properties.getConnectTimeout()
                )
                .followRedirects(
                        HttpClient.Redirect.NEVER
                )
                .build();
    }

    public synchronized SearchPage search(
            String playerName
    ) {
        if (!properties.isEnabled()) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Transfermarkt discovery disabilitata"
            );
        }

        properties.validateEnabledConfiguration();

        if (playerName == null
                || playerName.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Nome giocatore obbligatorio"
            );
        }

        String query =
                URLEncoder.encode(
                        playerName.trim(),
                        StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                );

        URI uri =
                validate(
                        properties
                                .getSearchUrlTemplate()
                                .replace(
                                        "{query}",
                                        query
                                )
                );

        FetchPage page =
                fetchHtml(uri);

        return new SearchPage(
                page.html(),
                page.finalUrl(),
                page.httpStatus(),
                page.payloadBytes()
        );
    }

    public synchronized ProfilePage fetchProfile(
            String profileUrl
    ) {
        if (!properties.isEnabled()) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Transfermarkt discovery disabilitata"
            );
        }

        properties.validateEnabledConfiguration();

        URI uri =
                validate(profileUrl);

        FetchPage page =
                fetchHtml(uri);

        return new ProfilePage(
                page.html(),
                page.finalUrl(),
                page.httpStatus(),
                page.payloadBytes()
        );
    }

    private FetchPage fetchHtml(
            URI initialUri
    ) {
        throttle();

        URI uri = initialUri;
        int redirects = 0;

        try {
            while (true) {
                HttpRequest request =
                        HttpRequest.newBuilder(uri)
                                .timeout(
                                        properties
                                                .getRequestTimeout()
                                )
                                .header(
                                        "User-Agent",
                                        "Mozilla/5.0 "
                                                + "(Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
                                                + "AppleWebKit/537.36 "
                                                + "Chrome/151 Safari/537.36"
                                )
                                .header(
                                        "Accept",
                                        "text/html,application/xhtml+xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.1"
                                )
                                .GET()
                                .build();

                lastRequestAt =
                        System.currentTimeMillis();

                HttpResponse<java.io.InputStream> response =
                        client.send(
                                request,
                                HttpResponse
                                        .BodyHandlers
                                        .ofInputStream()
                        );

                int status =
                        response.statusCode();

                if (status >= 300
                        && status < 400) {

                    String location;

                    try (var body =
                            response.body()) {

                        redirects++;

                        if (redirects
                                > properties
                                        .getMaxRedirects()) {
                            throw new BadRequestException(
                                    "Troppi redirect Transfermarkt"
                            );
                        }

                        location =
                                response.headers()
                                        .firstValue(
                                                "location"
                                        )
                                        .orElseThrow(() ->
                                                new BadRequestException(
                                                        "Redirect Transfermarkt senza destinazione"
                                                )
                                        );
                    }

                    uri =
                            validate(
                                    uri.resolve(
                                            location
                                    ).toString()
                            );

                    continue;
                }

                if (status < 200
                        || status >= 300) {

                    response.body().close();

                    throw new BadRequestException(
                            "Transfermarkt ha risposto HTTP "
                                    + status
                    );
                }

                String contentType =
                        response.headers()
                                .firstValue(
                                        "content-type"
                                )
                                .orElse("")
                                .toLowerCase(
                                        Locale.ROOT
                                );

                if (!contentType.contains(
                        "text/html"
                )) {
                    response.body().close();

                    throw new BadRequestException(
                            "Transfermarkt non ha restituito HTML"
                    );
                }

                try (
                        var input =
                                response.body();
                        var output =
                                new ByteArrayOutputStream()
                ) {
                    byte[] buffer =
                            new byte[8192];

                    int total = 0;
                    int read;

                    while (
                            (read =
                                    input.read(
                                            buffer
                                    )) != -1
                    ) {
                        total += read;

                        if (total
                                > properties
                                        .getMaxBytes()) {
                            throw new BadRequestException(
                                    "HTML Transfermarkt supera il limite configurato"
                            );
                        }

                        output.write(
                                buffer,
                                0,
                                read
                        );
                    }

                    if (total == 0) {
                        throw new BadRequestException(
                                "HTML Transfermarkt vuoto"
                        );
                    }

                    return new FetchPage(
                            output.toString(
                                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                            ),
                            uri.toString(),
                            status,
                            total
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        catch (BadRequestException exception) {
            throw exception;
        }
        catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Richiesta Transfermarkt fallita",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    URI validate(String value) {
        try {
            URI uri =
                    URI.create(value);

            if (!uri.isAbsolute()
                    || uri.getHost() == null
                    || uri.getUserInfo() != null) {
                throw new BadRequestException(
                        "URL Transfermarkt non valido"
                );
            }

            if (!"https".equalsIgnoreCase(
                    uri.getScheme()
            )) {
                throw new BadRequestException(
                        "Transfermarkt discovery richiede HTTPS"
                );
            }

            String host =
                    uri.getHost()
                            .toLowerCase(
                                    Locale.ROOT
                            );

            if (!host.equals(
                    "transfermarkt.com"
            )
                    && !host.endsWith(
                            ".transfermarkt.com"
                    )) {
                throw new BadRequestException(
                        "Host Transfermarkt non consentito"
                );
            }

            for (InetAddress address :
                    InetAddress.getAllByName(
                            uri.getHost()
                    )) {

                if (address.isAnyLocalAddress()
                        || address.isLoopbackAddress()
                        || address.isLinkLocalAddress()
                        || address.isSiteLocalAddress()) {
                    throw new BadRequestException(
                            "Host Transfermarkt privato/locale non consentito"
                    );
                }
            }

            return uri;
        }
        catch (BadRequestException exception) {
            throw exception;
        }
        catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "URL Transfermarkt non valido",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    private void throttle() {
        long waitMillis =
                properties
                        .getMinIntervalMillis()
                        - (
                                System.currentTimeMillis()
                                        - lastRequestAt
                        );

        if (waitMillis <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            Thread.sleep(waitMillis);
        }
        catch (InterruptedException exception) {
            Thread.currentThread()
                    .interrupt();

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Transfermarkt discovery interrotta",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    public record SearchPage(
            String html,
            String finalUrl,
            int httpStatus,
            long payloadBytes
    ) {
    }

    public record ProfilePage(
            String html,
            String finalUrl,
            int httpStatus,
            long payloadBytes
    ) {
    }

    private record FetchPage(
            String html,
            String finalUrl,
            int httpStatus,
            long payloadBytes
    ) {
    }
}

        this.persistenceService = persistenceService;
    }

    @PostMapping("/run")
    public TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse run(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "#{@currentSeasonResolver.resolve()}") String season,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String club,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "30") int limit) {
        return discoveryService.discover(
                season,
                club,
                limit);
    }

    @PostMapping("/persist")
    public TransfermarktPersistenceResponse persist(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "#{@currentSeasonResolver.resolve()}") String season,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String club,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "30") int limit) {
        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse discovery = discoveryService.discover(
                season,
                club,

                season,
                discovery);

                discovery.season(),
                discovery.club(),
                discovery.requestedPlayers(),
                discovery.matchedVerified(),
                discovery.reviewRequired(),
                discovery.notFound(),

            "https://www.transfermarkt.com/schnellsuche/ergebnis/schnellsuche?query={query}";
    private Duration connectTimeout = Duration.ofSeconds(5);
    private Duration requestTimeout = Duration.ofSeconds(15);
    private int maxBytes = 1_500_000;
    private int maxRedirects = 3;
    private long minIntervalMillis = 1_200L;

    public void validateEnabledConfiguration() {
        if (!enabled) {
            return;
        }
        if (searchUrlTemplate == null
                || searchUrlTemplate.isBlank()
                || !searchUrlTemplate.contains("{query}")) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "app.transfermarkt-discovery.search-url-template deve contenere {query}"
            );

                || connectTimeout.isZero()
                || connectTimeout.isNegative()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "app.transfermarkt-discovery.connect-timeout deve essere > 0"
            );
        }
        if (requestTimeout == null
                || requestTimeout.isZero()
                || requestTimeout.isNegative()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "app.transfermarkt-discovery.request-timeout deve essere > 0"
            );

        if (maxBytes <= 0) {

                    "app.transfermarkt-discovery.max-bytes deve essere > 0"

        if (maxRedirects < 0) {
