package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.time.LocalDate;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@Service
public class TransfermarktDiscoveryService {

    // Search is a fallback: an existing verified Transfermarkt ID is authoritative identity evidence.
    private static final int MAX_PROFILE_CANDIDATES = 8;

    private final JdbcClient jdbc;
    private final TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties properties;
    private final TransfermarktDiscoveryClient client;
    private final TransfermarktSearchParser searchParser;
    private final TransfermarktProfileParser profileParser;
    private final TransfermarktCandidateMatcher matcher;

    public TransfermarktDiscoveryService(
            JdbcClient jdbc,
            TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties properties,
            TransfermarktDiscoveryClient client,
            TransfermarktSearchParser searchParser,
            TransfermarktProfileParser profileParser,
            TransfermarktCandidateMatcher matcher
    ) {
        this.jdbc = jdbc;
        this.properties = properties;
        this.client = client;
        this.searchParser = searchParser;
        this.profileParser = profileParser;
        this.matcher = matcher;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse discover(
            String season,
            String club,
            int limit
    ) {
        if (!properties.isEnabled()) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Transfermarkt discovery disabilitata"
            );
        }

        if (season == null || season.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Season obbligatoria"
            );
        }

        if (limit < 1 || limit > 50) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "limit deve essere compreso tra 1 e 50"
            );
        }

        List<OperationalPlayer> players =
                loadOperationalPlayers(
                        season,
                        club,
                        limit
                );

        List<TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery> output =
                new ArrayList<>();

        int matched = 0;
        int review = 0;
        int notFound = 0;
        int failed = 0;

        for (OperationalPlayer player : players) {
            try {
                PlayerResolution resolution =
                        resolvePlayer(player);

                switch (resolution.status()) {
                    case "MATCHED_VERIFIED" -> matched++;
                    case "REVIEW_REQUIRED" -> review++;
                    default -> notFound++;
                }

                output.add(
                        result(
                                player,
                                resolution.status(),
                                resolution.score(),
                                resolution.candidate(),
                                resolution.profile(),
                                resolution.reason()
                        )
                );
            }
            catch (RuntimeException exception) {
                failed++;

                output.add(
                        new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery(
                                player.id(),
                                player.name(),
                                player.club(),
                                "FAILED",
                                0,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                safeMessage(exception)
                        )
                );
            }
        }

        return new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse(
                season,
                club,
                players.size(),
                matched,
                review,
                notFound,
                failed,
                false,
                List.copyOf(output)
        );
    }

    /**
     * Production automation path.
     *
     * Unlike the existing manual discover(...) method this method only
     * selects operational players whose identity is still incomplete and
     * whose retry cooldown is eligible.
     *
     * Existing manual discovery semantics remain unchanged.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse discoverIncomplete(
            String season,
            int limit
    ) {

        if (!properties.isEnabled()) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Transfermarkt discovery disabilitata"
            );
        }

        if (season == null || season.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Season obbligatoria"
            );
        }

        if (limit < 1 || limit > 50) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "limit deve essere compreso tra 1 e 50"
            );
        }

        List<OperationalPlayer> players =
                loadIncompleteOperationalPlayers(
                        season,
                        limit
                );

        List<TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery> output =
                new ArrayList<>();

        int matched = 0;
        int review = 0;
        int notFound = 0;
        int failed = 0;

        for (OperationalPlayer player : players) {

            try {

                PlayerResolution resolution =
                        resolvePlayer(player);

                switch (resolution.status()) {
                    case "MATCHED_VERIFIED" -> matched++;
                    case "REVIEW_REQUIRED" -> review++;
                    default -> notFound++;
                }

                output.add(
                        result(
                                player,
                                resolution.status(),
                                resolution.score(),
                                resolution.candidate(),
                                resolution.profile(),
                                resolution.reason()
                        )
                );

            }
            catch (RuntimeException exception) {

                failed++;

                output.add(
                        new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery(
                                player.id(),
                                player.name(),
                                player.club(),
                                "FAILED",
                                0,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                safeMessage(exception)
                        )
                );
            }
        }

        return new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse(
                season,
                null,
                players.size(),
                matched,
                review,
                notFound,
                failed,
                false,
                List.copyOf(output)
        );
    }
    private PlayerResolution resolvePlayer(
            OperationalPlayer player
    ) {
        var knownCandidate =
                knownTransfermarktCandidate(player);

        if (knownCandidate.isPresent()) {
            PlayerResolution direct =
                    resolvePlayerFromCandidates(
                            player,
                            List.of(knownCandidate.get())
                    );

            if ("MATCHED_VERIFIED".equals(
                    direct.status()
            )) {
                return direct;
            }

            List<TransfermarktCandidate> searched =
                    searchKnownCandidateById(player);

            if (!searched.isEmpty()) {
                PlayerResolution fallback =
                        resolvePlayerFromCandidates(
                                player,
                                searched
                        );

                if ("MATCHED_VERIFIED".equals(
                        fallback.status()
                )) {
                    return fallback;
                }
            }

            return direct;
        }

        return resolvePlayerFromCandidates(
                player,
                searchCandidates(
                        firstNonBlank(
                                player.canonicalFullName(),
                                player.name()
                        )
                )
        );
    }

    private PlayerResolution resolvePlayerFromCandidates(
            OperationalPlayer player,
            List<TransfermarktCandidate> candidates
    ) {

        if (candidates.isEmpty()) {
            return new PlayerResolution(
                    "NOT_FOUND",
                    0,
                    null,
                    null,
                    "Nessun candidato Transfermarkt"
            );
        }

        List<ScoredCandidate> ranked =
                candidates.stream()
                        .map(candidate ->
                                new ScoredCandidate(
                                        candidate,
                                        matcher.score(
                                                firstNonBlank(
                                                        player.canonicalFullName(),
                                                        player.name()
                                                ),
                                                player.club(),
                                                candidate
                                        )
                                )
                        )
                        .filter(item ->
                                item.score() >= 55
                        )
                        .sorted(
                                Comparator.comparingInt(
                                        ScoredCandidate::score
                                ).reversed()
                        )
                        .limit(MAX_PROFILE_CANDIDATES)
                        .toList();

        if (ranked.isEmpty()) {
            return new PlayerResolution(
                    "NOT_FOUND",
                    0,
                    null,
                    null,
                    "Nessun candidato raggiunge la soglia minima"
            );
        }

        List<VerifiedCandidate> verified =
                new ArrayList<>();

        List<VerifiedCandidate> reviewable =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (ScoredCandidate scored : ranked) {
            try {
                TransfermarktDiscoveryClient.ProfilePage page =
                        client.fetchProfile(
                                scored.candidate().url()
                        );

                TransfermarktProfile profile =
                        profileParser.parse(
                                page.html(),
                                page.finalUrl()
                        );

                Verification verification =
                        verifyProfile(
                                player,
                                scored.candidate(),
                                profile
                        );

                VerifiedCandidate checked =
                        new VerifiedCandidate(
                                scored,
                                profile,
                                verification
                        );

                if ("MATCHED_VERIFIED".equals(
                        verification.status()
                )) {
                    verified.add(checked);
                }
                else if ("REVIEW_REQUIRED".equals(
                        verification.status()
                )) {
                    reviewable.add(checked);
                }
            }
            catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
                // A single remote candidate must never abort the player.
            }
        }

        if (verified.size() == 1) {
            VerifiedCandidate winner =
                    verified.getFirst();

            return new PlayerResolution(
                    "MATCHED_VERIFIED",
                    winner.scored().score(),
                    winner.scored().candidate(),
                    winner.profile(),
                    winner.verification().reason()
            );
        }

        if (verified.size() > 1) {
            VerifiedCandidate best =
                    verified.stream()
                            .max(
                                    Comparator.comparingInt(
                                            item ->
                                                    item.scored()
                                                            .score()
                                    )
                            )
                            .orElseThrow();

            return new PlayerResolution(
                    "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
                    best.scored().score(),
                    best.scored().candidate(),
                    best.profile(),
                    "Piu profili Transfermarkt compatibili: review obbligatoria"
            );
        }

        if (!reviewable.isEmpty()) {
            VerifiedCandidate best =
                    reviewable.stream()
                            .max(
                                    Comparator.comparingInt(
                                            item ->
                                                    item.scored()
                                                            .score()
                                    )
                            )
                            .orElseThrow();

            return new PlayerResolution(
                    "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
                    best.scored().score(),
                    best.scored().candidate(),
                    best.profile(),
                    best.verification().reason()
            );
        }

        return new PlayerResolution(
                "NOT_FOUND",
                ranked.getFirst().score(),
                ranked.getFirst().candidate(),
                null,
                "Nessun profilo candidato ha superato la verifica"
        );
    }

    private List<TransfermarktCandidate> searchCandidates(
            String playerName
    ) {
        Map<String, TransfermarktCandidate> unique =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (String query : searchQueries(playerName)) {
            TransfermarktDiscoveryClient.SearchPage page =
                    client.search(query);

            for (TransfermarktCandidate candidate :
                    searchParser.parse(
                            page.html(),
                            page.finalUrl()
                    )) {
                unique.putIfAbsent(
                        candidate.transfermarktPlayerId(),
                        candidate
                );
            }

            /*
             * If the exact Fantacalcio query already gives useful
             * candidates, avoid an unnecessary second remote request.
             */
            if (!unique.isEmpty()) {
                break;
            }
        }

        return List.copyOf(
                unique.values()
        );
    }

    private List<TransfermarktCandidate> searchKnownCandidateById(
            OperationalPlayer player
    ) {
        Map<String, TransfermarktCandidate> matching =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        List<String> queries =
                new ArrayList<>();

        queries.add(
                firstNonBlank(
                        player.canonicalFullName(),
                        player.name()
                )
        );

        for (String query : searchQueries(player.name())) {
            if (!queries.contains(query)) {
                queries.add(query);
            }
        }

        for (String query : queries) {
            TransfermarktDiscoveryClient.SearchPage page =
                    client.search(query);

            searchParser.parse(
                            page.html(),
                            page.finalUrl()
                    )
                    .stream()
                    .filter(candidate ->
                            player.transfermarktPlayerId()
                                    .equals(
                                            candidate.transfermarktPlayerId()
                                    )
                    )
                    .forEach(candidate ->
                            matching.putIfAbsent(
                                    candidate.transfermarktPlayerId(),
                                    candidate
                            )
                    );
        }

        return List.copyOf(
                matching.values()
        );
    }

    List<String> searchQueries(
            String playerName
    ) {
        if (playerName == null || playerName.isBlank()) {
            return List.of();
        }

        String original =
                playerName.trim();

        String simplified =
                original
                        .replaceAll(
                                "(?i)\\s+[A-Z](?:\\.[A-Z])?\\.?$",
                                ""
                        )
                        .replaceAll(
                                "(?i)\\s+[A-Z]\\.[A-Z]\\.$",
                                ""
                        )
                        .trim();

        if (simplified.equalsIgnoreCase(original)
                || simplified.isBlank()) {
            return List.of(original);
        }

        return List.of(
                original,
                simplified
        );
    }

    Verification verifyProfile(
            OperationalPlayer player,
            TransfermarktCandidate candidate,
            TransfermarktProfile profile
    ) {
        if (profile == null) {
            return new Verification(
                    "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
                    "Profilo Transfermarkt non leggibile"
            );
        }

        if (profile.transfermarktPlayerId() != null
                && !profile.transfermarktPlayerId()
                        .equals(
                                candidate.transfermarktPlayerId()
                        )) {
            return new Verification(
                    "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
                    "ID profilo diverso dal candidato"
            );
        }

        String expectedName =
                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                        .normalize(
                                firstNonBlank(
                                        player.canonicalFullName(),
                                        player.name()
                                )
                        );

        String profileName =
                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                        .normalize(
                                profile.fullName()
                        );

        String displayName =
                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                        .normalize(
                                player.name()
                        );

        if (player.birthDate() != null
                && profile.birthDate() != null
                && !player.birthDate().equals(
                        profile.birthDate()
                )) {
            return new Verification(
                    "NOT_FOUND",
                    "Data di nascita Transfermarkt diversa dal profilo identita locale"
            );
        }

        boolean strongIdentity =
                profile.birthDate() != null
                        && player.birthDate() != null
                        && profile.birthDate().equals(
                                player.birthDate()
                        )
                        && player.transfermarktPlayerId() != null
                        && player.transfermarktPlayerId().equals(
                                profile.transfermarktPlayerId()
                        );

        boolean compatibleName =
                matcher.surnameCompatible(
                        expectedName,
                        profileName
                )
                || expectedName.equals(
                        profileName
                )
                || (
                        (player.canonicalFullName() == null
                                || player.canonicalFullName().isBlank())
                                && matcher.surnameCompatible(
                                        displayName,
                                        profileName
                                )
                );

        boolean strongProfessionalNameCompatibility =
                strongIdentity
                        && hasStrongSharedNameToken(
                                expectedName,
                                profileName
                        );

        if (!compatibleName
                && !strongProfessionalNameCompatibility) {
            return new Verification(
                    "NOT_FOUND",
                    "Nome del profilo non coerente con Fantacalcio"
            );
        }

        /*
         * A Fantacalcio suffix such as "O." or "K." is useful
         * when identity evidence is weak.
         *
         * With an already verified Transfermarkt ID and an exact
         * birth-date match, however, that suffix must not reject
         * legitimate professional names such as:
         *
         * Vitinha O. -> Vitinha
         * Gaspar K.  -> Gaspar
         */
        if (!strongIdentity
                && !initialCompatible(
                        player.name(),
                        profile.fullName()
                )) {
            return new Verification(
                    "NOT_FOUND",
                    "Iniziale Fantacalcio non coerente con il nome Transfermarkt"
            );
        }

        String expectedClub =
                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                        .normalize(
                                player.club()
                        );

        String profileClub =
                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                        .normalize(
                                profile.currentClub()
                        );

        if (profileClub.isBlank()) {
            if (strongIdentity) {
                return new Verification(
                        "MATCHED_VERIFIED",
                        "Identita verificata con ID, nome canonico e data di nascita; roster Transfermarkt non leggibile"
                );
            }

            return new Verification(
                    "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
                    "Squadra corrente non leggibile dal profilo"
            );
        }

        if (!clubCompatible(
                expectedClub,
                profileClub
        )) {
            if (strongIdentity) {
                return new Verification(
                        "MATCHED_VERIFIED",
                        "Identita verificata con ID, nome canonico e data di nascita; roster Transfermarkt temporalmente diverso: "
                                + profile.currentClub()
                );
            }

            return new Verification(
                    "NOT_FOUND",
                    "Squadra Transfermarkt diversa da Fantacalcio: "
                            + profile.currentClub()
            );
        }

        if (profile.birthDate() == null) {
            return new Verification(
                    "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
                    "Data di nascita non leggibile dal profilo"
            );
        }

        return new Verification(
                "MATCHED_VERIFIED",
                "Nome, squadra e data di nascita verificati sul profilo Transfermarkt"
        );
    }

    boolean initialCompatible(
            String fantacalcioName,
            String transfermarktName
    ) {
        if (fantacalcioName == null
                || transfermarktName == null) {
            return true;
        }

        String trimmed =
                fantacalcioName.trim();

        /*
         * Handles catalog forms such as:
         * Rossi F.       -> Francesco Rossi
         * Kristensen T.  -> Thomas Kristensen
         * Sulemana I.    -> Ibrahim Sulemana
         *
         * Do not interpret compound abbreviations such as D.S.
         * as a first-name initial.
         */
        var matcher =
                java.util.regex.Pattern
                        .compile(
                                "^(.+?)\\s+([A-Za-z])\\.$"
                        )
                        .matcher(trimmed);

        if (!matcher.matches()) {
            return true;
        }

        String surname =
                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                        .normalize(
                                matcher.group(1)
                        );

        char initial =
                Character.toLowerCase(
                        matcher.group(2)
                                .charAt(0)
                );

        String normalizedProfile =
                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                        .normalize(
                                transfermarktName
                        );

        if (!normalizedProfile.contains(surname)) {
            return false;
        }

        String[] tokens =
                normalizedProfile.split(" ");

        if (tokens.length < 2
                || tokens[0].isBlank()) {
            return false;
        }

        return tokens[0]
                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
                .charAt(0) == initial;
    }

    private boolean clubCompatible(
            String expected,
            String actual
    ) {
        if (expected.isBlank()
                || actual.isBlank()) {
            return false;
        }

        return actual.contains(expected)
                || expected.contains(actual);
    }

    private boolean hasStrongSharedNameToken(
            String expected,
            String actual
    ) {
        if (expected == null
                || expected.isBlank()
                || actual == null
                || actual.isBlank()) {
            return false;
        }

        Set<String> expectedTokens =
                Set.of(expected.split(" "));

        return Arrays.stream(actual.split(" "))
                .filter(token ->
                        token.length() >= 6
                )
                .anyMatch(expectedTokens::contains);
    }

    private long sharedNameTokens(
            String expected,
            String actual
    ) {
        Set<String> expectedTokens =
                Set.of(expected.split(" "));

        return Arrays.stream(actual.split(" "))
                .filter(token -> token.length() >= 2)
                .filter(expectedTokens::contains)
                .distinct()
                .count();
    }

    private TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery result(
            OperationalPlayer player,
            String status,
            int score,
            TransfermarktCandidate candidate,
            TransfermarktProfile profile,

    ) {
        return new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery(
                player.id(),
                player.name(),
                player.club(),
                status,
                score,
                candidate == null
                        ? null
                        : candidate.transfermarktPlayerId(),
                profile != null
                        && profile.fullName() != null
                                ? profile.fullName()
                                : candidate == null
                                        ? null
                                        : candidate.name(),
                profile != null
                        && profile.profileUrl() != null
                                ? profile.profileUrl()
                                : candidate == null
                                        ? null
                                        : candidate.url(),
                profile == null
                        ? null
                        : profile.currentClub(),
                profile == null
                        ? null
                        : profile.birthDate(),
                profile == null
                        ? null
                        : profile.nationality(),
                profile == null
                        ? null
                        : profile.heightCm(),
                profile == null
                        ? null
                        : profile.preferredFoot(),
                reason
        );
    }

    private List<OperationalPlayer> loadOperationalPlayers(
            String season,
            String club,
            int limit
    ) {
        String clubFilter =
                club == null || club.isBlank()
                        ? ""
                        : " AND LOWER(c.name) = LOWER(:club) ";

        var query =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            p.id,
                            p.display_name,
                            c.name AS club_name,
                            COALESCE(
                                identity.canonical_full_name,
                                identity_override.canonical_full_name
                            ) AS canonical_full_name,
                            COALESCE(
                                identity.birth_date,
                                identity_override.birth_date
                            ) AS birth_date,
                            COALESCE(
                                identity.transfermarkt_player_id,
                                identity_override.transfermarkt_player_id
                            ) AS transfermarkt_player_id
                        FROM player_reconciliation_results result
                        JOIN seasons s
                          ON s.id = result.season_id
                         AND s.code = :season
                        JOIN players p
                          ON p.id = result.player_id
                         AND p.active = TRUE
                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                          ON registration.player_id = p.id
                         AND registration.season_id = s.id
                         AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                        JOIN clubs c
                          ON c.id = registration.club_id
                        LEFT JOIN player_identity_profiles identity
                          ON identity.player_id = p.id

                        LEFT JOIN verified_identity_overrides identity_override
                          ON identity_override.season_code = s.code
                         AND LOWER(identity_override.club_name) = LOWER(c.name)
                         AND LOWER(identity_override.player_display_name) =
                             LOWER(p.display_name)

                        WHERE 1 = 1
                        """
                        + clubFilter
                        + """
                        ORDER BY c.name, p.display_name, p.id
                        LIMIT :limit
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "season",
                                season
                        )
                        .param(
                                "limit",
                                limit
                        );

        if (club != null && !club.isBlank()) {
            query =
                    query.param(
                            "club",
                            club.trim()
                    );
        }

        return query
                .query((rs, rowNumber) ->
                        new OperationalPlayer(
                                rs.getLong("id"),
                                rs.getString("display_name"),
                                rs.getString("club_name"),
                                rs.getString("canonical_full_name"),
                                rs.getObject(
                                        "birth_date",
                                        LocalDate.class
                                ),
                                rs.getString("transfermarkt_player_id")
                        )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private String safeMessage(
            RuntimeException exception
    ) {
        String message =
                exception.getMessage();

        if (message == null || message.isBlank()) {
            return exception
                    .getClass()
                    .getSimpleName();
        }

        return message.length() > 300
                ? message.substring(0, 300)
                : message;
    }

    private String firstNonBlank(
            String first,
            String second
    ) {
        return first != null && !first.isBlank()
                ? first
                : second;
    }

    private java.util.Optional<TransfermarktCandidate> knownTransfermarktCandidate(
            OperationalPlayer player
    ) {
        if (player.transfermarktPlayerId() == null
                || player.transfermarktPlayerId().isBlank()) {
            return java.util.Optional.empty();
        }

        String id = player.transfermarktPlayerId().trim();
        String normalizedSlug =
                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                        .normalize(
                                firstNonBlank(
                                        player.canonicalFullName(),
                                        player.name()
                                )
                        );

        String[] slugTokens =
                normalizedSlug.split(" ");

        String slug =
                slugTokens.length >= 5
                        ? slugTokens[0]
                        : normalizedSlug.replace(' ', '-');

        return java.util.Optional.of(
                new TransfermarktCandidate(
                        id,
                        firstNonBlank(
                                player.canonicalFullName(),
                                player.name()
                        ),
                        "https://www.transfermarkt.com/"
                                + slug
                                + "/profil/spieler/"
                                + id,
                        player.club()
                )
        );
    }

    static record OperationalPlayer(
            Long id,

    ) {
    }

    ) {
    }

    ) {
    }

            ScoredCandidate scored,

    ) {
    }

    private record PlayerResolution(
            String status,
            int score,
            TransfermarktCandidate candidate,
            TransfermarktProfile profile,
            String reason
    ) {
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import java.nio.charset.Charset;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

@Component
public class TransfermarktProfileParser {

    private static final Pattern PLAYER_ID =
            Pattern.compile("/profil/spieler/([1-9][0-9]*)");

    private static final Pattern DATE_DMY =
            Pattern.compile(
                    "(?i)(?:Date of birth/Age|Date of birth|Geburtsdatum|Data di nascita)\\s*:\\s*"
                            + "(\\d{2}[./]\\d{2}[./]\\d{4})"
            );

    private static final Pattern HEIGHT =
            Pattern.compile(
                    "(?i)(?:Height|GrÃƒÂ¶ÃƒÅ¸e|Altezza)\\s*:\\s*"
                            + "([12][,.]\\d{2})\\s*m"
            );

    private static final Pattern CITIZENSHIP =
            Pattern.compile(
                    "(?i)(?:Citizenship|StaatsbÃƒÂ¼rgerschaft|NazionalitÃƒÂ )\\s*:\\s*"
                            + "(.+?)(?=\\s+(?:Height|Position|Foot|Player agent|Current club|Joined|Contract expires|Date of death)\\s*:|$)"
            );

    private static final Pattern FOOT =
            Pattern.compile(
                    "(?i)(?:Foot|FuÃƒÅ¸|Piede)\\s*:\\s*"
                            + "(right|left|both|rechts|links|beidfÃƒÂ¼ÃƒÅ¸ig|destro|sinistro|entrambi)"
            );

    private static final Pattern CURRENT_CLUB =
            Pattern.compile(
                    "(?i)Current club\\s*:\\s*(.+?)"
                            + "(?=\\s+(?:Joined|Contract expires|Outfitter|Social-Media)\\s*:|$)"
            );

    public TransfermarktProfile parse(
            String html,
            String profileUrl
    ) {
        if (html == null || html.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "HTML profilo Transfermarkt vuoto"
            );
        }

        Document document =
                Jsoup.parse(
                        html,
                        profileUrl == null ? "" : profileUrl
                );

        String body =
                clean(
                        document.body() == null
                                ? document.text()
                                : document.body().text()
                );

        String fullName =
                cleanName(
                        firstNonBlank(
                                text(
                                        document,
                                        "h1.data-header__headline-wrapper"
                                ),
                                attr(
                                        document,
                                        "meta[property=og:title]",
                                        "content"
                                )
                        )
                );

        LocalDate birthDate =
                parseDate(
                        group(
                                DATE_DMY,
                                body
                        )
                );

        Integer heightCm =
                parseHeight(
                        group(
                                HEIGHT,
                                body
                        )
                );

        String nationality =
                normalizeCitizenship(
                        group(
                                CITIZENSHIP,
                                body
                        )
                );

        String preferredFoot =
                normalizeFoot(
                        group(
                                FOOT,
                                body
                        )
                );

        String currentClub =
                cleanClub(
                        firstNonBlank(
                                text(
                                        document,
                                        "span.data-header__club"
                                ),
                                text(
                                        document,
                                        "div.data-header__club-info span"
                                ),
                                text(
                                        document,
                                        "div.data-header__club-info a"
                                ),
                                group(
                                        CURRENT_CLUB,
                                        body
                                )
                        )
                );

        return new TransfermarktProfile(
                playerId(profileUrl),
                fullName,
                birthDate,
                nationality,
                heightCm,
                preferredFoot,
                currentClub,
                profileUrl
        );
    }

    private String playerId(String url) {
        if (url == null) {
            return null;
        }

        Matcher matcher =
                PLAYER_ID.matcher(url);

        return matcher.find()
                ? matcher.group(1)
                : null;
    }

    private String group(
            Pattern pattern,
            String input
    ) {
        if (input == null) {
            return null;
        }

        Matcher matcher =
                pattern.matcher(input);

        return matcher.find()
                ? clean(matcher.group(1))
                : null;
    }

    private LocalDate parseDate(
            String value
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String normalized =
                value.replace('.', '/');

        try {
            return LocalDate.parse(
                    normalized,
                    DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(
                            "dd/MM/yyyy",
                            Locale.ROOT
                    )
            );
        }
        catch (DateTimeParseException exception) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private Integer parseHeight(
            String value
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String normalized =
                value.replace(',', '.');

        try {
            double metres =
                    Double.parseDouble(
                            normalized
                    );

            return (int) Math.round(
                    metres * 100.0
            );
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException exception) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private String normalizeCitizenship(
            String value
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String cleaned =
                value.replaceAll(
                                "(?i)Image:\\s*",
                                ""
                        )
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        )
                        .trim();

        /*
         * Transfermarkt may expose multiple citizenships.
         * Keep the source text rather than inventing one.
         */
        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;
    }

    private String normalizeFoot(
            String value
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String normalized =
                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                        .normalize(value);

        if (normalized.contains("right")
                || normalized.contains("rechts")
                || normalized.contains("destro")) {
            return "RIGHT";
        }

        if (normalized.contains("left")
                || normalized.contains("links")
                || normalized.contains("sinistro")) {
            return "LEFT";
        }

        if (normalized.contains("both")
                || normalized.contains("beidf")
                || normalized.contains("entrambi")) {
            return "BOTH";
        }

        return null;
    }

    private String cleanName(
            String value
    ) {
        String cleaned =
                clean(value);

        if (cleaned == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String normalized =
                cleaned
                        .replaceFirst(
                                "^#\\d+\\s+",
                                ""
                        )
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s*-\\s*Player profile.*$",
                                ""
                        )
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s*\\|\\s*Transfermarkt.*$",
                                ""
                        )
                        .trim();

        return repairMojibake(normalized);
    }

    private String cleanClub(
            String value
    ) {
        String cleaned =
                clean(value);

        if (cleaned == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String normalized =
                repairMojibake(
                        cleaned
                                .replaceFirst(
                                        "(?i)\\s+Serie A.*$",
                                        ""
                                )
                                .trim()
                );

        if (normalized == null
                || normalized.length() > 100
                || normalized.contains("Transfermarkt Videos")
                || normalized.contains("Quick Links")
                || normalized.contains("Legal notice")) {
            return null;
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    String repairMojibake(
            String value
    ) {
        if (value == null
                || value.isBlank()) {
            return value;
        }

        int originalScore =
                mojibakeScore(value);

        if (originalScore == 0) {
            return value;
        }

        try {
            byte[] bytes =
                    value.getBytes(
                            Charset.forName(
                                    "windows-1252"
                            )
                    );

            String repaired =
                    new String(
                            bytes,
                            StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                    );

            if (repaired.indexOf('\uFFFD') >= 0) {
                return value;
            }

            int repairedScore =
                    mojibakeScore(repaired);

            return repairedScore < originalScore
                    ? repaired
                    : value;
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
            return value;
        }
    }

    private int mojibakeScore(
            String value
    ) {
        int score = 0;

        for (int index = 0;
                index < value.length();
                index++) {

            char character =
                    value.charAt(index);

            /*
             * Common UTF-8 -> Windows-1252 mojibake lead
             * characters, expressed numerically so the Java
             * source itself is encoding-independent.
             */
            if (character == '\u00C2'
                    || character == '\u00C3'
                    || character == '\u00C4'
                    || character == '\u00C5') {
                score += 2;
            }

            /*
             * C1 control range is another strong corruption
             * signal after an incorrect character decoding.
             */
            if (character >= '\u0080'
                    && character <= '\u009F') {
                score += 3;
            }
        }

        return score;
    }
    private String text(
            Document document,
            String selector
    ) {
        Element element =
                document.selectFirst(
                        selector
                );

        return element == null
                ? null
                : clean(
                        element.text()
                );
    }

    private String attr(
            Document document,
            String selector,
            String attribute
    ) {
        Element element =
                document.selectFirst(
                        selector
                );

        return element == null
                ? null
                : clean(
                        element.attr(
                                attribute
                        )
                );
    }

    private String firstNonBlank(
            String... values
    ) {
        for (String value : values) {
            if (value != null
                    && !value.isBlank()) {
                return value;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String cleaned =
                value
                        .replace('\u00A0', ' ')
                        .replaceAll(
                                "\\s+",
                                " "
                        )
                        .trim();

        return cleaned.isBlank()
                ? null
                : cleaned;
    }

    @Transactional

        int persistedFields = 0;

        for (
                TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery player
                : response.players()
        ) {
            if (!"MATCHED_VERIFIED".equals(player.status())) {
                continue;
            }

            if (isBlank(player.transfermarktPlayerId())) {
                continue;
            }

            ensureIdentityProfile(player);
            fillMissingCanonicalFields(player);

            persistedFields += persistField(
                    player,
                    season,
                    "CANONICAL_FULL_NAME",
                    player.transfermarktName()
            );

            persistedFields += persistField(
                    player,
                    season,
                    "BIRTH_DATE",
                    player.birthDate()
            );

            persistedFields += persistField(
                    player,
                    season,
                    "NATIONALITY",
                    player.nationality()
            );

            persistedFields += persistField(
                    player,
                    season,
                    "HEIGHT_CM",
                    player.heightCm()
            );

            persistedFields += persistField(
                    player,
                    season,
                    "PREFERRED_FOOT",
                    player.preferredFoot()
            );

            persistedFields += persistField(
                    player,
                    season,
                    "TRANSFERMARKT_PLAYER_ID",
                    player.transfermarktPlayerId()
            );
        }

        return persistedFields;
    }

    /**
     * Automatic discovery can legitimately find a newly reconciled player
     * before a player_identity_profiles row has ever been imported.
     *
     * Only MATCHED_VERIFIED players reach this method.
     *
     * A new profile is therefore created as VERIFIED_PARTIAL/HIGH using
     * source-verified name and birth date. Existing profiles are never
     * replaced here.
     */
    private void ensureIdentityProfile(
            TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery player
    ) {

        if (
                isBlank(player.transfermarktName())
                        || player.birthDate() == null
        ) {
            return;
        }

        String nationality =
                clean(player.nationality());

        String nationalityCode =
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        nationality,
                        null,
                        player.transfermarktPlayerId()
                );

        jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_identity_profiles (
                    player_id,
                    canonical_full_name,
                    birth_date,
                    nationality,
                    nationality_code,
                    height_cm,
                    preferred_foot,
                    transfermarkt_player_id,
                    identity_status,
                    confidence
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :canonicalFullName,
                    :birthDate,
                    :nationality,
                    :nationalityCode,
                    :heightCm,
                    :preferredFoot,
                    :transfermarktPlayerId,
                    'VERIFIED_PARTIAL',
                    'HIGH'
                )
                ON CONFLICT (player_id)
                DO NOTHING
                """)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        player.playerId()
                )
                .param(
                        "canonicalFullName",
                        player.transfermarktName(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "birthDate",
                        player.birthDate(),
                        Types.DATE
                )
                .param(
                        "nationality",
                        nationality,
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "nationalityCode",
                        nationalityCode,
                        Types.CHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "heightCm",
                        player.heightCm(),
                        Types.SMALLINT
                )
                .param(
                        "preferredFoot",
                        clean(player.preferredFoot()),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "transfermarktPlayerId",
                        player.transfermarktPlayerId(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .update();
    }
    private void fillMissingCanonicalFields(
            TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery player
    ) {
        String nationality =
                clean(player.nationality());

        String nationalityCode =
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        nationality,
                        null,
                        player.transfermarktPlayerId()
                );

        String preferredFoot =
                clean(player.preferredFoot());

        jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE player_identity_profiles
                SET
                    birth_date = COALESCE(
                        birth_date,
                        :birthDate
                    ),
                    nationality = COALESCE(
                        nationality,
                        :nationality
                    ),
                    nationality_code = COALESCE(
                        nationality_code,
                        :nationalityCode
                    ),
                    height_cm = COALESCE(
                        height_cm,
                        :heightCm
                    ),
                    preferred_foot = COALESCE(
                        preferred_foot,
                        :preferredFoot
                    ),
                    transfermarkt_player_id = COALESCE(
                        transfermarkt_player_id,
                        :transfermarktPlayerId
                    ),
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                """)
                .param(
                        "birthDate",
                        player.birthDate(),
                        Types.DATE
                )
                .param(
                        "nationality",
                        nationality,
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "nationalityCode",
                        nationalityCode,
                        Types.CHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "heightCm",
                        player.heightCm(),
                        Types.SMALLINT
                )
                .param(
                        "preferredFoot",
                        preferredFoot,
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "transfermarktPlayerId",
                        player.transfermarktPlayerId(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        player.playerId()
                )
                .update();

        jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE players
                SET
                    birth_date = COALESCE(
                        birth_date,
                        :birthDate
                    ),
                    nationality_code = COALESCE(
                        nationality_code,
                        :nationalityCode
                    ),
                    height_cm = COALESCE(
                        height_cm,
                        :heightCm
                    ),
                    preferred_foot = COALESCE(
                        preferred_foot,
                        :preferredFoot
                    ),
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = :playerId
                """)
                .param(
                        "birthDate",
                        player.birthDate(),
                        Types.DATE
                )
                .param(
                        "nationalityCode",
                        nationalityCode,
                        Types.CHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "heightCm",
                        player.heightCm(),
                        Types.SMALLINT
                )
                .param(
                        "preferredFoot",
                        preferredFoot,
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        player.playerId()
                )
                .update();
    }

    private int persistField(
            TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery player,
            String season,
            String fieldName,
            Object observedValue
    ) {
        if (observedValue == null) {
            return 0;
        }

        String normalizedValue =
                normalizeValue(observedValue);

        if (
                normalizedValue == null
                || normalizedValue.isBlank()
        ) {
            return 0;
        }

        String evidence =
                buildEvidence(
                        normalizedValue,
                        season,
                        player
                );

        jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_identity_provenance (
                    player_id,
                    field_name,
                    source,
                    source_external_id,
                    source_url,
                    confidence,
                    evidence
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :fieldName,
                    :source,
                    :sourceExternalId,
                    :sourceUrl,
                    :confidence,
                    CAST(:evidence AS JSONB)
                )
                ON CONFLICT (
                    player_id,
                    field_name,
                    source,
                    source_external_id
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url,
                    confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence,
                    evidence = EXCLUDED.evidence,
                    imported_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                """)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        player.playerId()
                )
                .param(
                        "fieldName",
                        fieldName
                )
                .param(
                        "source",
                        SOURCE
                )
                .param(
                        "sourceExternalId",
                        player.transfermarktPlayerId()
                )
                .param(
                        "sourceUrl",
                        player.transfermarktUrl(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "confidence",
                        CONFIDENCE
                )
                .param(
                        "evidence",
                        evidence
                )
                .update();

        return 1;
    }

    private String buildEvidence(
            String observedValue,
            String season,
            TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery player
    ) {
        Map<String, Object> evidence =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        evidence.put(
                "value",
                observedValue
        );

        evidence.put(
                "season",
                season
        );

        evidence.put(
                "verification",
                "MATCHED_VERIFIED"
        );

        evidence.put(
                "score",
                player.score()
        );

        if (
                !isBlank(
                        player.transfermarktCurrentClub()
                )
        ) {
            evidence.put(
                    "transfermarktCurrentClub",
                    player.transfermarktCurrentClub()
            );
        }

        if (!isBlank(player.reason())) {
            evidence.put(
                    "reason",
                    player.reason()
            );
        }

        return toJson(evidence);
    }

    private String normalizeValue(
            Object value
    ) {
        if (value instanceof LocalDate localDate) {
            return localDate.toString();
        }

        if (value instanceof Integer integer) {
            return integer.toString();
        }

        return value.toString().trim();
    }

    private String clean(
            String value
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        String cleaned = value.trim();

        return cleaned.isEmpty()
                ? null
                : cleaned;
    }

    private String toJson(
            Map<String, Object> values
    ) {
        StringBuilder json =
                new StringBuilder("{");

        boolean first = true;

        for (
                Map.Entry<String, Object> entry
                : values.entrySet()
        ) {
            if (!first) {
                json.append(',');
            }

            first = false;

            json.append('"')
                    .append(
                            escapeJson(
                                    entry.getKey()
                            )
                    )
                    .append("\":");

            Object value =
                    entry.getValue();

            if (
                    value instanceof Number
                    || value instanceof Boolean
            ) {
                json.append(value);
            } else {
                json.append('"')
                        .append(
                                escapeJson(
                                        String.valueOf(value)
                                )
                        )
                        .append('"');
            }
        }

        json.append('}');

        return json.toString();
    }

    private String escapeJson(
            String value
    ) {
        return value
                .replace("\\", "\\\\")
                .replace("\"", "\\\"")
                .replace("\r", "\\r")
                .replace("\n", "\\n")
                .replace("\t", "\\t");
    }

    private boolean isBlank(
            String value
    ) {
        return value == null
                || value.isBlank();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import org.jsoup.Jsoup;
import org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
import org.jsoup.nodes.Element;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class TransfermarktSearchParser {

    private static final Pattern PLAYER_ID =
            Pattern.compile("/profil/spieler/([1-9][0-9]*)");

    public List<TransfermarktCandidate> parse(
            String html,
            String baseUri
    ) {
        if (html == null || html.isBlank()) {
            return List.of();
        }

        Document document =
                Jsoup.parse(
                        html,
                        baseUri == null ? "" : baseUri
                );

        Map<String, TransfermarktCandidate> candidates =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (Element link :
                document.select(
                        "a[href*=\"/profil/spieler/\"]"
                )) {

            String href = link.absUrl("href");
            if (href == null || href.isBlank()) {
                href = link.attr("href");
            }

            Matcher matcher =
                    PLAYER_ID.matcher(href);

            if (!matcher.find()) {
                continue;
            }

            String id = matcher.group(1);

            String name =
                    firstNonBlank(
                            link.attr("title"),
                            link.text()
                    );

            if (name == null || name.isBlank()) {
                continue;
            }

            Element row = link.closest("tr");

            String context =
                    row == null
                            ? firstNonBlank(
                                    link.parent() == null
                                            ? null
                                            : link.parent().text(),
                                    ""
                            )
                            : row.text();

            candidates.putIfAbsent(
                    id,
                    new TransfermarktCandidate(
                            id,
                            name.trim(),
                            href,
                            context == null
                                    ? ""
                                    : context.trim()
                    )
            );
        }

        return List.copyOf(
                candidates.values()
        );
    }

    private String firstNonBlank(
            String first,
            String second
    ) {
        if (first != null && !first.isBlank()) {
            return first;
        }
        return second;
    }
}
