package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer.admin;

import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class ImportBatchAdminService {

    private static final Set<String> ALLOWED_SOURCES =
            Set.of(
                    "FANTACALCIO",
                    "GAZZETTA",
                    "FANTAMARKT"
            );

    private static final Set<String> ALLOWED_STATUSES =
            Set.of(
                    "PROCESSING",
                    "COMPLETED",
                    "FAILED"
            );

    private static final int DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 20;
    private static final int MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 100;

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public ImportBatchAdminService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ImportBatchPageResponse findBatches(
            String source,
            String season,
            String status,
            int page,
            int size
    ) {
        int safePage = validatePage(page);
        int safeSize = validateSize(size);

        String normalizedSource =
                normalizeSource(source);

        String normalizedStatus =
                normalizeStatus(status);

        String normalizedSeason =
                normalizeOptional(season);

        StringBuilder where = new StringBuilder(
                """
                WHERE 1 = 1
                """
        );

        Map<String, Object> parameters =
                new HashMap<>();

        if (normalizedSource != null) {
            where.append(
                    " AND batch.source = :source "
            );

            parameters.put(
                    "source",
                    normalizedSource
            );
        }

        if (normalizedSeason != null) {
            where.append(
                    " AND season.code = :season "
            );

            parameters.put(
                    "season",
                    normalizedSeason
            );
        }

        if (normalizedStatus != null) {
            where.append(
                    " AND batch.status = :status "
            );

            parameters.put(
                    "status",
                    normalizedStatus
            );
        }

        long totalElements =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM import_batches batch

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = batch.season_id
                        """
                        + where
                )
                        .params(parameters)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        parameters.put(
                "limit",
                safeSize
        );

        parameters.put(
                "offset",
                safePage * safeSize
        );

        List<ImportBatchSummaryResponse> content =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            batch.id,
                            batch.source,
                            season.code AS season_code,
                            batch.original_filename,
                            batch.status,
                            batch.total_rows,
                            batch.valid_rows,
                            batch.invalid_rows,
                            batch.reconciled_rows,
                            batch.started_at,
                            batch.completed_at,
                            batch.reconciliation_started_at,
                            batch.reconciliation_completed_at,
                            batch.error_message

                        FROM import_batches batch

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = batch.season_id
                        """
                        + where
                        + """
                        ORDER BY
                            batch.started_at DESC,
                            batch.id DESC

                        LIMIT :limit
                        OFFSET :offset
                        """
                )
                        .params(parameters)
                        .query(
                                this::mapBatch
                        )
                        .list();

        int totalPages =
                calculateTotalPages(
                        totalElements,
                        safeSize
                );

        return new ImportBatchPageResponse(
                content,
                safePage,
                safeSize,
                totalElements,
                totalPages
        );
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ImportBatchDetailResponse findBatch(
            Long batchId,
            int errorPage,
            int errorSize
    ) {
        if (batchId == null || batchId <= 0) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "ID batch non valido"
            );
        }

        int safeErrorPage =
                validatePage(errorPage);

        int safeErrorSize =
                validateSize(errorSize);

        ImportBatchSummaryResponse batch =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            batch.id,
                            batch.source,
                            season.code AS season_code,
                            batch.original_filename,
                            batch.status,
                            batch.total_rows,
                            batch.valid_rows,
                            batch.invalid_rows,
                            batch.reconciled_rows,
                            batch.started_at,
                            batch.completed_at,
                            batch.reconciliation_started_at,
                            batch.reconciliation_completed_at,
                            batch.error_message

                        FROM import_batches batch

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = batch.season_id

                        WHERE batch.id = :batchId
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "batchId",
                                batchId
                        )
                        .query(
                                this::mapBatch
                        )
                        .optional()
                        .orElseThrow(() ->
                                new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                        "Batch import non trovato: "
                                                + batchId
                                )
                        );

        long totalInvalidRows =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_import_rows
                        WHERE batch_id = :batchId
                          AND valid = FALSE
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "batchId",
                                batchId
                        )
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        List<ImportRowErrorResponse> invalidRows =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            id,
                            row_number,
                            external_id,
                            external_name,
                            club_name,
                            fantasy_role,
                            validation_error,
                            raw_data::TEXT AS raw_data

                        FROM player_import_rows

                        WHERE batch_id = :batchId
                          AND valid = FALSE

                        ORDER BY
                            row_number ASC,
                            id ASC

                        LIMIT :limit
                        OFFSET :offset
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "batchId",
                                batchId
                        )
                        .param(
                                "limit",
                                safeErrorSize
                        )
                        .param(
                                "offset",
                                safeErrorPage
                                        * safeErrorSize
                        )
                        .query(
                                this::mapInvalidRow
                        )
                        .list();

        int totalErrorPages =
                calculateTotalPages(
                        totalInvalidRows,
                        safeErrorSize
                );

        return new ImportBatchDetailResponse(
                batch,
                invalidRows,
                safeErrorPage,
                safeErrorSize,
                totalInvalidRows,
                totalErrorPages
        );
    }

    private ImportBatchSummaryResponse mapBatch(
            ResultSet resultSet,
            int rowNumber
    ) throws SQLException {
        return new ImportBatchSummaryResponse(
                resultSet.getLong("id"),
                resultSet.getString("source"),
                resultSet.getString("season_code"),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "original_filename"
                ),
                resultSet.getString("status"),
                resultSet.getInt("total_rows"),
                resultSet.getInt("valid_rows"),
                resultSet.getInt("invalid_rows"),
                resultSet.getInt("reconciled_rows"),
                resultSet.getObject(
                        "started_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                ),
                resultSet.getObject(
                        "completed_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                ),
                resultSet.getObject(
                        "reconciliation_started_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                ),
                resultSet.getObject(
                        "reconciliation_completed_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                ),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "error_message"
                )
        );
    }

    private ImportRowErrorResponse mapInvalidRow(
            ResultSet resultSet,
            int rowNumber
    ) throws SQLException {
        return new ImportRowErrorResponse(
                resultSet.getLong("id"),
                resultSet.getInt("row_number"),
                resultSet.getString("external_id"),
                resultSet.getString("external_name"),
                resultSet.getString("club_name"),
                resultSet.getString("fantasy_role"),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "validation_error"
                ),
                resultSet.getString("raw_data")
        );
    }

    private String normalizeSource(
            String source
    ) {
        String normalized =
                normalizeOptional(source);

        if (normalized == null) {
            return null;
        }

        normalized = normalized.toUpperCase(
                Locale.ROOT
        );

        if (!ALLOWED_SOURCES.contains(normalized)) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Fonte non valida: " + source
            );
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private String normalizeStatus(
            String status
    ) {
        String normalized =
                normalizeOptional(status);

        if (normalized == null) {
            return null;
        }

        normalized = normalized.toUpperCase(
                Locale.ROOT
        );

        if (!ALLOWED_STATUSES.contains(normalized)) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Stato import non valido: "
                            + status
            );
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private String normalizeOptional(
            String value
    ) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    private int validatePage(int page) {
        if (page < 0) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "La pagina non puÃ² essere negativa"
            );
        }

        return page;
    }

    private int validateSize(int size) {
        if (size <= 0) {
            return DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE;
        }

        if (size > MAX_PAGE_SIZE) {
            return MAX_PAGE_SIZE;
        }

        return size;
    }

    private int calculateTotalPages(
            long totalElements,
            int size
    ) {
        if (totalElements == 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        return (int) Math.ceil(
                (double) totalElements / size
        );
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.Arrays;

import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

public record CsvImportPayload(String filename, byte[] bytes) {
    public CsvImportPayload {
        bytes = bytes == null ? null : Arrays.copyOf(bytes, bytes.length);
    }

    public static CsvImportPayload from(MultipartFile file, String fallback) {
        if (file == null) throw new BadRequestException("File CSV obbligatorio");
        try {
            String name=file.getOriginalFilename();
            return new CsvImportPayload(name==null||name.isBlank()?fallback:name,file.getBytes());
        } catch (java.io.IOException ex) {
            throw new BadRequestException("Impossibile leggere il file CSV",ex);
        }
    }

    public byte[] bytes(){return bytes==null?null:Arrays.copyOf(bytes,bytes.length);}
    public InputStream openStream(){return new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes);}
    public boolean empty(){return bytes==null||bytes.length==0;}
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.sql.Types;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;

import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVFormat;
import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVParser;
import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVRecord;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;
import org.springframework.transaction.TransactionDefinition;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.SecretSanitizer;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import tools.jackson.core.JacksonException;
import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;

@Service
public class PlayerImportService {

    private static final Set<String> ALLOWED_SOURCES =
            Set.of(
                    "FANTACALCIO",
                    "GAZZETTA",
                    "FANTAMARKT"
            );

    private static final Set<String> REQUIRED_COLUMNS =
            Set.of(
                    "external_id",
                    "name",
                    "club",
                    "role"
            );

    private static final Set<String> VALID_ROLES =
            Set.of(
                    "P",
                    "D",
                    "C",
                    "A"
            );

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final TextNormalizer textNormalizer;
    private final JsonMapper jsonMapper;
    private final TransactionTemplate transactionTemplate;
    private final TransactionTemplate requiresNewTransaction;

    public PlayerImportService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            TextNormalizer textNormalizer,
            JsonMapper jsonMapper,
            PlatformTransactionManager transactionManager
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.textNormalizer = textNormalizer;
        this.jsonMapper = jsonMapper;

        this.transactionTemplate =
                new TransactionTemplate(
                        transactionManager
                );

        this.requiresNewTransaction =
                new TransactionTemplate(
                        transactionManager
                );

        this.requiresNewTransaction
                .setPropagationBehavior(
                        TransactionDefinition
                                .PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW
                );
    }

    public PlayerImportResponse importCsv(
            String source,
            String seasonCode,
            MultipartFile file
    ) {
        return importPayload(source,seasonCode,CsvImportPayload.from(file,"players.csv"));
    }

    public PlayerImportResponse importPayload(
            String source,
            String seasonCode,
            CsvImportPayload file
    ) {
        String normalizedSource =
                normalizeSource(source);

        String normalizedSeason =
                validateSeasonCode(seasonCode);

        validateFileReference(file);

        Long seasonId = findSeasonId(
                normalizedSeason
        );

        String filename = resolveFilename(file);

        Long batchId = createBatch(
                normalizedSource,
                seasonId,
                filename
        );

        try {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(
                    transactionTemplate.execute(
                            transactionStatus ->
                                    processImport(
                                            batchId,
                                            normalizedSource,
                                            normalizedSeason,
                                            filename,
                                            file
                                    )
                    )
            );
        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
            String errorMessage =
                    readableErrorMessage(exception);

            markBatchFailed(
                    batchId,
                    errorMessage
            );

            if (exception instanceof BadRequestException) {
                throw exception;
            }

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Import CSV fallito: "
                            + errorMessage,
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    private PlayerImportResponse processImport(
            Long batchId,
            String source,
            String seasonCode,
            String filename,
            CsvImportPayload file
    ) {
        int totalRows = 0;
        int validRows = 0;
        int invalidRows = 0;

        Set<String> externalIds =
                new HashSet<>();

        Set<String> playerKeys =
                new HashSet<>();

        try (
                BufferedReader reader =
                        new BufferedReader(
                                new InputStreamReader(
                                        file.openStream(),
                                        StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                                )
                        );

                CSVParser parser =
                        CSVFormat.DEFAULT.builder()
                                .setHeader()
                                .setSkipHeaderRecord(true)
                                .setIgnoreEmptyLines(true)
                                .setIgnoreSurroundingSpaces(true)
                                .setTrim(true)
                                .get()
                                .parse(reader)
        ) {
            validateHeaders(
                    parser.getHeaderNames()
            );

            for (CSVRecord record : parser) {
                totalRows++;

                ImportedRow importedRow =
                        parseRow(
                                parser,
                                record,
                                totalRows,
                                externalIds,
                                playerKeys
                        );

                saveImportedRow(
                        batchId,
                        importedRow
                );

                if (importedRow.valid()) {
                    validRows++;
                } else {
                    invalidRows++;
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Impossibile leggere il file CSV",
                    exception
            );
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Formato CSV non valido: "
                            + readableErrorMessage(exception),
                    exception
            );
        }

        if (totalRows == 0) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Il file CSV non contiene righe dati"
            );
        }

        completeBatch(
                batchId,
                totalRows,
                validRows,
                invalidRows
        );

        return new PlayerImportResponse(
                batchId,
                source,
                seasonCode,
                filename,
                totalRows,
                validRows,
                invalidRows,
                "COMPLETED",
                null
        );
    }

    private ImportedRow parseRow(
            CSVParser parser,
            CSVRecord record,
            int rowNumber,
            Set<String> externalIds,
            Set<String> playerKeys
    ) {
        String externalId =
                value(
                        record,
                        "external_id"
                );

        String name =
                value(
                        record,
                        "name"
                );

        String club =
                value(
                        record,
                        "club"
                );

        String role =
                normalizeRole(
                        value(
                                record,
                                "role"
                        )
                );

        String quotationText =
                value(
                        record,
                        "quotation"
                );

        String fmvText =
                value(
                        record,
                        "fmv"
                );

        String normalizedName =
                textNormalizer.normalize(name);

        String normalizedClub =
                textNormalizer.normalize(club);

        ParsedDecimal quotation =
                parseDecimal(
                        quotationText,
                        "Quotazione"
                );

        ParsedDecimal fmv =
                parseDecimal(
                        fmvText,
                        "FMV"
                );

        List<String> errors =
                new ArrayList<>();

        if (isBlank(externalId)) {
            errors.add(
                    "ID esterno mancante"
            );
        }

        if (isBlank(name)) {
            errors.add(
                    "Nome giocatore mancante"
            );
        }

        if (isBlank(club)) {
            errors.add(
                    "Squadra mancante"
            );
        }

        if (isBlank(role)) {
            errors.add(
                    "Ruolo mancante"
            );
        } else if (!VALID_ROLES.contains(role)) {
            errors.add(
                    "Ruolo non valido: " + role
            );
        }

        if (quotation.error() != null) {
            errors.add(
                    quotation.error()
            );
        }

        if (fmv.error() != null) {
            errors.add(
                    fmv.error()
            );
        }

        if (!isBlank(externalId)) {
            String externalIdKey =
                    externalId.toLowerCase(
                            Locale.ROOT
                    );

            if (!externalIds.add(externalIdKey)) {
                errors.add(
                        "ID esterno duplicato nel file"
                );
            }
        }

        if (
                !normalizedName.isBlank()
                && !normalizedClub.isBlank()
        ) {
            String playerKey =
                    normalizedName
                            + "|"
                            + normalizedClub;

            if (!playerKeys.add(playerKey)) {
                errors.add(
                        "Giocatore duplicato nel file"
                );
            }
        }

        Map<String, String> rawData =
                rawData(
                        parser,
                        record
                );

        String validationError =
                errors.isEmpty()
                        ? null
                        : String.join(
                                "; ",
                                errors
                        );

        return new ImportedRow(
                rowNumber,
                externalId,
                name,
                normalizedName,
                club,
                normalizedClub,
                role,
                quotation.value(),
                fmv.value(),
                errors.isEmpty(),
                validationError,
                toJson(rawData)
        );
    }

    private void saveImportedRow(
            Long batchId,
            ImportedRow row
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_import_rows (
                    batch_id,
                    row_number,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    normalized_name,
                    club_name,
                    normalized_club_name,
                    fantasy_role,
                    quotation,
                    fantasy_market_value,
                    valid,
                    validation_error,
                    raw_data
                )
                VALUES (
                    :batchId,
                    :rowNumber,
                    :externalId,
                    :externalName,
                    :normalizedName,
                    :clubName,
                    :normalizedClubName,
                    :fantasyRole,
                    :quotation,
                    :fmv,
                    :valid,
                    :validationError,
                    CAST(:rawData AS JSONB)
                )
                """)
                .param(
                        "batchId",
                        batchId
                )
                .param(
                        "rowNumber",
                        row.rowNumber()
                )
                .param(
                        "externalId",
                        row.externalId(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "externalName",
                        emptyIfNull(
                                row.externalName()
                        )
                )
                .param(
                        "normalizedName",
                        emptyIfNull(
                                row.normalizedName()
                        )
                )
                .param(
                        "clubName",
                        row.clubName(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "normalizedClubName",
                        row.normalizedClubName(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "fantasyRole",
                        VALID_ROLES.contains(
                                row.fantasyRole()
                        )
                                ? row.fantasyRole()
                                : null,
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "quotation",
                        row.quotation(),
                        Types.NUMERIC
                )
                .param(
                        "fmv",
                        row.fmv(),
                        Types.NUMERIC
                )
                .param(
                        "valid",
                        row.valid()
                )
                .param(
                        "validationError",
                        row.validationError(),
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param(
                        "rawData",
                        row.rawData()
                )
                .update();
    }

    private void validateHeaders(
            List<String> headers
    ) {
        Set<String> normalizedHeaders =
                new HashSet<>();

        for (String header : headers) {
            if (header != null) {
                normalizedHeaders.add(
                        header.trim()
                                .toLowerCase(
                                        Locale.ROOT
                                )
                );
            }
        }

        List<String> missingColumns =
                REQUIRED_COLUMNS.stream()
                        .filter(column ->
                                !normalizedHeaders.contains(
                                        column
                                )
                        )
                        .sorted()
                        .toList();

        if (!missingColumns.isEmpty()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Colonne obbligatorie mancanti: "
                            + String.join(
                                    ", ",
                                    missingColumns
                            )
            );
        }
    }

    private Map<String, String> rawData(
            CSVParser parser,
            CSVRecord record
    ) {
        Map<String, String> rawData =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (String header : parser.getHeaderNames()) {
            rawData.put(
                    header,
                    record.isMapped(header)
                            ? record.get(header)
                            : null
            );
        }

        return rawData;
    }

    private Long findSeasonId(
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = :seasonCode
                """)
                .param(
                        "seasonCode",
                        seasonCode
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Stagione non trovata: "
                                        + seasonCode
                        )
                );
    }

    private Long createBatch(
            String source,
            Long seasonId,
            String filename
    ) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(
                requiresNewTransaction.execute(
                        transactionStatus ->
                                jdbcClient.sql("""
                                        INSERT INTO import_batches (
                                            source,
                                            season_id,
                                            original_filename,
                                            status,
                                            error_message
                                        )
                                        VALUES (
                                            :source,
                                            :seasonId,
                                            :filename,
                                            'PROCESSING',
                                            NULL
                                        )
                                        RETURNING id
                                        """)
                                        .param(
                                                "source",
                                                source
                                        )
                                        .param(
                                                "seasonId",
                                                seasonId
                                        )
                                        .param(
                                                "filename",
                                                filename
                                        )
                                        .query(Long.class)
                                        .single()
                )
        );
    }

    private void completeBatch(
            Long batchId,
            int totalRows,
            int validRows,
            int invalidRows
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE import_batches
                SET status = 'COMPLETED',
                    total_rows = :totalRows,
                    valid_rows = :validRows,
                    invalid_rows = :invalidRows,
                    error_message = NULL,
                    completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = :batchId
                """)
                .param(
                        "totalRows",
                        totalRows
                )
                .param(
                        "validRows",
                        validRows
                )
                .param(
                        "invalidRows",
                        invalidRows
                )
                .param(
                        "batchId",
                        batchId
                )
                .update();
    }

    private void markBatchFailed(
            Long batchId,
            String errorMessage
    ) {
        requiresNewTransaction.executeWithoutResult(
                transactionStatus ->
                        jdbcClient.sql("""
                                UPDATE import_batches
                                SET status = 'FAILED',
                                    error_message = :errorMessage,
                                    completed_at =
                                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                                WHERE id = :batchId
                                """)
                                .param(
                                        "errorMessage",
                                        truncate(
                                                errorMessage,
                                                2000
                                        )
                                )
                                .param(
                                        "batchId",
                                        batchId
                                )
                                .update()
        );
    }

    private String normalizeSource(
            String source
    ) {
        if (source == null || source.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Fonte obbligatoria"
            );
        }

        String normalizedSource =
                source.trim()
                        .toUpperCase(
                                Locale.ROOT
                        );

        if (!ALLOWED_SOURCES.contains(
                normalizedSource
        )) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Fonte non valida: "
                            + source
            );
        }

        return normalizedSource;
    }

    private String validateSeasonCode(
            String seasonCode
    ) {
        if (
                seasonCode == null
                || seasonCode.isBlank()
        ) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Stagione obbligatoria"
            );
        }

        return seasonCode.trim();
    }

    private void validateFileReference(
            CsvImportPayload file
    ) {
        if (file == null) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "File CSV obbligatorio"
            );
        }
    }

    private String resolveFilename(
            CsvImportPayload file
    ) {
        String originalFilename =
                file.filename();

        if (
                originalFilename == null
                || originalFilename.isBlank()
        ) {
            return "players.csv";
        }

        String normalizedFilename =
                originalFilename
                        .replace("\\", "/");

        int separatorIndex =
                normalizedFilename
                        .lastIndexOf('/');

        if (separatorIndex >= 0) {
            normalizedFilename =
                    normalizedFilename.substring(
                            separatorIndex + 1
                    );
        }

        return truncate(
                normalizedFilename,
                255
        );
    }

    private String value(
            CSVRecord record,
            String column
    ) {
        if (!record.isMapped(column)) {
            return null;
        }

        String value = record.get(column);

        return value == null || value.isBlank()
                ? null
                : value.trim();
    }

    private String normalizeRole(
            String role
    ) {
        if (role == null || role.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }

        return role.trim()
                .toUpperCase(
                        Locale.ROOT
                );
    }

    private ParsedDecimal parseDecimal(
            String rawValue,
            String fieldName
    ) {
        if (rawValue == null) {
            return new ParsedDecimal(
                    null,
                    null
            );
        }

        try {
            BigDecimal value =
                    new BigDecimal(
                            rawValue.replace(
                                    ",",
                                    "."
                            )
                    );

            if (value.signum() < 0) {
                return new ParsedDecimal(
                        null,
                        fieldName
                                + " non puÃ² essere negativa"
                );
            }

            return new ParsedDecimal(
                    value,
                    null
            );
        } catch (NumberFormatException exception) {
            return new ParsedDecimal(
                    null,
                    fieldName
                            + " non valida: "
                            + rawValue
            );
        }
    }

    private String toJson(
            Map<String, String> data
    ) {
        try {
            return jsonMapper.writeValueAsString(
                    data
            );
        } catch (JacksonException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Impossibile convertire "
                            + "la riga in JSON",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    private String readableErrorMessage(
            Throwable exception
    ) {
        return SecretSanitizer.sanitize(exception);
    }

    private String emptyIfNull(
            String value
    ) {
        return value == null
                ? ""
                : value;
    }

    private boolean isBlank(
            String value
    ) {
        return value == null
                || value.isBlank();
    }

    private String truncate(
            String value,
            int maximumLength
    ) {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (value.length() <= maximumLength) {
            return value;
        }

        return value.substring(
                0,
                maximumLength
        );
    }

    private record ParsedDecimal(
            BigDecimal value,
            String error
    ) {
    }

    private record ImportedRow(
            int rowNumber,
            String externalId,
            String externalName,
            String normalizedName,
            String clubName,
            String normalizedClubName,
            String fantasyRole,
            BigDecimal quotation,
            BigDecimal fmv,
            boolean valid,
            String validationError,
            String rawData
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer;

import java.text.Normalizer;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class TextNormalizer {

    public String normalize(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return "";
        }

        String normalized = Normalizer.normalize(
                value,
                Normalizer.Form.NFD
        );

        return normalized
                .replaceAll("\\p{M}", "")
                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
                .replaceAll("[^a-z0-9 ]", " ")
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.refresh.DataRefreshResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.refresh.DataRefreshService;

@Service
public class AutomatedDataUpdateService {

    private final FantacalcioListoneProperties listoneProperties;
    private final FantacalcioListoneSyncService listoneSyncService;
    private final SourceIngestionProperties sourceIngestionProperties;
    private final SourceIngestionService sourceIngestionService;
    private final DataRefreshService refreshService;
    private final AutomationRunService automationRunService;

    @Autowired
    public AutomatedDataUpdateService(
            FantacalcioListoneProperties listoneProperties,
            FantacalcioListoneSyncService listoneSyncService,
            SourceIngestionProperties sourceIngestionProperties,
            SourceIngestionService sourceIngestionService,
            DataRefreshService refreshService,
            AutomationRunService automationRunService
    ) {
        this.listoneProperties = listoneProperties;
        this.listoneSyncService = listoneSyncService;
        this.sourceIngestionProperties = sourceIngestionProperties;
        this.sourceIngestionService = sourceIngestionService;
        this.refreshService = refreshService;
        this.automationRunService = automationRunService;
    }

    /*
     * Compatibility constructor used by existing focused unit tests.
     *
     * It intentionally preserves the historical isolated service-test path.
     * Spring production wiring always uses the @Autowired constructor above,
     * therefore real scheduled executions always use AutomationRunService.
     */
    AutomatedDataUpdateService(
            SourceIngestionProperties sourceIngestionProperties,
            SourceIngestionService sourceIngestionService,
            DataRefreshService refreshService
    ) {

        FantacalcioListoneProperties disabledListone =
                new FantacalcioListoneProperties();

        disabledListone.setEnabled(false);

        this.listoneProperties = disabledListone;
        this.listoneSyncService = null;
        this.sourceIngestionProperties = sourceIngestionProperties;
        this.sourceIngestionService = sourceIngestionService;
        this.refreshService = refreshService;
        this.automationRunService = null;
    }

    public AutomatedUpdateResponse run(
            String season
    ) {

        if (automationRunService == null) {
            return runPipeline(
                    season,
                    null
            );
        }

        long automationRunId =
                automationRunService.begin(
                        season
                );

        try {

            AutomatedUpdateResponse result =
                    runPipeline(
                            season,
                            automationRunId
                    );

            automationRunService.complete(
                    automationRunId,
                    result.listone() == null
                            ? null
                            : result.listone().runId(),
                    result.ingestion().size(),
                    result.refresh() == null
                            ? null
                            : result.refresh().id()
            );

            return result;

        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {

            automationRunService.fail(
                    automationRunId,
                    exception
            );

            throw exception;
        }
    }

    private AutomatedUpdateResponse runPipeline(
            String season,
            Long automationRunId
    ) {

        FantacalcioListoneSyncResponse listone =
                null;

        if (listoneProperties.isEnabled()) {

            heartbeat(
                    automationRunId,
                    "LISTONE"
            );

            if (listoneSyncService == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Fantacalcio listone sync abilitato senza servizio configurato"
                );
            }

            listone =
                    listoneSyncService.sync(
                            season
                    );
        }

        List<SourceIngestionResponse> ingestion =
                List.of();

        if (sourceIngestionProperties.isEnabled()) {

            heartbeat(
                    automationRunId,
                    "INGESTION"
            );

            ingestion =
                    sourceIngestionService.ingestAll(
                            season
                    );

            boolean requiredFailed =
                    ingestion.stream()
                            .anyMatch(response ->
                                    response.required()
                                            && "FAILED".equals(
                                                    response.status()
                                            )
                            );

            if (requiredFailed) {
                throw new ConflictException(
                        "Ingestion richiesta fallita; refresh non eseguito"
                );
            }
        }

        heartbeat(
                automationRunId,
                "REFRESH"
        );

        DataRefreshResponse refresh =
                refreshService.runScheduled(
                        season
                );

        return new AutomatedUpdateResponse(
                listone,
                ingestion,
                refresh
        );
    }

    private void heartbeat(
            Long automationRunId,
            String stage
    ) {

        if (
                automationRunId != null
                        && automationRunService != null
        ) {
            automationRunService.stage(
                    automationRunId,
                    stage
            );
        }
    }

    public record AutomatedUpdateResponse(
            FantacalcioListoneSyncResponse listone,
            List<SourceIngestionResponse> ingestion,
            DataRefreshResponse refresh
    ) {

        public AutomatedUpdateResponse(
                List<SourceIngestionResponse> ingestion,
                DataRefreshResponse refresh
        ) {
            this(
                    null,
                    ingestion,
                    refresh
            );
        }
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Types;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.SecretSanitizer;

@Service
public class AutomationRunService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbc;
    private final Duration staleThreshold;

    public AutomationRunService(
            JdbcClient jdbc,
            @Value("${app.production-automation.stale-threshold:2h}")
            Duration staleThreshold
    ) {
        this.jdbc = jdbc;

        if (
                staleThreshold == null
                        || staleThreshold.isZero()
                        || staleThreshold.isNegative()
        ) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "app.production-automation.stale-threshold deve essere maggiore di zero"
            );
        }

        this.staleThreshold = staleThreshold;
    }

    public long begin(String season) {

        long seasonId = seasonId(season);

        recoverStale(seasonId);

        try {
            return jdbc.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO automation_runs (
                        season_id,
                        trigger_type,
                        status,
                        stage
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        :seasonId,
                        'SCHEDULED',
                        'RUNNING',
                        'STARTING'
                    )
                    RETURNING id
                    """)
                    .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                    .query(Long.class)
                    .single();

        } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException exception) {

            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Aggiornamento automatico gia' in esecuzione per la stagione "
                            + season
            );
        }
    }

    public void stage(
            long runId,
            String stage
    ) {

        int updated = jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE automation_runs
                SET
                    stage = :stage,
                    last_heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = :runId
                  AND status = 'RUNNING'
                """)
                .param("stage", stage)
                .param("runId", runId)
                .update();

        if (updated != 1) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Esecuzione automatica non piu' attiva: " + runId
            );
        }
    }

    public void complete(
            long runId,
            Long listoneRunId,
            int ingestionRunCount,
            Long refreshRunId
    ) {

        int updated = jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE automation_runs
                SET
                    status = 'COMPLETED',
                    stage = 'COMPLETED',
                    listone_run_id = :listoneRunId,
                    ingestion_run_count = :ingestionRunCount,
                    refresh_run_id = :refreshRunId,
                    last_heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    error_message = NULL
                WHERE id = :runId
                  AND status = 'RUNNING'
                """)
                .param(
                        "listoneRunId",
                        listoneRunId,
                        Types.BIGINT
                )
                .param(
                        "ingestionRunCount",
                        ingestionRunCount
                )
                .param(
                        "refreshRunId",
                        refreshRunId,
                        Types.BIGINT
                )
                .param("runId", runId)
                .update();

        if (updated != 1) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Impossibile completare esecuzione automatica " + runId
            );
        }
    }

    public void fail(
            long runId,
            Throwable exception
    ) {

        String safeError =
                truncate(
                        SecretSanitizer.sanitize(exception),
                        2000
                );

        jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE automation_runs
                SET
                    status = 'FAILED',
                    last_heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    error_message = :error
                WHERE id = :runId
                  AND status = 'RUNNING'
                """)
                .param(
                        "error",
                        safeError,
                        Types.VARCHAR
                )
                .param("runId", runId)
                .update();
    }

    public AutomationRunResponse latest(
            String season
    ) {

        return jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT
                    run.id,
                    season.code AS season,
                    run.trigger_type,
                    run.status,
                    run.stage,
                    run.listone_run_id,
                    run.ingestion_run_count,
                    run.refresh_run_id,
                    run.started_at,
                    run.last_heartbeat_at,
                    run.completed_at,
                    run.error_message
                FROM automation_runs run
                JOIN seasons season
                  ON season.id = run.season_id
                WHERE season.code = :season
                ORDER BY
                    run.started_at DESC,
                    run.id DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("season", season)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        map(resultSet)
                )
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Nessuna esecuzione automatica trovata per la stagione "
                                        + season
                        )
                );
    }

    private void recoverStale(
            long seasonId
    ) {

        jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE automation_runs
                SET
                    status = 'FAILED',
                    completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    error_message =
                        'Esecuzione automatica interrotta recuperata automaticamente'
                WHERE season_id = :seasonId
                  AND status = 'RUNNING'
                  AND last_heartbeat_at <
                      CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                      - (:staleSeconds * INTERVAL '1 second')
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param(
                        "staleSeconds",
                        staleThreshold.toSeconds()
                )
                .update();
    }

    private long seasonId(
            String season
    ) {

        return jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = :season
                """)
                .param("season", season)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Stagione non trovata: " + season
                        )
                );
    }

    private AutomationRunResponse map(
            ResultSet resultSet
    ) throws SQLException {

        return new AutomationRunResponse(
                resultSet.getLong("id"),
                resultSet.getString("season"),
                resultSet.getString("trigger_type"),
                resultSet.getString("status"),
                resultSet.getString("stage"),
                (Long) resultSet.getObject(
                        "listone_run_id"
                ),
                resultSet.getInt(
                        "ingestion_run_count"
                ),
                (Long) resultSet.getObject(
                        "refresh_run_id"
                ),
                resultSet.getObject(
                        "started_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                ),
                resultSet.getObject(
                        "last_heartbeat_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                ),
                resultSet.getObject(
                        "completed_at",
                        OffsetDateTime.class
                ),
                resultSet.getString(
                        "error_message"
                )
        );
    }

    private String truncate(
            String value,
            int maximum
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return value.length() <= maximum
                ? value
                : value.substring(0, maximum);
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

@Component
public class FantacalcioListoneClient {

    private final FantacalcioListoneProperties properties;
    private final HttpClient client;

    public FantacalcioListoneClient(FantacalcioListoneProperties properties) {
        this.properties = properties;
        this.client = HttpClient.newBuilder()
                .connectTimeout(properties.getConnectTimeout())
                .followRedirects(HttpClient.Redirect.NEVER)
                .build();
    }

    public FetchResult fetch() {
        properties.validate();

        URI uri = validate(properties.getUrl());
        int redirects = 0;

        try {
            while (true) {
                HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(uri)
                        .timeout(properties.getRequestTimeout())
                        .header(
                                "User-Agent",
                                "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
                                        + "AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/151 Safari/537.36"
                        )
                        .header("Accept", "text/html,application/xhtml+xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.1")
                        .GET()
                        .build();

                HttpResponse<java.io.InputStream> response = client.send(
                        request,
                        HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofInputStream()
                );

                int status = response.statusCode();

                if (status >= 300 && status < 400) {
                    String location;
                    try (var body = response.body()) {
                        if (++redirects > properties.getMaxRedirects()) {
                            throw new BadRequestException("Troppi redirect Fantacalcio");
                        }
                        location = response.headers()
                                .firstValue("location")
                                .orElseThrow(() -> new BadRequestException(
                                        "Redirect Fantacalcio senza destinazione"
                                ));
                    }
                    uri = validate(uri.resolve(location).toString());
                    continue;
                }

                if (status < 200 || status >= 300) {
                    response.body().close();
                    throw new BadRequestException(
                            "Fantacalcio listone ha risposto HTTP " + status
                    );
                }

                String contentType = response.headers()
                        .firstValue("content-type")
                        .orElse("")
                        .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

                if (!contentType.contains("text/html")) {
                    response.body().close();
                    throw new BadRequestException(
                            "Fantacalcio listone non ha restituito HTML"
                    );
                }

                try (
                        var input = response.body();
                        var output = new ByteArrayOutputStream()
                ) {
                    byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                    int total = 0;
                    int read;

                    while ((read = input.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                        total += read;
                        if (total > properties.getMaxBytes()) {
                            throw new BadRequestException(
                                    "HTML Fantacalcio supera il limite configurato"
                            );
                        }
                        output.write(buffer, 0, read);
                    }

                    if (total == 0) {
                        throw new BadRequestException("HTML Fantacalcio vuoto");
                    }

                    return new FetchResult(
                            output.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
                            status,
                            uri,
                            total
                    );
                }
            }
        } catch (BadRequestException exception) {
            throw exception;
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Download listone Fantacalcio fallito",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    URI validate(String value) {
        try {
            URI uri = URI.create(value);

            if (!uri.isAbsolute()
                    || uri.getHost() == null
                    || uri.getUserInfo() != null) {
                throw new BadRequestException("URL listone Fantacalcio non valido");
            }

            if (!"https".equalsIgnoreCase(uri.getScheme())) {
                throw new BadRequestException(
                        "Il listone Fantacalcio richiede HTTPS"
                );
            }

            String host = uri.getHost().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (!host.equals("fantacalcio.it")
                    && !host.endsWith(".fantacalcio.it")) {
                throw new BadRequestException(
                        "Host listone Fantacalcio non consentito"
                );
            }

            for (InetAddress address : InetAddress.getAllByName(uri.getHost())) {
                if (address.isAnyLocalAddress()
                        || address.isLoopbackAddress()
                        || address.isLinkLocalAddress()
                        || address.isSiteLocalAddress()) {
                    throw new BadRequestException(
                            "Host privato/locale non consentito"
                    );
                }
            }

            return uri;
        } catch (BadRequestException exception) {
            throw exception;
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "URL listone Fantacalcio non valido",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    public record FetchResult(
            String html,
            int httpStatus,
            URI finalUri,
            long payloadBytes
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

@Component
public class FantacalcioListoneParser {

    private static final Pattern ROW = Pattern.compile(
            "<tr\\s+class=\"player-row\"(?<attrs>.*?)>(?<body>.*?)</tr>",
            Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE | Pattern.DOTALL
    );

    private static final Pattern CLASSIC_ROLE = Pattern.compile(
            "data-filter-role-classic=\"([pdca])\"",
            Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE
    );

    private static final Pattern PLAYER_LINK = Pattern.compile(
            "href=\"https://www\\.fantacalcio\\.it/serie-a/squadre/"
                    + "([^/\"?#]+)/([^/\"]+)/(\\d+)\"",
            Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE
    );

    private static final Pattern PLAYER_NAME = Pattern.compile(
            "<a[^>]*class=\"[^\"]*player-name[^\"]*player-link[^\"]*\"[^>]*>"
                    + ".*?<span>(.*?)</span>.*?</a>",
            Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE | Pattern.DOTALL
    );

    private static final Pattern CURRENT_PRICE = Pattern.compile(
            "<td[^>]*class=\"[^\"]*player-classic-current-price[^\"]*\"[^>]*>"
                    + "(.*?)</td>",
            Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE | Pattern.DOTALL
    );

    private static final Pattern FVM = Pattern.compile(
            "<td[^>]*class=\"[^\"]*player-classic-fvm[^\"]*\"[^>]*>"
                    + "(.*?)</td>",
            Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE | Pattern.DOTALL
    );

    /*
     * Fantacalcio uses this semantic marker for players that are
     * still visible in the listone but no longer play in Serie A:
     *
     * <span class="out-of-game"
     *       title="Non gioca piÃ¹ in Serie A">*</span>
     *
     * Do not infer the state from a generic asterisk: the CSS class
     * is the authoritative marker exposed by the source.
     */
    private static final Pattern OUT_OF_GAME = Pattern.compile(
            "<span[^>]*class=\"[^\"]*\\bout-of-game\\b[^\"]*\"[^>]*>",
            Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE | Pattern.DOTALL
    );

    private static final Pattern TAG = Pattern.compile("<[^>]+>");

    private static final Pattern NUMERIC_HTML_ENTITY = Pattern.compile(
            "&#(?:x([0-9a-fA-F]+)|([0-9]+));"
    );

    public List<ListonePlayer> parse(String html) {
        if (html == null || html.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException("HTML listone Fantacalcio vuoto");
        }

        List<ListonePlayer> result = new ArrayList<>();
        Matcher rows = ROW.matcher(html);

        while (rows.find()) {
            String attrs = rows.group("attrs");
            String body = rows.group("body");

            Matcher roleMatcher = CLASSIC_ROLE.matcher(attrs);
            Matcher linkMatcher = PLAYER_LINK.matcher(body);
            Matcher nameMatcher = PLAYER_NAME.matcher(body);

            if (!roleMatcher.find() || !linkMatcher.find() || !nameMatcher.find()) {
                continue;
            }

            String role = roleMatcher.group(1).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

            String clubSlug = clean(linkMatcher.group(1))
                    .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

            String playerSlug = clean(linkMatcher.group(2))
                    .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

            String numericId = linkMatcher.group(3);

            String name = clean(nameMatcher.group(1));

            BigDecimal quotation = decimal(
                    firstGroup(CURRENT_PRICE, body)
            );

            BigDecimal fmv = decimal(
                    firstGroup(FVM, body)
            );

            boolean outOfGame =
                    OUT_OF_GAME.matcher(body).find();

            if (name.isBlank()) {
                throw new BadRequestException(
                        "Riga Fantacalcio con nome vuoto: " + numericId
                );
            }

            result.add(new ListonePlayer(
                    "FANTACALCIO-" + numericId,
                    numericId,
                    name,
                    clubSlug,
                    playerSlug,
                    role,
                    quotation,
                    fmv,
                    outOfGame
            ));
        }

        if (result.size() < 300) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Parsing listone Fantacalcio sospetto: trovati solo "
                            + result.size() + " giocatori"
            );
        }

        long distinctIds = result.stream()
                .map(ListonePlayer::externalId)
                .distinct()
                .count();

        if (distinctIds != result.size()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Listone Fantacalcio contiene ID duplicati"
            );
        }

        return List.copyOf(result);
    }

    private String firstGroup(Pattern pattern, String input) {
        Matcher matcher = pattern.matcher(input);

        return matcher.find()
                ? clean(matcher.group(1))
                : null;
    }

    private BigDecimal decimal(String raw) {
        if (raw == null || raw.isBlank() || "-".equals(raw)) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return new BigDecimal(
                    raw.replace(",", ".").trim()
            );
        } catch (NumberFormatException exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Valore numerico Fantacalcio non valido: " + raw,
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    private String clean(String value) {
        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }

        String text = TAG.matcher(value).replaceAll("");

        text = decodeNumericHtmlEntities(text);

        return text
                .replace("&nbsp;", " ")
                .replace("&#160;", " ")
                .replace("&amp;", "&")
                .replace("&quot;", "\"")
                .replace("&#39;", "'")
                .replace("&apos;", "'")
                .replace("&lt;", "<")
                .replace("&gt;", ">")
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();
    }

    private String decodeNumericHtmlEntities(String value) {
        Matcher matcher = NUMERIC_HTML_ENTITY.matcher(value);

        StringBuffer output = new StringBuffer();

        while (matcher.find()) {
            try {
                int codePoint;

                if (matcher.group(1) != null) {
                    codePoint = Integer.parseInt(
                            matcher.group(1),
                            16
                    );
                } else {
                    codePoint = Integer.parseInt(
                            matcher.group(2)
                    );
                }

                String decoded =
                        new String(Character.toChars(codePoint));

                matcher.appendReplacement(
                        output,
                        Matcher.quoteReplacement(decoded)
                );

            } catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
                matcher.appendReplacement(
                        output,
                        Matcher.quoteReplacement(
                                matcher.group()
                        )
                );
            }
        }

        matcher.appendTail(output);

        return output.toString();
    }

    public record ListonePlayer(
            String externalId,
            String numericFantacalcioId,
            String name,
            String clubSlug,
            String playerSlug,
            String role,
            BigDecimal quotation,
            BigDecimal fmv,
            boolean outOfGame
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import java.time.Duration;

import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "app.fantacalcio-listone")

    private boolean enabled;

            "https://www.fantacalcio.it/quotazioni-fantacalcio/2026-27";

    private Duration connectTimeout =
            Duration.ofSeconds(5);

    private Duration requestTimeout =
            Duration.ofSeconds(20);

    private Duration staleThreshold =
            Duration.ofHours(2);

    private int maxBytes =
            3_000_000;

    private int maxRedirects =
            3;

    public void validate() {

        if (!enabled) {
            return;
        }

        if (
                url == null
                        || url.isBlank()
        ) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "app.fantacalcio-listone.url obbligatorio"
            );
        }

        if (
                connectTimeout == null
                        || connectTimeout.isZero()
                        || connectTimeout.isNegative()
        ) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "app.fantacalcio-listone.connect-timeout deve essere > 0"
            );
        }

        if (
                requestTimeout == null
                        || requestTimeout.isZero()
                        || requestTimeout.isNegative()
        ) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "app.fantacalcio-listone.request-timeout deve essere > 0"
            );

        if (
                staleThreshold == null
                        || staleThreshold.isZero()
                        || staleThreshold.isNegative()
        ) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(

            );

        if (maxBytes <= 0) {
