package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.lineup;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/**
 * B68 lineup scoring core.
 *
 * Principles:
 * - only real available signals are used;
 * - a missing signal is omitted, never converted to zero or a neutral 50;
 * - availability can make a player operationally unusable;
 * - fixture difficulty already contains home/away context, therefore no
 *   additional home bonus is applied here;
 * - confidence describes evidence quality and does not artificially
 *   increase or decrease the football score.
 */
@Component
public class B68LineupScorer {

    private static final double PERFORMANCE_WEIGHT = 0.45;
    private static final double STARTING_WEIGHT = 0.25;
    private static final double AVAILABILITY_WEIGHT = 0.20;
    private static final double FIXTURE_WEIGHT = 0.10;

    public ScoreResult score(Input input) {

        if (input == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Input B68 obbligatorio"
            );
        }

        String role = normalizeRole(input.role());

        validatePercentage(
                input.fantasyAverageRolePercentile(),
                "fantasyAverageRolePercentile"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                input.usageRolePercentile(),
                "usageRolePercentile"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                input.goalRateRolePercentile(),
                "goalRateRolePercentile"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                input.assistRateRolePercentile(),
                "assistRateRolePercentile"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                decimal(input.startingProbability()),
                "startingProbability"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                decimal(input.availabilityProbability()),
                "availabilityProbability"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                decimal(input.fixtureDifficulty()),
                "fixtureDifficulty"
        );

        validatePercentage(
                decimal(input.dataConfidenceScore()),
                "dataConfidenceScore"
        );

        if (input.historySeasonsAvailable() < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "historySeasonsAvailable non puÃ² essere negativo"
            );
        }

        String availabilityStatus =
                normalizeAvailabilityStatus(
                        input.availabilityStatus()
                );

        List<Double> performanceSignals =
                performanceSignals(
                        role,
                        input
                );

        Double performanceScore =
                medianOrNull(
                        performanceSignals
                );

        Double startingProbability =
                decimal(
                        input.startingProbability()
                );

        Double availabilityProbability =
                decimal(
                        input.availabilityProbability()
                );

        Double fixtureDifficulty =
                decimal(
                        input.fixtureDifficulty()
                );

        Double fixtureScore =
                fixtureDifficulty == null
                        ? null
                        : 100.0 - fixtureDifficulty;

        boolean hardUnavailable =
                isHardUnavailable(
                        availabilityStatus
                );

        int domainSignalCount = 0;

        if (performanceScore != null) {
            domainSignalCount++;
        }

        if (startingProbability != null) {
            domainSignalCount++;
        }

        if (availabilityProbability != null) {
            domainSignalCount++;
        }

        if (fixtureScore != null) {
            domainSignalCount++;
        }

        BigDecimal confidence =
                confidence(
                        performanceScore,
                        input.dataConfidenceScore(),
                        startingProbability,
                        availabilityProbability,
                        fixtureScore
                );

        String evidenceTier =
                evidenceTier(
                        performanceSignals.size(),
                        input.dataConfidenceScore(),
                        startingProbability,
                        availabilityProbability,
                        fixtureScore,
                        domainSignalCount
                );

        if (hardUnavailable) {
            return new ScoreResult(
                    BigDecimal.ZERO.setScale(2),
                    roundNullable(performanceScore),
                    roundNullable(fixtureScore),
                    roundNullable(startingProbability),
                    roundNullable(availabilityProbability),
                    performanceSignals.size(),
                    domainSignalCount,
                    evidenceTier,
                    confidence,
                    false,
                    exclusionReason(availabilityStatus)
            );
        }

        Double selectionScore =
                weightedAvailableScore(
                        performanceScore,
                        startingProbability,
                        availabilityProbability,
                        fixtureScore
                );

        return new ScoreResult(
                roundNullable(selectionScore),
                roundNullable(performanceScore),
                roundNullable(fixtureScore),
                roundNullable(startingProbability),
                roundNullable(availabilityProbability),
                performanceSignals.size(),
                domainSignalCount,
                evidenceTier,
                confidence,
                selectionScore != null,
                selectionScore == null
                        ? "Nessun segnale reale disponibile"
                        : null
        );
    }

    private List<Double> performanceSignals(
            String role,
            Input input
    ) {

        List<Double> signals =
                new ArrayList<>();

        addIfPresent(
                signals,
                input.fantasyAverageRolePercentile()
        );

        addIfPresent(
                signals,
                input.usageRolePercentile()
        );

        /*
         * For goalkeepers B66 does not expose role-normalized
         * goalkeeper-specific goal/assist performance indicators.
         * Therefore only fantasy average and usage are admitted.
         */
        if (!"P".equals(role)) {

            addIfPresent(
                    signals,
                    input.goalRateRolePercentile()
            );

            addIfPresent(
                    signals,
                    input.assistRateRolePercentile()
            );
        }

        return signals;
    }

    private Double weightedAvailableScore(
            Double performanceScore,
            Double startingProbability,
            Double availabilityProbability,
            Double fixtureScore
    ) {

        double weightedTotal = 0;
        double availableWeight = 0;

        if (performanceScore != null) {
            weightedTotal +=
                    performanceScore
                            * PERFORMANCE_WEIGHT;

            availableWeight +=
                    PERFORMANCE_WEIGHT;
        }

        if (startingProbability != null) {
            weightedTotal +=
                    startingProbability
                            * STARTING_WEIGHT;

            availableWeight +=
                    STARTING_WEIGHT;
        }

        if (availabilityProbability != null) {
            weightedTotal +=
                    availabilityProbability
                            * AVAILABILITY_WEIGHT;

            availableWeight +=
                    AVAILABILITY_WEIGHT;
        }

        if (fixtureScore != null) {
            weightedTotal +=
                    fixtureScore
                            * FIXTURE_WEIGHT;

            availableWeight +=
                    FIXTURE_WEIGHT;
        }

        if (availableWeight == 0) {
            return null;
        }

        return weightedTotal / availableWeight;
    }

    private BigDecimal confidence(
            Double performanceScore,
            BigDecimal dataConfidenceScore,
            Double startingProbability,
            Double availabilityProbability,
            Double fixtureScore
    ) {

        double value = 0;

        if (performanceScore != null) {
            Double performanceConfidence =
                    decimal(
                            dataConfidenceScore
                    );

            if (performanceConfidence != null) {
                value +=
                        performanceConfidence
                                * PERFORMANCE_WEIGHT;
            }
        }

        if (startingProbability != null) {
            value += 100 * STARTING_WEIGHT;
        }

        if (availabilityProbability != null) {
            value += 100 * AVAILABILITY_WEIGHT;
        }

        if (fixtureScore != null) {
            value += 100 * FIXTURE_WEIGHT;
        }

        return round(value);
    }

    private String evidenceTier(
            int performanceSignalCount,
            BigDecimal dataConfidenceScore,
            Double startingProbability,
            Double availabilityProbability,
            Double fixtureScore,
            int domainSignalCount
    ) {

        double historicalConfidence =
                dataConfidenceScore == null
                        ? 0
                        : dataConfidenceScore
                                .doubleValue();

        if (
                historicalConfidence >= 80
                && performanceSignalCount >= 3
                && startingProbability != null
                && availabilityProbability != null
                && fixtureScore != null
        ) {
            return "HIGH";
        }

        if (
                historicalConfidence >= 70
                && performanceSignalCount >= 1
                && fixtureScore != null
                && (
                        startingProbability != null
                        || availabilityProbability != null
                )
        ) {
            return "MEDIUM";
        }

        if (domainSignalCount >= 2) {
            return "LOW";
        }

        if (domainSignalCount == 1) {
            return "MINIMAL";
        }

        return "NO_EVIDENCE";
    }

    private boolean isHardUnavailable(
            String status
    ) {

        return "INJURED".equals(status)
                || "SUSPENDED".equals(status)
                || "UNAVAILABLE".equals(status);
    }

    private String exclusionReason(
            String status
    ) {

        return switch (status) {

            case "INJURED" ->
                    "Giocatore escluso: infortunato";

            case "SUSPENDED" ->
                    "Giocatore escluso: squalificato";

            case "UNAVAILABLE" ->
                    "Giocatore escluso: indisponibile";

            default ->
                    "Giocatore non utilizzabile";
        };
    }

    private String normalizeAvailabilityStatus(
            String value
    ) {

        if (
                value == null
                || value.isBlank()
        ) {
            return "UNKNOWN";
        }

        return value
                .trim()
                .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private String normalizeRole(
            String role
    ) {

        if (role == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Ruolo B68 obbligatorio"
            );
        }

        String normalized =
                role.trim()
                        .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (
                !"P".equals(normalized)
                && !"D".equals(normalized)
                && !"C".equals(normalized)
                && !"A".equals(normalized)
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Ruolo B68 non valido: "
                            + role
            );
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private void validatePercentage(
            Double value,
            String field
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return;
        }

        if (
                !Double.isFinite(value)
                || value < 0
                || value > 100
        ) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    field
                            + " deve essere compreso tra 0 e 100"
            );
        }
    }

    private void addIfPresent(
            List<Double> values,
            Double value
    ) {

        if (value != null) {
            values.add(value);
        }
    }

    private Double medianOrNull(
            List<Double> values
    ) {

        if (values.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        List<Double> ordered =
                values.stream()
                        .sorted(
                                Comparator.naturalOrder()
                        )
                        .toList();

        int size = ordered.size();

        if (size % 2 == 1) {
            return ordered.get(
                    size / 2
            );
        }

        return (
                ordered.get(
                        size / 2 - 1
                )
                + ordered.get(
                        size / 2
                )
        ) / 2.0;
    }

    private Double decimal(
            BigDecimal value
    ) {

        return value == null
                ? null
                : value.doubleValue();
    }

    private BigDecimal roundNullable(
            Double value
    ) {

        return value == null
                ? null
                : round(value);
    }

    private BigDecimal round(
            double value
    ) {

        return BigDecimal
                .valueOf(value)
                .setScale(
                        2,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                );
    }

    public record Input(
            String role,
            Double fantasyAverageRolePercentile,
            Double usageRolePercentile,
            Double goalRateRolePercentile,
            Double assistRateRolePercentile,
            BigDecimal startingProbability,
            BigDecimal availabilityProbability,
            String availabilityStatus,
            BigDecimal fixtureDifficulty,
            BigDecimal dataConfidenceScore,
            int historySeasonsAvailable
    ) {
    }

    public record ScoreResult(
            BigDecimal selectionScore,
            BigDecimal performanceScore,
            BigDecimal fixtureScore,
            BigDecimal startingProbability,
            BigDecimal availabilityProbability,
            int performanceSignalCount,
            int domainSignalCount,
            String evidenceTier,
            BigDecimal confidence,
            boolean actionable,
            String exclusionReason
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.lineup;

import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/lineups")
public class RecommendedLineupController {

    private final RecommendedLineupService service;

    public RecommendedLineupController(
            RecommendedLineupService service
    ) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    @GetMapping("/recommended")
    public RecommendedLineupResponse recommend(

            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "#{@currentSeasonResolver.resolve()}")
            String season,

            @RequestParam
            int matchday,

            @RequestParam(required = false)
            Long squadId,

            @RequestParam(
                    required = false,
                    defaultValue = ""
            )
            String unavailablePlayerIds,

            Authentication authentication
    ) {
        return service.recommend(
                season,
                matchday,
                squadId,
                unavailablePlayerIds,
                authentication.getName(),
                isAdmin(authentication)
        );
    }

    private boolean isAdmin(Authentication authentication) {
        return authentication.getAuthorities().stream()
                .anyMatch(authority -> "ROLE_ADMIN".equals(authority.getAuthority()));
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.lineup;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.B69FixtureMatchupResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.B69FixtureMatchupService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.B69RoleDifficultyResponse;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class RecommendedLineupService {

    private static final String PERFORMANCE_VERSION =
            "B66_FEATURES_V3";

    private static final List<Formation> FORMATIONS =
            List.of(
                    new Formation("3-4-3", 3, 4, 3),
                    new Formation("3-5-2", 3, 5, 2),
                    new Formation("4-3-3", 4, 3, 3),
                    new Formation("4-4-2", 4, 4, 2),
                    new Formation("4-5-1", 4, 5, 1),
                    new Formation("5-3-2", 5, 3, 2),
                    new Formation("5-4-1", 5, 4, 1)
            );

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final B69FixtureMatchupService matchupService;
    private final B68LineupScorer lineupScorer;

    public RecommendedLineupService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            B69FixtureMatchupService matchupService,
            B68LineupScorer lineupScorer
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.matchupService = matchupService;
        this.lineupScorer = lineupScorer;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public RecommendedLineupResponse recommend(
            String season,
            int matchday,
            String unavailablePlayerIds
    ) {
        return recommend(
                season,
                matchday,
                null,
                unavailablePlayerIds
        );
    }

    /**
     * Ownership-aware HTTP path: the squad is always resolved for the
     * authenticated principal (or an administrator) and never for another
     * owner. This is the only path used by RecommendedLineupController.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public RecommendedLineupResponse recommend(
            String season,
            int matchday,
            Long requestedSquadId,
            String unavailablePlayerIds,
            String username,
            boolean administrator
    ) {

        Long squadId =
                resolveSquadId(
                        season,
                        requestedSquadId,
                        username,
                        administrator
                );

        return buildRecommendation(
                season,
                matchday,
                squadId,
                unavailablePlayerIds
        );
    }

    /**
     * Compatibility path for internal callers and backend tests.
     * It deliberately does NOT enforce ownership: it is not reachable
     * through the HTTP controller anymore.
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public RecommendedLineupResponse recommend(
            String season,
            int matchday,
            Long requestedSquadId,
            String unavailablePlayerIds
    ) {

        Long squadId =
                resolveSquadId(
                        season,
                        requestedSquadId
                );

        return buildRecommendation(
                season,
                matchday,
                squadId,
                unavailablePlayerIds
        );
    }

    private RecommendedLineupResponse buildRecommendation(
            String season,
            int matchday,
            Long squadId,
            String unavailablePlayerIds
    ) {

        if (matchday < 1 || matchday > 38) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "La giornata deve essere compresa tra 1 e 38"
            );
        }

        List<PlayerCandidate> candidates =
                loadCandidates(
                        season,
                        matchday,
                        squadId
                );

        FormationResult bestResult =
                FORMATIONS.stream()
                        .map(formation ->
                                evaluateFormation(
                                        formation,
                                        candidates
                                )
                        )
                        .max(
                                Comparator
                                        .comparingInt(
                                                FormationResult::
                                                        selectedPlayers
                                        )
                                        .thenComparing(
                                                FormationResult::
                                                        totalScore
                                        )
                        )
                        .orElseThrow();

        List<LineupPlayerResponse> starters =
                bestResult.selected()
                        .stream()
                        .sorted(
                                candidateRoleComparator()
                        )
                        .map(this::toResponse)
                        .toList();

        List<Long> starterIds =
                bestResult.selected()
                        .stream()
                        .map(
                                PlayerCandidate::playerId
                        )
                        .toList();

        List<LineupPlayerResponse> bench =
                createSmartBench(
                        candidates,
                        starterIds
                );

        List<Long> simulatedUnavailableIds =
                parseUnavailablePlayerIds(
                        unavailablePlayerIds
                );

        int maxSubstitutions =
                loadMaxSubstitutions(
                        squadId
                );

        List<LineupSubstitutionResponse> substitutions =
                createAutomaticSubstitutions(
                        starters,
                        bench,
                        simulatedUnavailableIds,
                        maxSubstitutions
                );

        Map<String, LineupRoleSummaryResponse> roles =
                createRoleSummary(
                        bestResult.formation(),
                        bestResult.selected()
                );

        int missingPlayers =
                11 - bestResult.selectedPlayers();

        List<String> warnings =
                new ArrayList<>();

        long unavailableStarters =
                starters.stream()
                        .filter(starter ->
                                simulatedUnavailableIds.contains(
                                        starter.playerId()
                                )
                        )
                        .count();

        if (
                unavailableStarters
                        > substitutions.size()
        ) {

            if (
                    substitutions.size()
                            >= maxSubstitutions
            ) {
                warnings.add(
                        "Limite massimo di "
                                + maxSubstitutions
                                + " sostituzioni raggiunto."
                );
            } else {
                warnings.add(
                        "Una o pi\u00F9 assenze non possono essere coperte: " + "nessuna riserva valida disponibile."
                );
            }
        }

        if (missingPlayers > 0) {
            warnings.add(
                    "Rosa incompleta: mancano "
                            + missingPlayers
                            + " giocatori per completare gli 11."
            );
        }

        long noEvidencePlayers =
                candidates.stream()
                        .filter(candidate ->
                                !candidate.actionable()
                        )
                        .filter(candidate ->
                                !isHardUnavailable(
                                        candidate.availabilityStatus()
                                )
                        )
                        .count();

        if (noEvidencePlayers > 0) {
            warnings.add(
                    noEvidencePlayers
                            + " giocatori non sono classificabili "
                            + "per insufficienza di evidenza reale."
            );
        }

        appendRoleWarning(
                warnings,
                roles,
                "P",
                "portieri"
        );

        appendRoleWarning(
                warnings,
                roles,
                "D",
                "difensori"
        );

        appendRoleWarning(
                warnings,
                roles,
                "C",
                "centrocampisti"
        );

        appendRoleWarning(
                warnings,
                roles,
                "A",
                "attaccanti"
        );

        BigDecimal formationScore =
                bestResult.selected().isEmpty()
                        ? BigDecimal.ZERO
                                .setScale(2)
                        : bestResult.totalScore()
                                .divide(
                                        BigDecimal.valueOf(
                                                bestResult
                                                        .selectedPlayers()
                                        ),
                                        2,
                                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                                );

        return new RecommendedLineupResponse(
                season,
                matchday,
                squadId,
                bestResult.formation().name(),
                missingPlayers == 0,
                bestResult.selectedPlayers(),
                missingPlayers,
                formationScore,
                roles,
                starters,
                bench,
                maxSubstitutions,
                substitutions.size(),
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        maxSubstitutions
                                - substitutions.size()
                ),
                substitutions,
                List.copyOf(warnings)
        );
    }

    private Long resolveSquadId(
            String season,
            Long requestedSquadId
    ) {

        if (requestedSquadId != null) {

            return jdbcClient.sql("""
                    SELECT squad.id

                    FROM fantasy_squads squad

                    WHERE squad.id = :squadId
                      AND squad.active = TRUE

                      AND EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1

                          FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player

                          JOIN seasons season
                              ON season.id =
                                  squad_player.season_id

                          WHERE squad_player.squad_id =
                                  squad.id

                            AND season.code = :season
                      )
                    """)
                    .param(
                            "squadId",
                            requestedSquadId
                    )
                    .param(
                            "season",
                            season
                    )
                    .query(Long.class)
                    .optional()
                    .orElseThrow(() ->
                            new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                    "Rosa attiva non trovata: "
                                            + requestedSquadId
                                            + " per la stagione "
                                            + season
                            )
                    );
        }

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT squad.id

                FROM fantasy_squads squad

                WHERE squad.active = TRUE

                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1

                      FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player

                      JOIN seasons season
                          ON season.id =
                              squad_player.season_id

                      WHERE squad_player.squad_id =
                              squad.id

                        AND season.code = :season
                  )

                ORDER BY squad.id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param(
                        "season",
                        season
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Nessuna rosa attiva trovata "
                                        + "per la stagione "
                                        + season
                        )
                );
    }

    /**
     * Ownership-aware squad resolution used by the HTTP path:
     * a requested squadId must belong to the authenticated principal,
     * and without squadId only the principal's own active squad is used.
     * Administrators may resolve any squad, mirroring SquadService.
     */
    private Long resolveSquadId(
            String season,
            Long requestedSquadId,
            String username,
            boolean administrator
    ) {

        if (requestedSquadId != null) {

            return jdbcClient.sql("""
                    SELECT squad.id

                    FROM fantasy_squads squad

                    WHERE squad.id = :squadId
                      AND squad.active = TRUE

                      AND (
                          :administrator = TRUE
                          OR LOWER(squad.owner_username)
                             = LOWER(:username)
                      )

                      AND EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1

                          FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player

                          JOIN seasons season
                              ON season.id =
                                  squad_player.season_id

                          WHERE squad_player.squad_id =
                                  squad.id

                            AND season.code = :season
                      )
                    """)
                    .param(
                            "squadId",
                            requestedSquadId
                    )
                    .param(
                            "username",
                            username
                    )
                    .param(
                            "administrator",
                            administrator
                    )
                    .param(
                            "season",
                            season
                    )
                    .query(Long.class)
                    .optional()
                    .orElseThrow(() ->
                            new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                    "Rosa attiva non trovata: "
                                            + requestedSquadId
                                            + " per la stagione "
                                            + season
                            )
                    );
        }

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT squad.id

                FROM fantasy_squads squad

                WHERE squad.active = TRUE

                  AND (
                      :administrator = TRUE
                      OR LOWER(squad.owner_username)
                         = LOWER(:username)
                  )

                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1

                      FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player

                      JOIN seasons season
                          ON season.id =
                              squad_player.season_id

                      WHERE squad_player.squad_id =
                              squad.id

                        AND season.code = :season
                  )

                ORDER BY squad.id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param(
                        "username",
                        username
                )
                .param(
                        "administrator",
                        administrator
                )
                .param(
                        "season",
                        season
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Nessuna rosa attiva trovata "
                                        + "per la stagione "
                                        + season
                        )
                );
    }

    private List<PlayerCandidate> loadCandidates(
            String season,
            int matchday,
            Long squadId
    ) {

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            player.id AS player_id,
                            player.display_name,
                            club.name AS club_name,
                            club.slug AS club_slug,
                            squad_player.fantasy_role,

                            performance.history_seasons_available,
                            performance.data_confidence_score,

                            (
                                performance.feature_values
                                    ->> 'fantasy_average_role_percentile'
                            )::double precision
                                AS fantasy_average_role_percentile,

                            (
                                performance.feature_values
                                    ->> 'usage_role_percentile'
                            )::double precision
                                AS usage_role_percentile,

                            (
                                performance.feature_values
                                    ->> 'goal_rate_role_percentile'
                            )::double precision
                                AS goal_rate_role_percentile,

                            (
                                performance.feature_values
                                    ->> 'assist_rate_role_percentile'
                            )::double precision
                                AS assist_rate_role_percentile,

                            availability.status
                                AS availability_status,

                            availability.starting_probability
                                AS starting_probability,

                            availability.availability_probability
                                AS availability_probability

                        FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player

                        JOIN fantasy_squads squad
                            ON squad.id =
                                squad_player.squad_id

                        JOIN players player
                            ON player.id =
                                squad_player.player_id

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id =
                                squad_player.season_id

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id =
                                player.id

                            AND registration.season_id =
                                season.id

                            AND registration.registration_status =
                                'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN clubs club
                            ON club.id =
                                registration.club_id

                        LEFT JOIN player_performance_feature_profiles
                            performance

                            ON performance.player_id =
                                player.id

                            AND performance.reference_season_id =
                                season.id

                            AND performance.algorithm_version =
                                :performanceVersion

                        LEFT JOIN player_availabilities availability
                            ON availability.player_id =
                                player.id

                            AND availability.season_id =
                                season.id

                            AND availability.matchday =
                                :matchday

                        WHERE squad.active = TRUE

                          AND player.active = TRUE

                          AND season.code = :season

                          AND squad.id = :squadId

                        ORDER BY player.display_name
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "performanceVersion",
                                PERFORMANCE_VERSION
                        )
                        .param(
                                "season",
                                season
                        )
                        .param(
                                "matchday",
                                matchday
                        )
                        .param(
                                "squadId",
                                squadId
                        )
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        List<PlayerCandidate> candidates =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {

            String clubSlug =
                    stringValue(
                            row.get("club_slug")
                    );

            String fantasyRole =
                    stringValue(
                            row.get("fantasy_role")
                    );

            B69FixtureMatchupResponse fixture =
                    matchupService
                            .findClubMatchups(
                                    season,
                                    clubSlug,
                                    matchday,
                                    matchday
                            )
                            .stream()
                            .findFirst()
                            .orElse(null);

            B69RoleDifficultyResponse roleMatchup =
                    fixture == null
                            ? null
                            : fixture.roles()
                                    .stream()
                                    .filter(role ->
                                            fantasyRole.equals(
                                                    role.role()
                                            )
                                    )
                                    .findFirst()
                                    .orElse(null);

            BigDecimal fixtureDifficulty =
                    roleMatchup == null
                            ? null
                            : roleMatchup
                                    .difficultyScore();

            BigDecimal startingProbability =
                    decimalOrNull(
                            row.get(
                                    "starting_probability"
                            )
                    );

            BigDecimal availabilityProbability =
                    decimalOrNull(
                            row.get(
                                    "availability_probability"
                            )
                    );

            String availabilityStatus =
                    stringValue(
                            row.get(
                                    "availability_status"
                            )
                    );

            if (
                    availabilityStatus == null
                    || availabilityStatus.isBlank()
            ) {
                availabilityStatus = "UNKNOWN";
            }

            BigDecimal confidence =
                    decimalOrNull(
                            row.get(
                                    "data_confidence_score"
                            )
                    );

            Integer historySeasons =
                    integerOrNull(
                            row.get(
                                    "history_seasons_available"
                            )
                    );

            B68LineupScorer.ScoreResult score =
                    lineupScorer.score(
                            new B68LineupScorer.Input(
                                    fantasyRole,
                                    doubleOrNull(
                                            row.get(
                                                    "fantasy_average_role_percentile"
                                            )
                                    ),
                                    doubleOrNull(
                                            row.get(
                                                    "usage_role_percentile"
                                            )
                                    ),
                                    doubleOrNull(
                                            row.get(
                                                    "goal_rate_role_percentile"
                                            )
                                    ),
                                    doubleOrNull(
                                            row.get(
                                                    "assist_rate_role_percentile"
                                            )
                                    ),
                                    startingProbability,
                                    availabilityProbability,
                                    availabilityStatus,
                                    fixtureDifficulty,
                                    confidence,
                                    historySeasons == null
                                            ? 0
                                            : historySeasons
                            )
                    );

            String reason =
                    createReason(
                            availabilityStatus,
                            score,
                            fixture,
                            roleMatchup,
                            historySeasons
                    );

            candidates.add(
                    new PlayerCandidate(
                            ((Number) row.get(
                                    "player_id"
                            )).longValue(),

                            stringValue(
                                    row.get(
                                            "display_name"
                                    )
                            ),

                            stringValue(
                                    row.get(
                                            "club_name"
                                    )
                            ),

                            stringValue(
                                    row.get(
                                            "fantasy_role"
                                    )
                            ),

                            fixture == null
                                    ? "Partita non disponibile"
                                    : fixture.opponent(),

                            fixture != null
                                    && fixture.home(),

                            fixtureDifficulty,

                            score.selectionScore(),

                            reason,

                            availabilityStatus,

                            score.actionable(),

                            score.evidenceTier(),

                            score.confidence()
                    )
            );
        }

        return candidates;
    }

    private FormationResult evaluateFormation(
            Formation formation,
            List<PlayerCandidate> candidates
    ) {

        List<PlayerCandidate> selected =
                new ArrayList<>();

        selected.addAll(
                selectByRole(
                        candidates,
                        "P",
                        1
                )
        );

        selected.addAll(
                selectByRole(
                        candidates,
                        "D",
                        formation.defenders()
                )
        );

        selected.addAll(
                selectByRole(
                        candidates,
                        "C",
                        formation.midfielders()
                )
        );

        selected.addAll(
                selectByRole(
                        candidates,
                        "A",
                        formation.forwards()
                )
        );

        BigDecimal totalScore =
                selected.stream()
                        .map(
                                PlayerCandidate::
                                        selectionScore
                        )
                        .reduce(
                                BigDecimal.ZERO,
                                BigDecimal::add
                        );

        return new FormationResult(
                formation,
                selected,
                selected.size(),
                totalScore
        );
    }

    private List<PlayerCandidate> selectByRole(
            List<PlayerCandidate> candidates,
            String role,
            int maximum
    ) {

        return candidates.stream()
                .filter(candidate ->
                        role.equals(
                                candidate.role()
                        )
                )
                .filter(
                        PlayerCandidate::actionable
                )
                .filter(candidate ->
                        !isHardUnavailable(
                                candidate
                                        .availabilityStatus()
                        )
                )
                .filter(candidate ->
                        candidate.selectionScore()
                                != null
                )
                .sorted(
                        Comparator
                                .comparing(
                                        PlayerCandidate::
                                                selectionScore
                                )
                                .reversed()
                                .thenComparing(
                                        PlayerCandidate::
                                                playerId
                                )
                )
                .limit(maximum)
                .toList();
    }

    private int loadMaxSubstitutions(
            Long squadId
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT league.max_substitutions

                FROM fantasy_squads squad

                JOIN league_configurations league
                    ON league.id =
                        squad.league_configuration_id

                WHERE squad.id = :squadId
                """)
                .param(
                        "squadId",
                        squadId
                )
                .query(Integer.class)
                .optional()
                .orElse(3);
    }

    private List<Long> parseUnavailablePlayerIds(
            String unavailablePlayerIds
    ) {

        if (
                unavailablePlayerIds == null
                || unavailablePlayerIds.isBlank()
        ) {
            return List.of();
        }

        try {
            return List.of(
                    unavailablePlayerIds.split(",")
            )
                    .stream()
                    .map(String::trim)
                    .filter(value ->
                            !value.isBlank()
                    )
                    .map(Long::valueOf)
                    .distinct()
                    .toList();

        } catch (NumberFormatException exception) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "unavailablePlayerIds deve contenere "
                            + "solo ID numerici separati da virgole"
            );
        }
    }

    private List<LineupSubstitutionResponse>
            createAutomaticSubstitutions(
                    List<LineupPlayerResponse> starters,
                    List<LineupPlayerResponse> bench,
                    List<Long> simulatedUnavailableIds,
                    int maxSubstitutions
            ) {

        List<LineupSubstitutionResponse> substitutions =
                new ArrayList<>();

        List<Long> usedBenchPlayerIds =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (LineupPlayerResponse starter : starters) {

            if (
                    substitutions.size()
                            >= maxSubstitutions
            ) {
                break;
            }

            if (
                    !requiresSubstitution(
                            starter,
                            simulatedUnavailableIds
                    )
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            LineupPlayerResponse replacement =
                    bench.stream()
                            .filter(candidate ->
                                    candidate.role()
                                            .equals(
                                                    starter.role()
                                            )
                            )
                            .filter(
                                    this::
                                            isUsableSubstitute
                            )
                            .filter(candidate ->
                                    !usedBenchPlayerIds
                                            .contains(
                                                    candidate
                                                            .playerId()
                                            )
                            )
                            .findFirst()
                            .orElse(null);

            if (replacement == null) {
                continue;
            }

            usedBenchPlayerIds.add(
                    replacement.playerId()
            );

            substitutions.add(
                    new LineupSubstitutionResponse(
                            starter,
                            replacement,
                            simulatedUnavailableIds
                                    .contains(
                                            starter.playerId()
                                    )
                                    ? "Sostituzione automatica: "
                                            + "assenza simulata"
                                    : "Sostituzione automatica "
                                            + "per stato "
                                            + starter
                                                    .availabilityStatus()
                    )
            );
        }

        return substitutions;
    }

    private boolean requiresSubstitution(
            LineupPlayerResponse player,
            List<Long> simulatedUnavailableIds
    ) {

        return simulatedUnavailableIds
                .contains(
                        player.playerId()
                )
                || isHardUnavailable(
                        player.availabilityStatus()
                );
    }

    private boolean isUsableSubstitute(
            LineupPlayerResponse player
    ) {

        return !isHardUnavailable(
                player.availabilityStatus()
        )
                && player.selectionScore() != null;
    }

    private boolean isHardUnavailable(
            String status
    ) {

        return "INJURED".equals(status)
                || "SUSPENDED".equals(status)
                || "UNAVAILABLE".equals(status);
    }

    private List<LineupPlayerResponse> createSmartBench(
            List<PlayerCandidate> candidates,
            List<Long> starterIds
    ) {

        List<PlayerCandidate> reserves =
                candidates.stream()
                        .filter(candidate ->
                                !starterIds.contains(
                                        candidate.playerId()
                                )
                        )
                        .toList();

        List<PlayerCandidate> orderedBench =
                new ArrayList<>();

        addBenchPlayersByRole(
                orderedBench,
                reserves,
                "P"
        );

        addBenchPlayersByRole(
                orderedBench,
                reserves,
                "D"
        );

        addBenchPlayersByRole(
                orderedBench,
                reserves,
                "C"
        );

        addBenchPlayersByRole(
                orderedBench,
                reserves,
                "A"
        );

        return orderedBench.stream()
                .map(this::toResponse)
                .toList();
    }

    private void addBenchPlayersByRole(
            List<PlayerCandidate> bench,
            List<PlayerCandidate> reserves,
            String role
    ) {

        reserves.stream()
                .filter(candidate ->
                        role.equals(
                                candidate.role()
                        )
                )
                .sorted(
                        Comparator
                                .comparingInt(
                                        this::
                                                availabilityPriority
                                )
                                .thenComparing(
                                        candidate ->
                                                candidate
                                                        .selectionScore()
                                                        == null
                                                        ? BigDecimal
                                                                .valueOf(-1)
                                                        : candidate
                                                                .selectionScore(),
                                        Comparator
                                                .reverseOrder()
                                )
                                .thenComparing(
                                        PlayerCandidate::
                                                playerId
                                )
                )
                .forEach(
                        bench::add
                );
    }

    private int availabilityPriority(
            PlayerCandidate candidate
    ) {

        return switch (
                candidate.availabilityStatus()
        ) {
            case "AVAILABLE", "PROBABLE" -> 1;
            case "DOUBTFUL" -> 2;
            case "UNKNOWN" -> 3;
            case "INJURED" -> 4;
            case "SUSPENDED" -> 5;
            case "UNAVAILABLE" -> 6;
            default -> 7;
        };
    }

    private Map<String, LineupRoleSummaryResponse>
            createRoleSummary(
                    Formation formation,
                    List<PlayerCandidate> selected
            ) {

        Map<String, LineupRoleSummaryResponse> roles =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        roles.put(
                "P",
                summary(
                        selected,
                        "P",
                        1
                )
        );

        roles.put(
                "D",
                summary(
                        selected,
                        "D",
                        formation.defenders()
                )
        );

        roles.put(
                "C",
                summary(
                        selected,
                        "C",
                        formation.midfielders()
                )
        );

        roles.put(
                "A",
                summary(
                        selected,
                        "A",
                        formation.forwards()
                )
        );

        return roles;
    }

    private LineupRoleSummaryResponse summary(
            List<PlayerCandidate> selected,
            String role,
            int required
    ) {

        int current =
                (int) selected.stream()
                        .filter(candidate ->
                                role.equals(
                                        candidate.role()
                                )
                        )
                        .count();

        return new LineupRoleSummaryResponse(
                required,
                current,
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        required - current
                )
        );
    }

    private void appendRoleWarning(
            List<String> warnings,
            Map<String, LineupRoleSummaryResponse> roles,
            String role,
            String roleName
    ) {

        LineupRoleSummaryResponse summary =
                roles.get(role);

        if (summary.missing() > 0) {
            warnings.add(
                    "Mancano "
                            + summary.missing()
                            + " "
                            + roleName
                            + "."
            );
        }
    }

    private Comparator<PlayerCandidate>
            candidateRoleComparator() {

        return Comparator
                .comparingInt(
                        (PlayerCandidate player) ->
                                roleOrder(
                                        player.role()
                                )
                )
                .thenComparing(
                        PlayerCandidate::
                                selectionScore,
                        Comparator.reverseOrder()
                )
                .thenComparing(
                        PlayerCandidate::
                                playerId
                );
    }

    private int roleOrder(
            String role
    ) {

        return switch (role) {
            case "P" -> 1;
            case "D" -> 2;
            case "C" -> 3;
            case "A" -> 4;
            default -> 5;
        };
    }

    private LineupPlayerResponse toResponse(
            PlayerCandidate candidate
    ) {

        return new LineupPlayerResponse(
                candidate.playerId(),
                candidate.playerName(),
                candidate.club(),
                candidate.role(),
                candidate.opponent(),
                candidate.home(),
                candidate.fixtureDifficulty(),
                candidate.selectionScore(),
                candidate.availabilityStatus(),
                candidate.reason()
        );
    }

    private String createReason(
            String availabilityStatus,
            B68LineupScorer.ScoreResult score,
            B69FixtureMatchupResponse fixture,
            B69RoleDifficultyResponse roleMatchup,
            Integer historySeasons
    ) {

        List<String> evidence =
                new ArrayList<>();

        evidence.add(
                "stato "
                        + availabilityStatus
        );

        if (
                score.performanceScore()
                        != null
        ) {
            evidence.add(
                    "performance B66 "
                            + score
                                    .performanceScore()
                            + "/100"
            );
        }

        if (
                score.startingProbability()
                        != null
        ) {
            evidence.add(
                    "titolarit\u00E0 "
                            + score
                                    .startingProbability()
                            + "%"
            );
        }

        if (
                score.availabilityProbability()
                        != null
        ) {
            evidence.add(
                    "disponibilit\u00E0 "
                            + score
                                    .availabilityProbability()
                            + "%"
            );
        }

        if (fixture != null) {

            evidence.add(
                    "avversario "
                            + fixture.opponent()
            );

            evidence.add(
                    "difficolt\u00E0 "
                            + (
                                    roleMatchup == null
                                            || roleMatchup.difficultyScore()
                                                    == null
                                            ? "non disponibile"
                                            : roleMatchup.difficultyScore()
                                                    + "/100"
                            )
            );

            evidence.add(
                    fixture.home()
                            ? "casa"
                            : "trasferta"
            );
        }

        evidence.add(
                "evidenza "
                        + score.evidenceTier()
        );

        evidence.add(
                "confidence "
                        + score.confidence()
                        + "/100"
        );

        if (historySeasons != null) {
            evidence.add(
                    "storico "
                            + historySeasons
                            + " stagioni"
            );
        }

        if (
                score.exclusionReason()
                        != null
        ) {
            evidence.add(
                    score.exclusionReason()
            );
        }

        return String.join(
                ", ",
                evidence
        ) + ".";
    }

    private BigDecimal decimalOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (value instanceof BigDecimal decimal) {
            return decimal;
        }

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return BigDecimal.valueOf(
                    number.doubleValue()
            );
        }

        return new BigDecimal(
                value.toString()
        );
    }

    private Double doubleOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.doubleValue();
        }

        return Double.valueOf(
                value.toString()
        );
    }

    private Integer integerOrNull(
            Object value
    ) {

        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number.intValue();
        }

        return Integer.valueOf(
                value.toString()
        );
    }

    private String stringValue(
            Object value
    ) {

        return value == null
                ? null
                : value.toString();
    }

    private record Formation(
            String name,
            int defenders,
            int midfielders,
            int forwards
    ) {
    }

    private record FormationResult(
            Formation formation,
            List<PlayerCandidate> selected,
            int selectedPlayers,
            BigDecimal totalScore
    ) {
    }

    private record PlayerCandidate(
            Long playerId,
            String playerName,
            String club,
            String role,
            String opponent,
            boolean home,
            BigDecimal fixtureDifficulty,
            BigDecimal selectionScore,
            String reason,
            String availabilityStatus,
            boolean actionable,
            String evidenceTier,
            BigDecimal confidence
    ) {
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class LiveAuctionAlternativeService {
    private final LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy policy;

    public LiveAuctionAlternativeService(LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy policy) {
        this.policy = policy;
    }

    public Optional<LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation> dominantAlternative(
            LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation current, int currentBid,
            List<LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation> alternatives) {
        return alternatives.stream()
                .filter(candidate -> contextFit(current, candidate))
                .filter(candidate -> candidate.target().b51RecommendedPrice() <= candidate.target().targetPrice())
                .filter(candidate -> policy.alternativeSaving(
                        candidate.target().b51RecommendedPrice(), currentBid))
                .filter(candidate -> policy.comparableEvidence(evidence(candidate), evidence(current)))
                .sorted(Comparator
                        .comparing((LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation c) -> c.target().fitScore()).reversed()
                        .thenComparing((LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation c) -> calendarScore(c), Comparator.reverseOrder())
                        .thenComparing(c -> c.target().b51RecommendedPrice())
                        .thenComparing((LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation c) -> evidence(c), Comparator.reverseOrder())
                        .thenComparing(c -> c.target().playerId()))
                .findFirst();
    }

    private boolean contextFit(LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation current,
            LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation alternative) {
        int fitDelta = alternative.target().fitScore().compareTo(current.target().fitScore());
        if ("P".equals(current.target().role()) && fitDelta < 0) {
            boolean closeFit = alternative.target().fitScore().doubleValue()
                    >= current.target().fitScore().doubleValue()
                            - LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy.GOALKEEPER_MAX_FIT_COMPENSATION;
            boolean materiallyBetterCalendar = calendarScore(alternative) >= calendarScore(current)
                    + LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy.GOALKEEPER_CALENDAR_IMPROVEMENT;
            if (!(closeFit && materiallyBetterCalendar)) return false;
        } else if (fitDelta < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        if ("A".equals(current.target().role()) && current.calendar() != null
                && alternative.calendar() != null
                && alternative.calendar().hardOverlapCount() > current.calendar().hardOverlapCount()) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private double calendarScore(LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation candidate) {
        return candidate.calendar() == null || candidate.calendar().calendarCombinationScore() == null
                ? -1 : candidate.calendar().calendarCombinationScore().doubleValue();
    }

    private int evidence(LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation candidate) {
        return candidate.strategic() == null ? 0 : candidate.strategic().evidenceCompleteness().intValue();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.DynamicBudgetResponse;

@Component
public class LiveAuctionBudgetGuard {
    public Result evaluate(int bid, int remainingBudget, DynamicBudgetResponse budget) {
        int after = remainingBudget - bid;
        int remainingAfterPurchase = Math.max(0,
                budget.slotsRemainingByRole().values().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum() - 1);
        boolean completionSafe = after >= remainingAfterPurchase;
        boolean roleSafe = bid <= budget.contextualMaximumBid();
        return new Result(after, remainingAfterPurchase, completionSafe && roleSafe,
                !completionSafe ? "BID_BREAKS_COMPLETION_RESERVE"
                        : !roleSafe ? "BID_EXCEEDS_B54_CONTEXTUAL_MAX" : "BUDGET_SAFE");
    }

    public record Result(int budgetAfterBid, int minimumCompletionReserve,
            boolean sustainable, String reason) { }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.CalendarCandidateService.CalendarPlayerCandidate;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.CalendarCombinationResult;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.CalendarCombinationScorer;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.ClubFixtureProfile;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.FixtureWindowService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.BoughtPlayerRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.SquadTargetResponse;

@Service
public class LiveAuctionCalendarBatchService {
    private final FixtureWindowService windowService;
    private final CalendarCombinationScorer scorer;

    public LiveAuctionCalendarBatchService(FixtureWindowService windowService,
            CalendarCombinationScorer scorer) {
        this.windowService = windowService;
        this.scorer = scorer;
    }

    public Map<Long, CalendarCombinationResult> evaluate(String season, int from, int horizon,
            List<SquadTargetResponse> targets, List<CalendarPlayerCandidate> activeCandidates,
            List<BoughtPlayerRequest> boughtPlayers, String role) {
        Map<Long, CalendarPlayerCandidate> active = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        activeCandidates.forEach(candidate -> active.put(candidate.playerId(), candidate));
        List<Long> ownedClubIds = boughtPlayers.stream()
                .filter(player -> role.equalsIgnoreCase(player.role()))
                .map(BoughtPlayerRequest::playerId).map(active::get).filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull)
                .map(CalendarPlayerCandidate::clubId).distinct().sorted().limit(2).toList();
        if (ownedClubIds.isEmpty()) return Map.of();

        List<Long> clubIds = new ArrayList<>(ownedClubIds);
        targets.stream().map(SquadTargetResponse::playerId).map(active::get)
                .filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull).map(CalendarPlayerCandidate::clubId)
                .filter(id -> !clubIds.contains(id)).forEach(clubIds::add);
        Map<Long, ClubFixtureProfile> profiles = windowService.loadClubProfiles(season, clubIds, from, horizon);
        Map<Long, CalendarCombinationResult> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (SquadTargetResponse target : targets) {
            CalendarPlayerCandidate candidate = active.get(target.playerId());
            if (candidate == null || ownedClubIds.contains(candidate.clubId())) continue;
            List<Long> combination = new ArrayList<>();
            combination.add(candidate.clubId());
            ownedClubIds.stream().filter(id -> !id.equals(candidate.clubId()))
                    .limit(2).forEach(combination::add);
            if (combination.size() < 2) continue;
            List<ClubFixtureProfile> candidateProfiles = combination.stream().map(profiles::get)
                    .filter(java.util.Objects::nonNull).toList();
            if (candidateProfiles.size() == combination.size()) {
                result.put(target.playerId(), scorer.evaluate(candidateProfiles, from, horizon));
            }
        }
        return Map.copyOf(result);
    }
}
