package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squad;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class SquadService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public SquadService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public SquadResponse findActiveSquad() {
        Map<String, Object> squad =
                findActiveSquadRow();

        return buildSquadResponse(squad);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public SquadResponse findSquad(
            Long squadId
    ) {
        return buildSquadResponse(
                findSquadRow(squadId)
        );
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<SquadSummaryResponse> findSquads(
            String season,
            String username,
            boolean administrator
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    squad.id,
                    squad.name,
                    squad.initial_budget,
                    squad.active,

                    season.code AS season,

                    league.goalkeepers_count
                        + league.defenders_count
                        + league.midfielders_count
                        + league.forwards_count
                            AS maximum_players,

                    COUNT(squad_player.id)
                        AS total_players,

                    COALESCE(
                        SUM(squad_player.purchase_price),
                        0
                    ) AS spent_budget

                FROM fantasy_squads squad

                JOIN league_configurations league
                    ON league.id =
                        squad.league_configuration_id

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                        league.season_id

                LEFT JOIN fantasy_squad_players squad_player
                    ON squad_player.squad_id =
                        squad.id

                WHERE season.code = :season
                  AND (:administrator = TRUE OR LOWER(squad.owner_username) = LOWER(:username))

                GROUP BY
                    squad.id,
                    squad.name,
                    squad.initial_budget,
                    squad.active,
                    season.code,
                    league.goalkeepers_count,
                    league.defenders_count,
                    league.midfielders_count,
                    league.forwards_count

                ORDER BY
                    squad.active DESC,
                    squad.id
                """)
                .param("season", season)
                .param("username", username)
                .param("administrator", administrator)
                .query((rs, rowNumber) -> {
                    int initialBudget =
                            rs.getInt(
                                    "initial_budget"
                            );

                    int spentBudget =
                            rs.getInt(
                                    "spent_budget"
                            );

                    return new SquadSummaryResponse(
                            rs.getLong("id"),
                            rs.getString("name"),
                            rs.getString("season"),
                            initialBudget,
                            spentBudget,
                            initialBudget - spentBudget,
                            rs.getInt(
                                    "total_players"
                            ),
                            rs.getInt(
                                    "maximum_players"
                            ),
                            rs.getBoolean("active")
                    );
                })
                .list();
    }

    /** Internal compatibility path; HTTP callers always use the ownership-aware overload. */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<SquadSummaryResponse> findSquads(String season) {
        return findSquads(season, "", true);
    }

    @Transactional
    public SquadResponse createSquad(CreateSquadRequest request, String ownerUsername) {
        Map<String, Object> league = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id, total_budget
                FROM league_configurations
                WHERE id = :leagueId
                """)
                .param("leagueId", request.leagueConfigurationId())
                .query().listOfRows().stream().findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(
                        "Configurazione lega non trovata: " + request.leagueConfigurationId()
                ));

        if (request.active()) {
            jdbcClient.sql("""
                    UPDATE fantasy_squads
                    SET active = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                    WHERE active = TRUE AND LOWER(owner_username) = LOWER(:owner)
                    """)
                    .param("owner", ownerUsername)
                    .update();
        }

        Long squadId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fantasy_squads (
                    league_configuration_id, name, initial_budget, active, owner_username
                ) VALUES (:leagueId, :name, :budget, :active, :owner)
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param("leagueId", request.leagueConfigurationId())
                .param("name", request.name().trim())
                .param("budget", number(league, "total_budget").intValue())
                .param("active", request.active())
                .param("owner", ownerUsername)
                .query(Long.class).single();
        return findSquad(squadId);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public SquadResponse findActiveSquad(String username, boolean administrator) {
        return buildSquadResponse(findActiveSquadRow(username, administrator));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public SquadResponse findSquad(Long squadId, String username, boolean administrator) {
        assertAccess(squadId, username, administrator);
        return findSquad(squadId);
    }

    @Transactional
    public SquadResponse addPlayer(
            AddSquadPlayerRequest request
    ) {
        Map<String, Object> squad =
                findActiveSquadRow();

        Long squadId =
                number(squad, "id").longValue();

        return addPlayer(
                squadId,
                request
        );
    }

    @Transactional
    public SquadResponse addPlayer(
            Long squadId,
            AddSquadPlayerRequest request
    ) {
        lockSquad(squadId);
        Map<String, Object> squad =
                findSquadRow(squadId);

        Long seasonId =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "season_id"
                ).longValue();

        int initialBudget =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "initial_budget"
                ).intValue();

        ensurePlayerNotAlreadyPresent(
                squadId,
                request.playerId()
        );

        Map<String, Object> player =
                findEligiblePlayer(
                        request.playerId(),
                        seasonId
                );

        String role =
                player.get(
                        "fantasy_role"
                ).toString();

        ensureRoleHasSpace(
                squad,
                squadId,
                role
        );

        int remainingBudget =
                initialBudget
                        - calculateSpentBudget(
                                squadId
                        );

        if (
                request.purchasePrice()
                        > remainingBudget
        ) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Budget insufficiente"
            );
        }

        int emptySlotsAfterPurchase =
                calculateRemainingSlots(
                        squad
                ) - 1;

        int budgetAfterPurchase =
                remainingBudget
                        - request.purchasePrice();

        if (
                budgetAfterPurchase
                        < emptySlotsAfterPurchase
        ) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Devi conservare almeno un credito "
                            + "per ogni posto ancora libero"
            );
        }

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fantasy_squad_players (
                    squad_id,
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    fantasy_role,
                    purchase_price
                )
                VALUES (
                    :squadId,
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :role,
                    :purchasePrice
                )
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        request.playerId()
                )
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("role", role)
                .param(
                        "purchasePrice",
                        request.purchasePrice()
                )
                .update();

        return findSquad(squadId);
    }

    @Transactional
    public SquadResponse removePlayer(
            Long playerId
    ) {
        Map<String, Object> squad =
                findActiveSquadRow();

        Long squadId =
                number(squad, "id")
                        .longValue();

        return removePlayer(
                squadId,
                playerId
        );
    }

    @Transactional
    public SquadResponse removePlayer(
            Long squadId,
            Long playerId
    ) {
        lockSquad(squadId);
        findSquadRow(squadId);

        int deleted =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        DELETE FROM fantasy_squad_players
                        WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                          AND player_id = :playerId
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "squadId",
                                squadId
                        )
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                playerId
                        )
                        .update();

        if (deleted == 0) {
            throw new ResourceNotFoundException(
                    "Giocatore non presente nella rosa"
            );
        }

        return findSquad(squadId);
    }

    @Transactional
    public SquadResponse updatePlayerPrice(
            Long squadId,
            Long playerId,
            UpdateSquadPlayerPriceRequest request
    ) {
        lockSquad(squadId);
        Map<String, Object> squad = findSquadRow(squadId);

        int currentPrice = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT purchase_price
                FROM fantasy_squad_players
                WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                  AND player_id = :playerId
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(
                        "Giocatore non presente nella rosa"
                ));

        int initialBudget = number(squad, "initial_budget").intValue();
        int spentWithoutPlayer = calculateSpentBudget(squadId) - currentPrice;
        int budgetAfterUpdate = initialBudget - spentWithoutPlayer - request.purchasePrice();

        if (budgetAfterUpdate < 0) {
            throw new ConflictException("Budget insufficiente");
        }

        int emptySlots = calculateRemainingSlots(squad);
        if (budgetAfterUpdate < emptySlots) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Devi conservare almeno un credito per ogni posto ancora libero"
            );
        }

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE fantasy_squad_players
                SET purchase_price = :purchasePrice
                WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                  AND player_id = :playerId
                """)
                .param("purchasePrice", request.purchasePrice())
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .update();

        return findSquad(squadId);
    }

    private SquadResponse buildSquadResponse(
            Map<String, Object> squad
    ) {
        Long squadId =
                number(squad, "id")
                        .longValue();

        int initialBudget =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "initial_budget"
                ).intValue();

        List<SquadPlayerResponse> players =
                findSquadPlayers(squadId);

        int spentBudget =
                players.stream()
                        .mapToInt(
                                SquadPlayerResponse::
                                        purchasePrice
                        )
                        .sum();

        int maxGoalkeepers =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "goalkeepers_count"
                ).intValue();

        int maxDefenders =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "defenders_count"
                ).intValue();

        int maxMidfielders =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "midfielders_count"
                ).intValue();

        int maxForwards =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "forwards_count"
                ).intValue();

        Map<String, SquadRoleSummaryResponse> roles =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        roles.put(
                "P",
                roleSummary(
                        countRole(players, "P"),
                        maxGoalkeepers
                )
        );

        roles.put(
                "D",
                roleSummary(
                        countRole(players, "D"),
                        maxDefenders
                )
        );

        roles.put(
                "C",
                roleSummary(
                        countRole(players, "C"),
                        maxMidfielders
                )
        );

        roles.put(
                "A",
                roleSummary(
                        countRole(players, "A"),
                        maxForwards
                )
        );

        int maximumPlayers =
                maxGoalkeepers
                        + maxDefenders
                        + maxMidfielders
                        + maxForwards;

        return new SquadResponse(
                squadId,
                squad.get("name").toString(),
                squad.get("season").toString(),
                initialBudget,
                spentBudget,
                initialBudget - spentBudget,
                players.size(),
                maximumPlayers,
                roles,
                players
        );
    }

    private List<SquadPlayerResponse> findSquadPlayers(
            Long squadId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    squad_player.id,
                    player.id AS player_id,
                    player.display_name,
                    club.name AS club_name,
                    squad_player.fantasy_role,
                    squad_player.purchase_price

                FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player

                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id =
                        squad_player.player_id

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND registration.season_id =
                        squad_player.season_id

                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id =
                        registration.club_id

                WHERE squad_player.squad_id =
                        :squadId

                ORDER BY
                    CASE squad_player.fantasy_role
                        WHEN 'P' THEN 1
                        WHEN 'D' THEN 2
                        WHEN 'C' THEN 3
                        WHEN 'A' THEN 4
                        ELSE 5
                    END,
                    player.display_name
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .query((rs, rowNumber) ->
                        new SquadPlayerResponse(
                                rs.getLong("id"),
                                rs.getLong(
                                        "player_id"
                                ),
                                rs.getString(
                                        "display_name"
                                ),
                                rs.getString(
                                        "club_name"
                                ),
                                rs.getString(
                                        "fantasy_role"
                                ),
                                rs.getInt(
                                        "purchase_price"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findEligiblePlayer(
            Long playerId,
            Long seasonId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    player.id,
                    player.display_name,
                    role.fantasy_role

                FROM players player

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND role.season_id =
                        :seasonId
                    AND role.source =
                        'FANTACALCIO'

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND registration.season_id =
                        :seasonId

                JOIN player_reconciliation_results reconciliation
                    ON reconciliation.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND reconciliation.season_id =
                        :seasonId

                WHERE player.id = :playerId
                  AND player.active = TRUE
                  AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'
                """)
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        playerId
                )
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Giocatore non disponibile "
                                        + "per la stagione della rosa"
                        )
                );
    }

    private void ensurePlayerNotAlreadyPresent(
            Long squadId,
            Long playerId
    ) {
        boolean alreadyPresent =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM fantasy_squad_players
                        WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                          AND player_id = :playerId
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "squadId",
                                squadId
                        )
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                playerId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single() > 0;

        if (alreadyPresent) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Giocatore giÃ  presente nella rosa"
            );
        }
    }

    private void ensureRoleHasSpace(
            Map<String, Object> squad,
            Long squadId,
            String role
    ) {
        int maximum =
                switch (role) {
                    case "P" ->
                            number(
                                    squad,
                                    "goalkeepers_count"
                            ).intValue();

                    case "D" ->
                            number(
                                    squad,
                                    "defenders_count"
                            ).intValue();

                    case "C" ->
                            number(
                                    squad,
                                    "midfielders_count"
                            ).intValue();

                    case "A" ->
                            number(
                                    squad,
                                    "forwards_count"
                            ).intValue();

                    default ->
                            throw new ConflictException(
                                    "Ruolo non valido"
                            );
                };

        int current =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM fantasy_squad_players
                        WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                          AND fantasy_role = :role
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "squadId",
                                squadId
                        )
                        .param("role", role)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        if (current >= maximum) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Limite giocatori raggiunto "
                            + "per il ruolo "
                            + role
            );
        }
    }

    private int calculateSpentBudget(
            Long squadId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT COALESCE(
                    SUM(purchase_price),
                    0
                )
                FROM fantasy_squad_players
                WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findActiveSquadRow() {
        return jdbcClient.sql(
                baseSquadQuery()
                        + """
                        WHERE squad.active = TRUE
                        ORDER BY squad.id DESC
                        LIMIT 1
                        """
                )
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Rosa attiva non trovata"
                        )
                );
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findActiveSquadRow(String username, boolean administrator) {
        return jdbcClient.sql(baseSquadQuery() + """
                WHERE squad.active = TRUE
                  AND (:administrator = TRUE OR LOWER(squad.owner_username) = LOWER(:username))
                ORDER BY squad.id DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("username", username)
                .param("administrator", administrator)
                .query().listOfRows().stream().findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Rosa attiva non trovata"));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public void assertAccess(Long squadId, String username, boolean administrator) {
        if (administrator) {
            findSquadRow(squadId);
            return;
        }
        boolean allowed = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fantasy_squads
                WHERE id = :squadId AND LOWER(owner_username) = LOWER(:username)
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .param("username", username)
                .query(Integer.class).single() > 0;
        if (!allowed) {
            throw new ResourceNotFoundException("Rosa non trovata: " + squadId);
        }
    }

    private void lockSquad(Long squadId) {
        jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id FROM fantasy_squads WHERE id = :squadId FOR UPDATE")
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Rosa non trovata: " + squadId));
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findSquadRow(
            Long squadId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql(
                baseSquadQuery()
                        + """
                        WHERE squad.id = :squadId
                        """
                )
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Rosa non trovata: "
                                        + squadId
                        )
                );
    }

    private String baseSquadQuery() {
        return """
                SELECT
                    squad.id,
                    squad.name,
                    squad.initial_budget,
                    squad.active,

                    league.goalkeepers_count,
                    league.defenders_count,
                    league.midfielders_count,
                    league.forwards_count,

                    season.id AS season_id,
                    season.code AS season

                FROM fantasy_squads squad

                JOIN league_configurations league
                    ON league.id =
                        squad.league_configuration_id

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                        league.season_id
                """;
    }

    private int calculateRemainingSlots(
            Map<String, Object> squad
    ) {
        Long squadId =
                number(squad, "id")
                        .longValue();

        int maximumPlayers =
                number(
                        squad,
                        "goalkeepers_count"
                ).intValue()
                + number(
                        squad,
                        "defenders_count"
                ).intValue()
                + number(
                        squad,
                        "midfielders_count"
                ).intValue()
                + number(
                        squad,
                        "forwards_count"
                ).intValue();

        int currentPlayers =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM fantasy_squad_players
                        WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "squadId",
                                squadId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        return maximumPlayers
                - currentPlayers;
    }

    private int countRole(
            List<SquadPlayerResponse> players,
            String role
    ) {
        return (int) players.stream()
                .filter(player ->
                        role.equals(
                                player.role()
                        )
                )
                .count();
    }

    private SquadRoleSummaryResponse roleSummary(
            int current,
            int maximum
    ) {
        return new SquadRoleSummaryResponse(
                current,
                maximum,
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        maximum - current
                )
        );
    }

    private Number number(
            Map<String, Object> row,
            String key
    ) {
        Object value = row.get(key);

        if (value instanceof Number number) {
            return number;
        }

        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Valore numerico mancante: "
                        + key
        );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadanalysis;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.FixtureDifficultyResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.FixtureDifficultyService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squad.SquadResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squad.SquadRoleSummaryResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squad.SquadService;

@Service
public class SquadAnalysisService {

    private static final List<String> ROLE_ORDER =
            List.of("P", "D", "C", "A");

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final SquadService squadService;
    private final FixtureDifficultyService fixtureDifficultyService;

    public SquadAnalysisService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            SquadService squadService,
            FixtureDifficultyService fixtureDifficultyService
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.squadService = squadService;
        this.fixtureDifficultyService =
                fixtureDifficultyService;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public SquadAnalysisResponse analyzeActiveSquad(
            int fromMatchday,
            int toMatchday
    ) {
        SquadResponse squad =
                squadService.findActiveSquad();

        return analyzeSquad(
                squad.id(),
                fromMatchday,
                toMatchday
        );
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public SquadAnalysisResponse analyzeSquad(
            Long squadId,
            int fromMatchday,
            int toMatchday
    ) {
        validateRequest(
                squadId,
                fromMatchday,
                toMatchday
        );

        SquadResponse squad =
                squadService.findSquad(squadId);

        int remainingSlots =
                Math.max(
                        0,
                        squad.maximumPlayers()
                                - squad.totalPlayers()
                );

        List<String> globalWarnings =
                new ArrayList<>();

        List<SquadConstraintRoleResponse> roles =
                buildRoleConstraints(
                        squad,
                        globalWarnings
                );

        boolean budgetValid =
                squad.remainingBudget()
                        >= remainingSlots;

        if (!budgetValid) {
            globalWarnings.add(
                    "Il budget residuo non garantisce almeno "
                            + "un credito per ogni slot libero"
            );
        }

        boolean roleLimitsValid =
                roles.stream()
                        .allMatch(role ->
                                role.currentPlayers()
                                        <= role.maximumPlayers()
                        );

        boolean totalPlayersValid =
                squad.totalPlayers()
                        <= squad.maximumPlayers();

        boolean constraintsValid =
                budgetValid
                        && roleLimitsValid
                        && totalPlayersValid;

        List<SquadCalendarPlayerResponse> players =
                findCalendarPlayers(
                        squad,
                        fromMatchday,
                        toMatchday,
                        globalWarnings
                );

        List<SquadPairingResponse> pairings =
                buildPairings(players);

        addConcentrationWarnings(
                players,
                globalWarnings
        );

        boolean squadComplete =
                remainingSlots == 0
                        && roles.stream()
                                .allMatch(
                                        SquadConstraintRoleResponse
                                                ::complete
                                );

        if (squadComplete) {
            globalWarnings.add(
                    "La rosa rispetta tutti gli slot previsti "
                            + "dalla configurazione"
            );
        }

        if (players.isEmpty()
                && squad.totalPlayers() > 0) {

            globalWarnings.add(
                    "Non Ã¨ stato possibile costruire l'analisi "
                            + "del calendario dei giocatori in rosa"
            );
        }

        String summary =
                buildSummary(
                        squad,
                        remainingSlots,
                        constraintsValid,
                        squadComplete,
                        pairings.size()
                );

        return new SquadAnalysisResponse(
                squad.id(),
                squad.name(),
                squad.season(),
                fromMatchday,
                toMatchday,
                squad.initialBudget(),
                squad.spentBudget(),
                squad.remainingBudget(),
                squad.totalPlayers(),
                squad.maximumPlayers(),
                remainingSlots,
                constraintsValid,
                squadComplete,
                summary,
                List.copyOf(roles),
                List.copyOf(players),
                List.copyOf(pairings),
                List.copyOf(globalWarnings)
        );
    }

    private List<SquadConstraintRoleResponse>
    buildRoleConstraints(
            SquadResponse squad,
            List<String> globalWarnings
    ) {
        List<SquadConstraintRoleResponse> response =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (String role : ROLE_ORDER) {
            SquadRoleSummaryResponse roleSummary =
                    squad.roles().get(role);

            if (roleSummary == null) {
                globalWarnings.add(
                        "Configurazione assente per il ruolo "
                                + role
                );

                continue;
            }

            int current =
                    roleSummary.current();

            int maximum =
                    roleSummary.maximum();

            int remaining =
                    Math.max(
                            0,
                            roleSummary.remaining()
                    );

            boolean complete =
                    remaining == 0
                            && current == maximum;

            List<String> warnings =
                    new ArrayList<>();

            String coverageStatus;

            if (current > maximum) {
                coverageStatus =
                        "LIMITE SUPERATO";

                warnings.add(
                        "Il numero di giocatori supera "
                                + "il limite del ruolo"
                );
            }
            else if (complete) {
                coverageStatus =
                        "COMPLETO";
            }
            else if (current == 0) {
                coverageStatus =
                        "SCOPERTO";

                warnings.add(
                        "Nessun giocatore acquistato "
                                + "per questo ruolo"
                );
            }
            else if (remaining == 1) {
                coverageStatus =
                        "QUASI COMPLETO";
            }
            else {
                coverageStatus =
                        "IN COSTRUZIONE";
            }

            if ("D".equals(role)
                    && current < 4) {

                warnings.add(
                        "Copertura difensiva ancora insufficiente "
                                + "per gestire rotazioni e modificatore"
                );
            }

            if ("P".equals(role)
                    && current == 1) {

                warnings.add(
                        "Ãˆ presente un solo portiere: "
                                + "manca una riserva"
                );
            }

            response.add(
                    new SquadConstraintRoleResponse(
                            role,
                            current,
                            maximum,
                            remaining,
                            complete,
                            coverageStatus,
                            List.copyOf(warnings)
                    )
            );
        }

        return response;
    }

    private List<SquadCalendarPlayerResponse>
    findCalendarPlayers(
            SquadResponse squad,
            int fromMatchday,
            int toMatchday,
            List<String> globalWarnings
    ) {
        List<PlayerRow> rows =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            squad_player.player_id,
                            player.display_name,
                            club.name AS club_name,
                            club.slug AS club_slug,
                            squad_player.fantasy_role,
                            squad_player.purchase_price

                        FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player

                        JOIN players player
                            ON player.id =
                                squad_player.player_id

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id =
                                squad_player.player_id
                            AND registration.season_id =
                                squad_player.season_id
                            AND registration.registration_status =
                                'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN clubs club
                            ON club.id =
                                registration.club_id

                        WHERE squad_player.squad_id =
                            :squadId

                        ORDER BY
                            CASE squad_player.fantasy_role
                                WHEN 'P' THEN 1
                                WHEN 'D' THEN 2
                                WHEN 'C' THEN 3
                                WHEN 'A' THEN 4
                                ELSE 5
                            END,
                            player.display_name
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "squadId",
                                squad.id()
                        )
                        .query((rs, rowNumber) ->
                                new PlayerRow(
                                        rs.getLong(
                                                "player_id"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "display_name"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "club_name"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "club_slug"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getString(
                                                "fantasy_role"
                                        ),
                                        rs.getInt(
                                                "purchase_price"
                                        )
                                )
                        )
                        .list();

        List<SquadCalendarPlayerResponse> response =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (PlayerRow row : rows) {
            List<FixtureDifficultyResponse> fixtures =
                    fixtureDifficultyService
                            .findClubFixtures(
                                    squad.season(),
                                    row.clubSlug(),
                                    fromMatchday,
                                    toMatchday
                            );

            double averageDifficulty =
                    fixtures.stream()
                            .mapToDouble(fixture ->
                                    fixture
                                            .difficultyScore()
                                            .doubleValue()
                            )
                            .average()
                            .orElse(60.0);

            int easyFixtures =
                    countDifficulty(
                            fixtures,
                            "FACILE"
                    );

            int mediumFixtures =
                    countDifficulty(
                            fixtures,
                            "MEDIA"
                    );

            int difficultFixtures =
                    countDifficulty(
                            fixtures,
                            "DIFFICILE"
                    );

            if (fixtures.isEmpty()) {
                globalWarnings.add(
                        "Calendario non disponibile per "
                                + row.playerName()
                                + " - "
                                + row.club()
                );
            }

            response.add(
                    new SquadCalendarPlayerResponse(
                            row.playerId(),
                            row.playerName(),
                            row.club(),
                            row.clubSlug(),
                            row.role(),
                            row.purchasePrice(),
                            decimal(averageDifficulty),
                            easyFixtures,
                            mediumFixtures,
                            difficultFixtures,
                            List.copyOf(fixtures)
                    )
            );
        }

        return response;
    }

    private List<SquadPairingResponse> buildPairings(
            List<SquadCalendarPlayerResponse> players
    ) {
        List<PairingCandidate> candidates =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (String role : ROLE_ORDER) {
            List<SquadCalendarPlayerResponse> rolePlayers =
                    players.stream()
                            .filter(player ->
                                    role.equals(
                                            player.role()
                                    )
                            )
                            .toList();

            for (int first = 0;
                    first < rolePlayers.size();
                    first++) {

                for (int second = first + 1;
                        second < rolePlayers.size();
                        second++) {

                    SquadCalendarPlayerResponse firstPlayer =
                            rolePlayers.get(first);

                    SquadCalendarPlayerResponse secondPlayer =
                            rolePlayers.get(second);

                    candidates.add(
                            createPairingCandidate(
                                    role,
                                    firstPlayer,
                                    secondPlayer
                            )
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        candidates.sort(
                Comparator
                        .comparing(
                                PairingCandidate::score,
                                Comparator.reverseOrder()
                        )
                        .thenComparing(
                                candidate ->
                                        candidate.firstPlayer()
                                                .playerName(),
                                String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER
                        )
                        .thenComparing(
                                candidate ->
                                        candidate.secondPlayer()
                                                .playerName(),
                                String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER
                        )
        );

        List<SquadPairingResponse> response =
                new ArrayList<>();

        int position = 1;

        for (PairingCandidate candidate : candidates) {
            response.add(
                    new SquadPairingResponse(
                            position++,
                            candidate.role(),
                            candidate.firstPlayer()
                                    .playerId(),
                            candidate.firstPlayer()
                                    .playerName(),
                            candidate.firstPlayer()
                                    .club(),
                            candidate.secondPlayer()
                                    .playerId(),
                            candidate.secondPlayer()
                                    .playerName(),
                            candidate.secondPlayer()
                                    .club(),
                            candidate.firstPlayer()
                                    .purchasePrice()
                                    + candidate.secondPlayer()
                                            .purchasePrice(),
                            decimal(candidate.score()),
                            pairingRecommendation(
                                    candidate.score()
                            ),
                            pairingExplanation(candidate)
                    )
            );
        }

        return response;
    }

    private PairingCandidate createPairingCandidate(
            String role,
            SquadCalendarPlayerResponse firstPlayer,
            SquadCalendarPlayerResponse secondPlayer
    ) {
        Map<Integer, Double> firstDifficulties =
                difficultiesByMatchday(
                        firstPlayer.fixtures()
                );

        Map<Integer, Double> secondDifficulties =
                difficultiesByMatchday(
                        secondPlayer.fixtures()
                );

        int coveredMatchdays = 0;
        int hardTogether = 0;
        double bestOptionTotal = 0;
        double differenceTotal = 0;

        for (Integer matchday :
                unionMatchdays(
                        firstDifficulties,
                        secondDifficulties
                )) {

            double firstDifficulty =
                    firstDifficulties.getOrDefault(
                            matchday,
                            60.0
                    );

            double secondDifficulty =
                    secondDifficulties.getOrDefault(
                            matchday,
                            60.0
                    );

            bestOptionTotal +=
                    Math.min(
                            firstDifficulty,
                            secondDifficulty
                    );

            differenceTotal +=
                    Math.abs(
                            firstDifficulty
                                    - secondDifficulty
                    );

            if (firstDifficulty >= 70
                    && secondDifficulty >= 70) {

                hardTogether++;
            }

            coveredMatchdays++;
        }

        double averageBestOption =
                coveredMatchdays == 0
                        ? 60.0
                        : bestOptionTotal
                                / coveredMatchdays;

        double averageDifference =
                coveredMatchdays == 0
                        ? 0
                        : differenceTotal
                                / coveredMatchdays;

        double score =
                100
                        - averageBestOption * 0.65
                        + Math.min(
                                25,
                                averageDifference * 0.70
                        )
                        - hardTogether * 6;

        if (!firstPlayer.club()
                .equalsIgnoreCase(
                        secondPlayer.club()
                )) {

            score += 5;
        }
        else {
            score -= 15;
        }

        score =
                clamp(score);

        return new PairingCandidate(
                role,
                firstPlayer,
                secondPlayer,
                score,
                averageBestOption,
                averageDifference,
                hardTogether
        );
    }

    private Map<Integer, Double> difficultiesByMatchday(
            List<FixtureDifficultyResponse> fixtures
    ) {
        Map<Integer, Double> response =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (FixtureDifficultyResponse fixture : fixtures) {
            response.put(
                    fixture.matchday(),
                    fixture.difficultyScore()
                            .doubleValue()
            );
        }

        return response;
    }

    private List<Integer> unionMatchdays(
            Map<Integer, Double> first,
            Map<Integer, Double> second
    ) {
        Map<Integer, Boolean> matchdays =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        first.keySet()
                .stream()
                .sorted()
                .forEach(matchday ->
                        matchdays.put(
                                matchday,
                                true
                        )
                );

        second.keySet()
                .stream()
                .sorted()
                .forEach(matchday ->
                        matchdays.put(
                                matchday,
                                true
                        )
                );

        return matchdays.keySet()
                .stream()
                .sorted()
                .toList();
    }

    private String pairingRecommendation(
            double score
    ) {
        if (score >= 70) {
            return "ABBINAMENTO ECCELLENTE";
        }

        if (score >= 55) {
            return "ABBINAMENTO CONSIGLIATO";
        }

        if (score >= 40) {
            return "ABBINAMENTO DISCRETO";
        }

        return "CALENDARI POCO COMPLEMENTARI";
    }

    private String pairingExplanation(
            PairingCandidate candidate
    ) {
        String clubText =
                candidate.firstPlayer()
                        .club()
                        .equalsIgnoreCase(
                                candidate.secondPlayer()
                                        .club()
                        )
                        ? "I giocatori appartengono allo stesso club."
                        : "I giocatori appartengono a club diversi.";

        return "Migliore difficoltÃ  media utilizzabile: "
                + decimal(
                        candidate.averageBestOption()
                )
                + ". Differenza media tra i calendari: "
                + decimal(
                        candidate.averageDifference()
                )
                + ". Giornate difficili contemporanee: "
                + candidate.hardTogether()
                + ". "
                + clubText;
    }

    private void addConcentrationWarnings(
            List<SquadCalendarPlayerResponse> players,
            List<String> globalWarnings
    ) {
        Map<String, Integer> totalByClub =
                new HashMap<>();

        Map<String, Integer> totalByClubAndRole =
                new HashMap<>();

        for (SquadCalendarPlayerResponse player : players) {
            totalByClub.merge(
                    player.club(),
                    1,
                    Integer::sum
            );

            totalByClubAndRole.merge(
                    player.club()
                            + "|"
                            + player.role(),
                    1,
                    Integer::sum
            );
        }

        totalByClub.forEach((club, total) -> {
            if (total >= 5) {
                globalWarnings.add(
                        "Concentrazione elevata: "
                                + total
                                + " giocatori appartengono al "
                                + club
                );
            }
        });

        totalByClubAndRole.forEach((key, total) -> {
            if (total >= 3) {
                String[] parts =
                        key.split(
                                "\\|",
                                2
                        );

                globalWarnings.add(
                        "Scarsa diversificazione nel ruolo "
                                + parts[1]
                                + ": "
                                + total
                                + " giocatori del "
                                + parts[0]
                );
            }
        });
    }

    private int countDifficulty(
            List<FixtureDifficultyResponse> fixtures,
            String difficulty
    ) {
        return (int) fixtures.stream()
                .filter(fixture ->
                        difficulty.equals(
                                fixture.difficultyLevel()
                        )
                )
                .count();
    }

    private String buildSummary(
            SquadResponse squad,
            int remainingSlots,
            boolean constraintsValid,
            boolean squadComplete,
            int pairings
    ) {
        String status =
                constraintsValid
                        ? "I vincoli attuali sono rispettati."
                        : "Sono presenti vincoli non rispettati.";

        if (squadComplete) {
            return "Rosa completa con "
                    + squad.totalPlayers()
                    + " giocatori, "
                    + squad.remainingBudget()
                    + " crediti residui e "
                    + pairings
                    + " abbinamenti analizzati. "
                    + status;
        }

        return "Rosa composta da "
                + squad.totalPlayers()
                + " giocatori su "
                + squad.maximumPlayers()
                + ". Restano "
                + remainingSlots
                + " slot e "
                + squad.remainingBudget()
                + " crediti. Sono stati analizzati "
                + pairings
                + " abbinamenti interni. "
                + status;
    }

    private void validateRequest(
            Long squadId,
            int fromMatchday,
            int toMatchday
    ) {
        if (squadId == null || squadId <= 0) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "L'identificativo della rosa non Ã¨ valido"
            );
        }

        if (fromMatchday < 1
                || toMatchday > 38
                || fromMatchday > toMatchday) {

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "L'intervallo delle giornate "
                            + "deve essere compreso tra 1 e 38"
            );
        }

        if (toMatchday - fromMatchday > 14) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "L'analisi puÃ² comprendere al massimo "
                            + "15 giornate"
            );
        }
    }

    private BigDecimal decimal(
            double value
    ) {
        return BigDecimal
                .valueOf(value)
                .setScale(
                        2,
                        RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                );
    }

    private double clamp(
            double value
    ) {
        return Math.max(
                0,
                Math.min(
                        100,
                        value
                )
        );
    }

            Long playerId,
            String playerName,

            String clubSlug,

            int purchasePrice
    ) {
    }

            String role,
            SquadCalendarPlayerResponse firstPlayer,
            SquadCalendarPlayerResponse secondPlayer,
            double score,
            double averageBestOption,
            double averageDifference,
            int hardTogether
    ) {
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

/**
 * Complements the existing fixture/pairing services. Inputs are their
 * difficulty scores; this class does not query or duplicate fixture data.
 */
@Component
public class CalendarCombinationEngine {
    public Result evaluate(List<List<BigDecimal>> playerDifficulties) {
        if (playerDifficulties == null || playerDifficulties.size() < 2
                || playerDifficulties.stream().anyMatch(List::isEmpty)) {
            return new Result(null, EvidenceStatus.NOT_AVAILABLE, 0);
        }
        int matchdays = playerDifficulties.stream().mapToInt(List::size).min().orElse(0);
        if (matchdays == 0) return new Result(null, EvidenceStatus.NOT_AVAILABLE, 0);
        double total = 0;
        for (int day = 0; day < matchdays; day++) {
            final int index = day;
            double best = playerDifficulties.stream().mapToDouble(p -> p.get(index).doubleValue()).min().orElse(100);
            long playable = playerDifficulties.stream().filter(p -> p.get(index).doubleValue() <= 60).count();
            total += (100 - best) * .75 + Math.min(2, playable) * 12.5;
        }
        double roleCapped = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, total / matchdays));
        return new Result(BigDecimal.valueOf(roleCapped).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP),
                EvidenceStatus.AVAILABLE, matchdays);
    }

    public record Result(BigDecimal score, EvidenceStatus evidence, int matchdays) { }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

@Component
public class DynamicBudgetEngine {

    static final List<String> ROLES = List.of("P", "D", "C", "A");

    public DynamicBudgetResponse calculate(SquadConstructionRequest request) {
        validate(request);
        Map<String, Integer> slots = normalizedSlots(request.rosterSlots());
        Map<String, Integer> filled = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<String, Integer> spent = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        ROLES.forEach(role -> { filled.put(role, 0); spent.put(role, 0); });

        for (BoughtPlayerRequest player : safePlayers(request.playersAlreadyBought())) {
            String role = normalizeRole(player.role());
            if (player.pricePaid() < 0) throw new BadRequestException("Il prezzo pagato non puÃ² essere negativo");
            filled.put(role, filled.get(role) + 1);
            spent.put(role, spent.get(role) + player.pricePaid());
        }

        Map<String, Integer> remaining = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        int totalRemaining = 0;
        for (String role : ROLES) {
            if (filled.get(role) > slots.get(role)) throw new BadRequestException("Slot occupati superiori agli slot rosa per " + role);
            int count = slots.get(role) - filled.get(role);
            remaining.put(role, count);
            totalRemaining += count;
        }
        int reserve = totalRemaining;
        if (request.remainingBudget() < reserve) throw new BadRequestException("Budget residuo insufficiente per completare la rosa");

        Map<String, Integer> baseline = baseline(request.initialBudget(), request.defenseModifier());
        int completedExpected = ROLES.stream().filter(role -> phaseIndex(role) < phaseIndex(request.currentPhaseRole()))
                .mapToInt(baseline::get).sum();
        int completedSpent = ROLES.stream().filter(role -> phaseIndex(role) < phaseIndex(request.currentPhaseRole()))
                .mapToInt(spent::get).sum();
        int savings = completedExpected - completedSpent;

        int discretionary = request.remainingBudget() - reserve;
        int openWeight = ROLES.stream().filter(role -> remaining.get(role) > 0).mapToInt(baseline::get).sum();
        Map<String, Integer> targets = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        int assigned = 0;
        List<String> open = ROLES.stream().filter(role -> remaining.get(role) > 0).toList();
        for (int i = 0; i < open.size(); i++) {
            String role = open.get(i);
            int target = i == open.size() - 1
                    ? request.remainingBudget() - assigned
                    : remaining.get(role) + (openWeight == 0 ? 0 : discretionary * baseline.get(role) / openWeight);
            targets.put(role, target);
            assigned += target;
        }
        ROLES.forEach(role -> targets.putIfAbsent(role, 0));

        String phase = normalizeRole(request.currentPhaseRole());
        int futureProtected = ROLES.stream().filter(role -> phaseIndex(role) > phaseIndex(phase)).mapToInt(targets::get).sum();
        int currentAvailable = Math.max(0, request.remainingBudget() - futureProtected);
        int currentRoleMinimumReserve =
                Math.max(0, remaining.get(phase) - 1);

        // Future role targets already include their completion reserve.
        // Protect here only the other slots in the current role.
        int maxBid = remaining.get(phase) == 0
                ? 0
                : Math.max(
                        1,
                        currentAvailable
                                - currentRoleMinimumReserve
                );

        return new DynamicBudgetResponse(reserve, futureProtected,
                currentRoleMinimumReserve, currentAvailable, maxBid,
                Map.copyOf(filled), Map.copyOf(remaining), Map.copyOf(targets), savings);
    }

    private Map<String, Integer> baseline(int budget, boolean modifier) {
        int[] weights = modifier ? new int[]{7, 15, 23, 55} : new int[]{6, 10, 25, 59};
        Map<String, Integer> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        int used = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < ROLES.size(); i++) {
            int value = i == ROLES.size() - 1 ? budget - used : budget * weights[i] / 100;
            result.put(ROLES.get(i), value); used += value;
        }
        return result;
    }

    private Map<String, Integer> normalizedSlots(Map<String, Integer> supplied) {
        Map<String, Integer> result = new LinkedHashMap<>(Map.of("P", 3, "D", 8, "C", 8, "A", 6));
        if (supplied != null && !supplied.isEmpty()) {
            for (var entry : supplied.entrySet()) {
                String role = normalizeRole(entry.getKey());
                if (entry.getValue() == null || entry.getValue() < 0) throw new BadRequestException("Gli slot non possono essere negativi");
                result.put(role, entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    private void validate(SquadConstructionRequest r) {
        if (r == null || r.season() == null || r.season().isBlank()) throw new BadRequestException("La stagione Ã¨ obbligatoria");
        if (r.initialBudget() < 150 || r.initialBudget() > 1000) throw new BadRequestException("Il budget iniziale deve essere compreso tra 150 e 1000");
        if (r.remainingBudget() < 0 || r.remainingBudget() > r.initialBudget()) throw new BadRequestException("Budget residuo non coerente");
        if (r.teams() < 6 || r.teams() > 12) throw new BadRequestException("Le squadre devono essere comprese tra 6 e 12");
        normalizeRole(r.currentPhaseRole());
    }

    static String normalizeRole(String role) {
        if (role == null || !ROLES.contains(role.trim().toUpperCase())) throw new BadRequestException("Il ruolo deve essere P, D, C oppure A");
        return role.trim().toUpperCase();
    }
    static int phaseIndex(String role) { return ROLES.indexOf(normalizeRole(role)); }
    private List<BoughtPlayerRequest> safePlayers(List<BoughtPlayerRequest> players) { return players == null ? List.of() : players; }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction;

import java.util.Map;

public record RosterProfileContext(
        Map<String, Integer> coveredProfiles,
        int unknownProfiles,
        int slotsRemaining,
        boolean defenseModifier
) {
    public int covered(String profile) {
        return coveredProfiles.getOrDefault(profile, 0);
    }

    public static RosterProfileContext empty(
            int slotsRemaining,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        return new RosterProfileContext(
                Map.of(),
                0,
                slotsRemaining,
                defenseModifier
        );
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Max;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Min;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotEmpty;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Pattern;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.AssertTrue;

public record SquadConstructionRequest(
        @NotBlank String season,
        @Min(6) @Max(12) int teams,
        @Min(150) @Max(1000) int initialBudget,
        @Min(0) int remainingBudget,
        boolean defenseModifier,
        @NotBlank @Pattern(regexp = "P|D|C|A") String currentPhaseRole,
        @NotNull @NotEmpty Map<String, Integer> rosterSlots,
        @NotNull List<@Valid BoughtPlayerRequest> playersAlreadyBought,
        @Min(1) @Max(100) int limit
) {
    @AssertTrue(message = "remainingBudget non puÃ² superare initialBudget")
    public boolean isBudgetConsistent() {
        return remainingBudget <= initialBudget;
    }

    @AssertTrue(message = "rosterSlots deve contenere solo P, D, C, A con valori non negativi")
    public boolean isRosterSlotsValid() {
        return rosterSlots != null && rosterSlots.entrySet().stream()
                .allMatch(entry -> List.of("P", "D", "C", "A").contains(entry.getKey())
                        && entry.getValue() != null && entry.getValue() >= 0);
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction.AuctionApiPriceService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction.AuctionPriceResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.SquadTargetScorer.Candidate;

@Service
public class SquadConstructionService {
    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final AuctionApiPriceService priceService;
    private final DynamicBudgetEngine budgetEngine;
    private final SquadTargetScorer scorer;

    public SquadConstructionService(JdbcClient jdbcClient, AuctionApiPriceService priceService,
            DynamicBudgetEngine budgetEngine, SquadTargetScorer scorer) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient; this.priceService = priceService;
        this.budgetEngine = budgetEngine; this.scorer = scorer;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public SquadConstructionResponse evaluate(SquadConstructionRequest request) {
        DynamicBudgetResponse budget = budgetEngine.calculate(request);
        String phase = DynamicBudgetEngine.normalizeRole(request.currentPhaseRole());
        Map<Long, AuctionPriceResponse> prices = priceService.calculateAll(request.season().trim(),
                request.initialBudget(), request.teams(), request.defenseModifier()).stream()
                .collect(Collectors.toMap(AuctionPriceResponse::playerId, Function.identity()));
        List<BoughtPlayerRequest> boughtPlayers = request.playersAlreadyBought() == null
                ? List.of()
                : request.playersAlreadyBought();
        Set<Long> bought = boughtPlayers.stream()
                .map(BoughtPlayerRequest::playerId).collect(Collectors.toSet());

        List<Candidate> candidates = loadCandidates(
                request.season().trim(),
                phase
        );
        Map<Long, Candidate> candidatesById = candidates.stream()
                .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                        Candidate::playerId,
                        Function.identity()
                ));
        RosterProfileContext roster = buildRosterProfile(
                boughtPlayers,
                candidatesById,
                prices,
                budget,
                phase,
                request.defenseModifier()
        );

        List<SquadTargetResponse> targets = candidates.stream()
                .filter(c -> !bought.contains(c.playerId()))
                .filter(c -> prices.containsKey(c.playerId())) // explicit B51 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE exclusion
                .map(c -> withPrice(c, prices.get(c.playerId()).recommendedPrice()))
                .map(c -> scorer.score(c, budget, phase, roster))
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(SquadTargetResponse::auctionPriorityScore).reversed()
                        .thenComparing(SquadTargetResponse::playerId))
                .limit(Math.min(100, Math.max(1, request.limit())))
                .toList();

        List<String> needs = missingProfileNeeds(
                roster,
                phase,
                budget
        );
        List<String> alternatives = "A".equals(phase)
                ? List.of("ONE_TOP_BALANCED", "THREE_SEMI_TOP", "VALUE_HEAVY")
                : List.of("BALANCED", "VALUE_HEAVY");
        return new SquadConstructionResponse(request.season().trim(), request.teams(), request.initialBudget(),
                request.remainingBudget(), phase, request.defenseModifier(), budget, needs, targets,
                targets.stream().filter(t -> t.valueScore().doubleValue() >= 70).toList(),
                targets.stream().filter(t -> t.upsideScore() != null && t.upsideScore().doubleValue() >= 70).toList(),
                targets.stream().filter(t -> "EVITARE SOVRAPREZZO".equals(t.recommendation())).toList(), alternatives);
    }

    private RosterProfileContext buildRosterProfile(
            List<BoughtPlayerRequest> boughtPlayers,
            Map<Long, Candidate> candidates,
            Map<Long, AuctionPriceResponse> prices,
            DynamicBudgetResponse budget,
            String phase,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        Map<String, Integer> covered = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        int unknown = 0;
        int remaining = budget.slotsRemainingByRole().get(phase);
        int averageSlotBudget = Math.max(
                1,
                budget.remainingBudgetTargets().get(phase)
                        / Math.max(1, remaining)
        );

        for (BoughtPlayerRequest bought : boughtPlayers) {
            if (!phase.equals(
                    DynamicBudgetEngine.normalizeRole(bought.role())
            )) {
                continue;
            }
            Candidate candidate = candidates.get(bought.playerId());
            if (candidate == null) {
                unknown++;
                continue;
            }
            AuctionPriceResponse market = prices.get(bought.playerId());
            int evidencePrice = market == null
                    ? bought.pricePaid()
                    : market.recommendedPrice();
            String category = scorer.classifyForRoster(
                    candidate,
                    evidencePrice,
                    averageSlotBudget
            );
            covered.merge(category, 1, Integer::sum);
        }

        return new RosterProfileContext(
                Map.copyOf(covered),
                unknown,
                remaining,
                defenseModifier
        );
    }

    List<String> missingProfileNeeds(
            RosterProfileContext roster,
            String phase,
            DynamicBudgetResponse budget
    ) {
        if (roster.slotsRemaining() == 0) {
            return List.of("REPARTO_COMPLETO");
        }

        List<String> needs = new ArrayList<>();
        int premium = roster.covered("PREMIUM")
                + roster.covered("SEMI_TOP");
        int depth = roster.covered("VALUE_PICK")
                + roster.covered("STARTER")
                + roster.covered("LOW_COST");

        if (premium == 0) {
            needs.add(
                    "MANCA_PREMIUM_O_SEMI_TOP"
                            + ("D".equals(phase)
                                    && roster.defenseModifier()
                                            ? "_PRIORITA_MODIFICATORE"
                                            : "")
            );
        }
        else {
            needs.add("QUALITA_PREMIUM_COPERTA");
        }
        if (roster.covered("BONUS_SPECIALIST") == 0
                && !"P".equals(phase)) {
            needs.add("MANCA_BONUS_SPECIALIST");
        }
        if (depth < Math.max(1, roster.slotsRemaining() / 2)) {
            needs.add("SERVE_VALUE_DEPTH");
        }
        if (roster.covered("UPSIDE_BET") == 0
                && roster.slotsRemaining() >= 2) {
            needs.add("SERVE_UPSIDE");
        }
        if (roster.covered("LOW_COST")
                > Math.max(2, budget.slotsFilledByRole().get(phase) / 2)) {
            needs.add("TROPPI_LOW_COST");
        }
        if (roster.unknownProfiles() > 0) {
            needs.add("PROFILI_ACQUISTATI_UNKNOWN="
                    + roster.unknownProfiles());
        }
        return List.copyOf(needs);
    }

    private Candidate withPrice(Candidate c, int price) {
        return new Candidate(c.playerId(), c.playerName(), c.club(), c.role(), c.qualityScore(), c.b50Confidence(),
                price, c.potentialScore(), c.starterProbability(), c.penaltyTaker(), c.setPieceTaker(),
                c.cornerTaker(), c.freeKickTaker(), c.attackingInvolvement(), c.realPosition());
    }

    private List<Candidate> loadCandidates(String season, String role) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT p.id, p.display_name, c.name club, r.fantasy_role,
                       v.player_value_score, v.data_confidence_score,
                       e.potential_score, t.starter_probability, t.penalty_taker,
                       t.set_piece_taker, t.corner_taker, t.free_kick_taker,
                       t.attacking_involvement, t.real_position
                FROM players p
                JOIN player_registrations pr ON pr.player_id=p.id AND pr.registration_status='ACTIVE'
                JOIN seasons s ON s.id=pr.season_id AND s.code=:season
                JOIN clubs c ON c.id=pr.club_id
                JOIN season_clubs season_club ON season_club.season_id=s.id
                     AND season_club.club_id=c.id
                JOIN player_roles r ON r.player_id=p.id AND r.season_id=s.id
                     AND r.source='FANTACALCIO' AND r.fantasy_role=:role
                JOIN player_value_profiles v ON v.player_id=p.id AND v.reference_season_id=s.id
                     AND v.algorithm_version='B50_FANTASY_VALUE_V1' AND v.ranking_status='RANKED'
                LEFT JOIN player_evaluations e ON e.player_id=p.id AND e.season_id=s.id
                LEFT JOIN player_tactical_profiles t ON t.player_id=p.id AND t.season_id=s.id
                WHERE p.active=TRUE
                ORDER BY p.id
                """).param("season", season).param("role", role).query((rs, n) -> new Candidate(
                        rs.getLong("id"), rs.getString("display_name"), rs.getString("club"), rs.getString("fantasy_role"),
                        rs.getDouble("player_value_score"), rs.getDouble("data_confidence_score"), 1,
                        number(rs.getObject("potential_score")), number(rs.getObject("starter_probability")),
                        bool(rs.getObject("penalty_taker")), bool(rs.getObject("set_piece_taker")),
                        bool(rs.getObject("corner_taker")), bool(rs.getObject("free_kick_taker")),
                        number(rs.getObject("attacking_involvement")), rs.getString("real_position"))).list();
    }
    private Double number(Object value) { return value instanceof Number n ? n.doubleValue() : null; }
    private Boolean bool(Object value) { return value instanceof Boolean b ? b : null; }
}
