package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class SquadTargetScorer {

    public String classifyForRoster(
            Candidate candidate,
            int effectivePrice,
            int averageSlotBudget
    ) {
        Candidate priced = new Candidate(
                candidate.playerId(),
                candidate.playerName(),
                candidate.club(),
                candidate.role(),
                candidate.qualityScore(),
                candidate.b50Confidence(),
                Math.max(1, effectivePrice),
                candidate.potentialScore(),
                candidate.starterProbability(),
                candidate.penaltyTaker(),
                candidate.setPieceTaker(),
                candidate.cornerTaker(),
                candidate.freeKickTaker(),
                candidate.attackingInvolvement(),
                candidate.realPosition()
        );
        double value = clamp(
                priced.qualityScore()
                        * Math.min(
                                1.25,
                                (double) averageSlotBudget
                                        / priced.b51Price()
                        )
        );
        Score upside = upside(priced, value);
        return category(
                priced,
                priced.qualityScore(),
                value,
                upside.value()
        );
    }

    public SquadTargetResponse score(Candidate candidate, DynamicBudgetResponse budget, String phaseRole) {
        return score(
                candidate,
                budget,
                phaseRole,
                RosterProfileContext.empty(
                        budget.slotsRemainingByRole().get(candidate.role()),
                        false
                )
        );
    }

    public SquadTargetResponse score(
            Candidate candidate,
            DynamicBudgetResponse budget,
            String phaseRole,
            RosterProfileContext roster
    ) {
        double quality = candidate.qualityScore();
        int roleSlots = Math.max(1, budget.slotsRemainingByRole().get(candidate.role()));
        int averageSlotBudget = Math.max(
                1,
                budget.remainingBudgetTargets().get(candidate.role())
                        / roleSlots
        );
        int contextualMax = Math.max(1, Math.min(budget.contextualMaximumBid(),
                budget.currentRoleBudgetAvailable()));

        // Affordability uses the role average, before targetPrice exists.
        // This keeps VALUE free from circular dependency on the individual target.
        double priceRatio = (double) averageSlotBudget
                / Math.max(1, candidate.b51Price());
        double value = clamp(quality * Math.min(1.25, priceRatio));

        Score bonus = bonus(candidate);
        Score advantage = roleAdvantage(candidate);
        Score upside = upside(candidate, value);
        String category = category(
                candidate,
                quality,
                value,
                upside.value()
        );
        double fit = rosterFit(
                category,
                candidate,
                averageSlotBudget,
                roster
        );
        int target = individualTargetPrice(
                candidate,
                quality,
                fit,
                category,
                averageSlotBudget,
                contextualMax,
                roster
        );
        BigDecimal aerial = null; // No aerial/header evidence exists in the audited schema.
        BigDecimal calendar = null; // Pairing engine remains authoritative; no per-player fallback is invented.

        double priority = clamp(quality * .35 + value * .35 + fit * .30);
        if (candidate.b51Price() > contextualMax) priority = clamp(priority - 20);
        double confidence = averagePresent(candidate.b50Confidence(), bonus.confidence(),
                advantage.confidence(), upside.confidence());

        Map<String, EvidenceStatus> evidence = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        evidence.put("B50_QUALITY", EvidenceStatus.AVAILABLE);
        evidence.put("B51_PRICE", EvidenceStatus.AVAILABLE);
        evidence.put("BONUS_OPPORTUNITY", bonus.status());
        evidence.put("ROLE_ADVANTAGE", advantage.status());
        evidence.put("CALENDAR_FIT", EvidenceStatus.NOT_AVAILABLE);
        evidence.put("AERIAL_THREAT", EvidenceStatus.NOT_AVAILABLE);
        evidence.put("UPSIDE", upside.status());

        List<String> reasons = new ArrayList<>();
        reasons.add("QualitÃ  B50 " + round(quality) + "/100");
        reasons.add("Prezzo B51 " + candidate.b51Price()
                + " crediti; budget medio slot " + averageSlotBudget
                + "; target individuale " + target);
        reasons.add("Fit reparto " + round(fit)
                + "/100 per profilo " + category);
        if (bonus.value() != null) reasons.add("OpportunitÃ  bonus basata sui segnali tattici disponibili");
        if (advantage.value() != null) reasons.add("Posizione reale confrontata separatamente col ruolo Fantacalcio");
        if (aerial == null) reasons.add("Minaccia aerea non disponibile: metriche aeree assenti");

        String recommendation = candidate.b51Price() > contextualMax ? "EVITARE SOVRAPREZZO"
                : priority >= 75 ? "TARGET PRIORITARIO"
                : value >= 70 ? "VALUE TARGET" : "VALUTARE AL PREZZO TARGET";
        return new SquadTargetResponse(candidate.playerId(), candidate.playerName(), candidate.club(), candidate.role(),
                bd(quality), bd(value), bd(fit), nullable(bonus.value()), nullable(advantage.value()), calendar,
                aerial, nullable(upside.value()), bd(priority), category, bd(confidence), Map.copyOf(evidence),
                candidate.b51Price(), averageSlotBudget, target,
                contextualMax, recommendation, List.copyOf(reasons));
    }

    private double rosterFit(
            String category,
            Candidate candidate,
            int averageSlotBudget,
            RosterProfileContext roster
    ) {
        if (roster.slotsRemaining() <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        boolean premiumCovered =
                roster.covered("PREMIUM")
                        + roster.covered("SEMI_TOP") > 0;
        boolean bonusCovered =
                roster.covered("BONUS_SPECIALIST") > 0;
        boolean valueDepthCovered =
                roster.covered("VALUE_PICK")
                        + roster.covered("STARTER")
                        + roster.covered("LOW_COST")
                        >= Math.max(1, roster.slotsRemaining() / 2);

        double fit = 45;

        if (!premiumCovered
                && ("PREMIUM".equals(category)
                        || "SEMI_TOP".equals(category))) {
            fit += roster.defenseModifier()
                    && "D".equals(candidate.role())
                            ? 35
                            : 25;
        }
        else if (premiumCovered
                && "PREMIUM".equals(category)) {
            fit -= 20;
        }

        if (!bonusCovered
                && "BONUS_SPECIALIST".equals(category)) {
            fit += 20;
        }

        if (!valueDepthCovered
                && ("VALUE_PICK".equals(category)
                        || "STARTER".equals(category)
                        || "LOW_COST".equals(category))) {
            fit += 25;
        }

        if (roster.slotsRemaining() == 1) {
            if (("VALUE_PICK".equals(category)
                    || "LOW_COST".equals(category))
                    && candidate.b51Price() <= averageSlotBudget) {
                fit += 25;
            }
            if (("PREMIUM".equals(category)
                    || "SEMI_TOP".equals(category))
                    && candidate.b51Price() > averageSlotBudget) {
                fit -= 30;
            }
        }

        return clamp(fit);
    }

    private int individualTargetPrice(
            Candidate candidate,
            double quality,
            double fit,
            String category,
            int averageSlotBudget,
            int contextualMax,
            RosterProfileContext roster
    ) {
        // Transparent B54.1 adjustment around the immutable B51 price:
        // 80% base + up to 10% quality + up to 15% roster fit.
        double multiplier = 0.80
                + quality * 0.001
                + fit * 0.0015;

        boolean premiumNeeded =
                roster.covered("PREMIUM")
                        + roster.covered("SEMI_TOP") == 0;

        if (premiumNeeded
                && ("PREMIUM".equals(category)
                        || "SEMI_TOP".equals(category))) {
            multiplier += 0.15;
        }

        int target = (int) Math.round(
                candidate.b51Price() * multiplier
        );

        if (("VALUE_PICK".equals(category)
                || "LOW_COST".equals(category))
                && candidate.b51Price() <= averageSlotBudget) {
            target = Math.min(
                    target,
                    candidate.b51Price()
                            + Math.max(1, candidate.b51Price() / 10)
            );
        }

        return Math.max(1, Math.min(contextualMax, target));
    }

    private Score bonus(Candidate c) {
        List<Double> signals = new ArrayList<>();
        if (c.penaltyTaker() != null) signals.add(c.penaltyTaker() ? 100d : 0d);
        if (c.setPieceTaker() != null) signals.add(c.setPieceTaker() ? 85d : 0d);
        if (c.cornerTaker() != null) signals.add(c.cornerTaker() ? 75d : 0d);
        if (c.freeKickTaker() != null) signals.add(c.freeKickTaker() ? 80d : 0d);
        if (c.attackingInvolvement() != null) signals.add(c.attackingInvolvement());
        if (signals.isEmpty()) return Score.missing();
        return new Score(signals.stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).average().orElseThrow(),
                signals.size() >= 3 ? EvidenceStatus.AVAILABLE : EvidenceStatus.PARTIAL,
                Math.min(100, signals.size() * 20));
    }

    private Score roleAdvantage(Candidate c) {
        if (c.realPosition() == null || c.realPosition().isBlank()) return Score.missing();
        String position = c.realPosition().toUpperCase();
        double score = 50;
        if ("D".equals(c.role()) && (position.contains("ALA") || position.contains("ESTERNO") || position.contains("CENTROCAM"))) score = 90;
        else if ("C".equals(c.role()) && (position.contains("TREQUART") || position.contains("ATTACC") || position.contains("ALA"))) score = 90;
        return new Score(score, EvidenceStatus.PARTIAL, 50);
    }

    private Score upside(Candidate c, double value) {
        List<Double> signals = new ArrayList<>();
        if (c.potentialScore() != null) signals.add(c.potentialScore());
        if (c.starterProbability() != null) signals.add(c.starterProbability());
        if (value >= 70) signals.add(value);
        if (signals.isEmpty()) return Score.missing();
        return new Score(signals.stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).average().orElseThrow(),
                signals.size() >= 2 ? EvidenceStatus.PARTIAL : EvidenceStatus.PARTIAL,
                Math.min(75, signals.size() * 25));
    }

    private String category(Candidate c, double quality, double value, Double upside) {
        if (quality >= 90) return "PREMIUM";
        if (quality >= 80) return "SEMI_TOP";
        if (value >= 75) return "VALUE_PICK";
        if (upside != null && upside >= 75) return "UPSIDE_BET";
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(c.penaltyTaker()) || Boolean.TRUE.equals(c.setPieceTaker())) return "BONUS_SPECIALIST";
        if (c.b51Price() <= 3) return "LOW_COST";
        return "STARTER";
    }

    private double averagePresent(double... values) {
        return java.util.Arrays.stream(values).filter(v -> v >= 0).average().orElse(0);
    }
    private double clamp(double value) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, value)); }
    private BigDecimal bd(double value) { return BigDecimal.valueOf(value).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP); }
    private BigDecimal nullable(Double value) { return value == null ? null : bd(value); }
    private String round(double value) { return bd(value).toPlainString(); }

    public record Candidate(Long playerId, String playerName, String club, String role,
            double qualityScore, double b50Confidence, int b51Price, Double potentialScore,
            Double starterProbability, Boolean penaltyTaker, Boolean setPieceTaker,
            Boolean cornerTaker, Boolean freeKickTaker, Double attackingInvolvement,
            String realPosition) { }

    private record Score(Double value, EvidenceStatus status, double confidence) {
        static Score missing() { return new Score(null, EvidenceStatus.NOT_AVAILABLE, -1); }
    }
}

    public PlayerStatisticsImportService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            TextNormalizer textNormalizer,
            JsonMapper jsonMapper,
            PlatformTransactionManager transactionManager
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.textNormalizer = textNormalizer;
        this.jsonMapper = jsonMapper;

        this.transactionTemplate =
                new TransactionTemplate(
                        transactionManager
                );

    public PlayerStatisticsImportResponse importCsv(
            String source,
            String seasonCode,
            MultipartFile file
    ) {
        return importPayload(source,seasonCode,CsvImportPayload.from(file,"player-statistics.csv"));
    }

    public PlayerStatisticsImportResponse importPayload(String source,String seasonCode,CsvImportPayload file) {
        String normalizedSource =
                normalizeSource(source);

        String normalizedSeason =
                validateSeasonCode(seasonCode);

        validateFileReference(file);

        Long seasonId =
                findSeasonId(normalizedSeason);

        String filename =
                resolveFilename(file);

        Long batchId =
                createBatch(
                        normalizedSource,
                        seasonId,
                        filename
                );

        try {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(
                    transactionTemplate.execute(
                            transactionStatus ->
                                    processImport(
                                            batchId,
                                            normalizedSource,
                                            normalizedSeason,
                                            seasonId,
                                            filename,
                                            file
                                    )
                    )
            );
        }
        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
            String errorMessage =
                    readableErrorMessage(exception);

            markBatchFailed(
                    batchId,
                    errorMessage
            );

            if (exception instanceof BadRequestException) {
                throw exception;
            }

            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Import statistiche CSV fallito: "
                            + errorMessage,
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    private PlayerStatisticsImportResponse processImport(
            Long batchId,
            String source,
            String seasonCode,
            Long seasonId,
            String filename,
            CsvImportPayload file
    ) {
        int totalRows = 0;
        int validRows = 0;
        int invalidRows = 0;
        int importedStatistics = 0;

        Set<String> rowKeys =
                new HashSet<>();

        try (
                BufferedReader reader =
                        new BufferedReader(
                                new InputStreamReader(
                                        file.openStream(),
                                        StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                                )
                        );

                CSVParser parser =
                        CSVFormat.DEFAULT.builder()
                                .setHeader()
                                .setSkipHeaderRecord(true)
                                .setIgnoreEmptyLines(true)
                                .setIgnoreSurroundingSpaces(true)
                                .setTrim(true)
                                .get()
                                .parse(reader)
        ) {
            validateHeaders(
                    parser.getHeaderNames(),
                    source
            );

            for (CSVRecord record : parser) {
                totalRows++;

                ImportedStatisticsRow row =
                        parseRow(
                                parser,
                                record,
                                totalRows,
                                source,
                                rowKeys
                        );

                saveImportedRow(
                        batchId,
                        row
                );

                if (row.valid()) {
                    upsertStatistics(
                            row,
                            seasonId,
                            source,
                            batchId
                    );

                    validRows++;
                    importedStatistics++;
                }
                else {
                    invalidRows++;
                }
            }
        }
        catch (IOException exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Impossibile leggere il file CSV",
                    exception
            );
        }
        catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Formato CSV non valido: "
                            + readableErrorMessage(exception),
                    exception
            );
        }

        if (totalRows == 0) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Il file CSV non contiene righe dati"
            );
        }

        completeBatch(
                batchId,
                totalRows,
                validRows,
                invalidRows,
                importedStatistics
        );

        return new PlayerStatisticsImportResponse(
                batchId,
                source,
                seasonCode,
                filename,
                totalRows,
                validRows,
                invalidRows,
                importedStatistics,
                "COMPLETED",
                null
        );
    }

    private ImportedStatisticsRow parseRow(

            CSVRecord record,
            int rowNumber,
            String source,
            Set<String> rowKeys
    ) {
        String externalId =
                value(
                        record,
                        "external_id"
                );

        String externalName =
                value(
                        record,
                        "name"
                );

        String clubName =
                value(
                        record,
                        "club"
                );

        List<String> historicalClubs = parseHistoricalClubs(
                value(record, "clubs_played"),
                clubName
        );

        String normalizedName =
                textNormalizer.normalize(
                        externalName
                );

        String normalizedClubName =
                textNormalizer.normalize(
                        clubName
                );

        List<String> errors =
                new ArrayList<>();

        if (isBlank(externalId)) {
            errors.add(
                    "ID esterno mancante"
            );
        }

        if (isBlank(externalName)) {
            errors.add(
                    "Nome giocatore mancante"
            );
        }

        if (!"FBREF".equals(source) && isBlank(clubName)) {
            errors.add(
                    "Squadra mancante"
            );
        }

        if ("FBREF".equals(source) && historicalClubs.isEmpty()) {
            errors.add("Club storici FBref mancanti");
        }

        ParsedInteger appearances =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "appearances"),
                        "Presenze",
                        true
                );

        ParsedInteger starts =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "starts"),
                        "TitolaritÃ ",
                        false
                );

        ParsedInteger minutesPlayed =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "minutes_played"),
                        "Minuti giocati",
                        false
                );

        ParsedDecimal averageRating =
                parseDecimal(
                        value(record, "average_rating"),
                        "Media voto",
                        BigDecimal.ZERO,
                        BigDecimal.TEN
                );

        ParsedDecimal fantasyAverage =
                parseDecimal(
                        value(record, "fantasy_average"),
                        "Fantamedia",
                        BigDecimal.ZERO,
                        BigDecimal.valueOf(20)
                );

        if ("FBREF".equals(source)
                && (averageRating.value() != null || fantasyAverage.value() != null)) {
            errors.add("FBref non puÃ² fornire media voto o fantamedia");
        }

        ParsedInteger goals =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "goals"),
                        "Gol",
                        false
                );

        ParsedInteger assists =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "assists"),
                        "Assist",
                        false
                );

        ParsedInteger penaltiesScored =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "penalties_scored"),
                        "Rigori segnati",
                        false
                );

        ParsedInteger penaltiesTaken =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "penalties_taken"),
                        "Rigori calciati",
                        false
                );

        ParsedInteger penaltiesMissed =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "penalties_missed"),
                        "Rigori sbagliati",
                        false
                );

        ParsedInteger yellowCards =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "yellow_cards"),
                        "Ammonizioni",
                        false
                );

        ParsedInteger redCards =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "red_cards"),
                        "Espulsioni",
                        false
                );

        ParsedInteger ownGoals =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "own_goals"),
                        "Autogol",
                        false
                );

        ParsedInteger goalsConceded =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "goals_conceded"),
                        "Gol subiti",
                        false
                );

        ParsedInteger cleanSheets =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "clean_sheets"),
                        "Clean sheet",
                        false
                );

        ParsedInteger penaltiesSaved =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "penalties_saved"),
                        "Rigori parati",
                        false
                );

        ParsedInteger saves =
                parseInteger(
                        value(record, "saves"),
                        "Parate",
                        false
                );

        ParsedDecimal expectedGoals =
                parseDecimal(
                        value(record, "expected_goals"),
                        "Expected goals",
                        BigDecimal.ZERO,
                        null
                );

        ParsedDecimal expectedAssists =
                parseDecimal(
                        value(record, "expected_assists"),
                        "Expected assists",
                        BigDecimal.ZERO,
                        null
                );

        addError(errors, appearances.error());
        addError(errors, starts.error());
        addError(errors, minutesPlayed.error());
        addError(errors, averageRating.error());
        addError(errors, fantasyAverage.error());
        addError(errors, goals.error());
        addError(errors, assists.error());
        addError(errors, penaltiesScored.error());
        addError(errors, penaltiesTaken.error());
        addError(errors, penaltiesMissed.error());
        addError(errors, yellowCards.error());
        addError(errors, redCards.error());
        addError(errors, ownGoals.error());
        addError(errors, goalsConceded.error());
        addError(errors, cleanSheets.error());
        addError(errors, penaltiesSaved.error());
        addError(errors, saves.error());
        addError(errors, expectedGoals.error());
        addError(errors, expectedAssists.error());

        Integer safeAppearances = appearances.value();
        Integer safeStarts = starts.value();

        if (safeStarts != null && safeAppearances != null
                && safeStarts > safeAppearances) {
            errors.add(
                    "Le titolaritÃ  non possono superare le presenze"
            );
        }

        String rowKey =
                source
                        + "|"
                        + normalizeKey(externalId);

        if (!isBlank(externalId)
                && !rowKeys.add(rowKey)) {

            errors.add(
                    "Giocatore duplicato nel file"
            );
        }

        Long playerId = null;
        Long clubId = null;

        String matchMethod = value(record, "match_method");
        String matchConfidence = value(record, "match_confidence");

        if (errors.stream().noneMatch(error -> error.contains("mancante"))) {
            if ("FBREF".equals(source)) {
                playerId = resolveFbrefPlayerId(
                        externalId,
                        firstNonBlank(value(record, "player_id"), value(record, "candidate_player_id")),
                        value(record, "match_status"),
                        matchMethod,
                        matchConfidence,
                        normalizedName,
                        errors
                );
                if (historicalClubs.size() == 1) {
                    clubId = resolveClubIdOptional(historicalClubs.getFirst());
                }
            }
            else {
                playerId = resolvePlayerId(source, externalId, normalizedName, errors);
                clubId = resolveClubId(clubName, normalizedClubName, errors);
            }
        }

        String validationError =
                errors.isEmpty()
                        ? null
                        : String.join(
                                "; ",
                                errors
                        );

        return new ImportedStatisticsRow(
                rowNumber,
                externalId,
                externalName,
                normalizedName,
                clubName,
                normalizedClubName,
                historicalClubs,
                matchMethod,
                matchConfidence,
                playerId,
                clubId,
                safeAppearances,
                safeStarts,
                minutesPlayed.value(),
                averageRating.value(),
                fantasyAverage.value(),
                goals.value(),
                assists.value(),
                penaltiesTaken.value(),
                penaltiesScored.value(),
                penaltiesMissed.value(),
                yellowCards.value(),
                redCards.value(),
                ownGoals.value(),
                goalsConceded.value(),
                cleanSheets.value(),
                saves.value(),
                penaltiesSaved.value(),
                expectedGoals.value(),
                expectedAssists.value(),
                errors.isEmpty(),
                validationError,
                toJson(
                        rawData(
                                parser,
                                record
                        )
                )
        );

    private Long resolvePlayerId(
            String source,
            String externalId,
            String normalizedName,
            List<String> errors
    ) {
        Optional<Long> mappedPlayerId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT player_id
                        FROM player_source_mappings
                        WHERE source = :source
                          AND external_id = :externalId
                        ORDER BY id
                        LIMIT 1
                        """)
                        .param("source", source)
                        .param("externalId", externalId)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .optional();

        if (mappedPlayerId.isPresent()) {
            return mappedPlayerId.get();
        }

        List<Long> sameNamePlayers =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM players
                        WHERE normalized_name = :normalizedName
                          AND active = TRUE
                        ORDER BY id
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "normalizedName",
                                normalizedName
                        )
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .list();

        if (sameNamePlayers.size() == 1) {
            return sameNamePlayers.getFirst();
        }

        if (sameNamePlayers.isEmpty()) {
            errors.add(
                    "Giocatore non trovato"
            );
        }
        else {
            errors.add(
                    "Giocatore non identificabile univocamente"
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    private Long resolveFbrefPlayerId(
            String externalId,
            String suppliedPlayerId,
            String matchStatus,
            String matchMethod,
            String matchConfidence,
            String normalizedExternalName,
            List<String> errors
    ) {
        boolean safeMatch = "MATCHED".equalsIgnoreCase(matchStatus)
                && "HIGH".equalsIgnoreCase(matchConfidence)
                && ("EXACT_FULL_NAME".equals(matchMethod)
                    || "CROSS_SEASON_EXACT_ANCHOR".equals(matchMethod)
                    || "MANUAL_VERIFIED".equals(matchMethod));
        if (!safeMatch) {
            errors.add("Match FBref non certificato: richiesti MATCHED, HIGH e metodo sicuro");
            return null;
        }

        Optional<Long> linkedPlayer = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT player_id
                FROM player_statistical_source_links
                WHERE source = 'FBREF' AND external_id = :externalId
                """)
                .param("externalId", externalId)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional();

        if (linkedPlayer.isPresent()) {
            if (!isBlank(suppliedPlayerId)
                    && !suppliedPlayerId.equals(linkedPlayer.get().toString())) {
                errors.add("FBref external_id giÃ  collegato a un altro player_id");
            }
            return linkedPlayer.get();
        }

        if (isBlank(suppliedPlayerId)) {
            errors.add("player_id certificato mancante per FBref");
            return null;
        }

        Long playerId;
        try {
            playerId = Long.valueOf(suppliedPlayerId);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException exception) {
            errors.add("player_id FBref non valido: " + suppliedPlayerId);
            return null;
        }

        boolean playerExists = jdbcClient.sql("SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM players WHERE id = :playerId)")
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .query(Boolean.class)
                .single();
        if (!playerExists) {
            errors.add("player_id FBref inesistente: " + playerId);
            return null;
        }

        if ("EXACT_FULL_NAME".equals(matchMethod)) {
            String catalogName = jdbcClient.sql("SELECT normalized_name FROM players WHERE id = :playerId")
                    .param("playerId", playerId)
                    .query(String.class)
                    .single();
            if (!textNormalizer.normalize(catalogName).equals(normalizedExternalName)
                    || normalizedExternalName.split(" ").length < 2) {
                errors.add("EXACT_FULL_NAME non coerente con il nome completo del catalogo");
                return null;
            }
        }

        Optional<String> otherExternalId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT external_id
                FROM player_statistical_source_links
                WHERE source = 'FBREF' AND player_id = :playerId
                  AND external_id <> :externalId
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("externalId", externalId)
                .query(String.class)
                .optional();
        if (otherExternalId.isPresent()) {
            errors.add("player_id giÃ  collegato al differente FBref ID " + otherExternalId.get());
            return null;
        }

        return playerId;
    }

    private Long resolveClubIdOptional(String clubName) {
        String normalized = textNormalizer.normalize(clubName);
        List<Long> clubIds = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id FROM clubs
                WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(:clubName)
                   OR LOWER(slug) = LOWER(:clubName)
                   OR LOWER(REPLACE(name, ' ', '')) = LOWER(REPLACE(:normalizedClub, ' ', ''))
                ORDER BY id
                """)
                .param("clubName", clubName)
                .param("normalizedClub", normalized)
                .query(Long.class)
                .list();
        return clubIds.size() == 1 ? clubIds.getFirst() : null;
    }

    private Long resolveClubId(
            String clubName,
            String normalizedClubName,
            List<String> errors
    ) {
        List<Long> clubIds =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM clubs
                        WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(:clubName)
                           OR LOWER(slug) = LOWER(:clubName)
                           OR LOWER(REPLACE(name, ' ', '')) =
                              LOWER(REPLACE(:normalizedClub, ' ', ''))
                        ORDER BY id
                        """)
                        .param("clubName", clubName)
                        .param(
                                "normalizedClub",
                                normalizedClubName
                        )
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .list();

        if (clubIds.size() == 1) {
            return clubIds.getFirst();
        }

        if (clubIds.isEmpty()) {
            errors.add(
                    "Squadra non trovata: " + clubName
            );
        }
        else {
            errors.add(
                    "Squadra non identificabile univocamente: "
                            + clubName
            );
        }

        return null;
    }

    private void upsertStatistics(
            ImportedStatisticsRow row,
            Long seasonId,
            String source,
            Long batchId
    ) {
        if ("FBREF".equals(source)) {
            upsertStatisticalLink(row);
        }

        Long statisticsId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_season_statistics (
                    player_id,
                    club_id,
                    season_id,
                    source,
                    source_external_id,
                    appearances,
                    starts,
                    minutes_played,
                    average_rating,
                    fantasy_average,
                    goals,
                    assists,
                    penalties_scored,
                    penalties_missed,
                    penalties_taken,
                    yellow_cards,
                    red_cards,
                    own_goals,
                    goals_conceded,
                    clean_sheets,
                    saves,
                    penalties_saved,
                    expected_goals,
                    expected_assists,
                    import_batch_id
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :clubId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :source,
                    :sourceExternalId,
                    :appearances,
                    :starts,
                    :minutesPlayed,
                    :averageRating,
                    :fantasyAverage,
                    :goals,
                    :assists,
                    :penaltiesScored,
                    :penaltiesMissed,
                    :penaltiesTaken,
                    :yellowCards,
                    :redCards,
                    :ownGoals,
                    :goalsConceded,
                    :cleanSheets,
                    :saves,
                    :penaltiesSaved,
                    :expectedGoals,
                    :expectedAssists,
                    :batchId
                )
                ON CONFLICT (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    source
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    club_id = EXCLUDED.club_id,
                    source_external_id = EXCLUDED.source_external_id,
                    appearances = EXCLUDED.appearances,
                    starts = EXCLUDED.starts,
                    minutes_played = EXCLUDED.minutes_played,
                    average_rating = EXCLUDED.average_rating,
                    fantasy_average = EXCLUDED.fantasy_average,
                    goals = EXCLUDED.goals,
                    assists = EXCLUDED.assists,
                    penalties_scored =
                        EXCLUDED.penalties_scored,
                    penalties_missed =
                        EXCLUDED.penalties_missed,
                    penalties_taken = EXCLUDED.penalties_taken,
                    yellow_cards = EXCLUDED.yellow_cards,
                    red_cards = EXCLUDED.red_cards,
                    own_goals = EXCLUDED.own_goals,
                    goals_conceded = EXCLUDED.goals_conceded,
                    clean_sheets = EXCLUDED.clean_sheets,
                    saves = EXCLUDED.saves,
                    penalties_saved = EXCLUDED.penalties_saved,
                    expected_goals = EXCLUDED.expected_goals,
                    expected_assists = EXCLUDED.expected_assists,
                    import_batch_id = EXCLUDED.import_batch_id,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param("playerId", row.playerId())
                .param("clubId", row.clubId())
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("source", source)
                .param("sourceExternalId", row.externalId())

    private void upsertStatisticalLink(ImportedStatisticsRow row) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_statistical_source_links (
                    player_id, source, external_id, external_name,
                    match_method, confidence, evidence
                ) VALUES (
                    :playerId, 'FBREF', :externalId, :externalName,
                    :matchMethod, 'HIGH', CAST(:evidence AS JSONB)
                )
                ON CONFLICT (source, external_id) DO UPDATE SET
                    external_name = EXCLUDED.external_name,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                """)
                .param("playerId", row.playerId())
                .param("externalId", row.externalId())
                .param("externalName", row.externalName())
                .param("matchMethod", row.matchMethod())
                .param("evidence", row.rawData())
                .update();
    }

    private void replaceHistoricalClubs(Long statisticsId, List<String> clubs) {
        jdbcClient.sql("DELETE FROM player_season_statistics_clubs WHERE statistics_id = :statisticsId")
                .param("statisticsId", statisticsId)
                .update();
        for (int index = 0; index < clubs.size(); index++) {
            String club = clubs.get(index);
            jdbcClient.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO player_season_statistics_clubs (
                        statistics_id, club_name, normalized_club_name, source_order
                    ) VALUES (:statisticsId, :clubName, :normalizedClubName, :sourceOrder)
                    """)
                    .param("statisticsId", statisticsId)
                    .param("clubName", club)
                    .param("normalizedClubName", textNormalizer.normalize(club))
                    .param("sourceOrder", index + 1)
                    .update();
        }
    }

    private Long createBatch(
            String source,
            Long seasonId,
            String filename
    ) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(
                requiresNewTransaction.execute(
                        transactionStatus ->
                                jdbcClient.sql("""
                                        INSERT INTO player_statistics_import_batches (
                                            source,
                                            season_id,
                                            original_filename,
                                            status
                                        )
                                        VALUES (
                                            :source,
                                            :seasonId,
                                            :filename,
                                            'PROCESSING'
                                        )
                                        RETURNING id
                                        """)
                                        .param("source", source)
                                        .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                                        .param("filename", filename)
                                        .query(Long.class)
                                        .single()
                )
        );
    }

    private void completeBatch(
            Long batchId,
            int totalRows,
            int validRows,
            int invalidRows,
            int importedStatistics
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE player_statistics_import_batches
                SET status = 'COMPLETED',
                    total_rows = :totalRows,
                    valid_rows = :validRows,
                    invalid_rows = :invalidRows,
                    imported_statistics = :importedStatistics,
                    completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    error_message = NULL
                WHERE id = :batchId
                """)
                .param("totalRows", totalRows)
                .param("validRows", validRows)
                .param("invalidRows", invalidRows)
                .param(
                        "importedStatistics",
                        importedStatistics
                )
                .param("batchId", batchId)
                .update();
    }

    private void markBatchFailed(
            Long batchId,
            String errorMessage
    ) {
        requiresNewTransaction.executeWithoutResult(
                transactionStatus ->
                        jdbcClient.sql("""
                                UPDATE player_statistics_import_batches
                                SET status = 'FAILED',
                                    error_message = :errorMessage,
                                    completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                                WHERE id = :batchId
                                """)
                                .param(
                                        "errorMessage",
                                        truncate(
                                                errorMessage,
                                                2000
                                        )
                                )
                                .param("batchId", batchId)
                                .update()
        );
    }

    private Long findSeasonId(String seasonCode) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = :seasonCode
                """)
                .param("seasonCode", seasonCode)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Stagione non trovata: "
                                        + seasonCode
                        )
                );
    }

    private void validateHeaders(List<String> headers, String source) {
        Set<String> normalizedHeaders =
                new HashSet<>();

        for (String header : headers) {
            if (header != null) {
                normalizedHeaders.add(
                        header.trim()
                                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
                );
            }
        }

        List<String> missingColumns =
                java.util.stream.Stream.concat(
                        REQUIRED_COLUMNS.stream(),
                        ("FBREF".equals(source)
                                ? Set.of("clubs_played", "candidate_player_id", "match_status",
                                        "match_method", "match_confidence")
                                : Set.of("club")).stream())
                        .filter(column ->
                                !normalizedHeaders.contains(column)
                        )
                        .sorted()
                        .toList();

        if (!missingColumns.isEmpty()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Colonne obbligatorie mancanti: "
                            + String.join(
                                    ", ",
                                    missingColumns
                            )
            );
        }
    }

    private String normalizeSource(String source) {
        if (source == null || source.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Fonte obbligatoria"
            );
        }

        String normalized =
                source.trim()
                        .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (!ALLOWED_SOURCES.contains(normalized)) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Fonte non valida: " + source
            );
        }

        return normalized;
    }

    private String validateSeasonCode(String seasonCode) {
        if (seasonCode == null || seasonCode.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "Stagione obbligatoria"
            );
        }

        return seasonCode.trim();
    }

    private void validateFileReference(
            CsvImportPayload file
    ) {
        if (file == null) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
                    "File CSV obbligatorio"
            );
        }
    }

    private String resolveFilename(CsvImportPayload file) {
        String filename =
                file.filename();

        if (filename == null || filename.isBlank()) {
            return "player-statistics.csv";
        }

        String normalized =
                filename.replace("\\", "/");

        int separator =
                normalized.lastIndexOf('/');

        if (separator >= 0) {
            normalized =
                    normalized.substring(separator + 1);
        }

        return truncate(normalized, 255);
    }

    private String value(
            CSVRecord record,
            String column
    ) {
        if (!record.isMapped(column)) {
            return null;
        }

        String rawValue =
                record.get(column);

        return rawValue == null || rawValue.isBlank()
                ? null
                : rawValue.trim();
    }

    private List<String> parseHistoricalClubs(String clubsPlayed, String clubName) {
        String raw = firstNonBlank(clubsPlayed, clubName);
        if (isBlank(raw)) {
            return List.of();
        }
        LinkedHashSet<String> clubs = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        Arrays.stream(raw.split("\\|"))
                .map(String::trim)
                .filter(value -> !value.isBlank())
                .forEach(clubs::add);
        return List.copyOf(clubs);
    }

    private String firstNonBlank(String first, String second) {
        return isBlank(first) ? second : first;
    }

    private ParsedInteger parseInteger(
            String rawValue,
            String fieldName,
            boolean required
    ) {
        if (rawValue == null) {
            if (required) {
                return new ParsedInteger(
                        null,
                        fieldName + " obbligatorie"
                );
            }

            return new ParsedInteger(null, null);
        }

        try {
            int parsed =
                    Integer.parseInt(rawValue);

            if (parsed < 0) {
                return new ParsedInteger(
                        null,
                        fieldName
                                + " non puÃ² essere negativo"
                );
            }

            return new ParsedInteger(parsed, null);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException exception) {
            return new ParsedInteger(
                    null,
                    fieldName
                            + " non valido: "
                            + rawValue
            );
        }
    }

    private ParsedDecimal parseDecimal(
            String rawValue,
            String fieldName,
            BigDecimal minimum,
            BigDecimal maximum
    ) {
        if (rawValue == null) {
            return new ParsedDecimal(null, null);
        }

        try {
            BigDecimal parsed =
                    new BigDecimal(
                            rawValue.replace(",", ".")
                    );

            if (minimum != null
                    && parsed.compareTo(minimum) < 0) {

                return new ParsedDecimal(
                        null,
                        fieldName
                                + " inferiore al minimo consentito"
                );
            }

            if (maximum != null
                    && parsed.compareTo(maximum) > 0) {

                return new ParsedDecimal(
                        null,
                        fieldName
                                + " superiore al massimo consentito"
                );
            }

            return new ParsedDecimal(parsed, null);
        }
        catch (NumberFormatException exception) {
            return new ParsedDecimal(
                    null,
                    fieldName
                            + " non valido: "
                            + rawValue
            );
        }
    }

    private Map<String, String> rawData(
            CSVParser parser,
            CSVRecord record
    ) {
        Map<String, String> data =
                new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (String header : parser.getHeaderNames()) {
            data.put(
                    header,
                    record.isMapped(header)
                            ? record.get(header)
                            : null
            );
        }

        return data;
    }

    private String toJson(
            Map<String, String> data
    ) {
        try {
            return jsonMapper.writeValueAsString(data);
        }
        catch (JacksonException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Impossibile convertire la riga in JSON",
                    exception
            );
        }
    }

    private void addError(
            List<String> errors,
            String error
    ) {
        if (error != null) {
            errors.add(error);
        }
    }

    private String normalizeKey(String value) {
        return value == null
                ? ""
                : value.trim()
                        .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private boolean isBlank(String value) {
        return value == null || value.isBlank();
    }

    private String readableErrorMessage(
            Throwable exception
    ) {
        return SecretSanitizer.sanitize(exception);
    }

    private String truncate(
            String value,
            int maximumLength
    ) {
        if (value == null
                || value.length() <= maximumLength) {
            return value;
        }

        return value.substring(
                0,
                maximumLength
        );
    }

    private record ParsedInteger(
            Integer value,
            String error
    ) {
    }

    private record ParsedDecimal(
            BigDecimal value,
            String error
    ) {
    }

    private record ImportedStatisticsRow(
            int rowNumber,
            String externalId,
            String externalName,
            String normalizedName,
            String clubName,
            String normalizedClubName,
            List<String> historicalClubs,
            String matchMethod,
            String matchConfidence,
            Long playerId,
            Long clubId,
            Integer appearances,
            Integer starts,
            Integer minutesPlayed,
            BigDecimal averageRating,
            BigDecimal fantasyAverage,
            Integer goals,
            Integer assists,
            Integer penaltiesTaken,
            Integer penaltiesScored,
            Integer penaltiesMissed,
            Integer yellowCards,
            Integer redCards,
            Integer ownGoals,
            Integer goalsConceded,
            Integer cleanSheets,
            Integer saves,
            Integer penaltiesSaved,

    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategic;

import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class RealPositionNormalizer {
    private static final Map<String, RealPosition> EXACT = Map.ofEntries(
            Map.entry("GK", RealPosition.GK), Map.entry("GOALKEEPER", RealPosition.GK),
            Map.entry("CB", RealPosition.CB), Map.entry("CENTRE-BACK", RealPosition.CB), Map.entry("CENTER-BACK", RealPosition.CB),
            Map.entry("RB", RealPosition.RB), Map.entry("RIGHT-BACK", RealPosition.RB),
            Map.entry("LB", RealPosition.LB), Map.entry("LEFT-BACK", RealPosition.LB),
            Map.entry("RWB", RealPosition.RWB), Map.entry("RIGHT WING-BACK", RealPosition.RWB),
            Map.entry("LWB", RealPosition.LWB), Map.entry("LEFT WING-BACK", RealPosition.LWB),
            Map.entry("DM", RealPosition.DM), Map.entry("DEFENSIVE MIDFIELD", RealPosition.DM),
            Map.entry("CM", RealPosition.CM), Map.entry("CENTRAL MIDFIELD", RealPosition.CM),
            Map.entry("AM", RealPosition.AM), Map.entry("ATTACKING MIDFIELD", RealPosition.AM),
            Map.entry("RW", RealPosition.RW), Map.entry("RIGHT WINGER", RealPosition.RW),
            Map.entry("LW", RealPosition.LW), Map.entry("LEFT WINGER", RealPosition.LW),
            Map.entry("SS", RealPosition.SS), Map.entry("SECOND STRIKER", RealPosition.SS),
            Map.entry("CF", RealPosition.CF), Map.entry("CENTRE-FORWARD", RealPosition.CF),
            Map.entry("ST", RealPosition.ST), Map.entry("STRIKER", RealPosition.ST),
            Map.entry("UTILITY", RealPosition.UTILITY)
    );

    public RealPosition normalize(String rawValue) {
        if (rawValue == null || rawValue.isBlank()) return RealPosition.UNKNOWN;
        return EXACT.getOrDefault(rawValue.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT), RealPosition.UNKNOWN);
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategic;

import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@Service
public class StrategicDataInspectionService {
    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<StrategicObservationResponse> findObservations(Long playerId, String seasonCode) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT o.*,
                    CASE WHEN o.minutes_played > 0 AND o.shots IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(o.shots * 90.0 / o.minutes_played, 4) END shots_per_90,
                    CASE WHEN o.minutes_played > 0 AND o.expected_goals IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(o.expected_goals * 90.0 / o.minutes_played, 4) END expected_goals_per_90,
                    CASE WHEN o.minutes_played > 0 AND o.expected_assists IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(o.expected_assists * 90.0 / o.minutes_played, 4) END expected_assists_per_90,
                    CASE WHEN o.aerial_duels > 0 AND o.aerial_duels_won IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(o.aerial_duels_won * 100.0 / o.aerial_duels, 2) END aerial_won_pct,
                    CASE WHEN o.appearances > 0 AND o.starts IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(o.starts * 100.0 / o.appearances, 2) END start_rate,
                    CASE WHEN o.appearances > 0 AND o.minutes_played IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(o.minutes_played * 1.0 / o.appearances, 2) END minutes_per_appearance
                FROM player_strategic_data_observations o
                JOIN seasons s ON s.id = o.season_id
                WHERE o.player_id = :playerId AND s.code = :seasonCode
                ORDER BY o.source, o.observed_at DESC NULLS LAST, o.id
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonCode", seasonCode)
                .query((rs, rowNum) -> new StrategicObservationResponse(
                        rs.getLong("id"), rs.getString("source"), rs.getString("source_record_id"),
                        rs.getObject("observed_at", java.time.OffsetDateTime.class),
                        rs.getObject("imported_at", java.time.OffsetDateTime.class),
                        rs.getString("evidence_status"), rs.getBigDecimal("confidence_score"),
                        rs.getString("real_position_raw"), position(rs.getString("real_position_normalized")),
                        rs.getString("penalty_hierarchy"), rs.getString("direct_free_kick_hierarchy"),
                        rs.getString("indirect_free_kick_hierarchy"), rs.getString("corner_hierarchy"),
                        rs.getObject("shots", Integer.class), rs.getObject("shots_on_target", Integer.class), rs.getBigDecimal("shots_per_90"),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("expected_goals"), rs.getBigDecimal("expected_goals_per_90"),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("expected_assists"), rs.getBigDecimal("expected_assists_per_90"),
                        rs.getObject("touches_in_box", Integer.class), rs.getObject("key_passes", Integer.class),
                        rs.getObject("shot_creating_actions", Integer.class), rs.getObject("goal_creating_actions", Integer.class),
                        rs.getObject("penalties_attempted", Integer.class), rs.getObject("penalties_scored", Integer.class),
                        rs.getObject("penalties_missed", Integer.class),
                        rs.getObject("aerial_duels", Integer.class), rs.getObject("aerial_duels_won", Integer.class), rs.getBigDecimal("aerial_won_pct"),
                        rs.getObject("headed_shots", Integer.class), rs.getObject("headed_goals", Integer.class), rs.getBigDecimal("headed_expected_goals"),

                        rs.getBigDecimal("corner_target_frequency"),

                        rs.getBigDecimal("start_rate"), rs.getBigDecimal("minutes_per_appearance"), rs.getBigDecimal("starter_probability"),
                        rs.getString("evidence")
                )).list();
    }

    private RealPosition position(String value) {

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategic;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
public class StrategicDataQualityPolicy {
    public String hierarchyFromGenericFlag(Boolean flag) {
        return flag == null ? null : "UNKNOWN";
    }

    public BigDecimal per90(BigDecimal value, Integer minutes) {
        if (value == null || minutes == null || minutes <= 0) return null;
        return value.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(90))
                .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(minutes), 4, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    public BigDecimal percentage(Integer won, Integer total) {
        if (won == null || total == null || total <= 0) return null;
        return BigDecimal.valueOf(won).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100))
                .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(total), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class AerialThreatService {
    public StrategicSignal calculate(AerialThreatInput in) {
        List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>();
        boolean offensiveHeading = in.headedShots() != null || in.headedGoals() != null || in.headedExpectedGoals() != null;
        boolean presence = in.offensiveBoxTouches() != null || in.setPieceBoxPresence() != null || in.cornerTargetFrequency() != null;
        boolean general = in.aerialDuels() != null || in.aerialDuelsWon() != null;
        if (!offensiveHeading) missing.add("offensiveHeadingEvidence");
        if (!presence) missing.add("offensiveBoxOrSetPiecePresence");
        if (!offensiveHeading) {
            StrategicSignalStatus status = general ? StrategicSignalStatus.PARTIAL : StrategicSignalStatus.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE;
            return new StrategicSignal(null, status, general ? bd(20) : BigDecimal.ZERO, "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
                    general ? List.of("GENERAL_AERIAL_EVIDENCE_ONLY") : List.of(), safe(in.sources()),
                    general ? List.of("Generic aerial duels cannot establish offensive threat") : List.of(), missing);
        }
        if (in.minutes() == null || in.minutes() <= 0) missing.add("positiveMinutes");
        if (!presence || in.minutes() == null || in.minutes() <= 0)
            return new StrategicSignal(null, StrategicSignalStatus.PARTIAL, bd(35), "PARTIAL_OFFENSIVE_HEADING_EVIDENCE",
                    List.of("OFFENSIVE_HEADING_EVIDENCE"), safe(in.sources()), conflict(in.sourceConflict()), missing);
        double per90Shots = in.headedShots() == null ? 0 : in.headedShots() * 90.0 / in.minutes();
        double per90Xg = in.headedExpectedGoals() == null ? 0 : in.headedExpectedGoals().doubleValue() * 90 / in.minutes();
        double score = Math.min(100, per90Shots * 25 + per90Xg * 180 + nz(in.headedGoals()) * 2
                + value(in.setPieceBoxPresence()) * 10 + value(in.cornerTargetFrequency()) * 10
                + nz(in.offensiveBoxTouches()) * .05);
        double confidence = in.evidenceConfidence() == null ? 50 : in.evidenceConfidence().doubleValue();
        if (in.sourceConflict()) confidence *= .65;
        return new StrategicSignal(bd(score), StrategicSignalStatus.AVAILABLE, bd(confidence),
                score >= 60 ? "STRONG_OFFENSIVE_AERIAL_THREAT" : score >= 30 ? "MODERATE_OFFENSIVE_AERIAL_THREAT" : "LIMITED_OFFENSIVE_AERIAL_THREAT",
                List.of("OFFENSIVE_HEADING_EVIDENCE", "BOX_OR_SET_PIECE_PRESENCE"), safe(in.sources()), conflict(in.sourceConflict()), missing);
    }
    private int nz(Integer v) { return v == null ? 0 : v; }
    private double value(BigDecimal v) { return v == null ? 0 : v.doubleValue(); }
    private List<String> safe(List<String> v) { return v == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(v); }
    private List<String> conflict(boolean v) { return v ? List.of("SOURCE_CONFLICT_SURFACED") : List.of(); }
    private BigDecimal bd(double v) { return BigDecimal.valueOf(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v))).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP); }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class BonusOpportunityService {
    public StrategicSignal calculate(BonusOpportunityInput in) {
        List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> reasons = new ArrayList<>();
        int dimensions = 0;
        double score = 0;
        if (explicit(in.penaltyHierarchy())) { dimensions++; score += hierarchy(in.penaltyHierarchy(), 32, 18); reasons.add("PENALTY_ACCESS=" + in.penaltyHierarchy()); }
        else missing.add("penaltyHierarchy");
        if (explicit(in.directFreeKickHierarchy())) { dimensions++; score += hierarchy(in.directFreeKickHierarchy(), 14, 8); reasons.add("DIRECT_FREE_KICK_ACCESS=" + in.directFreeKickHierarchy()); }
        if (explicit(in.cornerHierarchy()) || explicit(in.indirectFreeKickHierarchy())) { dimensions++; score += 10; reasons.add("SET_PIECE_CREATION"); }
        if (in.expectedGoalsPer90() != null || in.shotsPer90() != null || in.touchesInBox() != null) {
            dimensions++; score += Math.min(24, value(in.expectedGoalsPer90()) * 30 + value(in.shotsPer90()) * 3 + nz(in.touchesInBox()) * .05); reasons.add("OPEN_PLAY_GOAL_THREAT");
        } else missing.add("openPlayGoalThreat");
        if (in.expectedAssistsPer90() != null || in.keyPasses() != null) {
            dimensions++; score += Math.min(20, value(in.expectedAssistsPer90()) * 35 + nz(in.keyPasses()) * .08); reasons.add("OPEN_PLAY_ASSIST_THREAT");
        } else missing.add("openPlayAssistThreat");
        if (in.minutes() == null || in.minutes() <= 0) missing.add("positiveMinutes");
        if (dimensions < 2 || (in.minutes() == null || in.minutes() <= 0) && !explicit(in.penaltyHierarchy()))
            return unavailable(missing, in.sources(), in.sourceConflict());
        double confidence = in.evidenceConfidence() == null ? 40 : in.evidenceConfidence().doubleValue();
        if (in.sourceConflict()) confidence *= .65;
        if (dimensions == 2) confidence *= .75;
        return signal(score, confidence, dimensions >= 3 ? StrategicSignalStatus.AVAILABLE : StrategicSignalStatus.PARTIAL,
                score >= 65 ? "HIGH" : score >= 35 ? "MODERATE" : "LIMITED", reasons, missing, in.sources(), in.sourceConflict());
    }

    private StrategicSignal unavailable(List<String> missing, List<String> sources, boolean conflict) {
        return new StrategicSignal(null, StrategicSignalStatus.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, BigDecimal.ZERO, "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
                List.of(), safe(sources), conflict ? List.of("SOURCE_CONFLICT_SURFACED") : List.of(), missing);
    }
    private boolean explicit(String v) { return "PRIMARY".equals(v) || "SECONDARY".equals(v); }
    private double hierarchy(String v, double primary, double secondary) { return "PRIMARY".equals(v) ? primary : secondary; }
    private double value(BigDecimal v) { return v == null ? 0 : v.doubleValue(); }
    private int nz(Integer v) { return v == null ? 0 : v; }
    private List<String> safe(List<String> v) { return v == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(v); }
    private StrategicSignal signal(double score, double confidence, StrategicSignalStatus status, String category,
            List<String> reasons, List<String> missing, List<String> sources, boolean conflict) {
        List<String> finalReasons = new ArrayList<>(reasons); if (conflict) finalReasons.add("SOURCE_CONFLICT_SURFACED");
        return new StrategicSignal(bd(Math.min(100, score)), status, bd(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, confidence))), category,
                List.copyOf(reasons), safe(sources), finalReasons, List.copyOf(missing));
    }
    private BigDecimal bd(double v) { return BigDecimal.valueOf(v).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP); }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class RoleAdvantageService {
    private static final Set<String> D_ATTACKING = Set.of("RWB","LWB","RW","LW");
    private static final Set<String> C_ATTACKING = Set.of("AM","RAM","LAM","RW","LW","SS");

    public StrategicSignal calculate(RoleAdvantageInput in) {
        List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>();
        if (in.fantasyRole() == null) missing.add("fantasyRole");
        if (in.realPosition() == null || in.realPosition().name().equals("UNKNOWN")) missing.add("realPosition");
        if (!missing.isEmpty()) return insufficient(missing, in.sources(), in.sourceConflict());
        double score = 50;
        String position = in.realPosition().name();
        if ("D".equals(in.fantasyRole()) && D_ATTACKING.contains(position)) score += 28;
        else if ("D".equals(in.fantasyRole()) && "CB".equals(position)) score -= 5;
        else if ("C".equals(in.fantasyRole()) && C_ATTACKING.contains(position)) score += 23;
        else if ("A".equals(in.fantasyRole()) && Set.of("AM","CM","DM").contains(position)) score -= 18;
        if (in.bonusOpportunity() != null && in.bonusOpportunity().score() != null)
            score += (in.bonusOpportunity().score().doubleValue() - 50) * .18;
        double confidence = in.positionConfidence() == null ? 35 : in.positionConfidence().doubleValue();
        if (in.minutes() == null || in.minutes() <= 0) { confidence *= .7; missing.add("positiveMinutes"); }
        if (in.sourceConflict()) confidence *= .6;
        String category = score >= 72 ? "STRONG_ADVANTAGE" : score >= 58 ? "MODERATE_ADVANTAGE"
                : score >= 42 ? "NEUTRAL" : "POTENTIAL_DISADVANTAGE";
        return new StrategicSignal(bd(score), confidence < 50 ? StrategicSignalStatus.PARTIAL : StrategicSignalStatus.AVAILABLE,
                bd(confidence), category, List.of("fantasyRole=" + in.fantasyRole(), "realPosition=" + position),
                safe(in.sources()), conflictReasons(in.sourceConflict()), List.copyOf(missing));
    }
    private StrategicSignal insufficient(List<String> missing, List<String> sources, boolean conflict) {
        return new StrategicSignal(null, StrategicSignalStatus.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, BigDecimal.ZERO,
                "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE", List.of(), safe(sources), conflictReasons(conflict), missing);
    }
    private List<String> conflictReasons(boolean conflict) { return conflict ? List.of("SOURCE_CONFLICT_SURFACED") : List.of(); }
    private List<String> safe(List<String> v) { return v == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(v); }
    private BigDecimal bd(double v) { return BigDecimal.valueOf(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v))).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP); }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.function.Function;

public class StrategicEvidenceResolver {
    public <T> Resolution<T> resolve(List<T> observations, Function<T, ?> metricKey) {
        List<T> supplied = observations.stream().filter(item -> metricKey.apply(item) != null).toList();
        if (supplied.isEmpty()) return new Resolution<>(null, false);
        Object first = metricKey.apply(supplied.getFirst());
        boolean conflict = supplied.stream().map(metricKey).anyMatch(value -> !Objects.equals(first, value));
        return conflict ? new Resolution<>(null, true) : new Resolution<>(supplied.getFirst(), false);
    }
    public record Resolution<T>(T observation, boolean conflict) {}
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class StrategicIntelligenceService {
    private final BonusOpportunityService bonusService;
    private final RoleAdvantageService roleService;
    private final AerialThreatService aerialService;
    private final UpsideIntelligenceService upsideService;

    public StrategicIntelligenceService(BonusOpportunityService bonusService,
            RoleAdvantageService roleService, AerialThreatService aerialService,
            UpsideIntelligenceService upsideService) {
        this.bonusService = bonusService;
        this.roleService = roleService;
        this.aerialService = aerialService;
        this.upsideService = upsideService;
    }

    public StrategicIntelligenceProfile calculate(StrategicProfileInput input) {
        StrategicSignal bonus = bonusService.calculate(input.bonus());
        RoleAdvantageInput roleInput = input.role();
        StrategicSignal role = roleService.calculate(new RoleAdvantageInput(roleInput.fantasyRole(),
                roleInput.realPosition(), roleInput.positionConfidence(), roleInput.minutes(), roleInput.starts(),
                bonus, roleInput.sources(), roleInput.sourceConflict()));
        StrategicSignal aerial = aerialService.calculate(input.aerial());
        UpsideInput upsideInput = input.upside();
        StrategicSignal upside = upsideService.calculate(new UpsideInput(upsideInput.potentialScore(),
                upsideInput.reliabilityScore(), upsideInput.riskScore(), upsideInput.starterProbability(),
                upsideInput.marketGap(), role, bonus, upsideInput.activeRegistration(), upsideInput.sources()));
        List<StrategicSignal> signals = List.of(bonus, role, aerial, upside);
        long available = signals.stream().filter(signal -> signal.score() != null).count();
        LinkedHashSet<String> missing = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        LinkedHashSet<String> sources = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        LinkedHashSet<String> conflicts = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        for (StrategicSignal signal : signals) {
            missing.addAll(signal.missingInputs()); sources.addAll(signal.sourceReferences());
            signal.reasons().stream().filter("SOURCE_CONFLICT_SURFACED"::equals).forEach(conflicts::add);
        }
        return new StrategicIntelligenceProfile(input.playerId(), input.season(), input.fantasyRole(),
                bonus, role, aerial, upside,
                BigDecimal.valueOf(available * 25).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP),
                new ArrayList<>(missing), new ArrayList<>(sources), new ArrayList<>(conflicts));
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class UpsideIntelligenceService {
    public StrategicSignal calculate(UpsideInput in) {
        List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>();
        if (in.potentialScore() == null) missing.add("potentialScore");
        int confirmations = 0;
        if (in.starterProbability() != null) confirmations++;
        if (in.marketGap() != null) confirmations++;
        if (available(in.roleAdvantage())) confirmations++;
        if (available(in.bonusOpportunity())) confirmations++;
        if (in.potentialScore() == null || confirmations < 2 || !in.activeRegistration()) {
            if (confirmations < 2) missing.add("twoIndependentConfirmations");
            if (!in.activeRegistration()) missing.add("activeRegistration");
            return new StrategicSignal(null, StrategicSignalStatus.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, BigDecimal.ZERO,
                    "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE", List.of(), safe(in.sources()), List.of(), missing);
        }
        double score = in.potentialScore().doubleValue() * .45
                + value(in.starterProbability()) * .20
                + neutral(in.marketGap()) * .15
                + signal(in.roleAdvantage()) * .10
                + signal(in.bonusOpportunity()) * .10;
        double confidence = in.reliabilityScore() == null ? 45 : in.reliabilityScore().doubleValue();
        if (in.riskScore() != null) { score -= in.riskScore().doubleValue() * .18; confidence -= in.riskScore().doubleValue() * .25; }
        String category = score >= 70 ? "HIGH_UPSIDE" : score >= 55 ? "MODERATE_UPSIDE" : score >= 35 ? "STABLE" : "LOW_UPSIDE";
        return new StrategicSignal(bd(score), confidence >= 55 ? StrategicSignalStatus.AVAILABLE : StrategicSignalStatus.PARTIAL,
                bd(confidence), category, List.of("POTENTIAL", "INDEPENDENT_CONFIRMATIONS=" + confirmations),
                safe(in.sources()), in.riskScore() == null ? List.of() : List.of("Risk reduces upside and confidence"), missing);
    }
    private boolean available(StrategicSignal s) { return s != null && s.score() != null; }
    private double signal(StrategicSignal s) { return available(s) ? s.score().doubleValue() : 50; }
    private double value(BigDecimal v) { return v == null ? 50 : v.doubleValue(); }
    private double neutral(BigDecimal v) { return v == null ? 50 : Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 50 + v.doubleValue())); }
    private List<String> safe(List<String> v) { return v == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(v); }
    private BigDecimal bd(double v) { return BigDecimal.valueOf(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v))).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP); }
}
