package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.system;

import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.Arrays;

import org.springframework.core.env.Environment;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class SystemStatusService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    private final Environment environment;

    public SystemStatusService(JdbcClient jdbcClient, Environment environment) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
        this.environment = environment;
    }

    public SystemStatusResponse getStatus() {
        String runtimeEnvironment = resolveRuntimeEnvironment(environment);

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT application_name, application_version
                FROM system_information
                ORDER BY id DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) -> new SystemStatusResponse(
                        "UP",
                        resultSet.getString("application_name"),
                        resultSet.getString("application_version"),
                        runtimeEnvironment,
                        OffsetDateTime.now()
                ))
                .single();
    }

    static String resolveRuntimeEnvironment(Environment environment) {
        String[] activeProfiles = environment.getActiveProfiles();
        if (Arrays.asList(activeProfiles).contains("prod")) {
            return "production";
        }
        if (Arrays.asList(activeProfiles).contains("dev")) {
            return "development";
        }
        if (activeProfiles.length > 0) {
            return activeProfiles[0];
        }

        return Arrays.stream(environment.getDefaultProfiles())
                .findFirst()
                .orElse("default");
    }
}

            TransferDetectionService service
    ) {

    @PostMapping("/run")
    public TransferDetectionResponse detect(
            @RequestParam long fantacalcioBatchId,
            @RequestParam(required = false)

            @RequestParam(required = false)
            Long fantamarktBatchId
    ) {

                fantacalcioBatchId,
                gazzettaBatchId,

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.transfer.detection;

import java.sql.Types;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class TransferDetectionService {

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public TransferDetectionService(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient
    ) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional
    public TransferDetectionResponse detectLatest(
            String season
    ) {

        long fantacalcioBatchId =
                requireLatestBatch(
                        season,
                        "FANTACALCIO"
                );

        Long gazzettaBatchId =
                optionalLatestBatch(
                        season,
                        "GAZZETTA"
                );

        Long fantamarktBatchId =
                optionalLatestBatch(
                        season,
                        "FANTAMARKT"
                );

        return detect(
                fantacalcioBatchId,
                gazzettaBatchId,
                fantamarktBatchId
        );
    }

    @Transactional
    public TransferDetectionResponse detect(
            long fantacalcioBatchId,
            Long gazzettaBatchId,
            Long fantamarktBatchId
    ) {

        BatchInfo fantacalcio =
                batchInfo(
                        fantacalcioBatchId,
                        "FANTACALCIO"
                );

        if (gazzettaBatchId != null) {
            ensureSameSeason(
                    fantacalcio,
                    batchInfo(
                            gazzettaBatchId,
                            "GAZZETTA"
                    )
            );
        }

        if (fantamarktBatchId != null) {
            ensureSameSeason(
                    fantacalcio,
                    batchInfo(
                            fantamarktBatchId,
                            "FANTAMARKT"
                    )
            );
        }

        List<TransferCandidate> candidates =
                loadClubChangeCandidates(
                        fantacalcio
                );

        List<SerieAExitCandidate> exitCandidates =
                loadSerieAExitCandidates(
                        fantacalcio
                );

        int createdClaims = 0;
        int corroboratedClaims = 0;
        int existingOpenClaims = 0;
        int staleClaimsSkipped = 0;

        List<Long> createdClaimIds =
                new ArrayList<>();

        for (TransferCandidate candidate
                : candidates) {

            if (!lockAndMatchCurrentRegistration(candidate)) {
                staleClaimsSkipped++;
                continue;
            }

            if (hasNewerOfficialEvidence(
                    candidate,
                    fantacalcio.observedAt()
            )) {
                staleClaimsSkipped++;
                continue;
            }

            if (hasExistingOpenClaim(
                    candidate
            )) {
                existingOpenClaims++;
                continue;
            }

            boolean corroborated =
                    isCorroborated(
                            candidate,
                            gazzettaBatchId,
                            "GAZZETTA"
                    )
                    || isCorroborated(
                            candidate,
                            fantamarktBatchId,
                            "FANTAMARKT"
                    );

            String status =
                    corroborated
                            ? "PENDING_VERIFICATION"
                            : "DETECTED";

            Long claimId =
                    insertDetectedClaim(
                            candidate,
                            fantacalcio,
                            status
                    );

            createdClaims++;
            createdClaimIds.add(claimId);

            if (corroborated) {
                corroboratedClaims++;
            }
        }

        for (SerieAExitCandidate candidate : exitCandidates) {

            if (!lockAndMatchCurrentRegistration(candidate)) {
                staleClaimsSkipped++;
                continue;
            }

            if (hasNewerOfficialEvidence(
                    candidate.playerId(),
                    candidate.seasonId(),
                    fantacalcio.observedAt()
            )) {
                staleClaimsSkipped++;
                continue;
            }

            if (hasExistingOpenExitClaim(candidate)) {
                existingOpenClaims++;
                continue;
            }

            Long claimId =
                    insertDetectedExitClaim(
                            candidate,
                            fantacalcio
                    );

            createdClaims++;
            createdClaimIds.add(claimId);
        }

        int missingFromFantacalcio =
                countMissingFromFantacalcio(
                        fantacalcio
                );

        return new TransferDetectionResponse(
                fantacalcio.season(),
                fantacalcio.id(),
                gazzettaBatchId,
                fantamarktBatchId,
                candidates.size(),
                exitCandidates.size(),
                createdClaims,
                corroboratedClaims,
                existingOpenClaims,
                staleClaimsSkipped,
                missingFromFantacalcio,
                List.copyOf(createdClaimIds)
        );
    }

    private List<TransferCandidate>
            loadClubChangeCandidates(
                    BatchInfo batch
            ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    mapping.player_id,
                    player.display_name AS player_name,

                    registration.club_id
                        AS from_club_id,

                    current_club.name
                        AS from_club_name,

                    target_club.id
                        AS to_club_id,

                    target_club.name
                        AS to_club_name

                FROM player_import_rows import_row

                JOIN player_source_mappings mapping
                    ON mapping.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                    AND mapping.external_id =
                        import_row.external_id

                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id =
                        mapping.player_id

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND registration.season_id =
                        :seasonId
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN clubs current_club
                    ON current_club.id =
                        registration.club_id

                JOIN LATERAL (
                    SELECT
                        club.id,
                        club.name

                    FROM clubs club

                    JOIN season_clubs membership
                        ON membership.club_id = club.id
                        AND membership.season_id = :seasonId

                    WHERE LOWER(club.name) =
                            LOWER(import_row.club_name)

                       OR LOWER(club.short_name) =
                            LOWER(import_row.club_name)

                       OR LOWER(club.slug) =
                            LOWER(
                                import_row
                                    .normalized_club_name
                            )

                    ORDER BY club.id
                    LIMIT 1
                ) target_club
                    ON TRUE

                WHERE import_row.batch_id = :batchId
                  AND import_row.valid = TRUE
                  AND player.active = TRUE
                  AND target_club.id <>
                        registration.club_id

                ORDER BY mapping.player_id
                """)
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        batch.seasonId()
                )
                .param(
                        "batchId",
                        batch.id()
                )
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new TransferCandidate(
                                resultSet.getLong(
                                        "player_id"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "player_name"
                                ),
                                batch.seasonId(),
                                resultSet.getLong(
                                        "from_club_id"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "from_club_name"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getLong(
                                        "to_club_id"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "to_club_name"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private List<SerieAExitCandidate> loadSerieAExitCandidates(
            BatchInfo batch
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    mapping.player_id,
                    player.display_name AS player_name,
                    registration.club_id AS from_club_id,
                    current_club.name AS from_club_name

                FROM player_import_rows import_row

                JOIN player_source_mappings mapping
                    ON mapping.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                   AND mapping.external_id =
                       import_row.external_id

                JOIN players player
                    ON player.id = mapping.player_id

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                   AND registration.season_id = :seasonId
                   AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'

                JOIN clubs current_club
                    ON current_club.id = registration.club_id

                WHERE import_row.batch_id = :batchId
                  AND import_row.valid = TRUE
                  AND player.active = TRUE
                  AND LOWER(
                        COALESCE(
                            import_row.raw_data ->> 'out_of_game',
                            'false'
                        )
                      ) = 'true'

                ORDER BY mapping.player_id
                """)
                .param("seasonId", batch.seasonId())
                .param("batchId", batch.id())
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new SerieAExitCandidate(
                                resultSet.getLong("player_id"),
                                resultSet.getString("player_name"),
                                batch.seasonId(),
                                resultSet.getLong("from_club_id"),
                                resultSet.getString("from_club_name")
                        )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private boolean lockAndMatchCurrentRegistration(
            SerieAExitCandidate candidate
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT club_id, registration_status
                FROM player_registrations
                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                  AND season_id = :seasonId
                FOR UPDATE
                """)
                .param("playerId", candidate.playerId())
                .param("seasonId", candidate.seasonId())
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        resultSet.getLong("club_id")
                                == candidate.fromClubId()
                        && "ACTIVE".equals(
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "registration_status"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .optional()
                .orElse(false);
    }

    private boolean hasExistingOpenExitClaim(
            SerieAExitCandidate candidate
    ) {

        int count =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_transfer_claims
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND season_id = :seasonId
                          AND from_club_id = :fromClubId
                          AND to_club_id IS NULL
                          AND verification_status IN (
                              'DETECTED',
                              'PENDING_VERIFICATION'
                          )
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                candidate.playerId()
                        )
                        .param(
                                "seasonId",
                                candidate.seasonId()
                        )
                        .param(
                                "fromClubId",
                                candidate.fromClubId()
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        return count > 0;
    }

    private Long insertDetectedExitClaim(
            SerieAExitCandidate candidate,
            BatchInfo batch
    ) {

        String detectionKey =
                "AUTO:"
                        + batch.id()
                        + ":EXIT:"
                        + candidate.playerId()
                        + ":"
                        + candidate.fromClubId();

        String sourceReference =
                batch.sourceReference() == null
                        || batch.sourceReference().isBlank()
                        ? "import-batch:" + batch.id()
                        : batch.sourceReference();

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_transfer_claims (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    from_club_id,
                    to_club_id,
                    destination_club_name,
                    source,
                    source_reference,
                    source_published_at,
                    observed_at,
                    effective_at,
                    verification_status,
                    detection_key
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :fromClubId,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    'FANTACALCIO',
                    :sourceReference,
                    NULL,
                    :observedAt,
                    NULL,
                    'DETECTED',
                    :detectionKey
                )
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        candidate.playerId()
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        candidate.seasonId()
                )
                .param(
                        "fromClubId",
                        candidate.fromClubId()
                )
                .param(
                        "sourceReference",
                        sourceReference
                )
                .param(
                        "observedAt",
                        batch.observedAt(),
                        Types.TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE
                )
                .param(
                        "detectionKey",
                        detectionKey
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }
    private boolean isCorroborated(
            TransferCandidate candidate,
            Long batchId,
            String source
    ) {

        if (batchId == null) {
            return false;
        }

        int count =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)

                        FROM player_source_mappings mapping

                        JOIN player_import_rows import_row
                            ON import_row.external_id =
                                mapping.external_id

                        WHERE mapping.player_id = :playerId
                          AND mapping.source = :source
                          AND import_row.batch_id = :batchId
                          AND import_row.valid = TRUE

                          AND LOWER(import_row.club_name) =
                              LOWER(:targetClub)
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                candidate.playerId()
                        )
                        .param(
                                "source",
                                source
                        )
                        .param(
                                "batchId",
                                batchId
                        )
                        .param(
                                "targetClub",
                                candidate.toClubName()
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        return count > 0;
    }

    private boolean hasExistingOpenClaim(
            TransferCandidate candidate
    ) {

        int count =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)

                        FROM player_transfer_claims

                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND season_id = :seasonId
                          AND from_club_id = :fromClubId
                          AND to_club_id = :toClubId
                          AND verification_status IN (
                              'DETECTED',
                              'PENDING_VERIFICATION'
                          )
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                candidate.playerId()
                        )
                        .param(
                                "seasonId",
                                candidate.seasonId()
                        )
                        .param(
                                "fromClubId",
                                candidate.fromClubId()
                        )
                        .param(
                                "toClubId",
                                candidate.toClubId()
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        return count > 0;
    }

    private boolean lockAndMatchCurrentRegistration(
            TransferCandidate candidate
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT club_id, registration_status
                FROM player_registrations
                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                  AND season_id = :seasonId
                FOR UPDATE
                """)
                .param("playerId", candidate.playerId())
                .param("seasonId", candidate.seasonId())
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        resultSet.getLong("club_id") == candidate.fromClubId()
                        && "ACTIVE".equals(
                                resultSet.getString("registration_status")
                        )
                )
                .optional()
                .orElse(false);
    }

    private boolean hasNewerOfficialEvidence(
            TransferCandidate candidate,
            OffsetDateTime snapshotAt
    ) {
        return hasNewerOfficialEvidence(
                candidate.playerId(),
                candidate.seasonId(),
                snapshotAt
        );
    }

    private boolean hasNewerOfficialEvidence(
            Long playerId,
            Long seasonId,
            OffsetDateTime snapshotAt
    ) {

        if (snapshotAt == null) {
            return false;
        }

        int count =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)

                        FROM player_transfer_claims

                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND season_id = :seasonId
                          AND verification_status = 'OFFICIAL'
                          AND verification_source IN (
                              'FIGC',
                              'LEGA_SERIE_A',
                              'OFFICIAL_CLUB'
                          )
                          AND COALESCE(
                              verification_published_at,
                              verified_at,
                              observed_at
                          ) > :snapshotAt
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                playerId
                        )
                        .param(
                                "seasonId",
                                seasonId
                        )
                        .param(
                                "snapshotAt",
                                snapshotAt
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        return count > 0;
    }

    private Long insertDetectedClaim(
            TransferCandidate candidate,
            BatchInfo batch,
            String status
    ) {

        String detectionKey =
                "AUTO:"
                        + batch.id()
                        + ":"
                        + candidate.playerId()
                        + ":"
                        + candidate.fromClubId()
                        + ":"
                        + candidate.toClubId();

        String sourceReference =
                batch.sourceReference() == null
                        || batch.sourceReference().isBlank()
                        ? "import-batch:" + batch.id()
                        : batch.sourceReference();

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_transfer_claims (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    from_club_id,
                    to_club_id,
                    destination_club_name,
                    source,
                    source_reference,
                    source_published_at,
                    observed_at,
                    effective_at,
                    verification_status,
                    detection_key
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :fromClubId,
                    :toClubId,
                    :destinationClubName,
                    'FANTACALCIO',
                    :sourceReference,
                    NULL,
                    :observedAt,
                    NULL,
                    :status,
                    :detectionKey
                )
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        candidate.playerId()
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        candidate.seasonId()
                )
                .param(
                        "fromClubId",
                        candidate.fromClubId()
                )
                .param(
                        "toClubId",
                        candidate.toClubId()
                )
                .param(
                        "destinationClubName",
                        candidate.toClubName()
                )
                .param(
                        "sourceReference",
                        sourceReference
                )
                .param(
                        "observedAt",
                        batch.observedAt(),
                        Types.TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE
                )
                .param(
                        "status",
                        status
                )
                .param(
                        "detectionKey",
                        detectionKey
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private int countMissingFromFantacalcio(
            BatchInfo batch
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player.id)

                FROM players player

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND registration.season_id =
                        :seasonId
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN player_source_mappings mapping
                    ON mapping.player_id = player.id
                    AND mapping.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                    AND mapping.external_id IS NOT NULL

                WHERE player.active = TRUE

                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1

                      FROM player_import_rows import_row

                      WHERE import_row.batch_id =
                                :batchId
                        AND import_row.valid = TRUE
                        AND import_row.external_id =
                                mapping.external_id
                  )
                """)
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        batch.seasonId()
                )
                .param(
                        "batchId",
                        batch.id()
                )
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }

    private long requireLatestBatch(
            String season,
            String source
    ) {

        Long batchId =
                optionalLatestBatch(
                        season,
                        source
                );

        if (batchId == null) {
            throw new ResourceNotFoundException(
                    "Nessun batch COMPLETED "
                            + source
                            + " per "
                            + season
            );
        }

        return batchId;
    }

    private Long optionalLatestBatch(
            String season,
            String source
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT batch.id

                FROM import_batches batch

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = batch.season_id

                WHERE season.code = :season
                  AND batch.source = :source
                  AND batch.status = 'COMPLETED'

                ORDER BY
                    COALESCE(
                        batch.source_observed_at,
                        batch.completed_at,
                        batch.started_at
                    ) DESC,
                    batch.id DESC

                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("season", season)
                .param("source", source)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElse(null);
    }

    private BatchInfo batchInfo(
            long batchId,
            String expectedSource
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    batch.id,
                    season.id AS season_id,
                    season.code AS season,
                    batch.source,
                    batch.status,
                    batch.source_reference,

                    COALESCE(
                        batch.source_observed_at,
                        batch.completed_at,
                        batch.started_at
                    ) AS observed_at

                FROM import_batches batch

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = batch.season_id

                WHERE batch.id = :batchId
                """)
                .param("batchId", batchId)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->
                        new BatchInfo(
                                resultSet.getLong("id"),
                                resultSet.getLong(
                                        "season_id"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "season"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "source"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "status"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "source_reference"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getObject(
                                        "observed_at",
                                        OffsetDateTime.class
                                )
                        )
                )
                .optional()
                .map(batch -> {

                    if (!expectedSource.equals(
                            batch.source()
                    )) {
                        throw new ConflictException(
                                "Batch "
                                        + batchId
                                        + " atteso come "
                                        + expectedSource
                                        + " ma trovato "
                                        + batch.source()
                        );
                    }

                    if (!"COMPLETED".equals(
                            batch.status()
                    )) {
                        throw new ConflictException(
                                "Batch non completato: "
                                        + batchId
                        );
                    }

                    return batch;
                })
                .orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResourceNotFoundException(
                                "Batch non trovato: "
                                        + batchId
                        )
                );
    }

    private void ensureSameSeason(
            BatchInfo reference,
            BatchInfo secondary
    ) {

        if (!reference.seasonId()
                .equals(secondary.seasonId())) {

            throw new ConflictException(
                    "I batch selezionati appartengono "
                            + "a stagioni diverse"
            );
        }
    }

    private record BatchInfo(
            Long id,
            Long seasonId,
            String season,
            String source,
            String status,
            String sourceReference,
            OffsetDateTime observedAt
    ) {
    }

    private record SerieAExitCandidate(
            Long playerId,
            String playerName,
            Long seasonId,
            Long fromClubId,
            String fromClubName
    ) {
    }

    private record TransferCandidate(
            Long playerId,
            String playerName,
            Long seasonId,
            Long fromClubId,
            String fromClubName,
            Long toClubId,
            String toClubName
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.transfer;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Positive;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.AssertTrue;

public record TransferClaimRequest(
        @NotNull @Positive Long playerId,
        @NotBlank @Size(max = 20) String season,
        String targetClub,
        boolean leavingSerieA,
        String destinationClubName,
        @NotBlank @Size(max = 50) String source,
        @NotBlank @Size(max = 1000) String sourceReference,
        @NotNull OffsetDateTime sourcePublishedAt,
        @NotNull LocalDate effectiveAt
) {
    @AssertTrue(message = "Destinazione trasferimento incoerente")
    public boolean isDestinationConsistent() {
        if (leavingSerieA) {
            return (targetClub == null || targetClub.isBlank())
                    && destinationClubName != null && !destinationClubName.isBlank();
        }
        return targetClub != null && !targetClub.isBlank()
                && (destinationClubName == null || destinationClubName.isBlank());
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.transfer;

import java.util.List;

import jakarta.validation.Valid;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/admin/transfers")
public class TransferVerificationController {

    private final TransferVerificationService service;

    public TransferVerificationController(
            TransferVerificationService service
    ) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    @PostMapping("/claims")
    public TransferClaimResponse createClaim(
            @Valid @RequestBody TransferClaimRequest request
    ) {
        return service.createClaim(request);
    }

    @PostMapping("/{claimId}/verify-official")
    public TransferClaimResponse verifyOfficial(
            @PathVariable Long claimId,
            @RequestBody OfficialTransferVerificationRequest request
    ) {
        return service.verifyOfficial(claimId, request);
    }

    @PostMapping("/{claimId}/reject")
    public TransferClaimResponse reject(
            @PathVariable Long claimId,
            @RequestParam String reason
    ) {
        return service.reject(
                claimId,
                reason
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/pending")
    public List<TransferClaimResponse> findPending(
            @RequestParam String season
    ) {
        return service.findPending(season);
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.transfer;

import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Types;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@Service
public class TransferVerificationService {

    private static final Set<String> ALLOWED_SOURCES = Set.of(
            "FIGC",
            "LEGA_SERIE_A",
            "OFFICIAL_CLUB",
            "FANTACALCIO",
            "GAZZETTA",
            "FANTAMARKT"
    );

    private static final Set<String> OFFICIAL_SOURCES = Set.of(
            "FIGC",
            "LEGA_SERIE_A",
            "OFFICIAL_CLUB"
    );

    private static final String CLAIM_SELECT = """
            SELECT
                claim.id,
                claim.player_id,
                player.display_name AS player_name,
                season.code AS season,
                from_club.name AS from_club,
                to_club.name AS to_club,
                claim.destination_club_name,
                claim.source,
                claim.source_reference,
                claim.source_published_at,
                claim.verification_source,
                claim.verification_reference,
                claim.verification_published_at,
                claim.observed_at,
                claim.effective_at,
                claim.verification_status,
                claim.verified_at,
                claim.rejection_reason
            FROM player_transfer_claims claim
            JOIN players player ON player.id = claim.player_id
            JOIN seasons season ON season.id = claim.season_id
            JOIN clubs from_club ON from_club.id = claim.from_club_id
            LEFT JOIN clubs to_club ON to_club.id = claim.to_club_id
            """;

    private final JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    public TransferVerificationService(JdbcClient jdbcClient) {
        this.jdbcClient = jdbcClient;
    }

    @Transactional
    public TransferClaimResponse createClaim(TransferClaimRequest request) {
        validateCreateRequest(request);

        String source = normalizeSource(request.source());
        Long seasonId = findSeasonId(request.season());
        requirePlayer(request.playerId());

        Map<String, Object> currentRegistration = findCurrentActiveRegistration(
                request.playerId(),
                seasonId
        );
        Long fromClubId = numberValue(currentRegistration, "club_id");
        String fromClub = stringValue(currentRegistration, "club_name");

        Long toClubId = null;
        String destinationClubName;
        if (request.leavingSerieA()) {
            destinationClubName = requireText(
                    request.destinationClubName(),
                    "La destinazione fuori dalla Serie A e' obbligatoria"
            );
        } else {
            String targetClub = requireText(
                    request.targetClub(),
                    "La nuova squadra di Serie A e' obbligatoria"
            );
            Map<String, Object> targetClubRow = findSeasonClub(targetClub, seasonId);
            toClubId = numberValue(targetClubRow, "id");
            destinationClubName = stringValue(targetClubRow, "name");
            if (fromClubId.equals(toClubId)) {
                throw new ConflictException(
                        "La squadra proposta coincide con la squadra corrente: " + fromClub
                );
            }
        }

        Long claimId = insertClaim(
                request,
                source,
                seasonId,
                fromClubId,
                toClubId,
                destinationClubName
        );
        return findById(claimId);
    }

    /** Compatibility path for claims originally created from an official source. */
    @Transactional
    public TransferClaimResponse verifyOfficial(Long claimId) {
        TransferClaimRow claim = findClaimRowForUpdate(claimId);
        if ("OFFICIAL".equals(claim.verificationStatus())) {
            return findById(claimId);
        }
        if (!OFFICIAL_SOURCES.contains(claim.source())) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "La fonte " + claim.source() + " non e' una fonte ufficiale"
            );
        }
        OfficialTransferVerificationRequest request = new OfficialTransferVerificationRequest(
                claim.source(),
                claim.sourceReference(),
                claim.sourcePublishedAt(),
                claim.effectiveAt()
        );
        return confirmOfficial(claim, request);
    }

    @Transactional
    public TransferClaimResponse verifyOfficial(
            Long claimId,
            OfficialTransferVerificationRequest request
    ) {
        TransferClaimRow claim = findClaimRowForUpdate(claimId);
        return confirmOfficial(claim, request);
    }

    private TransferClaimResponse confirmOfficial(
            TransferClaimRow claim,
            OfficialTransferVerificationRequest request
    ) {
        if ("OFFICIAL".equals(claim.verificationStatus())) {
            return findById(claim.id());
        }
        if ("REJECTED".equals(claim.verificationStatus())) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Una segnalazione rifiutata non puo' diventare ufficiale"
            );
        }

        ValidatedOfficialEvidence evidence = validateOfficialEvidence(request);
        if (claim.toClubId() != null) {
            requireSeasonMembership(claim.toClubId(), claim.seasonId());
        }

        lockAndValidateCurrentRegistration(claim);
        if (claim.toClubId() == null) {
            applySerieAExit(claim, evidence.effectiveAt());
        } else {
            applySerieATransfer(claim, evidence.effectiveAt());
        }

        markOfficial(claim.id(), evidence);
        saveRegistrationEvent(claim, evidence);
        rejectSupersededClaims(claim);
        return findById(claim.id());
    }

    @Transactional
    public TransferClaimResponse reject(Long claimId, String reason) {
        TransferClaimRow claim = findClaimRowForUpdate(claimId);
        if ("OFFICIAL".equals(claim.verificationStatus())) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "Un trasferimento gia' ufficiale non puo' essere rifiutato"
            );
        }
        if ("REJECTED".equals(claim.verificationStatus())) {
            return findById(claimId);
        }

        String rejectionReason = requireText(reason, "Motivo del rifiuto obbligatorio");
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE player_transfer_claims
                SET verification_status = 'REJECTED',
                    rejection_reason = :reason,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = :claimId
                """)
                .param("reason", rejectionReason)
                .param("claimId", claimId)
                .update();
        return findById(claimId);
    }

    public List<TransferClaimResponse> findPending(String season) {
        return jdbcClient.sql(CLAIM_SELECT + """
                WHERE season.code = :season
                  AND claim.verification_status IN ('DETECTED', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION')
                ORDER BY claim.observed_at DESC, claim.id DESC
                """)
                .param("season", season)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) -> mapResponse(resultSet))
                .list();
    }

    public TransferClaimResponse findById(Long claimId) {
        return jdbcClient.sql(CLAIM_SELECT + " WHERE claim.id = :claimId")
                .param("claimId", claimId)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) -> mapResponse(resultSet))
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(
                        "Segnalazione trasferimento non trovata: " + claimId
                ));
    }

    private void validateCreateRequest(TransferClaimRequest request) {
        if (request == null) {
            throw new BadRequestException("Richiesta trasferimento mancante");
        }
        if (request.playerId() == null) {
            throw new BadRequestException("playerId obbligatorio");
        }
        requireText(request.season(), "Stagione obbligatoria");

        String source = normalizeSource(requireText(request.source(), "Fonte obbligatoria"));
        if (!ALLOWED_SOURCES.contains(source)) {
            throw new BadRequestException("Fonte trasferimento non supportata: " + source);
        }
        requireText(request.sourceReference(), "Riferimento alla fonte obbligatorio");

        if (request.leavingSerieA()) {
            if (request.targetClub() != null && !request.targetClub().isBlank()) {
                throw new BadRequestException(
                        "Un giocatore che lascia la Serie A non puo' avere targetClub"
                );
            }
            requireText(
                    request.destinationClubName(),
                    "La destinazione fuori dalla Serie A e' obbligatoria"
            );
        } else {
            requireText(request.targetClub(), "La nuova squadra di Serie A e' obbligatoria");
        }
    }

    private ValidatedOfficialEvidence validateOfficialEvidence(
            OfficialTransferVerificationRequest request
    ) {
        if (request == null) {
            throw new BadRequestException("Evidenza ufficiale mancante");
        }
        String source = normalizeSource(requireText(request.source(), "Fonte ufficiale obbligatoria"));
        if (!OFFICIAL_SOURCES.contains(source)) {
            throw new BadRequestException("Fonte di verifica non ufficiale: " + source);
        }
        String reference = requireText(
                request.sourceReference(),
                "Riferimento ufficiale obbligatorio"
        );
        if (request.effectiveAt() == null) {
            throw new BadRequestException("Data effettiva del trasferimento obbligatoria");
        }
        return new ValidatedOfficialEvidence(
                source,
                reference,
                request.sourcePublishedAt(),
                request.effectiveAt()
        );
    }

    private Long insertClaim(
            TransferClaimRequest request,
            String source,
            Long seasonId,
            Long fromClubId,
            Long toClubId,
            String destinationClubName
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_transfer_claims (
                    player_id, season_id, from_club_id, to_club_id,
                    destination_club_name, source, source_reference,
                    source_published_at, effective_at, verification_status
                ) VALUES (
                    :playerId, :seasonId, :fromClubId, :toClubId,
                    :destinationClubName, :source, :sourceReference,
                    :sourcePublishedAt, :effectiveAt, 'DETECTED'
                )
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param("playerId", request.playerId())
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("fromClubId", fromClubId)
                .param("toClubId", toClubId, Types.BIGINT)
                .param("destinationClubName", destinationClubName)
                .param("source", source)
                .param("sourceReference", request.sourceReference().trim())
                .param("sourcePublishedAt", request.sourcePublishedAt(), Types.TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE)
                .param("effectiveAt", request.effectiveAt(), Types.DATE)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void lockAndValidateCurrentRegistration(TransferClaimRow claim) {
        RegistrationState registration = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT club_id, registration_status
                FROM player_registrations
                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                  AND season_id = :seasonId
                FOR UPDATE
                """)
                .param("playerId", claim.playerId())
                .param("seasonId", claim.seasonId())
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) -> new RegistrationState(
                        resultSet.getLong("club_id"),
                        resultSet.getString("registration_status")
                ))
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ConflictException(
                        "Registrazione corrente del giocatore non trovata"
                ));

        if (!"ACTIVE".equals(registration.status())
                || !claim.fromClubId().equals(registration.clubId())) {
            throw new ConflictException(
                    "La registrazione corrente non corrisponde allo stato di partenza della claim"
            );
        }
    }

    private void applySerieATransfer(TransferClaimRow claim, LocalDate effectiveAt) {
        int updated = jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE player_registrations
                SET club_id = :toClubId,
                    joined_at = :effectiveAt,
                    left_at = NULL,
                    registration_status = 'ACTIVE',
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                  AND season_id = :seasonId
                  AND club_id = :fromClubId
                  AND registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                """)
                .param("toClubId", claim.toClubId())
                .param("effectiveAt", effectiveAt)
                .param("playerId", claim.playerId())
                .param("seasonId", claim.seasonId())
                .param("fromClubId", claim.fromClubId())
                .update();
        requireSingleRegistrationUpdate(updated);
    }

    private void applySerieAExit(TransferClaimRow claim, LocalDate effectiveAt) {
        int updated = jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE player_registrations
                SET left_at = :effectiveAt,
                    registration_status = 'RELEASED',
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                  AND season_id = :seasonId
                  AND club_id = :fromClubId
                  AND registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                """)
                .param("effectiveAt", effectiveAt)
                .param("playerId", claim.playerId())
                .param("seasonId", claim.seasonId())
                .param("fromClubId", claim.fromClubId())
                .update();
        requireSingleRegistrationUpdate(updated);
    }

    private void requireSingleRegistrationUpdate(int updated) {
        if (updated != 1) {
            throw new ConflictException("Registrazione del giocatore non aggiornata");
        }
    }

    private void markOfficial(Long claimId, ValidatedOfficialEvidence evidence) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE player_transfer_claims
                SET verification_status = 'OFFICIAL',
                    verification_source = :verificationSource,
                    verification_reference = :verificationReference,
                    verification_published_at = :verificationPublishedAt,
                    effective_at = :effectiveAt,
                    verified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    rejection_reason = NULL,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = :claimId
                """)
                .param("verificationSource", evidence.source())
                .param("verificationReference", evidence.reference())
                .param(
                        "verificationPublishedAt",
                        evidence.publishedAt(),
                        Types.TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE
                )
                .param("effectiveAt", evidence.effectiveAt())
                .param("claimId", claimId)
                .update();
    }

    private void saveRegistrationEvent(
            TransferClaimRow claim,
            ValidatedOfficialEvidence evidence
    ) {
        String eventType = claim.toClubId() == null
                ? "LEFT_SERIE_A"
                : "TRANSFER_IN_SERIE_A";
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_registration_events (
                    player_id, season_id, from_club_id, to_club_id,
                    destination_club_name, event_type, effective_at,
                    transfer_claim_id, source, source_reference
                ) VALUES (
                    :playerId, :seasonId, :fromClubId, :toClubId,
                    :destinationClubName, :eventType, :effectiveAt,
                    :claimId, :source, :sourceReference
                )
                """)
                .param("playerId", claim.playerId())
                .param("seasonId", claim.seasonId())
                .param("fromClubId", claim.fromClubId())
                .param("toClubId", claim.toClubId(), Types.BIGINT)
                .param("destinationClubName", claim.destinationClubName())
                .param("eventType", eventType)
                .param("effectiveAt", evidence.effectiveAt())
                .param("claimId", claim.id())
                .param("source", evidence.source())
                .param("sourceReference", evidence.reference())
                .update();
    }

    private void rejectSupersededClaims(TransferClaimRow officialClaim) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE player_transfer_claims
                SET verification_status = 'REJECTED',
                    rejection_reason = :reason,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                  AND season_id = :seasonId
                  AND from_club_id = :fromClubId
                  AND id <> :officialClaimId
                  AND verification_status IN ('DETECTED', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION')
                """)
                .param("reason", "Superseded by official transfer claim " + officialClaim.id())
                .param("playerId", officialClaim.playerId())
                .param("seasonId", officialClaim.seasonId())
                .param("fromClubId", officialClaim.fromClubId())
                .param("officialClaimId", officialClaim.id())
                .update();
    }

    private Long findSeasonId(String season) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id FROM seasons WHERE code = :season")
                .param("season", season)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Stagione non trovata: " + season));
    }

    private void requirePlayer(Long playerId) {
        boolean exists = jdbcClient.sql("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM players WHERE id = :playerId)")
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .query(Boolean.class)
                .single();
        if (!exists) {
            throw new ResourceNotFoundException("Giocatore non trovato: " + playerId);
        }
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findCurrentActiveRegistration(Long playerId, Long seasonId) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT registration.club_id, club.name AS club_name
                FROM player_registrations registration
                JOIN clubs club ON club.id = registration.club_id
                WHERE registration.player_id = :playerId
                  AND registration.season_id = :seasonId
                  AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(
                        "Registrazione ACTIVE del giocatore non trovata"
                ));
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findSeasonClub(String club, Long seasonId) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT club.id, club.name
                FROM season_clubs membership
                JOIN clubs club ON club.id = membership.club_id
                WHERE membership.season_id = :seasonId
                  AND (
                      LOWER(club.name) = LOWER(:club)
                      OR LOWER(club.short_name) = LOWER(:club)
                      OR LOWER(club.slug) = LOWER(:club)
                  )
                ORDER BY club.id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("club", club)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(
                        "Squadra non appartenente alla stagione richiesta: " + club
                ));
    }

    private void requireSeasonMembership(Long clubId, Long seasonId) {
        boolean member = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT EXISTS(
                    SELECT 1 FROM season_clubs
                    WHERE season_id = :seasonId AND club_id = :clubId
                )
                """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("clubId", clubId)
                .query(Boolean.class)
                .single();
        if (!member) {
            throw new ConflictException("Il club target non appartiene alla stagione della claim");
        }
    }

    private TransferClaimRow findClaimRowForUpdate(Long claimId) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    id, player_id, season_id, from_club_id, to_club_id,
                    destination_club_name, source, source_reference,
                    source_published_at, effective_at, verification_status
                FROM player_transfer_claims
                WHERE id = :claimId
                FOR UPDATE
                """)
                .param("claimId", claimId)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) -> new TransferClaimRow(
                        resultSet.getLong("id"),
                        resultSet.getLong("player_id"),
                        resultSet.getLong("season_id"),
                        resultSet.getLong("from_club_id"),
                        nullableLong(resultSet, "to_club_id"),
                        resultSet.getString("destination_club_name"),
                        resultSet.getString("source"),
                        resultSet.getString("source_reference"),
                        resultSet.getObject("source_published_at", OffsetDateTime.class),
                        resultSet.getObject("effective_at", LocalDate.class),
                        resultSet.getString("verification_status")
                ))
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(
                        "Segnalazione trasferimento non trovata: " + claimId
                ));
    }

    private TransferClaimResponse mapResponse(ResultSet resultSet) throws SQLException {
        return new TransferClaimResponse(
                resultSet.getLong("id"),
                resultSet.getLong("player_id"),
                resultSet.getString("player_name"),
                resultSet.getString("season"),
                resultSet.getString("from_club"),
                resultSet.getString("to_club"),
                resultSet.getString("destination_club_name"),
                resultSet.getString("source"),
                resultSet.getString("source_reference"),
                resultSet.getObject("source_published_at", OffsetDateTime.class),
                resultSet.getString("verification_source"),
                resultSet.getString("verification_reference"),
                resultSet.getObject("verification_published_at", OffsetDateTime.class),
                resultSet.getObject("observed_at", OffsetDateTime.class),
                resultSet.getObject("effective_at", LocalDate.class),
                resultSet.getString("verification_status"),
                resultSet.getObject("verified_at", OffsetDateTime.class),
                resultSet.getString("rejection_reason")
        );
    }

    private Long nullableLong(ResultSet resultSet, String column) throws SQLException {
        long value = resultSet.getLong(column);
        return resultSet.wasNull() ? null : value;
    }

    private String requireText(String value, String message) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            throw new BadRequestException(message);
        }
        return value.trim();
    }

    private String normalizeSource(String source) {
        return source.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private Long numberValue(Map<String, Object> row, String key) {
        return ((Number) row.get(key)).longValue();
    }

    private String stringValue(Map<String, Object> row, String key) {
        Object value = row.get(key);
        return value == null ? null : value.toString();
    }

    private record TransferClaimRow(
            Long id,
            Long playerId,
            Long seasonId,
            Long fromClubId,
            Long toClubId,
            String destinationClubName,
            String source,
            String sourceReference,
            OffsetDateTime sourcePublishedAt,
            LocalDate effectiveAt,
            String verificationStatus
    ) {
    }

    private record RegistrationState(Long clubId, String status) {
    }

    private record ValidatedOfficialEvidence(
            String source,
            String reference,
            OffsetDateTime publishedAt,
            LocalDate effectiveAt
    ) {
    }
}

INSERT INTO club_strength_ratings (
    club_id,
    season_id,
    overall_rating,
    attacking_rating,
    defensive_rating,
    home_rating,
    away_rating
)
SELECT
    club.id,
    season.id,

    CASE club.slug
        WHEN 'inter' THEN 91
        WHEN 'napoli' THEN 88
        WHEN 'juventus' THEN 86
        WHEN 'milan' THEN 85
        WHEN 'roma' THEN 82
        WHEN 'atalanta' THEN 81
        WHEN 'bologna' THEN 77
        WHEN 'lazio' THEN 76
        WHEN 'fiorentina' THEN 75
        ELSE 65
    END,

    CASE club.slug
        WHEN 'inter' THEN 92
        WHEN 'napoli' THEN 89
        WHEN 'milan' THEN 87
        WHEN 'juventus' THEN 84
        ELSE 66
    END,

    CASE club.slug
        WHEN 'inter' THEN 92
        WHEN 'juventus' THEN 88
        WHEN 'napoli' THEN 86
        WHEN 'roma' THEN 82
        ELSE 65
    END,

    CASE club.slug
        WHEN 'inter' THEN 94
        WHEN 'napoli' THEN 91
        WHEN 'juventus' THEN 89
        WHEN 'milan' THEN 88
        ELSE 68
    END,

    CASE club.slug
        WHEN 'inter' THEN 88
        WHEN 'napoli' THEN 85
        WHEN 'juventus' THEN 83
        WHEN 'milan' THEN 82
        ELSE 62
    END

FROM clubs club
JOIN seasons season
    ON season.code = '2026/2027'

ON CONFLICT (club_id, season_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    overall_rating = EXCLUDED.overall_rating,
    attacking_rating = EXCLUDED.attacking_rating,
    defensive_rating = EXCLUDED.defensive_rating,
    home_rating = EXCLUDED.home_rating,
    away_rating = EXCLUDED.away_rating,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

INSERT INTO fixtures (
    season_id,
    matchday,
    home_club_id,
    away_club_id,
    kickoff_at
)
SELECT
    season.id,
    fixture_data.matchday,
    home_club.id,
    away_club.id,
    fixture_data.kickoff_at

FROM (
    VALUES
        (1, 'napoli', 'lecce', '2026-08-22 18:00:00+02'::timestamptz),
        (1, 'inter', 'roma', '2026-08-22 20:45:00+02'::timestamptz),
        (1, 'milan', 'venezia', '2026-08-23 18:00:00+02'::timestamptz),
        (1, 'juventus', 'atalanta', '2026-08-23 20:45:00+02'::timestamptz),

        (2, 'juventus', 'napoli', '2026-08-29 20:45:00+02'::timestamptz),
        (2, 'lecce', 'inter', '2026-08-30 18:00:00+02'::timestamptz),
        (2, 'roma', 'milan', '2026-08-30 20:45:00+02'::timestamptz),

        (3, 'napoli', 'venezia', '2026-09-12 18:00:00+02'::timestamptz),
        (3, 'inter', 'juventus', '2026-09-12 20:45:00+02'::timestamptz),
        (3, 'milan', 'lecce', '2026-09-13 18:00:00+02'::timestamptz)
) AS fixture_data(
    matchday,
    home_slug,
    away_slug,
    kickoff_at
)

JOIN seasons season
    ON season.code = '2026/2027'

JOIN clubs home_club
    ON home_club.slug = fixture_data.home_slug

JOIN clubs away_club
    ON away_club.slug = fixture_data.away_slug

ON CONFLICT (
    season_id,
    matchday,
    home_club_id,
    away_club_id
)
DO NOTHING;

    CONSTRAINT fk_availability_player
        FOREIGN KEY (player_id)
        REFERENCES players(id),

    CONSTRAINT fk_availability_season
        FOREIGN KEY (season_id)
        REFERENCES seasons(id),

    CONSTRAINT uq_player_availability
        UNIQUE (player_id, season_id, matchday),

    CONSTRAINT ck_availability_matchday
        CHECK (matchday BETWEEN 1 AND 38),

    CONSTRAINT ck_availability_status
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'AVAILABLE',
                'PROBABLE',
                'DOUBTFUL',
                'INJURED',
                'SUSPENDED',
                'UNAVAILABLE'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_starting_probability
        CHECK (
            starting_probability IS NULL
            OR starting_probability BETWEEN 0 AND 100
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_availability_probability
        CHECK (
            availability_probability IS NULL
            OR availability_probability BETWEEN 0 AND 100
        )
);

CREATE INDEX idx_player_availability_matchday
    ON player_availabilities(season_id, matchday, status);

        REFERENCES seasons(id)

-- ============================================================
-- V34 - REMOVE LEGACY SYNTHETIC PRODUCTION DATA
--
-- Removes historical development fixtures from non-test DBs:
-- - legacy synthetic players identified by their exact normalized names
-- - their player-related data
-- - three obsolete synthetic import batches
--
-- The cleanup is intentionally database-name agnostic and idempotent:
-- every deletion is restricted to exact historical fingerprints.
-- ============================================================

DO $$
BEGIN
    CREATE TEMP TABLE synthetic_player_ids (
        player_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY
    ) ON COMMIT DROP;

    INSERT INTO synthetic_player_ids (player_id)
    SELECT id
    FROM players
    WHERE normalized_name IN (
        'giocatore test uno',
        'giocatore test due',
        'andrea valenti',
        'marco rinaldi',
        'luca sereni',
        'davide moretti',
        'matteo ferri',
        'alessandro conti',
        'simone leoni',
        'riccardo marini',
        'federico sala',
        'nicola gatti',
        'tommaso villa',
        'emanuele greco',
        'gabriele romano',
        'pietro de luca',
        'samuele caruso',
        'christian lombardi',
        'filippo santoro',
        'leonardo martini',
        'michele esposito',
        'antonio vitale',
        'daniele pellegrini',
        'kevin bianchi',
        'jacopo colombo'
    );

    DELETE FROM auction_price_snapshots
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    DELETE FROM fantasy_squad_players
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    DELETE FROM player_availabilities
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    DELETE FROM player_availability_history
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    DELETE FROM player_evaluations
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    DELETE FROM player_market_values
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    DELETE FROM player_reconciliation_results
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    DELETE FROM player_registrations
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    DELETE FROM player_roles
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    DELETE FROM player_season_statistics
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    DELETE FROM player_source_mappings
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    DELETE FROM player_tactical_profiles
    WHERE player_id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    UPDATE player_statistics_import_rows
    SET resolved_player_id = NULL
    WHERE resolved_player_id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    DELETE FROM players
    WHERE id IN (
        SELECT player_id FROM synthetic_player_ids
    );

    DELETE FROM import_batches
    WHERE
        (
            source = 'FANTACALCIO'
            AND original_filename = 'players-test.csv'
            AND total_rows = 3
            AND valid_rows = 3
            AND invalid_rows = 0
        )
        OR
        (
            source = 'GAZZETTA'
            AND original_filename = 'players-gazzetta-test.csv'
            AND total_rows = 3
            AND valid_rows = 3
            AND invalid_rows = 0
        )
        OR
        (
            source = 'FANTAMARKT'
            AND original_filename = 'players-fantamarkt-test.csv'
            AND total_rows = 3
            AND valid_rows = 3
            AND invalid_rows = 0
        );

END

-- ============================================================
-- V50 - AUCTION PRICE MODEL V1
-- Block 51
--
-- Versioned and auditable derived layer built on:
-- - B50 fantasy player value
-- - current Fantacalcio FVM market signal
--
-- B50 remains immutable.
-- Legacy auction_price_snapshots is preserved for compatibility.
-- ============================================================


-- ============================================================
-- 1. ALGORITHM REGISTRY
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE auction_price_algorithms (
    version VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,

    reference_season_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES seasons(id),

    b50_algorithm_version VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL
        REFERENCES player_value_algorithms(version),

    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'ACTIVE',
                'SUPERSEDED'
            )
        ),

    model_family VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            model_family =
                'B50_MARKET_BLEND_AUCTION_PRICE'
        ),

    -- P: 55% B50 + 45% market signal
    goalkeeper_b50_weight NUMERIC(5,4) NOT NULL,

    -- D/C/A: 65% B50 + 35% market signal
    outfield_b50_weight NUMERIC(5,4) NOT NULL,

    -- Market signal:
    -- 50% FVM role percentile
    -- 50% logarithmic FVM strength
    market_percentile_weight NUMERIC(5,4) NOT NULL,
    market_strength_weight NUMERIC(5,4) NOT NULL,

    definition_payload JSONB NOT NULL,

    definition_fingerprint CHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
        DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_algorithm_weights
        CHECK (
            goalkeeper_b50_weight
                BETWEEN 0 AND 1
            AND outfield_b50_weight
                BETWEEN 0 AND 1
            AND market_percentile_weight
                BETWEEN 0 AND 1
            AND market_strength_weight
                BETWEEN 0 AND 1

            AND ABS(
                market_percentile_weight
                + market_strength_weight
                - 1
            ) < 0.0001
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_algorithm_payload
        CHECK (
            jsonb_typeof(definition_payload)
                = 'object'
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_algorithm_fingerprint
        CHECK (
            definition_fingerprint
                ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        )
);


-- ============================================================
-- 2. VERSIONED PLAYER PRICE PROFILES
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE auction_price_profiles (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    player_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES players(id),

    reference_season_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES seasons(id),

    algorithm_version VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL
        REFERENCES auction_price_algorithms(version),

    b50_algorithm_version VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL
        REFERENCES player_value_algorithms(version),

    league_teams INTEGER NOT NULL,

    total_budget INTEGER NOT NULL,

    defense_modifier BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

    role_code CHAR(1) NOT NULL,

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- B50 INPUT
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    b50_role_rank INTEGER,

    b50_role_percentile NUMERIC(6,2),

    data_confidence_score NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- CURRENT MARKET INPUT
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    quotation NUMERIC(10,2),

    fantasy_market_value NUMERIC(10,2),

    fvm_role_percentile NUMERIC(6,2),

    fvm_strength NUMERIC(6,2),

    market_signal NUMERIC(6,2),

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- B51 DERIVED VALUE
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    auction_score NUMERIC(6,2),

    auction_role_rank INTEGER,

    auction_role_percentile NUMERIC(6,2),

    pricing_status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,

    minimum_price INTEGER,

    recommended_price INTEGER,

    maximum_price INTEGER,

    budget_percentage NUMERIC(7,3),

    evidence JSONB NOT NULL,

    input_fingerprint CHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    generated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
        DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    -- One immutable output for each auction configuration.
    CONSTRAINT uq_auction_price_profile
        UNIQUE (
            player_id,
            reference_season_id,
            algorithm_version,
            league_teams,
            total_budget,
            defense_modifier
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_teams
        CHECK (
            league_teams BETWEEN 6 AND 12
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_budget
        CHECK (
            total_budget BETWEEN 150 AND 1000
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_role
        CHECK (
            role_code IN (
                'P',
                'D',
                'C',
                'A'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_confidence
        CHECK (
            data_confidence_score
                BETWEEN 0 AND 100
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_fvm
        CHECK (
            quotation IS NULL
            OR quotation >= 0
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_fmv
        CHECK (
            fantasy_market_value IS NULL
            OR fantasy_market_value >= 0
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_percentiles
        CHECK (
            (
                b50_role_percentile IS NULL
                OR b50_role_percentile
                    BETWEEN 0 AND 100
            )
            AND (
                fvm_role_percentile IS NULL
                OR fvm_role_percentile
                    BETWEEN 0 AND 100
            )
            AND (
                fvm_strength IS NULL
                OR fvm_strength
                    BETWEEN 0 AND 100
            )
            AND (
                market_signal IS NULL
                OR market_signal
                    BETWEEN 0 AND 100
            )
            AND (
                auction_score IS NULL
                OR auction_score
                    BETWEEN 0 AND 100
            )
            AND (
                auction_role_percentile IS NULL
                OR auction_role_percentile
                    BETWEEN 0 AND 100
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_status
        CHECK (
            pricing_status IN (
                'PRICED',
                'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE'
            )
        ),

    -- A priced player must have the complete derived output.
    -- Insufficient evidence must never receive a fake price.
    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_price_state
        CHECK (
            (
                pricing_status = 'PRICED'

                AND b50_role_rank IS NOT NULL
                AND b50_role_rank > 0

                AND b50_role_percentile IS NOT NULL

                AND auction_score IS NOT NULL

                AND auction_role_rank IS NOT NULL
                AND auction_role_rank > 0

                AND auction_role_percentile IS NOT NULL

                AND minimum_price IS NOT NULL
                AND minimum_price >= 1

                AND recommended_price IS NOT NULL
                AND recommended_price >= minimum_price

                AND maximum_price IS NOT NULL
                AND maximum_price >= recommended_price

                AND budget_percentage IS NOT NULL
                AND budget_percentage >= 0
            )
            OR
            (
                pricing_status =
                    'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE'

                AND b50_role_rank IS NULL
                AND b50_role_percentile IS NULL

                AND auction_score IS NULL
                AND auction_role_rank IS NULL
                AND auction_role_percentile IS NULL

                AND minimum_price IS NULL
                AND recommended_price IS NULL
                AND maximum_price IS NULL
                AND budget_percentage IS NULL
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_evidence
        CHECK (
            jsonb_typeof(evidence)
                = 'object'
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_fingerprint
        CHECK (
            input_fingerprint
                ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        )
);

-- The current Serie A catalog was explicitly seeded for 2026/2027 in V4.
