SELECT season.id, club.id
FROM seasons season
JOIN clubs club ON club.slug IN (
    'atalanta', 'bologna', 'cagliari', 'como', 'fiorentina',
    'frosinone', 'genoa', 'inter', 'juventus', 'lazio',
    'lecce', 'milan', 'monza', 'napoli', 'parma', 'roma',
    'sassuolo', 'torino', 'udinese', 'venezia'
)
WHERE season.code = '2026/2027'
ON CONFLICT (season_id, club_id) DO NOTHING;

-- Existing season-scoped registrations and fixtures are authoritative evidence
-- of historical membership; no current club set is projected onto other seasons.
INSERT INTO season_clubs (season_id, club_id)
SELECT DISTINCT registration.season_id, registration.club_id
FROM player_registrations registration
ON CONFLICT (season_id, club_id) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO season_clubs (season_id, club_id)
SELECT fixture.season_id, membership.club_id
FROM fixtures fixture
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES (fixture.home_club_id), (fixture.away_club_id)
) AS membership(club_id)
ON CONFLICT (season_id, club_id) DO NOTHING;

-- B63.3D
-- A Fantacalcio out_of_game signal proves that the player must no longer
-- be operational in Serie A, but it does not prove the destination.
--
-- Automatic Serie A exit claims are identified by their controlled
-- FANTACALCIO AUTO:*:EXIT:* detection key and may therefore keep both
-- destination fields NULL throughout their lifecycle.
--
-- Manual/non-automatic claims continue to require a destination.

ALTER TABLE player_transfer_claims
DROP CONSTRAINT ck_transfer_destination;

-- Repair only the old automatically-generated sentinel claims.
-- Preserve claim IDs/history instead of deleting and recreating them.
UPDATE player_transfer_claims claim
SET destination_club_name = NULL,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE claim.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
  AND claim.destination_club_name = 'OUTSIDE_SERIE_A'
  AND claim.to_club_id IS NULL
  AND claim.verification_status IN (
      'DETECTED',
      'PENDING_VERIFICATION'
  )
  AND claim.detection_key LIKE 'AUTO:%:EXIT:%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM player_registration_events event
      WHERE event.transfer_claim_id = claim.id
  );

ALTER TABLE player_transfer_claims
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_transfer_destination
CHECK (
    to_club_id IS NOT NULL
    OR destination_club_name IS NOT NULL
    OR (
        source = 'FANTACALCIO'
        AND detection_key LIKE 'AUTO:%:EXIT:%'
    )
);

    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_b67_fantasy_average_role_percentile
        CHECK (
            fantasy_average_role_percentile IS NULL
            OR fantasy_average_role_percentile BETWEEN 0 AND 100
        );


ALTER TABLE auction_price_profiles

        CHECK (

            OR usage_role_percentile BETWEEN 0 AND 100
        );


ALTER TABLE auction_price_profiles
    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_b67_goal_rate_role_percentile
        CHECK (
            goal_rate_role_percentile IS NULL
            OR goal_rate_role_percentile BETWEEN 0 AND 100
        );

    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_b67_assist_rate_role_percentile
        CHECK (
            assist_rate_role_percentile IS NULL
            OR assist_rate_role_percentile BETWEEN 0 AND 100
        );

    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_b67_performance_signal_count
        CHECK (
            performance_signal_count IS NULL
            OR performance_signal_count BETWEEN 0 AND 4
        );

        CHECK (
            evidence_tier IS NULL
            OR evidence_tier IN (
                'HIGH_EVIDENCE',
                'MEDIUM_EVIDENCE',
                'LOW_EVIDENCE',
                'MARKET_ONLY'
            )
        );


ALTER TABLE auction_price_profiles
    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_dependency_v67
        CHECK (
            (
                b50_algorithm_version IS NOT NULL
                AND performance_algorithm_version IS NULL
            )
            OR
            (
                b50_algorithm_version IS NULL
                AND performance_algorithm_version IS NOT NULL
            )
        );


-- ============================================================
-- PRICE STATE
--
-- Preserve B51 semantics while allowing B67 to price players
-- without B50 evidence.
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE auction_price_profiles
    DROP CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_price_state;


ALTER TABLE auction_price_profiles
    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_auction_profile_price_state
        CHECK (
            (
                pricing_status = 'PRICED'

                AND auction_score IS NOT NULL

                AND auction_role_rank IS NOT NULL
                AND auction_role_rank > 0

                AND auction_role_percentile IS NOT NULL

                AND minimum_price IS NOT NULL
                AND minimum_price >= 1

                AND recommended_price IS NOT NULL
                AND recommended_price >= minimum_price

                AND maximum_price IS NOT NULL
                AND maximum_price >= recommended_price

                AND budget_percentage IS NOT NULL
                AND budget_percentage >= 0

                AND
                (
                    (
                        b50_algorithm_version IS NOT NULL
                        AND performance_algorithm_version IS NULL

                        AND b50_role_rank IS NOT NULL
                        AND b50_role_rank > 0

                        AND b50_role_percentile IS NOT NULL
                    )
                    OR
                    (
                        b50_algorithm_version IS NULL
                        AND performance_algorithm_version IS NOT NULL

                        AND b50_role_rank IS NULL
                        AND b50_role_percentile IS NULL

                        AND market_signal IS NOT NULL
                        AND evidence_tier IS NOT NULL
                    )
                )
            )
            OR
            (
                pricing_status = 'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE'

                AND b50_role_rank IS NULL
                AND b50_role_percentile IS NULL

                AND auction_score IS NULL
                AND auction_role_rank IS NULL
                AND auction_role_percentile IS NULL

                AND minimum_price IS NULL
                AND recommended_price IS NULL
                AND maximum_price IS NULL
                AND budget_percentage IS NULL
            )
        );


-- ============================================================
-- SEMANTIC POLICY
-- ============================================================
--
-- NULL historical feature = UNKNOWN.
-- UNKNOWN is omitted, never converted to zero.
--
-- Zero is valid observed evidence.
--
-- Market domain:
-- median(FVM role percentile, quotation role percentile)
--
-- Performance domain:
-- median(available formal B66 role-relative signals)
--
-- Final B67 value:
-- equal combination of market and performance domains when both
-- exist; otherwise the available domain is used.
--
-- Confidence affects evidence tier / price range,
-- not player quality.
--
-- No B66 retrospective overall score is created.
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE automation_runs (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    season_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES seasons(id),

    trigger_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
        DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED',

    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
        DEFAULT 'RUNNING',

    stage VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL
        DEFAULT 'STARTING',

    listone_run_id BIGINT,

    ingestion_run_count INTEGER NOT NULL
        DEFAULT 0,

    refresh_run_id BIGINT,

    started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    last_heartbeat_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,

    error_message VARCHAR(2000),

    CONSTRAINT ck_automation_run_trigger
        CHECK (
            trigger_type IN (
                'SCHEDULED'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_automation_run_status
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'RUNNING',
                'COMPLETED',
                'FAILED'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_automation_run_stage
        CHECK (
            stage IN (
                'STARTING',
                'LISTONE',
                'INGESTION',
                'REFRESH',
                'COMPLETED'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_automation_ingestion_count
        CHECK (
            ingestion_run_count >= 0
        )
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_automation_run_running_per_season
    ON automation_runs(season_id)
    WHERE status = 'RUNNING';

CREATE INDEX idx_automation_runs_season_started
    ON automation_runs(
        season_id,
        started_at DESC,
        id DESC
    );

CREATE INDEX idx_automation_runs_status
    ON automation_runs(status);

-- =====================================================================
-- V69 - Selective automated identity enrichment
--
-- Keeps V68 production automation history immutable.
--
-- Purpose:
-- - durable per-player Transfermarkt automation attempts
-- - avoid retrying the same unresolved players every scheduler run
-- - prevent bounded batches from starving later eligible players
-- - preserve history counters and last result
--
-- This table does NOT assert identity truth.
-- MATCHED_VERIFIED truth is persisted only through the existing
-- Transfermarkt provenance persistence service.
-- =====================================================================

CREATE TABLE identity_enrichment_automation_attempts (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    season_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES seasons(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    player_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES players(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    last_status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,

    attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL
        DEFAULT 1,

    last_score INTEGER NOT NULL
        DEFAULT 0,

    transfermarkt_player_id VARCHAR(30),

    last_reason VARCHAR(500),

    last_attempt_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        NOT NULL
        DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    next_retry_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        NOT NULL
        DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        NOT NULL
        DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    CONSTRAINT uq_identity_automation_attempt_player
        UNIQUE (season_id, player_id),

    CONSTRAINT ck_identity_automation_attempt_status
        CHECK (
            last_status IN (
                'MATCHED_VERIFIED',
                'REVIEW_REQUIRED',
                'NOT_FOUND',
                'FAILED'
            )
        ),

    CONSTRAINT ck_identity_automation_attempt_count
        CHECK (attempt_count >= 1),

    CONSTRAINT ck_identity_automation_attempt_score
        CHECK (last_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_identity_automation_retry
    ON identity_enrichment_automation_attempts (
        season_id,
        next_retry_at,
        player_id
    );

CREATE INDEX idx_identity_automation_status
    ON identity_enrichment_automation_attempts (
        season_id,
        last_status,
        last_attempt_at DESC
    );

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

class AuctionApiPriceServiceTest {

    @Test
    void shouldCalculateCurrentB67PlayerPrice() {

        B67AuctionPriceModelService modelService =
                mock(B67AuctionPriceModelService.class);

        AuctionApiPriceService service =
                new AuctionApiPriceService(
                        modelService
                );

        B67AuctionPriceModelService.AuctionPriceModelResult modelResult =
                pricedResult(
                        10L,
                        "Paz N.",
                        "Como",
                        "C",
                        91.25,
                        1,
                        97.10,
                        150,
                        175,
                        200,
                        "HIGH_EVIDENCE"
                );

        when(
                modelService.calculateAll(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1000,
                        8,
                        false
                )
        ).thenReturn(
                List.of(modelResult)
        );

        AuctionPriceResponse response =
                service.calculate(
                        10L,
                        "2026/2027",
                        1000,
                        8,
                        false
                );

        assertThat(response.playerId())
                .isEqualTo(10L);

        assertThat(response.playerName())
                .isEqualTo("Paz N.");

        assertThat(response.role())
                .isEqualTo("C");

        assertThat(response.minimumPrice())
                .isEqualTo(150);

        assertThat(response.recommendedPrice())
                .isEqualTo(175);

        assertThat(response.maximumPrice())
                .isEqualTo(200);

        assertThat(response.calculationScore())
                .isEqualByComparingTo(
                        new BigDecimal("91.25")
                );

        assertThat(response.recommendation())
                .isEqualTo("PRICED");

        assertThat(response.explanation())
                .contains(
                        "B67_AUCTION_PRICE_V1"
                )
                .contains(
                        "HIGH_EVIDENCE"
                );

        verify(modelService)
                .calculateAll(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1000,
                        8,
                        false
                );
    }

                )

        );

        List<AuctionPriceResponse> responses =

                );

        assertThat(responses)
                .hasSize(2);

        assertThat(responses)
                .extracting(

                )
                .containsExactly(
                        10L,
                        20L
                );
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.condition.EnabledIfEnvironmentVariable;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Propagation;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional(propagation = Propagation.NOT_SUPPORTED)
@EnabledIfEnvironmentVariable(
        named = "B51_SANDBOX_CERTIFICATION",
        matches = "true"
)
class AuctionPricePersistenceServiceIntegrationTest {

    private static final String SEASON = "2026/2027";
    private static final int BUDGET = 1000;
    private static final int TEAMS = 8;
    private static final boolean DEFENSE_MODIFIER = false;

    @Autowired
    private AuctionPricePersistenceService persistenceService;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldPersistB51IdempotentlyAndRespectCertifiedInvariants() {

        clearOnlyB51CertificationConfiguration();

        AuctionPricePersistenceService.PersistResult pass1 =
                persistenceService.generateAndPersist(
                        SEASON,
                        BUDGET,
                        TEAMS,
                        DEFENSE_MODIFIER
                );

        assertThat(pass1.algorithmVersion())
                .isEqualTo(AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION);

        assertThat(pass1.calculatedProfiles())
                .isEqualTo(495);

        assertThat(pass1.insertedProfiles())
                .isEqualTo(495);

        assertThat(pass1.unchangedProfiles())
                .isZero();

        assertDatabaseState();

        AuctionPricePersistenceService.PersistResult pass2 =
                persistenceService.generateAndPersist(
                        SEASON,
                        BUDGET,
                        TEAMS,
                        DEFENSE_MODIFIER
                );

        assertThat(pass2.calculatedProfiles())
                .isEqualTo(495);

        assertThat(pass2.insertedProfiles())
                .isZero();

        assertThat(pass2.unchangedProfiles())
                .isEqualTo(495);

        assertDatabaseState();

        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("=== B51 SANDBOX PASS1 ===");
        System.out.println(
                "calculated=" + pass1.calculatedProfiles()
                        + " inserted=" + pass1.insertedProfiles()
                        + " unchanged=" + pass1.unchangedProfiles()
        );

        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("=== B51 SANDBOX PASS2 ===");
        System.out.println(
                "calculated=" + pass2.calculatedProfiles()
                        + " inserted=" + pass2.insertedProfiles()
                        + " unchanged=" + pass2.unchangedProfiles()
        );

        printRoleAudit();
        printCriticalPlayers();
    }

    private void clearOnlyB51CertificationConfiguration() {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                DELETE FROM auction_price_profiles
                WHERE algorithm_version = :version
                  AND league_teams = :teams
                  AND total_budget = :budget
                  AND defense_modifier = :defenseModifier
                """)
                .param(
                        "version",
                        AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION
                )
                .param("teams", TEAMS)
                .param("budget", BUDGET)
                .param(
                        "defenseModifier",
                        DEFENSE_MODIFIER
                )
                .update();

        Integer remainingProfiles =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_price_profiles
                        WHERE algorithm_version = :version
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "version",
                                AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        if (remainingProfiles == 0) {
            jdbcClient.sql("""
                    DELETE FROM auction_price_algorithms
                    WHERE version = :version
                    """)
                    .param(
                            "version",
                            AuctionPriceModelService.ALGORITHM_VERSION
                    )
                    .update();
        }
    }

    private void assertDatabaseState() {

        Integer total =
                count("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_price_profiles
                        WHERE algorithm_version =
                            'B51_AUCTION_PRICE_V1'
                          AND league_teams = 8
                          AND total_budget = 1000
                          AND defense_modifier = FALSE
                        """);

        Integer priced =
                count("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_price_profiles
                        WHERE algorithm_version =
                            'B51_AUCTION_PRICE_V1'
                          AND league_teams = 8
                          AND total_budget = 1000
                          AND defense_modifier = FALSE
                          AND pricing_status = 'PRICED'
                        """);

        Integer insufficient =
                count("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_price_profiles
                        WHERE algorithm_version =
                            'B51_AUCTION_PRICE_V1'
                          AND league_teams = 8
                          AND total_budget = 1000
                          AND defense_modifier = FALSE
                          AND pricing_status =
                            'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE'
                        """);

        Integer invalidPriced =
                count("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_price_profiles
                        WHERE algorithm_version =
                            'B51_AUCTION_PRICE_V1'
                          AND league_teams = 8
                          AND total_budget = 1000
                          AND defense_modifier = FALSE
                          AND pricing_status = 'PRICED'
                          AND (
                                recommended_price IS NULL
                                OR recommended_price < 1
                                OR minimum_price IS NULL
                                OR maximum_price IS NULL
                                OR minimum_price >
                                    recommended_price
                                OR maximum_price <
                                    recommended_price
                          )
                        """);

        Integer invalidInsufficient =
                count("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_price_profiles
                        WHERE algorithm_version =
                            'B51_AUCTION_PRICE_V1'
                          AND league_teams = 8
                          AND total_budget = 1000
                          AND defense_modifier = FALSE
                          AND pricing_status =
                            'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE'
                          AND (
                                auction_score IS NOT NULL
                                OR auction_role_rank IS NOT NULL
                                OR recommended_price IS NOT NULL
                                OR minimum_price IS NOT NULL
                                OR maximum_price IS NOT NULL
                          )
                        """);

        Integer algorithms =
                count("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_price_algorithms
                        WHERE version =
                            'B51_AUCTION_PRICE_V1'
                        """);

        assertThat(total).isEqualTo(495);
        assertThat(priced).isEqualTo(451);
        assertThat(insufficient).isEqualTo(44);
        assertThat(invalidPriced).isZero();
        assertThat(invalidInsufficient).isZero();
        assertThat(algorithms).isEqualTo(1);

        List<Map<String, Object>> roleBudgets =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            role_code,
                            COUNT(*) AS ranked_players,
                            SUM(recommended_price) AS total_price
                        FROM auction_price_profiles
                        WHERE algorithm_version =
                            'B51_AUCTION_PRICE_V1'
                          AND league_teams = 8
                          AND total_budget = 1000
                          AND defense_modifier = FALSE
                          AND pricing_status = 'PRICED'
                        GROUP BY role_code
                        ORDER BY role_code
                        """)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        for (Map<String, Object> row : roleBudgets) {

            String role =
                    row.get("role_code").toString();

            int rankedPlayers =
                    ((Number) row.get("ranked_players"))
                            .intValue();

            int totalPrice =
                    ((Number) row.get("total_price"))
                            .intValue();

            int marketSlots =
                    switch (role) {
                        case "P" -> TEAMS * 3;
                        case "D" -> TEAMS * 8;
                        case "C" -> TEAMS * 8;
                        case "A" -> TEAMS * 6;
                        default ->
                                throw new IllegalStateException(
                                        "Ruolo inatteso: " + role
                                );
                    };

            int maximumAllowed =
                    switch (role) {
                        case "P" -> 480;
                        case "D" -> 800;
                        case "C" -> 2000;
                        case "A" -> 4720;
                        default ->
                                throw new IllegalStateException(
                                        "Ruolo inatteso: " + role
                                );
                    };

            int outsideMarketSlots =
                    Math.max(
                            0,
                            rankedPlayers - marketSlots
                    );

            int effectiveMarketSpend =
                    totalPrice - outsideMarketSlots;

            assertThat(effectiveMarketSpend)
                    .as(
                            "Budget slot mercato ruolo "
                                    + role
                    )
                    .isLessThanOrEqualTo(maximumAllowed);
        }
    }

    private Integer count(String sql) {
        return jdbcClient
                .sql(sql)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void printRoleAudit() {

        System.out.println();
        System.out.println("=== B51 ROLE AUDIT ===");

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            role_code,
                            COUNT(*) FILTER (
                                WHERE pricing_status = 'PRICED'
                            ) AS priced,
                            COUNT(*) FILTER (
                                WHERE pricing_status =
                                    'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE'
                            ) AS insufficient,
                            SUM(
                                CASE
                                    WHEN pricing_status = 'PRICED'
                                    THEN recommended_price
                                    ELSE 0
                                END
                            ) AS recommended_sum
                        FROM auction_price_profiles
                        WHERE algorithm_version =
                            'B51_AUCTION_PRICE_V1'
                          AND league_teams = 8
                          AND total_budget = 1000
                          AND defense_modifier = FALSE
                        GROUP BY role_code
                        ORDER BY role_code
                        """)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        for (Map<String, Object> row : rows) {
            System.out.println(row);
        }
    }

                              'Carnesecchi',

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.List;

import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

public final class B51TestMarket {

    private B51TestMarket() {
    }

    public static List<AuctionPriceResponse> pricedPlayers(
            JdbcClient jdbcClient,
            String season,
            int budget,
            int teams,
            boolean defenseModifier
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    player.id,
                    player.display_name,
                    club.name AS club_name,
                    role.fantasy_role
                FROM players player
                JOIN player_registrations registration
                  ON registration.player_id = player.id
                 AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                JOIN seasons season
                  ON season.id = registration.season_id
                JOIN clubs club
                  ON club.id = registration.club_id
                JOIN season_clubs season_club
                  ON season_club.season_id = season.id
                 AND season_club.club_id = club.id
                JOIN player_roles role
                  ON role.player_id = player.id
                 AND role.season_id = season.id
                 AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                WHERE player.active = TRUE
                  AND season.code = :season
                ORDER BY player.id
                """)
                .param("season", season)
                .query()
                .listOfRows()
                .stream()
                .map(row -> {
                    long id = ((Number) row.get("id")).longValue();
                    int recommended = (int) (id % 40) + 1;

                    return new AuctionPriceResponse(
                            id,
                            row.get("display_name").toString(),
                            row.get("club_name").toString(),
                            row.get("fantasy_role").toString(),
                            teams,
                            budget,
                            defenseModifier,
                            Math.max(1, recommended - 2),
                            recommended,
                            recommended + 2,
                            BigDecimal.valueOf(recommended)
                                    .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(100))
                                    .divide(
                                            BigDecimal.valueOf(budget),
                                            2,
                                            RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                                    ),
                            BigDecimal.valueOf(100 - id % 50),
                            "PRICED",
                            "B51 test price"
                    );
                })
                .toList();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class B67AuctionPricePersistenceIntegrationTest {

    private static final String SEASON = "2026/2027";
    private static final String B66_VERSION = "B66_FEATURES_V3";
    private static final String B67_VERSION = "B67_AUCTION_PRICE_V1";

    @Autowired
    private B67AuctionPriceModelService modelService;

    @Autowired
    private B67AuctionPricePersistenceService persistenceService;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    private Long marketOnlyPlayerId;
    private int expectedOperationalPlayers;

    @BeforeEach
    void prepareIsolatedB67Dataset() {

        Long seasonId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM seasons
                        WHERE code = :seasonCode
                        """)
                .param("seasonCode", SEASON)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();

        /*
         * B67 depends on an ACTIVE B66 algorithm.
         *
         * This is test-only data and the whole test is transactional:
         * Spring rolls it back automatically after every test.
         */
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_performance_algorithms (
                            version,
                            reference_season_id,
                            status,
                            model_decision
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :version,
                            :seasonId,
                            'ACTIVE',
                            'COMPONENT_FEATURES_ONLY'
                        )
                        ON CONFLICT (version)
                        DO UPDATE SET
                            reference_season_id = EXCLUDED.reference_season_id,
                            status = 'ACTIVE',
                            model_decision = 'COMPONENT_FEATURES_ONLY'
                        """)
                .param("version", B66_VERSION)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();

        /*
         * The common test catalogue already contains players,
         * registrations and INTERNAL roles.
         *
         * B67 deliberately accepts only the authoritative
         * FANTACALCIO fantasy role, so derive that role from the
         * existing deterministic test role.
         */
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_roles (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            source,
                            fantasy_role,
                            tactical_role,
                            primary_role
                        )
                        SELECT
                            role.player_id,
                            role.season_id,
                            'FANTACALCIO',
                            role.fantasy_role,
                            role.tactical_role,
                            TRUE
                        FROM player_roles role
                        WHERE role.season_id = :seasonId
                          AND role.source = 'INTERNAL'
                        ON CONFLICT (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            source
                        )
                        DO UPDATE SET
                            fantasy_role = EXCLUDED.fantasy_role,
                            tactical_role = EXCLUDED.tactical_role,
                            primary_role = TRUE
                        """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();

        /*
         * Pick one deterministic player to exercise B67's
         * certified NO_HISTORY -> MARKET_ONLY policy.
         */
        marketOnlyPlayerId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT MIN(player.id)
                        FROM players player
                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                           AND registration.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                           AND role.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                        JOIN season_clubs season_club
                            ON season_club.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND season_club.club_id = registration.club_id
                        WHERE player.active = TRUE
                        """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();

        assertThat(marketOnlyPlayerId)
                .isNotNull();

        /*
         * Deterministic B66 feature profiles.
         *
         * No invented production data is involved:
         * these rows exist exclusively inside the rollback-only
         * test transaction and exercise B67's actual DB contract.
         */
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_performance_feature_profiles (
                            player_id,
                            reference_season_id,
                            current_club_id,
                            role_code,
                            algorithm_version,
                            history_seasons_available,
                            latest_history_season,
                            source_mix,
                            small_sample,
                            data_confidence_score,
                            input_fingerprint,
                            feature_values,
                            evidence
                        )
                        SELECT
                            player.id,
                            :seasonId,
                            registration.club_id,
                            role.fantasy_role,
                            :algorithmVersion,

                            CASE
                                WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                    THEN 0
                                ELSE 1
                            END,

                            CASE
                                WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                    THEN NULL
                                ELSE '2025/2026'
                            END,

                            CASE
                                WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                    THEN 'NO_HISTORY'
                                ELSE 'ONE_SEASON_ONLY'
                            END,

                            CASE
                                WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                    THEN TRUE
                                ELSE FALSE
                            END,

                            CASE
                                WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                    THEN 0
                                ELSE 80
                            END,

                            repeat(
                                CASE
                                    WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                        THEN 'a'
                                    ELSE 'b'
                                END,
                                64
                            ),

                            CASE
                                WHEN player.id = :marketOnlyPlayerId
                                    THEN jsonb_build_object(
                                        'fantasy_average_role_percentile', NULL,
                                        'usage_role_percentile', NULL,
                                        'goal_rate_role_percentile', NULL,
                                        'assist_rate_role_percentile', NULL
                                    )
                                ELSE jsonb_build_object(
                                    'fantasy_average_role_percentile',
                                        ((player.id * 17) % 101),
                                    'usage_role_percentile',
                                        ((player.id * 23) % 101),
                                    'goal_rate_role_percentile',
                                        ((player.id * 31) % 101),
                                    'assist_rate_role_percentile',
                                        ((player.id * 43) % 101)
                                )
                            END,

                            jsonb_build_object(
                                'test_dataset', TRUE,
                                'purpose', 'B67 isolated integration test'
                            )

                        FROM players player

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                           AND registration.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                           AND role.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                        JOIN season_clubs season_club
                            ON season_club.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND season_club.club_id = registration.club_id

                        WHERE player.active = TRUE

                        ON CONFLICT (
                            player_id,
                            reference_season_id,
                            algorithm_version
                        )
                        DO UPDATE SET
                            current_club_id = EXCLUDED.current_club_id,
                            role_code = EXCLUDED.role_code,
                            history_seasons_available =
                                EXCLUDED.history_seasons_available,
                            latest_history_season =
                                EXCLUDED.latest_history_season,
                            source_mix = EXCLUDED.source_mix,
                            small_sample = EXCLUDED.small_sample,
                            data_confidence_score =
                                EXCLUDED.data_confidence_score,
                            input_fingerprint =
                                EXCLUDED.input_fingerprint,
                            feature_values =
                                EXCLUDED.feature_values,
                            evidence =
                                EXCLUDED.evidence
                        """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("algorithmVersion", B66_VERSION)
                .param("marketOnlyPlayerId", marketOnlyPlayerId)
                .update();

        /*
         * Fantacalcio market evidence is deterministic as well.
         *
         * It gives every test player genuine market signals while
         * the selected NO_HISTORY player has no performance signals.
         */
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_market_values (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            source,
                            quotation,
                            fantasy_market_value
                        )
                        SELECT
                            player.id,
                            :seasonId,
                            'FANTACALCIO',
                            1 + (player.id % 30),
                            1 + (player.id % 80)
                        FROM players player
                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                           AND registration.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                           AND role.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                        WHERE player.active = TRUE
                        ON CONFLICT (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            source
                        )
                        DO UPDATE SET
                            quotation = EXCLUDED.quotation,
                            fantasy_market_value =
                                EXCLUDED.fantasy_market_value
                        """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();

        expectedOperationalPlayers = jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM seasons season

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.season_id = season.id
                           AND registration.registration_status = 'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN players player
                            ON player.id = registration.player_id
                           AND player.active = TRUE

                        JOIN season_clubs season_club
                            ON season_club.season_id = season.id
                           AND season_club.club_id =
                               registration.club_id

                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                           AND role.season_id = season.id
                           AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                        JOIN player_performance_feature_profiles performance
                            ON performance.player_id = player.id
                           AND performance.reference_season_id =
                               season.id
                           AND performance.algorithm_version =
                               :algorithmVersion

                        WHERE season.code = :seasonCode
                        """)
                .param("algorithmVersion", B66_VERSION)
                .param("seasonCode", SEASON)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();

        assertThat(expectedOperationalPlayers)
                .isGreaterThan(0);
    }

                modifierOn =
                modelService.calculateAll(
                        SEASON,
                        1000,
                        8,
                        true
                );

        assertThat(modifierOn)
                .hasSize(expectedOperationalPlayers);

        long defenseTotalNoModifier =
                modelService.calculateAll(
                                SEASON,
                                1000,
                                8,
                                false
                        )
                        .stream()
                        .filter(result ->
                                "D".equals(
                                        result.role()
                                )
                        )
                        .mapToLong(
                                B67AuctionPriceModelService
                                        .AuctionPriceModelResult
                                        ::recommendedPrice
                        )
                        .sum();

        long defenseTotalModifier =
                modifierOn
                        .stream()
                        .filter(result ->
                                "D".equals(
                                        result.role()
                                )
                        )
                        .mapToLong(
                                B67AuctionPriceModelService
                                        .AuctionPriceModelResult
                                        ::recommendedPrice
                        )
                        .sum();

        assertThat(defenseTotalModifier)
                .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(
                        defenseTotalNoModifier
                );

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class B67AuctionValueScorerTest {

    private final B67AuctionValueScorer scorer =
            new B67AuctionValueScorer();

    @Test
    void shouldCombineMarketAndPerformanceAsEqualDomains() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "A",

                        100.0,
                        100.0,

                        0.0,
                        0.0,
                        0.0,
                        100.0
                );

        /*
         * Market median = 100.
         * Performance median = 0.
         *
         * Equal domain combination = 50.
         *
         * A flat median over all six signals would incorrectly
         * produce 0 and would overweight historical feature count.
         */
        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isEqualTo(50.0);

        assertThat(
                result.performanceSignalCount()
        ).isEqualTo(4);

        assertThat(
                result.totalSignalCount()
        ).isEqualTo(6);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldUseMedianInsidePerformanceDomain() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "C",

                        null,
                        null,

                        90.0,
                        70.0,
                        50.0,
                        30.0
                );

        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isEqualTo(60.0);

        assertThat(
                result.performanceSignalCount()
        ).isEqualTo(4);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldKeepUnknownNullInsteadOfTurningItIntoZero() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "D",

                        40.0,
                        20.0,

                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isEqualTo(30.0);

        assertThat(
                result.performanceSignalCount()
        ).isZero();

        assertThat(
                result.totalSignalCount()
        ).isEqualTo(2);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldAllowMarketOnlyGoalkeeperLikePenev() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "P",

                        10.0,
                        10.0,

                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isEqualTo(10.0);

        assertThat(
                result.performanceSignalCount()
        ).isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void goalkeeperShouldIgnoreGoalAndAssistSignals() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "P",

                        60.0,
                        40.0,

                        null,
                        null,

                        100.0,
                        100.0
                );

        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isEqualTo(50.0);

        assertThat(
                result.performanceSignalCount()
        ).isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void zeroMustRemainRealEvidence() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "C",

                        0.0,
                        0.0,

                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturnNullOnlyWhenEveryEvidenceSignalIsMissing() {

        B67AuctionValueScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        "A",

                        null,
                        null,

                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(
                result.auctionValueScore()
        ).isNull();

        assertThat(
                result.totalSignalCount()
        ).isZero();
    }
}

    private void prepareEligiblePlayers() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> players =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            player.id AS player_id,
                            season.id AS season_id,
                            role.fantasy_role,
                            role.tactical_role

                        FROM players player

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                            AND registration.registration_status =
                                'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = registration.season_id

                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                            AND role.season_id = season.id

                        WHERE player.active = TRUE
                          AND season.code = '2026/2027'

                        ORDER BY player.id
                        """)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        assertThat(players)
                .isNotEmpty();

        for (Map<String, Object> player : players) {
            Long playerId =
                    ((Number) player.get("player_id"))
                            .longValue();

            Long seasonId =
                    ((Number) player.get("season_id"))
                            .longValue();

            String fantasyRole =
                    player.get("fantasy_role")
                            .toString();

            Object tacticalRole =
                    player.get("tactical_role");

            jdbcClient.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO player_roles (
                        player_id,
                        season_id,
                        source,
                        fantasy_role,
                        tactical_role,
                        primary_role,
                        valid_from
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        :playerId,
                        :seasonId,
                        'FANTACALCIO',
                        :fantasyRole,
                        :tacticalRole,
                        TRUE,
                        DATE '2026-07-01'
                    )
                    ON CONFLICT (
                        player_id,
                        season_id,
                        source
                    )
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        fantasy_role =
                            EXCLUDED.fantasy_role,

                        tactical_role =
                            EXCLUDED.tactical_role,

                        primary_role = TRUE,

                        valid_from =
                            EXCLUDED.valid_from
                    """)
                    .param("playerId", playerId)
                    .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                    .param(
                            "fantasyRole",
                            fantasyRole
                    )
                    .param(
                            "tacticalRole",
                            tacticalRole
                    )
                    .update();
        }
    }

    private PlayerData findPlayerNotInSquad() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    player.id AS player_id,
                    season.id AS season_id,
                    role.fantasy_role

                FROM players player

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = registration.season_id

                JOIN player_roles role
                    ON role.player_id = player.id
                    AND role.season_id = season.id
                    AND role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE player.active = TRUE
                  AND season.code = '2026/2027'

                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player
                      WHERE squad_player.squad_id = :squadId
                        AND squad_player.player_id = player.id
                  )

                ORDER BY player.id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .query((rs, rowNumber) ->
                        new PlayerData(
                                rs.getLong(
                                        "player_id"
                                ),
                                rs.getLong(
                                        "season_id"
                                ),
                                rs.getString(
                                        "fantasy_role"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .single();
    }

    private List<PlayerData> findPlayersByRole(
            String role,
            int limit
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    player.id AS player_id,
                    season.id AS season_id,
                    player_role.fantasy_role

                FROM players player

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = registration.season_id

                JOIN player_roles player_role
                    ON player_role.player_id = player.id
                    AND player_role.season_id = season.id
                    AND player_role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE player.active = TRUE
                  AND season.code = '2026/2027'
                  AND player_role.fantasy_role = :role

                ORDER BY player.id
                LIMIT :limit
                """)
                .param("role", role)
                .param("limit", limit)
                .query((rs, rowNumber) ->
                        new PlayerData(
                                rs.getLong(
                                        "player_id"
                                ),
                                rs.getLong(
                                        "season_id"
                                ),
                                rs.getString(
                                        "fantasy_role"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private void insertPurchase(
            PlayerData player,
            int purchasePrice
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fantasy_squad_players (
                    squad_id,
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    fantasy_role,
                    purchase_price
                )
                VALUES (
                    :squadId,
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :role,
                    :purchasePrice
                )
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        player.playerId()
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        player.seasonId()
                )
                .param(
                        "role",
                        player.role()
                )
                .param(
                        "purchasePrice",
                        purchasePrice
                )
                .update();
    }

    private LiveAuctionRoleStrategyResponse findRole(
            LiveAuctionStrategyResponse response,
            String role
    ) {
        return response.roles()
                .stream()
                .filter(item ->
                        role.equals(item.role())
                )
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow();
    }

    private List<LiveAuctionTargetResponse> allTargets(
            LiveAuctionStrategyResponse response
    ) {
        return response.roles()
                .stream()
                .flatMap(role ->
                        role.targets().stream()
                )
                .toList();
    }

    private record PlayerData(
            Long playerId,
            Long seasonId,
            String role
    ) {
    }
}

    private List<Long> prepareEligiblePlayers() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> players =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            player.id AS player_id,
                            season.id AS season_id,
                            role.fantasy_role,
                            role.tactical_role

                        FROM players player

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                            AND registration.registration_status =
                                'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = registration.season_id

                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                            AND role.season_id = season.id


                        WHERE player.active = TRUE
                          AND season.code = '2026/2027'

                        ORDER BY player.id
                        LIMIT 5
                        """)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        assertThat(players)
                .isNotEmpty();

        for (Map<String, Object> player : players) {
            Long playerId =
                    ((Number) player.get("player_id"))
                            .longValue();

            Long seasonId =
                    ((Number) player.get("season_id"))
                            .longValue();

            String fantasyRole =
                    player.get("fantasy_role")
                            .toString();

            Object tacticalRole =
                    player.get("tactical_role");

            jdbcClient.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO player_roles (
                        player_id,
                        season_id,
                        source,
                        fantasy_role,
                        tactical_role,
                        primary_role,
                        valid_from
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        :playerId,
                        :seasonId,
                        'FANTACALCIO',
                        :fantasyRole,
                        :tacticalRole,
                        TRUE,
                        DATE '2026-07-01'
                    )
                    ON CONFLICT (
                        player_id,
                        season_id,
                        source
                    )
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        fantasy_role =
                            EXCLUDED.fantasy_role,

                        tactical_role =
                            EXCLUDED.tactical_role,

                        primary_role = TRUE,

                        valid_from =
                            EXCLUDED.valid_from
                    """)
                    .param("playerId", playerId)
                    .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                    .param("fantasyRole", fantasyRole)
                    .param("tacticalRole", tacticalRole)
                    .update();
        }

        return players.stream()
                .map(player ->
                        ((Number) player.get("player_id"))
                                .longValue()
                )
                .toList();
    }
    private String findExistingRole() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoBean;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.*;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction.LiveAuctionDecisionRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction.LiveAuctionDecisionResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction.LiveAuctionDecisionService;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class AuctionContextAdapterIntegrationTest {
    @Autowired AuctionStateService state;
    @Autowired AuctionPurchaseService purchases;
    @Autowired AuctionContextAdapter adapter;
    @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc;
    @MockitoBean LiveAuctionDecisionService b58;
    Long sandboxSquad;
    @BeforeEach void fixture(){B59TestFixture.addFantacalcioRoles(jdbc);sandboxSquad=B59TestFixture.createSquad(jdbc);}

    @Test
    void buildsCertifiedB58ContextWithExactRosterUnavailableAndCurrentPrice(){
        var session=state.activate(state.create(new CreateSessionRequest(squadId())).id());
        Long other=available(session.id());
        purchases.purchase(session.id(),new PurchaseRequest(other,AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,null,"other"));
        Long current=available(session.id());
        state.nominate(session.id(),new NominationRequest(current,7));
        when(b58.decide(any())).thenReturn(org.mockito.Mockito.mock(LiveAuctionDecisionResponse.class));

        adapter.decide(session.id(),new SessionDecisionRequest(9,null,null,10));

        ArgumentCaptor<LiveAuctionDecisionRequest> captor=ArgumentCaptor.forClass(LiveAuctionDecisionRequest.class);
        verify(b58).decide(captor.capture());
        var context=captor.getValue();
        assertThat(context.currentPlayerId()).isEqualTo(current);
        assertThat(context.currentPrice()).isEqualTo(7);
        assertThat(context.proposedBid()).isEqualTo(9);
        assertThat(context.availabilityComplete()).isTrue();
        assertThat(context.unavailablePlayerIds()).containsExactly(other);
        int spent=context.playersAlreadyBought().stream().mapToInt(p->p.pricePaid()).sum();
        assertThat(context.remainingBudget()).isEqualTo(context.totalBudget()-spent);
    }
    private Long squadId(){return sandboxSquad;}
    private Long available(Long session){return jdbc.sql("SELECT player_id FROM auction_player_states WHERE session_id=:s AND availability='AVAILABLE' ORDER BY player_id LIMIT 1").param("s",session).query(Long.class).single();}
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.Future;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.CreateSessionRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.PurchaseRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.PurchaseResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@SpringBootTest
class AuctionIdempotencyConcurrencyIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired
    AuctionStateService state;

    @Autowired
    AuctionPurchaseService purchases;

    @Autowired
    JdbcClient jdbc;

    Long sessionId;
    Long playerId;
    Long squadId;

    List<Long> fixtureRolePlayers = List.of();

    @BeforeEach
    void setup() {

        cleanup();

        fixtureRolePlayers =
                B59TestFixture.addFantacalcioRoles(jdbc);

        squadId =
                B59TestFixture.createSquad(jdbc);

        sessionId =
                state.activate(
                        state.create(
                                new CreateSessionRequest(squadId),
                                "idempotency-owner"
                        ).id()
                ).id();

        playerId =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT player_id
                        FROM auction_player_states
                        WHERE session_id = :session
                          AND availability = 'AVAILABLE'
                        ORDER BY player_id
                        LIMIT 1
                        """)
                        .param("session", sessionId)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();
    }

    @AfterEach
    void tearDown() {

        cleanup();

        if (squadId != null) {
            jdbc.sql("""
                    DELETE FROM fantasy_squads
                    WHERE id = :id
                    """)
                    .param("id", squadId)
                    .update();
        }

        if (!fixtureRolePlayers.isEmpty()) {
            jdbc.sql("""
                    DELETE FROM player_roles
                    WHERE source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                      AND player_id IN (:ids)
                    """)
                    .param("ids", fixtureRolePlayers)
                    .update();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentSameIdempotencySamePayloadProducesSinglePurchase() throws Exception {

        PurchaseRequest request =
                new PurchaseRequest(
                        playerId,
                        AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,
                        null,
                        "same-key"
                );

        var ready = new CountDownLatch(2);
        var start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        var executor =
                Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);

        List<Future<Object>> futures =
                new ArrayList<>();

        futures.add(
                executor.submit(
                        () -> run(
                                ready,
                                start,
                                request
                        )
                )
        );

        futures.add(
                executor.submit(
                        () -> run(
                                ready,
                                start,
                                request
                        )
                )
        );

        ready.await();
        start.countDown();

        int success = 0;
        int conflict = 0;

        for (Future<Object> future : futures) {

            Object result =
                    future.get();

            if (result instanceof PurchaseResponse) {
                success++;
            }

            if (result instanceof ConflictException) {
                conflict++;
            }
        }

        executor.shutdown();

        assertThat(success + conflict)
                .isEqualTo(2);

        assertThat(success)
                .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_purchases
                        WHERE session_id = :session
                          AND idempotency_key = 'same-key'
                        """)
                        .param("session", sessionId)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single()
        )
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_purchases
                        WHERE session_id = :session
                          AND player_id = :player
                        """)
                        .param("session", sessionId)
                        .param("player", playerId)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single()
        )
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentSameIdempotencyDifferentPayloadAllowsOnlyOneStoredPayload() throws Exception {

        PurchaseRequest first =
                new PurchaseRequest(
                        playerId,
                        AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,
                        null,
                        "shared-key"
                );

        PurchaseRequest second =
                new PurchaseRequest(
                        playerId,
                        AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,
                        2,
                        "shared-key"
                );

        var ready = new CountDownLatch(2);
        var start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        var executor =
                Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);

        List<Future<Object>> futures =
                List.of(
                        executor.submit(
                                () -> run(
                                        ready,
                                        start,
                                        first
                                )
                        ),
                        executor.submit(
                                () -> run(
                                        ready,
                                        start,
                                        second
                                )
                        )
                );

        ready.await();
        start.countDown();

        int success = 0;
        int conflict = 0;

        for (Future<Object> future : futures) {

            Object result =
                    future.get();

            if (result instanceof PurchaseResponse) {
                success++;
            }

            if (result instanceof ConflictException) {
                conflict++;
            }
        }

        executor.shutdown();

        assertThat(success)
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(conflict)
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_purchases
                        WHERE session_id = :session
                          AND idempotency_key = 'shared-key'
                        """)
                        .param("session", sessionId)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single()
        )
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    private Object run(
            CountDownLatch ready,
            CountDownLatch start,
            PurchaseRequest request
    ) {

        try {

            ready.countDown();
            start.await();

            return purchases.purchase(
                    sessionId,
                    request
            );

        } catch (ConflictException exception) {

            return exception;

        } catch (Exception exception) {

            return exception;
        }
    }

    private void cleanup() {

        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM auction_events")
                .update();

        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM auction_purchases")
                .update();

        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM auction_player_states")
                .update();

        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM auction_sessions")
                .update();
    }
}

    Long squadTwo;
    Long squadThree;

        squadTwo = B59TestFixture.createSquad(jdbc);
        squadThree = B59TestFixture.createSquad(jdbc);
    }

    @Test
    void differentOwnersCanHaveActiveSessionsAtSameTime() {

        var first =
                state.create(
                        new CreateSessionRequest(squadOne),
                        "owner-a"
                );

        var second =
                state.create(
                        new CreateSessionRequest(squadTwo),
                        "owner-b"
                );

        var firstActive = state.activate(first.id());
        var secondActive = state.activate(second.id());

        assertThat(firstActive.status())
                .isEqualTo(AuctionSessionStatus.ACTIVE);

        assertThat(secondActive.status())
                .isEqualTo(AuctionSessionStatus.ACTIVE);

        int activeCount =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM auction_sessions
                        WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
                          AND owner_username IN ('owner-a', 'owner-b')
                        """)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(activeCount)
                .isEqualTo(2);
    }

    @Test
    void sameOwnerCannotHaveTwoActiveSessions() {

        var first =
                state.create(
                        new CreateSessionRequest(squadOne),
                        "owner-a"
                );

        var second =
                state.create(
                        new CreateSessionRequest(squadTwo),
                        "owner-a"
                );

        state.activate(first.id());

        assertThatThrownBy(
                () -> state.activate(second.id())
        )
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "sessione ACTIVE"
                );

        /*
         * Non eseguire altre query qui:
         * PostgreSQL invalida la transazione corrente dopo
         * la violazione del unique constraint.
         *
         * Il vincolo DB Ã¨ precisamente ciÃ² che questo test
         * vuole certificare.
         */
    }

    @Test
    void sameSquadCannotHaveTwoActiveSessionsEvenWithDifferentOwners() {

        var first =
                state.create(
                        new CreateSessionRequest(squadThree),
                        "owner-a"
                );

        var second =
                state.create(
                        new CreateSessionRequest(squadThree),
                        "owner-b"
                );

        state.activate(first.id());

        assertThatThrownBy(
                () -> state.activate(second.id())
        )
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "sessione ACTIVE"
                );

        /*
         * Anche qui nessuna query successiva al constraint
         * violation nella stessa transazione PostgreSQL.
         */
    }
}
