package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.CreateSessionRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auctionstate.AuctionStateDtos.PurchaseRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class AuctionStateLifecycleIntegrationTest {
    @Autowired AuctionStateService state;
    @Autowired AuctionPurchaseService purchases;
    @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc;
    Long sandboxSquad;

    @BeforeEach void fixture(){B59TestFixture.addFantacalcioRoles(jdbc);sandboxSquad=B59TestFixture.createSquad(jdbc);}

    @Test
    void createsInitializesOnlyEligiblePlayersAndCompletesWithoutHistoryLoss(){
        var created=state.create(new CreateSessionRequest(squadId()));
        assertThat(created.status()).isEqualTo(AuctionSessionStatus.DRAFT);
        assertThat(created.season()).isEqualTo("2026/2027");
        assertThatThrownBy(()->purchases.purchase(created.id(),new PurchaseRequest(
                eligibleNotOwned(),AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,null,"draft-key")))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);

        var active=state.activate(created.id());
        var snapshot=state.state(created.id());
        assertThat(active.status()).isEqualTo(AuctionSessionStatus.ACTIVE);
        assertThat(snapshot.availabilityComplete()).isTrue();
        assertThat(snapshot.players()).isNotEmpty().allSatisfy(player->
                assertThat(isEligible(player.playerId(),active.season())).isTrue());
        assertThat(snapshot.players()).extracting(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::playerId)
                .doesNotHaveDuplicates();

        var completed=state.complete(created.id());
        assertThat(completed.status()).isEqualTo(AuctionSessionStatus.COMPLETED);
        assertThat(state.state(created.id()).players()).hasSameSizeAs(snapshot.players());
        assertThatThrownBy(()->purchases.purchase(created.id(),new PurchaseRequest(
                eligibleNotOwned(),AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,null,"completed-key")))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void initializationExcludesActiveRegistrationAtNonMemberClub(){
        Long excluded=eligibleNotOwned();
        jdbc.sql("""
                DELETE FROM season_clubs membership
                USING seasons season, player_registrations registration
                WHERE season.code='2026/2027' AND membership.season_id=season.id
                  AND registration.player_id=:player AND registration.season_id=season.id
                  AND membership.club_id=registration.club_id
                """).param("player",excluded).update();

        var session=activated();

        assertThat(state.state(session.id()).players())
                .extracting(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::playerId)
                .doesNotContain(excluded);
    }

    @Test
    void otherPurchaseIsIdempotentAndNeverChangesUserBudgetOrRoster(){
        var session=activated();
        Long player=availablePlayer(session.id(),null);
        var before=state.state(session.id());
        var request=new PurchaseRequest(player,AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,null,"other-idempotent");
        var first=purchases.purchase(session.id(),request);
        var retry=purchases.purchase(session.id(),request);
        var after=state.state(session.id());
        assertThat(retry).isEqualTo(first);
        assertThat(after.remainingBudget()).isEqualTo(before.remainingBudget());
        assertThat(after.spentBudget()).isEqualTo(before.spentBudget());
        assertThat(after.purchases()).hasSize(1);
        assertThat(after.players()).filteredOn(p->p.playerId().equals(player)).singleElement()
                .extracting(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::availability)
                .isEqualTo(AuctionPlayerAvailability.ACQUIRED_BY_OTHER);
        assertThatThrownBy(()->purchases.purchase(session.id(),new PurchaseRequest(
                player,AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,2,"other-idempotent")))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class).hasMessageContaining("payload diverso");
    }

    @Test
    void userPurchaseUpdatesAuthoritativeRosterExactlyOnceAndPreservesReserve(){
        var session=activated();
        Long player=availablePlayer(session.id(),"role-open");
        int before=state.state(session.id()).remainingBudget();
        var request=new PurchaseRequest(player,AuctionBuyerType.USER,1,"user-idempotent");
        var first=purchases.purchase(session.id(),request);
        var retry=purchases.purchase(session.id(),request);
        var after=state.state(session.id());
        assertThat(retry.id()).isEqualTo(first.id());
        assertThat(after.remainingBudget()).isEqualTo(before-1);
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fantasy_squad_players WHERE squad_id=:s AND player_id=:p")
                .param("s",session.squadId()).param("p",player).query(Integer.class).single()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(after.purchases()).hasSize(1);
        assertThat(after.players()).filteredOn(p->p.playerId().equals(player)).singleElement()
                .extracting(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::availability)
                .isEqualTo(AuctionPlayerAvailability.ACQUIRED_BY_USER);
    }

    @Test
    void duplicatePlayerPurchaseConflictsAndDoesNotPartiallyMutate(){
        var session=activated(); Long player=availablePlayer(session.id(),null);
        purchases.purchase(session.id(),new PurchaseRequest(player,AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,3,"winner"));
        assertThatThrownBy(()->purchases.purchase(session.id(),new PurchaseRequest(
                player,AuctionBuyerType.USER,1,"loser"))).isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
        assertThat(state.state(session.id()).purchases()).hasSize(1);
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fantasy_squad_players WHERE squad_id=:s AND player_id=:p")
                .param("s",session.squadId()).param("p",player).query(Integer.class).single()).isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void unsafeUserPurchaseRollsBackPurchaseRosterAndAvailability(){
        var session=activated();Long player=availablePlayer(session.id(),"role-open");
        assertThatThrownBy(()->purchases.purchase(session.id(),new PurchaseRequest(
                player,AuctionBuyerType.USER,session.totalBudget()+1,"unsafe")))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
        assertThat(state.state(session.id()).purchases()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fantasy_squad_players WHERE squad_id=:s AND player_id=:p")
                .param("s",session.squadId()).param("p",player).query(Integer.class).single()).isZero();
        assertThat(state.state(session.id()).players()).filteredOn(p->p.playerId().equals(player)).singleElement()
                .extracting(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::availability)
                .isEqualTo(AuctionPlayerAvailability.AVAILABLE);
    }

    @Test
    void purchaseRecheckRejectsPlayerWhoseClubLeavesSeasonAfterInitialization(){
        var session=activated();Long player=availablePlayer(session.id(),null);
        jdbc.sql("""
                DELETE FROM season_clubs membership
                USING auction_sessions auction, player_registrations registration
                WHERE auction.id=:session AND membership.season_id=auction.season_id
                  AND registration.player_id=:player AND registration.season_id=auction.season_id
                  AND membership.club_id=registration.club_id
                """).param("session",session.id()).param("player",player).update();

        assertThatThrownBy(()->purchases.purchase(session.id(),new PurchaseRequest(
                player,AuctionBuyerType.OTHER,null,"membership-removed")))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
        assertThat(state.state(session.id()).purchases()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(state.state(session.id()).players()).filteredOn(p->p.playerId().equals(player)).singleElement()
                .extracting(AuctionStateDtos.PlayerStateResponse::availability)
                .isEqualTo(AuctionPlayerAvailability.AVAILABLE);
    }

    private AuctionStateDtos.SessionResponse activated(){var created=state.create(new CreateSessionRequest(squadId()));return state.activate(created.id());}
    private Long squadId(){return sandboxSquad;}
    private Long eligibleNotOwned(){return jdbc.sql("""
            SELECT p.id FROM players p JOIN player_registrations r ON r.player_id=p.id
            JOIN seasons s ON s.id=r.season_id AND s.code='2026/2027'
            JOIN season_clubs sc ON sc.season_id=s.id AND sc.club_id=r.club_id
            JOIN player_roles pr ON pr.player_id=p.id AND pr.season_id=s.id AND pr.source='FANTACALCIO'
            WHERE p.active=TRUE AND r.registration_status='ACTIVE'
            ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 1
            """).query(Long.class).single();}
    private Long availablePlayer(Long session,String mode){return jdbc.sql("""
            SELECT state.player_id FROM auction_player_states state
            JOIN auction_sessions auction ON auction.id=state.session_id
            JOIN fantasy_squads squad ON squad.id=auction.squad_id
            JOIN league_configurations league ON league.id=squad.league_configuration_id
            WHERE state.session_id=:session AND state.availability='AVAILABLE'
              AND (:open=FALSE OR
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fantasy_squad_players f WHERE f.squad_id=squad.id
                 AND f.fantasy_role=state.fantasy_role) < CASE state.fantasy_role
                 WHEN 'P' THEN league.goalkeepers_count WHEN 'D' THEN league.defenders_count
                 WHEN 'C' THEN league.midfielders_count ELSE league.forwards_count END)
            ORDER BY state.player_id LIMIT 1
            """).param("session",session).param("open",mode!=null).query(Long.class).single();}
    private boolean isEligible(Long player,String season){return jdbc.sql("""
            SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM players p JOIN player_registrations r ON r.player_id=p.id
            JOIN seasons s ON s.id=r.season_id
            JOIN season_clubs sc ON sc.season_id=s.id AND sc.club_id=r.club_id
            JOIN player_roles pr ON pr.player_id=p.id AND pr.season_id=s.id AND pr.source='FANTACALCIO'
            WHERE p.id=:p AND s.code=:s AND p.active=TRUE
              AND r.registration_status='ACTIVE' AND pr.fantasy_role IN ('P','D','C','A'))
            """).param("p",player).param("s",season).query(Boolean.class).single();}
}

    @Test
    void shouldBuildCompleteAuctionStrategy() {
        prepareEligiblePlayers();

        AuctionStrategyResponse response =
                service.buildStrategy(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1000,
                        8,
                        true
                );

        assertThat(response.season())
                .isEqualTo("2026/2027");

        assertThat(response.totalBudget())
                .isEqualTo(1000);

        assertThat(response.teams())
                .isEqualTo(8);

        assertThat(response.defenseModifier())
                .isTrue();

        assertThat(response.totalRequiredPlayers())
                .isEqualTo(25);

        assertThat(response.roles())
                .hasSize(4);

        assertThat(response.roles())
                .extracting(
                        AuctionRoleStrategyResponse::role
                )
                .containsExactly(
                        "P",
                        "D",
                        "C",
                        "A"
                );

        assertThat(response.roles())
                .extracting(
                        AuctionRoleStrategyResponse
                                ::requiredSlots
                )
                .containsExactly(
                        3,
                        8,
                        8,
                        6
                );

        assertThat(response.strategySummary())
                .contains("spesa prevista")
                .contains("residuo previsto");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldUseModifierBudgetAllocation() {
        prepareEligiblePlayers();

        AuctionStrategyResponse response =
                service.buildStrategy(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1000,
                        8,
                        true
                );

        assertThat(findRole(response, "P")
                .budgetPercentage())
                .isEqualByComparingTo(
                        new BigDecimal("8.0")
                );

        assertThat(findRole(response, "D")
                .budgetPercentage())
                .isEqualByComparingTo(
                        new BigDecimal("22.0")
                );

        assertThat(findRole(response, "C")
                .budgetPercentage())
                .isEqualByComparingTo(
                        new BigDecimal("27.0")
                );

        assertThat(findRole(response, "A")
                .budgetPercentage())
                .isEqualByComparingTo(
                        new BigDecimal("43.0")
                );

        assertThat(findRole(response, "D")
                .allocatedBudget())
                .isEqualTo(220);
    }

    void shouldKeepPlannedSpendingInsideRoleBudget() {

                        "2026/2027",
                        1000,
                        8,
                        true
                );

        assertThat(response.roles())
                .allSatisfy(role -> {

                    )
                            .isEqualTo(
                                    role.allocatedBudget()
                                            - role.plannedSpending()
                            );
                });
    }

    @Test
    void shouldKeepTotalStrategyInsideBudget() {
        prepareEligiblePlayers();

        AuctionStrategyResponse response =
                service.buildStrategy(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1000,
                        8,
                        true
                );

        assertThat(response.totalPlannedSpending())
                .isLessThanOrEqualTo(
                        response.totalBudget()
                );

        assertThat(response.expectedRemainingBudget())
                .isEqualTo(
                        response.totalBudget()
                                - response.totalPlannedSpending()
                );

        assertThat(response.withinBudget())
                .isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldExcludeUnavailablePlayersFromTargets() {
        List<Long> playerIds =
                prepareEligiblePlayers();

        Long playerId =
                playerIds.getFirst();

        insertUnavailableStatus(playerId);

        AuctionStrategyResponse response =
                service.buildStrategy(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1000,
                        8,
                        true
                );

        assertThat(allSelectedPlayers(response))
                .noneSatisfy(player ->
                        assertThat(player.playerId())
                                .isEqualTo(playerId)
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldCreateRoleWarningsWhenFewPlayersAreAvailable() {
        prepareEligiblePlayers();

        AuctionStrategyResponse response =
                service.buildStrategy(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1000,
                        8,
                        true
                );

        assertThat(response.roles())
                .allSatisfy(role ->
                        assertThat(role.warnings())
                                .isNotNull()
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectBlankSeason() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.buildStrategy(
                        " ",
                        1000,
                        8,

                )
        )

                )

    private List<Long> prepareEligiblePlayers() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> players =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            player.id AS player_id,
                            season.id AS season_id,
                            role.fantasy_role,
                            role.tactical_role

                        FROM players player

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                            AND registration.registration_status =
                                'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = registration.season_id

                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                            AND role.season_id = season.id

                        WHERE player.active = TRUE
                          AND season.code = '2026/2027'

                        ORDER BY player.id
                        LIMIT 12
                        """)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        assertThat(players)
                .isNotEmpty();

        for (Map<String, Object> player : players) {
            Long playerId =
                    ((Number) player.get("player_id"))
                            .longValue();

            Long seasonId =
                    ((Number) player.get("season_id"))
                            .longValue();

            String fantasyRole =
                    player.get("fantasy_role")
                            .toString();

            Object tacticalRole =
                    player.get("tactical_role");

            jdbcClient.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO player_roles (
                        player_id,
                        season_id,
                        source,
                        fantasy_role,
                        tactical_role,
                        primary_role,
                        valid_from
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        :playerId,
                        :seasonId,
                        'FANTACALCIO',
                        :fantasyRole,
                        :tacticalRole,
                        TRUE,
                        DATE '2026-07-01'
                    )
                    ON CONFLICT (
                        player_id,
                        season_id,
                        source
                    )
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        fantasy_role =
                            EXCLUDED.fantasy_role,

                        tactical_role =
                            EXCLUDED.tactical_role,

                        primary_role = TRUE,

                        valid_from =
                            EXCLUDED.valid_from
                    """)
                    .param("playerId", playerId)
                    .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                    .param("fantasyRole", fantasyRole)
                    .param("tacticalRole", tacticalRole)
                    .update();
        }

        return players.stream()
                .map(player ->
                        ((Number) player.get("player_id"))
                                .longValue()
                )
                .toList();
    }

    private void insertUnavailableStatus(
            Long playerId
    ) {
        Long seasonId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM seasons
                        WHERE code = '2026/2027'
                        """)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_availabilities (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    matchday,
                    status,
                    starting_probability,
                    availability_probability,
                    injury_description,
                    source
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    15,
                    'INJURED',
                    0,
                    0,
                    'Problema muscolare',
                    'MANUAL'
                )
                ON CONFLICT (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    matchday
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    status = 'INJURED',
                    starting_probability = 0,
                    availability_probability = 0,
                    injury_description =
                        'Problema muscolare',
                    source = 'MANUAL',
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();
    }

    private AuctionRoleStrategyResponse findRole(
            AuctionStrategyResponse response,
            String role
    ) {
        return response.roles()
                .stream()
                .filter(item ->
                        role.equals(item.role())
                )
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow();
    }

    private List<AuctionStrategyPlayerResponse>
    allSelectedPlayers(
            AuctionStrategyResponse response
    ) {
        return response.roles()
                .stream()
                .flatMap(role ->
                        java.util.stream.Stream.of(
                                role.primaryTargets(),
                                role.valueAlternatives(),
                                role.highPotentialBets(),
                                role.playersToAvoid()
                        )
                )
                .flatMap(List::stream)
                .toList();
    }
}

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

class PlayerAvailabilityServiceTest {

    @Autowired
    private PlayerAvailabilityService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldUpdateAvailabilityAndCreateHistory() {
        Long playerId = findActivePlayerId();

        PlayerAvailabilityResponse response =
                service.update(
                        playerId,
                        new UpdatePlayerAvailabilityRequest(
                                "2026/2027",
                                2,
                                "injured",
                                0,
                                0,
                                "Problema muscolare",
                                LocalDate.of(2026, 8, 20),
                                "manual"
                        )
                );

        assertThat(response.playerId())
                .isEqualTo(playerId);

        assertThat(response.status())
                .isEqualTo("INJURED");

        assertThat(response.startingProbability())
                .isZero();

        assertThat(response.availabilityProbability())
                .isZero();

        assertThat(response.injuryDescription())
                .isEqualTo("Problema muscolare");

        assertThat(response.updatedAt())
                .isNotNull();

        List<PlayerAvailabilityHistoryResponse> history =
                service.findHistory(
                        playerId,
                        "2026/2027",
                        2
                );

        assertThat(history)
                .hasSize(1);

        assertThat(history.getFirst().status())
                .isEqualTo("INJURED");

        assertThat(history.getFirst().source())
                .isEqualTo("MANUAL");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldCreateMultipleHistoryEntriesForSameAvailability() {
        Long playerId = findActivePlayerId();

        service.update(
                playerId,
                new UpdatePlayerAvailabilityRequest(
                        "2026/2027",
                        3,
                        "DOUBTFUL",
                        40,
                        60,
                        null,
                        null,
                        "FANTACALCIO"
                )
        );

        service.update(
                playerId,
                new UpdatePlayerAvailabilityRequest(
                        "2026/2027",
                        3,
                        "AVAILABLE",
                        85,
                        100,
                        null,
                        null,
                        "GAZZETTA"
                )
        );

        List<PlayerAvailabilityHistoryResponse> history =
                service.findHistory(
                        playerId,
                        "2026/2027",
                        3
                );

        assertThat(history)
                .hasSize(2);

        assertThat(history)
                .extracting(
                        PlayerAvailabilityHistoryResponse::status
                )
                .containsExactly(
                        "AVAILABLE",
                        "DOUBTFUL"
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectInjuredPlayerWithoutDescription() {
        Long playerId = findActivePlayerId();

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.update(
                        playerId,

                );
    }

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT player.id
                FROM players player
                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = registration.season_id
                WHERE player.active = TRUE
                  AND season.code = '2026/2027'
                ORDER BY player.id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void upsertStrength(
            Long seasonId,
            Long clubId,
            int overall,
            int attack,
            int defense,
            int home,
            int away
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO club_strength_ratings (
                    club_id,
                    season_id,
                    overall_rating,
                    attacking_rating,
                    defensive_rating,
                    home_rating,
                    away_rating
                )
                VALUES (
                    :clubId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :overall,
                    :attack,
                    :defense,
                    :home,
                    :away
                )

                ON CONFLICT (
                    club_id,
                    season_id
                )

                DO UPDATE SET
                    overall_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.overall_rating,

                    attacking_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.attacking_rating,

                    defensive_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.defensive_rating,

                    home_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.home_rating,

                    away_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.away_rating
                """)
                .param(
                        "clubId",
                        clubId
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "overall",
                        overall
                )
                .param(
                        "attack",
                        attack
                )
                .param(
                        "defense",
                        defense
                )
                .param(
                        "home",
                        home
                )
                .param(
                        "away",
                        away
                )
                .update();
    }

    private record FixtureIdentity(
            int matchday,
            Long homeClubId,
            Long awayClubId
    ) {

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

@SpringBootTest
class CalendarCandidateServiceIntegrationTest {
    private static final String PREFIX="B57 Calendar Candidate ";
    @Autowired CalendarCandidateService service;
    @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc;
    private Long activePlayer,inactivePlayer,clubId,season2025,season2026;

    @BeforeEach void setUp(){clean();clubId=jdbc.sql("SELECT id FROM clubs WHERE active=TRUE ORDER BY id LIMIT 1").query(Long.class).single();
        season2025=season("2025/2026");season2026=season("2026/2027");activePlayer=player("Active");inactivePlayer=player("Inactive");
        membership(season2025);membership(season2026);
        registration(activePlayer,season2026,"ACTIVE");registration(inactivePlayer,season2026,"INACTIVE");registration(inactivePlayer,season2025,"ACTIVE");
        role(activePlayer,season2026);role(inactivePlayer,season2026);role(inactivePlayer,season2025);}
    @AfterEach void tearDown(){clean();}
    @Test void currentUseCaseIncludesOnlyActiveRegistration(){
        var candidates=service.loadActive("2026/2027","P");
        assertThat(candidates).extracting(CalendarCandidateService.CalendarPlayerCandidate::playerId).contains(activePlayer).doesNotContain(inactivePlayer);
    }
    @Test void seasonsAreIsolatedAndHistoricalRegistrationIsPreserved(){
        assertThat(service.loadActive("2025/2026","P")).extracting(CalendarCandidateService.CalendarPlayerCandidate::playerId).contains(inactivePlayer);
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("SELECT registration_status FROM player_registrations WHERE player_id=:p AND season_id=:s").param("p",inactivePlayer).param("s",season2026).query(String.class).single()).isEqualTo("INACTIVE");
    }
    @Test void invalidFantasyRoleIsRejectedWithoutChangingRoles(){
        assertThat(org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.catchThrowable(()->service.loadActive("2026/2027","X"))).isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class);
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("SELECT fantasy_role FROM player_roles WHERE player_id=:p AND season_id=:s AND source='FANTACALCIO'").param("p",activePlayer).param("s",season2026).query(String.class).single()).isEqualTo("P");
    }
    @Test void playerAtClubOutsideRequestedSeasonIsExcluded(){
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM season_clubs WHERE season_id=:s AND club_id=:c")
                .param("s",season2026).param("c",clubId).update();
        assertThat(service.loadActive("2026/2027","P"))
                .extracting(CalendarCandidateService.CalendarPlayerCandidate::playerId)
                .doesNotContain(activePlayer);
        assertThat(service.loadActive("2025/2026","P"))
                .extracting(CalendarCandidateService.CalendarPlayerCandidate::playerId)
                .contains(inactivePlayer);
    }
    private Long player(String suffix){return jdbc.sql("INSERT INTO players(last_name,display_name,normalized_name,active) VALUES(:n,:n,:norm,TRUE) RETURNING id").param("n",PREFIX+suffix).param("norm",(PREFIX+suffix).toLowerCase()).query(Long.class).single();}
    private void registration(Long p,Long s,String status){jdbc.sql("INSERT INTO player_registrations(player_id,club_id,season_id,registration_status) VALUES(:p,:c,:s,:st)").param("p",p).param("c",clubId).param("s",s).param("st",status).update();}
    private void role(Long p,Long s){jdbc.sql("INSERT INTO player_roles(player_id,season_id,source,fantasy_role) VALUES(:p,:s,'FANTACALCIO','P')").param("p",p).param("s",s).update();}
    private void membership(Long s){jdbc.sql("INSERT INTO season_clubs(season_id,club_id) VALUES(:s,:c) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING").param("s",s).param("c",clubId).update();}
    private Long season(String code){return jdbc.sql("SELECT id FROM seasons WHERE code=:c").param("c",code).query(Long.class).single();}
    private void clean(){jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM player_roles WHERE player_id IN(SELECT id FROM players WHERE display_name LIKE :p)").param("p",PREFIX+"%").update();jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM player_registrations WHERE player_id IN(SELECT id FROM players WHERE display_name LIKE :p)").param("p",PREFIX+"%").update();jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM players WHERE display_name LIKE :p").param("p",PREFIX+"%").update();}
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class CalendarCombinationScorerTest {
    private final CalendarCombinationScorer scorer = new CalendarCombinationScorer();

    @Test void realDifficultyScaleIsNormalized() {
        assertThat(CalendarDifficulty.fromScore(new BigDecimal("49.99"))).isEqualTo(CalendarDifficulty.EASY);
        assertThat(CalendarDifficulty.fromScore(new BigDecimal("50"))).isEqualTo(CalendarDifficulty.MEDIUM);
        assertThat(CalendarDifficulty.fromScore(new BigDecimal("70"))).isEqualTo(CalendarDifficulty.HARD);
    }
    @Test void unknownStaysUnknown() { assertThat(CalendarDifficulty.fromScore(null)).isEqualTo(CalendarDifficulty.UNKNOWN); }
    @Test void hardEasyCreatesPositiveComplementarity() {
        var result=scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,H,E,E),profile(2,E,H,M)),1,3);
        assertThat(result.complementaryMatchdays()).isEqualTo(2); assertThat(result.favorableCoverageCount()).isEqualTo(3);
    }
    @Test void simultaneousHardIsPenalized() {
        var overlap=scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,H,H,E),profile(2,H,H,E)),1,3);
        var alternating=scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,H,E,E),profile(2,E,H,E)),1,3);
        assertThat(overlap.hardOverlapCount()).isEqualTo(2); assertThat(overlap.calendarCombinationScore()).isLessThan(alternating.calendarCombinationScore());
    }
    @Test void complementaryPairBeatsSameDifficultPattern() {
        assertThat(scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,H,E,H),profile(2,E,H,E)),1,3).calendarCombinationScore())
                .isGreaterThan(scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,H,E,H),profile(2,H,E,H)),1,3).calendarCombinationScore());
    }
    @Test void pairOrderDoesNotMatter() {
        var a=profile(1,H,E,M);var b=profile(2,E,H,E);
        assertThat(scorer.evaluate(List.of(a,b),1,3)).isEqualTo(scorer.evaluate(List.of(b,a),1,3));
    }
    @Test void repeatedCalculationIsDeterministic() {
        var input=List.of(profile(1,H,E,M),profile(2,E,H,E)); assertThat(scorer.evaluate(input,1,3)).isEqualTo(scorer.evaluate(input,1,3));
    }
    @Test void tripleIsPermutationInvariant() {
        var a=profile(1,H,E,M);var b=profile(2,E,H,E);var c=profile(3,M,M,E);
        assertThat(scorer.evaluate(List.of(a,b,c),1,3)).isEqualTo(scorer.evaluate(List.of(c,a,b),1,3));
    }
    @Test void tripleCoverageBeatsAllHardOverlap() {
        var covered=scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,E,H,H),profile(2,H,E,H),profile(3,H,H,E)),1,3);
        var hard=scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,H,H,H),profile(2,H,H,H),profile(3,H,H,H)),1,3);
        assertThat(covered.calendarCombinationScore()).isGreaterThan(hard.calendarCombinationScore());
    }
    @Test void duplicateClubCannotCreatePairOrTriple() {
        assertThatThrownBy(()->scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,E,E),profile(1,H,H)),1,2)).isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class);
    }
    @Test void goalkeeperPreferredOptionRequiresUniqueEasyAgainstHard() {
        var result=scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,E,M),profile(2,H,H)),1,2);
        assertThat(result.preferredClubByMatchday()).containsEntry(1,1L).doesNotContainKey(2);
    }
    @Test void unknownNeverCreatesPreferredOption() {
        var result=scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,U,E),profile(2,H,H)),1,2);
        assertThat(result.preferredClubByMatchday()).doesNotContainKey(1);
    }
    @Test void postponedIsSurfacedAsMissing() {
        var a=profile(1,E,E); var mutable=new LinkedHashMap<>(a.matchdays()); mutable.put(1,fixture(1,1,E,"POSTPONED"));
        var result=scorer.evaluate(List.of(new ClubFixtureProfile(1L,"C1",mutable),profile(2,H,H)),1,2);
        assertThat(result.missingMatchdays()).contains(1); assertThat(result.status()).isEqualTo(CalendarCombinationStatus.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE);
    }
    @Test void insufficientWindowHasNullScore() {
        var result=scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,U,E,U),profile(2,H,E,U)),1,3);
        assertThat(result.calendarCombinationScore()).isNull();
    }
    @Test void horizonIsValidatedAndCappedAtTen() {
        assertThatThrownBy(()->scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,E,E),profile(2,H,H)),1,11)).isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class);
    }
    @Test void missingFixtureDoesNotBecomeMedium() {
        var a=new ClubFixtureProfile(1L,"C1",Map.of(1,fixture(1,1,E,"SCHEDULED")));
        var result=scorer.evaluate(List.of(a,profile(2,H,H)),1,2); assertThat(result.missingMatchdays()).contains(2);
    }
    @Test void sameClubCalendarIsReusedByPlayerLayerNotRecomputed() {
        var profile=profile(1,E,H,E); assertThat(profile.matchdays()).hasSize(3);
    }
    @Test void alternatingAttackWindowsAvoidHardStreak() {
        var alternating=scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,H,E,H,E),profile(2,E,H,E,H)),1,4);
        var streak=scorer.evaluate(List.of(profile(1,H,H,E,E),profile(2,H,H,E,E)),1,4);
        assertThat(alternating.calendarCombinationScore()).isGreaterThan(streak.calendarCombinationScore());
    }

    private static final CalendarDifficulty E=CalendarDifficulty.EASY,M=CalendarDifficulty.MEDIUM,H=CalendarDifficulty.HARD,U=CalendarDifficulty.UNKNOWN;
    private ClubFixtureProfile profile(long id,CalendarDifficulty... values){Map<Integer,ClubFixtureDay> days=new LinkedHashMap<>();for(int i=0;i<values.length;i++)days.put(i+1,fixture(id,i+1,values[i],"SCHEDULED"));return new ClubFixtureProfile(id,"C"+id,Map.copyOf(days));}
    private ClubFixtureDay fixture(long id,int day,CalendarDifficulty value,String status){BigDecimal score=switch(value){case EASY->BigDecimal.valueOf(35);case MEDIUM->BigDecimal.valueOf(60);case HARD->BigDecimal.valueOf(80);case UNKNOWN->null;};return new ClubFixtureDay(id,day,(long)(id*100+day),true,status,null,score,value);}
}

class CalendarCombinationServiceTest {

        var result=new CalendarCombinationService(loader,new CalendarCombinationScorer()).evaluatePairs("2026/2027",ids,1,5);

    }

        when(loader.loadClubProfiles("2026/2027",ids,1,3)).thenReturn(profiles(ids));

        assertThat(result).hasSize(4);assertThat(result).extracting(CalendarCombinationResult::clubIds).doesNotHaveDuplicates();verify(loader).loadClubProfiles("2026/2027",ids,1,3);
    }

        List<Long> ids=LongStream.rangeClosed(1,31).boxed().toList();
        assertThatThrownBy(()->service.evaluatePairs("2026/2027",ids,1,5)).hasMessageContaining("maximum 30");
    }
    @Test void triplePoolCapIsExplicitAndNeverSilentlyTruncated() {

        assertThatThrownBy(()->service.evaluateTriples("2026/2027",ids,1,5)).hasMessageContaining("maximum 18");
    }
    @Test void duplicateCandidatesAreRejected() {
        var service=new CalendarCombinationService(mock(FixtureWindowService.class),new CalendarCombinationScorer());
        assertThatThrownBy(()->service.evaluatePairs("2026/2027",List.of(1L,1L),1,5)).hasMessageContaining("Duplicate");
    }
    private Map<Long,ClubFixtureProfile> profiles(List<Long> ids){Map<Long,ClubFixtureProfile> result=new LinkedHashMap<>();for(Long id:ids){Map<Integer,ClubFixtureDay> days=new LinkedHashMap<>();for(int d=1;d<=5;d++){var difficulty=(id+d)%2==0?CalendarDifficulty.EASY:CalendarDifficulty.HARD;days.put(d,new ClubFixtureDay(id,d,id*100+d,true,"SCHEDULED",null,BigDecimal.valueOf(difficulty==CalendarDifficulty.EASY?35:80),difficulty));}result.put(id,new ClubFixtureProfile(id,"C"+id,days));}return result;}

    private TestCatalog createCatalog(String season, int startYear) {
        long seasonId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO seasons (code, start_year, end_year, current_season)
                VALUES (:season, :startYear, :endYear, FALSE) RETURNING id
                """).param("season", season).param("startYear", startYear).param("endYear", startYear + 1)
                .query(Long.class).single();
        long clubId = createClub("Club " + startYear);
        addMembership(seasonId, clubId);
        long fcBatch = createBatch(seasonId, "FANTACALCIO", 0);
        long gaBatch = createBatch(seasonId, "GAZZETTA", 0);
        return new TestCatalog(season, seasonId, clubId, fcBatch, gaBatch);
    }

    private long createClub(String name) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO clubs (name, short_name, slug, country_code, active)
                VALUES (:name, :name, :slug, 'IT', TRUE) RETURNING id
                """).param("name", name).param("slug", name.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-'))
                .query(Long.class).single();
    }

    private void addMembership(long seasonId, long clubId) {
        jdbcClient.sql("INSERT INTO season_clubs (season_id, club_id) VALUES (:seasonId, :clubId)")
                .param("seasonId", seasonId).param("clubId", clubId).update();
    }

    private PlayerIds createPlayer(TestCatalog catalog, String name, String role,
            boolean secondarySource, boolean registration) {
        long playerId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO players (last_name, display_name, normalized_name, active)
                VALUES (:name, :name, :normalized, TRUE) RETURNING id
                """).param("name", name).param("normalized", name.toLowerCase())
                .query(Long.class).single();
        if (registration) {
            jdbcClient.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO player_registrations (player_id, club_id, season_id, registration_status)
                    VALUES (:playerId, :clubId, :seasonId, 'ACTIVE')
                    """).param("playerId", playerId).param("clubId", catalog.clubId())
                    .param("seasonId", catalog.seasonId()).update();
        }
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_roles (player_id, season_id, source, fantasy_role, primary_role)
                VALUES (:playerId, :seasonId, 'FANTACALCIO', :role, TRUE)
                """).param("playerId", playerId).param("seasonId", catalog.seasonId())
                .param("role", role).update();
        String fcId = "FC-QG-" + playerId;
        String gaId = "GA-QG-" + playerId;
        insertMapping(playerId, "FANTACALCIO", fcId, name);
        if (secondarySource) {
            insertMapping(playerId, "GAZZETTA", gaId, name);
        }
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_reconciliation_results (
                    season_id, player_id, normalized_name, normalized_club_name, sources_count,
                    identity_resolution_method, club_resolution_source)
                VALUES (:seasonId, :playerId, :normalized, :club, :sources, 'EXTERNAL_ID', 'FANTACALCIO')
                """).param("seasonId", catalog.seasonId()).param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("normalized", name.toLowerCase()).param("club", "club")
                .param("sources", secondarySource ? 2 : 1).update();
        return new PlayerIds(playerId, fcId, gaId);
    }

    private void insertMapping(long playerId, String source, String externalId, String name) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_source_mappings (player_id, source, external_id, external_name, verified)
                VALUES (:playerId, :source, :externalId, :name, TRUE)
                """).param("playerId", playerId).param("source", source)
                .param("externalId", externalId).param("name", name).update();
    }

    private void insertReview(TestCatalog catalog, String externalId, String name, String status) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO reconciliation_review_items (
                    season_id, fantacalcio_batch_id, gazzetta_batch_id,
                    fantacalcio_external_id, fantacalcio_name, fantacalcio_club,
                    review_status, exclusion_reason, excluded_at)
                VALUES (:seasonId, :fcBatch, :gaBatch, :externalId, :name, 'Test Club', :status,
                        CASE WHEN :status = 'EXCLUDED' THEN 'OUT_OF_SERIE_A' END,
                        CASE WHEN :status = 'EXCLUDED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END)
                """).param("seasonId", catalog.seasonId()).param("fcBatch", catalog.fcBatch())
                .param("gaBatch", catalog.gaBatch()).param("externalId", externalId)
                .param("name", name).param("status", status).update();
    }

    private long createBatch(long seasonId, String source, int rows) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO import_batches (source, season_id, original_filename, status, total_rows,
                    valid_rows, invalid_rows, completed_at, source_observed_at)
                VALUES (:source, :seasonId, :filename, 'COMPLETED', :rows, :rows, 0,
                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) RETURNING id
                """).param("source", source).param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("filename", "quality-gate-" + source + ".csv").param("rows", rows)
                .query(Long.class).single();
    }

    private long seasonId(String season) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id FROM seasons WHERE code = :season")
                .param("season", season).query(Long.class).single();
    }

    private void insertImportRow(long batchId, String externalId, String name) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_import_rows (batch_id, row_number, external_id, external_name,
                    normalized_name, club_name, normalized_club_name, fantasy_role, valid, raw_data)
                VALUES (:batchId, 1, :externalId, :name, :normalized, 'Roma', 'roma', 'C', TRUE, '{}'::jsonb)
                """).param("batchId", batchId).param("externalId", externalId)
                .param("name", name).param("normalized", name.toLowerCase()).update();
    }

    }

    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class SecretSanitizerTest {

    @Test
    void redactsEveryAuthorizationSchemeWithoutTokenFragments() {
        for (String scheme : new String[] {"Bearer", "Basic", "Digest", "Custom"}) {
            String sanitized = SecretSanitizer.sanitize(
                    "Authorization: " + scheme + " token-prefix-token-suffix"
            );
            assertThat(sanitized)
                    .doesNotContain("token-prefix", "token-suffix", scheme)
                    .contains("Authorization: [REDACTED]");
        }
        assertThat(SecretSanitizer.sanitize("authorization=my-secret-token"))
                .isEqualTo("authorization=[REDACTED]");
    }

    @Test
    void removesCredentialsAndSensitiveUrlParts() {
        String sanitized = SecretSanitizer.sanitize(new IllegalStateException(
                "Authorization: Bearer abc password=hunter2 "
                        + "https://alice:secret@example.test/feed?token=abc#fragment "
                        + "jdbc:postgresql://db:5432/app?password=secret"
        ));

        assertThat(sanitized)
                .doesNotContain("abc", "hunter2", "alice", "secret", "token=", "#fragment")
                .contains("[REDACTED]");
    }

    @Test
    void limitsPersistedLength() {
        assertThat(SecretSanitizer.sanitize("x".repeat(3000))).hasSize(2000);
    }

    @Test
    void handlesNullBlankSafeAndMalformedValues() {
        assertThat(SecretSanitizer.sanitize((Throwable) null)).isEqualTo("Errore sconosciuto");
        assertThat(SecretSanitizer.sanitize("   ")).isEqualTo("Errore sconosciuto");
        assertThat(SecretSanitizer.sanitize("Messaggio operativo sicuro"))
                .isEqualTo("Messaggio operativo sicuro");
        assertThat(SecretSanitizer.sanitize("Errore su https://user:pass@[host/feed?secret=x#frag"))
                .doesNotContain("user", "pass", "secret=x", "#frag");
    }

    @Test
    void redactsAllSupportedSecretKeysAndJdbc() {
        String sanitized = SecretSanitizer.sanitize(
                "password=a passwd=b pwd=c token=d api_key=e api-key=f apikey=g secret=h "
                        + "jdbc:postgresql://db.internal/app?password=i"
        );
        assertThat(sanitized).doesNotContain("=a", "=b", "=c", "=d", "=e", "=f", "=g", "=h",
                "jdbc:postgresql", "db.internal");
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.config;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.get;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.post;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.status;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.time.Clock;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.setup.MockMvcBuilders;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

class RateLimitFilterTest {

    @Test
    void enforcesThresholdSeparatesIdentitiesAndResetsAndCleansUp() throws Exception {
        MutableClock clock = new MutableClock();
        RateLimitFilter filter = new RateLimitFilter(2, Duration.ofMinutes(1), clock);
        MockMvc mvc = MockMvcBuilders.standaloneSetup(new ProbeController()).addFilters(filter).build();

        mvc.perform(post("/mutation").with(request -> { request.setRemoteAddr("10.0.0.1"); return request; }))
                .andExpect(status().isOk());
        mvc.perform(post("/mutation").with(request -> { request.setRemoteAddr("10.0.0.1"); return request; }))
                .andExpect(status().isOk());
        mvc.perform(post("/mutation").with(request -> { request.setRemoteAddr("10.0.0.1"); return request; }))
                .andExpect(status().isTooManyRequests());
        mvc.perform(post("/mutation").with(request -> { request.setRemoteAddr("10.0.0.2"); return request; }))
                .andExpect(status().isOk());

        assertThat(filter.trackedIdentities()).isEqualTo(2);
        clock.advance(Duration.ofMinutes(1));
        mvc.perform(post("/mutation").with(request -> { request.setRemoteAddr("10.0.0.1"); return request; }))
                .andExpect(status().isOk());
        assertThat(filter.trackedIdentities()).isEqualTo(1);

        mvc.perform(get("/public").with(request -> { request.setRemoteAddr("10.0.0.1"); return request; }))
                .andExpect(status().isOk());
    }

    @RestController
    static class ProbeController {
        @PostMapping("/mutation") void mutation() { }
        @GetMapping("/public") void publicGet() { }
    }

    static final class MutableClock extends Clock {
        private Instant instant = Instant.parse("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z");
        void advance(Duration duration) { instant = instant.plus(duration); }
        @Override public ZoneId getZone() { return ZoneId.of("UTC"); }
        @Override public Clock withZone(ZoneId zone) { return this; }
        @Override public Instant instant() { return instant; }
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.config;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.DefaultApplicationArguments;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@SpringBootTest
class UserBootstrapProvisioningIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc;
    @Autowired PasswordEncoder encoder;
    @Autowired UserProvisioningService provisioning;

    @BeforeEach
    void cleanup() {
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM app_users WHERE username LIKE 'corrective-%'").update();
    }

    @Test
    void bootstrapDoesNotOverwritePasswordAndFailsOnRoleMismatch() {
        SecurityUserBootstrap first = new SecurityUserBootstrap(jdbc, encoder,
                "corrective-admin", "initial-admin-password", "corrective-user", "initial-user-password");
        first.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments());
        String hash = hash("corrective-user");

        SecurityUserBootstrap retry = new SecurityUserBootstrap(jdbc, encoder,
                "corrective-admin", "changed-admin-password", "corrective-user", "changed-user-password");
        retry.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments());
        assertThat(hash("corrective-user")).isEqualTo(hash);
        assertThat(encoder.matches("initial-user-password", hash)).isTrue();

        jdbc.sql("UPDATE app_users SET role='ADMIN' WHERE username='corrective-user'").update();
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> retry.run(new DefaultApplicationArguments()))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalStateException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("Ruolo bootstrap incoerente");
    }

    @Test
    void provisioningHashesPasswordAndRejectsCaseInsensitiveUsernameOrEmail() {
        provisioning.create(new ProvisionUserRequest("corrective-alpha", "alpha@example.test",
                "a-secure-password", "USER", true));
        assertThat(encoder.matches("a-secure-password", hash("corrective-alpha"))).isTrue();

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> provisioning.create(new ProvisionUserRequest(
                "CORRECTIVE-ALPHA", "other@example.test", "another-password", "USER", true)))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> provisioning.create(new ProvisionUserRequest(
                "corrective-beta", "ALPHA@example.test", "another-password", "USER", true)))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    private String hash(String username) {
        return jdbc.sql("SELECT password_hash FROM app_users WHERE username=:username")
                .param("username", username).query(String.class).single();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.evaluation;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class PlayerEvaluationGenerationServiceTest {

    @Autowired
    private PlayerEvaluationGenerationService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldGenerateDifferentEvaluationsFromMarketValues() {

        Long seasonId = findSeasonId();
        Long clubId = findClubId();
        addMembership(seasonId, clubId);

        Long premiumPlayerId = createPlayer(
                "Valutazione Test Premium",
                "valutazione test premium"
        );

        Long budgetPlayerId = createPlayer(
                "Valutazione Test Budget",
                "valutazione test budget"
        );

        createRegistration(
                premiumPlayerId,
                clubId,
                seasonId
        );

        createRegistration(
                budgetPlayerId,
                clubId,
                seasonId
        );

        createRole(
                premiumPlayerId,
                seasonId,
                "A"
        );

        createRole(
                budgetPlayerId,
                seasonId,
                "A"
        );

        createReconciliation(
                premiumPlayerId,
                seasonId,
                "valutazione test premium",
                "club test",
                2
        );

        createReconciliation(
                budgetPlayerId,
                seasonId,
                "valutazione test budget",
                "club test",
                2
        );

        createMarketValue(
                premiumPlayerId,
                seasonId,
                new BigDecimal("45"),
                new BigDecimal("320")
        );

        createMarketValue(
                budgetPlayerId,
                seasonId,
                new BigDecimal("5"),
                new BigDecimal("20")
        );

        PlayerEvaluationGenerationResponse response =
                service.generate("2024/2025");

        assertThat(response.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(response.generatedEvaluations())
                .isEqualTo(response.eligiblePlayers());

        EvaluationScores premium =
                findEvaluation(premiumPlayerId);

        EvaluationScores budget =
                findEvaluation(budgetPlayerId);

        assertThat(premium.valueScore())
                .isGreaterThan(budget.valueScore());

        assertThat(premium.reliabilityScore())
                .isGreaterThan(
                        budget.reliabilityScore()
                );

        assertThat(premium.riskScore())
                .isLessThan(budget.riskScore());

        assertThat(premium.projectedGoals())
                .isGreaterThan(
                        budget.projectedGoals()
                );

        assertThat(premium.summary())
                .contains(
                        "Valutazione automatica iniziale"
                );
    }

    private Long findSeasonId() {

            Long playerId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""

                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .query((resultSet, rowNumber) ->

                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "risk_score"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getBigDecimal(
                                        "value_score"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getInt(
                                        "projected_goals"
                                ),
                                resultSet.getString(
                                        "evaluation_summary"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .single();
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class B69FixtureMatchupServiceTest {

    @Autowired
    private B69FixtureMatchupService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    private String clubSlug;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {

        Long seasonId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM seasons
                        WHERE code = '2026/2027'
                        """)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        List<Club> clubs =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            club.id,
                            club.slug

                        FROM clubs club

                        JOIN season_clubs membership
                            ON membership.club_id =
                                club.id

                        WHERE membership.season_id =
                            :seasonId

                          AND club.active = TRUE

                        ORDER BY club.id

                        LIMIT 2
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "seasonId",
                                seasonId
                        )
                        .query(
                                (rs, rowNumber) ->
                                        new Club(
                                                rs.getLong("id"),
                                                rs.getString("slug")
                                        )
                        )
                        .list();

        assertThat(clubs)
                .hasSize(2);

        Club home =
                clubs.get(0);

        Club away =
                clubs.get(1);

        clubSlug =
                home.slug();

        strength(
                seasonId,
                home.id(),
                65,
                70,
                68,
                72,
                61
        );

        strength(
                seasonId,
                away.id(),
                58,
                55,
                52,
                63,
                51
        );

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fixtures (
                    season_id,
                    matchday,
                    home_club_id,
                    away_club_id,
                    status
                )
                VALUES (
                    :seasonId,
                    1,
                    :home,
                    :away,
                    'SCHEDULED'
                )

                ON CONFLICT (
                    season_id,
                    matchday,
                    home_club_id,
                    away_club_id
                )

                DO UPDATE SET
                    status = 'SCHEDULED'
                """)
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "home",
                        home.id()
                )
                .param(
                        "away",
                        away.id()
                )
                .update();
    }

    @Test
    void returnsRoleAwareFixtureForEveryFantasyRole() {

        List<B69FixtureMatchupResponse> result =
                service.findClubMatchups(
                        "2026/2027",
                        clubSlug,
                        1,
                        1
                );

        assertThat(result)
                .hasSize(1);

        B69FixtureMatchupResponse fixture =
                result.getFirst();

        assertThat(fixture.home())
                .isTrue();

        assertThat(fixture.roles())
                .extracting(
                        B69RoleDifficultyResponse::role
                )
                .containsExactly(
                        "P",
                        "D",
                        "C",
                        "A"
                );

        assertThat(fixture.roles())
                .allSatisfy(role -> {

                    assertThat(
                            role.difficultyScore()
                    ).isNotNull();

                    assertThat(
                            role.difficultyLevel()
                    )
                            .isIn(
                                    "FACILE",
                                    "MEDIA",
                                    "DIFFICILE"
                            );

                    assertThat(
                            role.evidenceCoverage()
                    )
                            .isEqualByComparingTo(
                                    "100.00"
                            );

                    assertThat(
                            role.evidenceTier()
                    )
                            .isEqualTo(
                                    "HIGH"
                            );
                });
    }

    private void strength(
            Long seasonId,
            Long clubId,
            int overall,
            int attack,
            int defense,
            int home,
            int away
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO club_strength_ratings (
                    club_id,
                    season_id,
                    overall_rating,
                    attacking_rating,
                    defensive_rating,
                    home_rating,
                    away_rating
                )
                VALUES (
                    :clubId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :overall,
                    :attack,
                    :defense,
                    :home,
                    :away
                )

                ON CONFLICT (
                    club_id,
                    season_id
                )

                DO UPDATE SET
                    overall_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.overall_rating,

                    attacking_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.attacking_rating,

                    defensive_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.defensive_rating,

                    home_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.home_rating,

                    away_rating =
                        EXCLUDED.away_rating
                """)
                .param("clubId", clubId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("overall", overall)
                .param("attack", attack)
                .param("defense", defense)
                .param("home", home)
                .param("away", away)
                .update();
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.fixture.importer;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.mock.web.MockMultipartFile;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class FixtureImportServiceTest {

    @Autowired
    private FixtureImportService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldImportValidFixtureAndRejectUnknownClub() {
        String csv = """
                matchday,home_club,away_club,kickoff_at,status,home_goals,away_goals
                10,Inter,Napoli,2026-10-31T20:45:00+01:00,SCHEDULED,,
                11,Inter,Club Inesistente,2026-11-07T20:45:00+01:00,SCHEDULED,,
                """;

        MockMultipartFile file =
                new MockMultipartFile(
                        "file",
                        "fixtures-test.csv",
                        "text/csv",
                        csv.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                );

        FixtureImportResponse response =
                service.importCsv(
                        "LEGA_SERIE_A",
                        "2026/2027",
                        file
                );

        assertThat(response.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(response.totalRows())
                .isEqualTo(2);

        assertThat(response.validRows())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(response.invalidRows())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(response.importedFixtures())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        Integer importedFixtureCount =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM fixtures fixture

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = fixture.season_id

                        JOIN clubs home_club
                            ON home_club.id =
                                fixture.home_club_id

                        JOIN clubs away_club
                            ON away_club.id =
                                fixture.away_club_id

                        WHERE season.code = '2026/2027'
                          AND fixture.matchday = 10
                          AND home_club.slug = 'inter'
                          AND away_club.slug = 'napoli'
                        """)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(importedFixtureCount)
                .isEqualTo(1);

        Integer invalidRowCount =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM fixture_import_rows
                        WHERE batch_id = :batchId
                          AND valid = FALSE
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "batchId",
                                response.batchId()
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(invalidRowCount)
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectGloballyExistingClubOutsideRequestedSeason() {
        Long seasonId = jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id FROM seasons WHERE code='2026/2027'")
                .query(Long.class).single();
        Long napoliId = jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id FROM clubs WHERE slug='napoli'")
                .query(Long.class).single();
        jdbcClient.sql("DELETE FROM season_clubs WHERE season_id=:season AND club_id=:club")
                .param("season", seasonId).param("club", napoliId).update();

        MockMultipartFile file = new MockMultipartFile("file", "season-membership.csv", "text/csv", """
                matchday,home_club,away_club
                12,Inter,Napoli
                """.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

        FixtureImportResponse response = service.importCsv("LEGA_SERIE_A", "2026/2027", file);

        assertThat(response.validRows()).isZero();
        assertThat(response.invalidRows()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(response.importedFixtures()).isZero();
    }
}

    private ClubStrengthGenerationService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldGenerateDifferentRatingsFromPlayerQuality() {

        Long seasonId = findSeasonId();

        List<Long> clubIds = findTwoClubIds();

        clubIds.forEach(clubId -> jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO season_clubs(season_id,club_id) VALUES(:seasonId,:clubId)
                ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
                """).param("seasonId",seasonId).param("clubId",clubId).update());

        Long strongClubId = clubIds.get(0);
        Long weakClubId = clubIds.get(1);

        createEligiblePlayer(
                seasonId,
                strongClubId,
                "Rating Test Strong Attacker",
                "rating test strong attacker",
                "A",
                new BigDecimal("95"),
                new BigDecimal("96"),
                new BigDecimal("10"),
                new BigDecimal("94"),
                16,
                8,
                32
        );

        createEligiblePlayer(
                seasonId,
                strongClubId,
                "Rating Test Strong Goalkeeper",
                "rating test strong goalkeeper",
                "P",
                new BigDecimal("94"),
                new BigDecimal("90"),
                new BigDecimal("12"),
                new BigDecimal("88"),
                0,
                0,
                34
        );

        createEligiblePlayer(
                seasonId,
                weakClubId,
                "Rating Test Weak Attacker",
                "rating test weak attacker",
                "A",
                new BigDecimal("25"),
                new BigDecimal("28"),
                new BigDecimal("80"),
                new BigDecimal("22"),
                1,
                1,
                8
        );

        createEligiblePlayer(
                seasonId,
                weakClubId,
                "Rating Test Weak Goalkeeper",
                "rating test weak goalkeeper",
                "P",
                new BigDecimal("30"),
                new BigDecimal("24"),
                new BigDecimal("78"),
                new BigDecimal("25"),
                0,
                0,
                7
        );

        ClubStrengthGenerationResponse response =
                service.generate("2024/2025");

        assertThat(response.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(response.eligiblePlayers())
                .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(4);

        assertThat(response.eligibleClubs())
                .isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(2);

        assertThat(response.generatedRatings())
                .isEqualTo(countSeasonClubs(seasonId));

        ClubRating strongRating =
                findRating(strongClubId, seasonId);

        ClubRating weakRating =
                findRating(weakClubId, seasonId);

        assertThat(strongRating.overall())
                .isGreaterThan(weakRating.overall());

        assertThat(strongRating.attack())
                .isGreaterThan(weakRating.attack());

        assertThat(strongRating.defense())
                .isGreaterThan(weakRating.defense());

        assertThat(strongRating.home())
                .isGreaterThan(strongRating.away());
    }
