package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.freshness;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.OffsetDateTime;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class DataFreshnessServiceTest {

    private DataFreshnessService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    private static final Instant FIXED_INSTANT =
            Instant.parse("2026-08-13T12:00:00Z");

    @BeforeEach
    void useFixedUtcClock() {
        service = new DataFreshnessService(
                jdbcClient,
                Clock.fixed(FIXED_INSTANT, ZoneOffset.UTC)
        );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReportFreshSources() {
        prepareFreshProductionImports();

        DataFreshnessResponse response =
                service.evaluate(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(
                response.overallStatus()
        ).isEqualTo("READY");

        assertThat(
                response.sources()
        )
                .extracting(
                        SourceFreshnessResponse::status
                )
                .containsOnly("FRESH");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReportWarningForAgingRequiredSource() {
        prepareFreshProductionImports();

        ageAllSourceBatches(
                "GAZZETTA",
                100
        );

        DataFreshnessResponse response =
                service.evaluate(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(
                response.overallStatus()
        ).isEqualTo("WARNING");

        assertThat(
                statusFor(
                        response,
                        "GAZZETTA"
                )
        ).isEqualTo("AGING");

        assertThat(response.blockers())
                .isEmpty();

        assertThat(response.warnings())
                .contains("GAZZETTA Ã¨ AGING: snapshot di 100 ore");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldBlockStaleRequiredSource() {
        prepareFreshProductionImports();

        ageAllSourceBatches(
                "FANTACALCIO",
                200
        );

        DataFreshnessResponse response =
                service.evaluate(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(
                response.overallStatus()
        ).isEqualTo("BLOCKED");

        assertThat(
                statusFor(
                        response,
                        "FANTACALCIO"
                )
        ).isEqualTo("STALE");

        assertThat(response.blockers())
                .contains("FANTACALCIO Ã¨ STALE: snapshot di 200 ore");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldTruncateOnlyARealSubHourAtTheBoundary() {
        prepareFreshProductionImports();

        setAllSourceBatchesObservedAt(
                "GAZZETTA",
                OffsetDateTime.ofInstant(
                        FIXED_INSTANT.minusSeconds(
                                100L * 60 * 60 - 1
                        ),
                        ZoneOffset.UTC
                )
        );

        DataFreshnessResponse response =
                service.evaluate("2026/2027");

        SourceFreshnessResponse gazzetta =
                response.sources().stream()
                        .filter(source ->
                                "GAZZETTA".equals(source.source())
                        )
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow();

        assertThat(gazzetta.ageHours()).isEqualTo(99);
        assertThat(gazzetta.status()).isEqualTo("AGING");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldOnlyWarnForStaleOptionalFantamarkt() {
        prepareFreshProductionImports();

        ageAllSourceBatches(
                "FANTAMARKT",
                500
        );

        DataFreshnessResponse response =
                service.evaluate(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(
                response.overallStatus()
        ).isEqualTo("WARNING");

        assertThat(
                statusFor(
                        response,
                        "FANTAMARKT"
                )
        ).isEqualTo("STALE");

        assertThat(response.blockers())
                .isEmpty();
    }

    private String statusFor(
            DataFreshnessResponse response,
            String source
    ) {

        return response.sources()
                .stream()
                .filter(item ->
                        source.equals(
                                item.source()
                        )
                )
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow()
                .status();
    }

    private void prepareFreshProductionImports() {
        createBatch(
                "FANTACALCIO",
                "freshness-fantacalcio.csv"
        );

        createBatch(
                "GAZZETTA",
                "freshness-gazzetta.csv"
        );

        createBatch(
                "FANTAMARKT",
                "freshness-fantamarkt.csv"
        );
    }

    private void createBatch(
            String source,
            String filename
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO import_batches (
                    source,
                    season_id,
                    original_filename,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    completed_at,
                    source_observed_at
                )

                SELECT
                    :source,
                    season.id,
                    :filename,
                    'COMPLETED',
                    1,
                    1,
                    0,
                    :now,
                    :now

                FROM seasons season
                WHERE season.code = '2026/2027'
                """)
                .param("source", source)
                .param("filename", filename)
                .param(
                        "now",
                        OffsetDateTime.ofInstant(
                                FIXED_INSTANT,
                                ZoneOffset.UTC
                        )
                )
                .update();
    }

    private void ageAllSourceBatches(
            String source,
            int hours
    ) {

        setAllSourceBatchesObservedAt(
                source,
                OffsetDateTime.ofInstant(
                        FIXED_INSTANT.minusSeconds(
                                hours * 60L * 60
                        ),
                        ZoneOffset.UTC
                )
        );
    }

    private void setAllSourceBatchesObservedAt(
            String source,
            OffsetDateTime observedAt
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE import_batches batch
                SET
                    source_observed_at = :observedAt,
                    completed_at = :observedAt

                FROM seasons season

                WHERE season.id =
                        batch.season_id

                  AND season.code =
                        '2026/2027'

                  AND batch.source =
                        :source

                  AND batch.status =
                        'COMPLETED'

                  AND LOWER(batch.original_filename)
                        NOT LIKE '%test%'
                """)
                .param("observedAt", observedAt)
                .param("source", source)
                .update();
    }
}

    @Test
    void allV46ProvenanceSourcesAreAccepted() {

        String[] sources = {
                "WIKIDATA",
                "FANTACALCIO",
                "TRANSFERMARKT",
                "UEFA",
                "FIGC",
                "LEGA_SERIE_A",
                "OFFICIAL_CLUB",
                "MANUAL_VERIFIED"
        };

        for (int index = 0;
                index < sources.length;
                index++) {

            String source =
                    sources[index];

            long playerId =
                    player(
                            "Approved Source "
                                    + index
                    );

            String transfermarktId =
                    "TRANSFERMARKT".equals(
                            source
                    )
                            ? Integer.toString(
                                    900000 + index
                            )
                            : "";

            String externalId =
                    source + "-"
                            + playerId;

            String content =
                    header()
                            + row(
                                    playerId,
                                    "Approved Source Player "
                                            + index,
                                    "",
                                    "Player",
                                    "1990-01-01",
                                    "",
                                    "",
                                    "",
                                    "",
                                    transfermarktId,
                                    "VERIFIED_PARTIAL",
                                    "HIGH",
                                    source,
                                    externalId,
                                    "https://source.example/"
                                            + source
                            );

            var response =
                    service.importCsv(
                            file(content)
                    );

            assertThat(
                    response.importedRows()
            ).isOne();

            assertThat(
                    jdbcClient
                            .sql("""
                                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                                    FROM player_identity_provenance
                                    WHERE player_id = :playerId
                                      AND source = :source
                                    """)
                            .param(
                                    "playerId",
                                    playerId
                            )
                            .param(
                                    "source",
                                    source
                            )
                            .query(Integer.class)
                            .single()
            ).isPositive();
        }
    }

    private long player(
            String name
    ) {

        return jdbcClient
                .sql("""
                        INSERT INTO players (
                            last_name,
                            display_name,
                            normalized_name,
                            active
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :name,
                            :name,
                            :normalized,
                            TRUE
                        )
                        RETURNING id
                        """)
                .param(
                        "name",
                        name
                )
                .param(
                        "normalized",
                        name.toLowerCase()
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private int count(
            String table
    ) {
        return jdbcClient
                .sql(
                        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "
                                + table
                )
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }

    private MockMultipartFile wikidataCsv(
            long id,
            String canonical,
            String first,
            String last,
            String birth,
            String nationality,
            String height,
            String foot,
            String status,
            String confidence,
            String qid
    ) {

        String sourceUrl =
                qid.isBlank()
                        ? ""
                        : "https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/"
                                + qid;

        return file(
                header()
                        + row(
                                id,
                                canonical,
                                first,
                                last,
                                birth,
                                nationality,
                                nationality,
                                height,
                                foot,
                                "",
                                status,
                                confidence,
                                "WIKIDATA",
                                qid,
                                sourceUrl
                        )
        );
    }

    private MockMultipartFile transfermarktCsv(
            long playerId,
            String externalId
    ) {

        return file(
                header()
                        + row(
                                playerId,
                                "Mario Example",
                                "Mario",
                                "Example",
                                "1992-03-04",
                                "Italia",
                                "IT",
                                "181",
                                "",
                                externalId,
                                "VERIFIED_COMPLETE",
                                "HIGH",
                                "TRANSFERMARKT",
                                externalId,
                                "https://www.transfermarkt.it/x/profil/spieler/"
                                        + externalId
                        )
        );
    }

    private String header() {
        return """
                player_id,canonical_full_name,first_name,last_name,birth_date,nationality,nationality_code,height_cm,preferred_foot,transfermarkt_player_id,identity_status,confidence,source,source_external_id,source_url,evidence
                """;
    }

    private String row(
            long playerId,
            String canonical,
            String first,
            String last,
            String birth,
            String nationality,
            String nationalityCode,
            String height,
            String foot,
            String transfermarktId,
            String status,
            String confidence,
            String source,
            String sourceExternalId,
            String sourceUrl
    ) {

        return String.join(
                ",",
                Long.toString(
                        playerId
                ),
                canonical,
                first,
                last,
                birth,
                nationality,
                nationalityCode,
                height,
                foot,
                transfermarktId,
                status,
                confidence,
                source,
                sourceExternalId,
                sourceUrl,
                "\"{}\""
        ) + "\n";
    }

    private MockMultipartFile file(
            String content
    ) {
        return new MockMultipartFile(
                "file",
                "identity.csv",
                "text/csv",
                content.getBytes(
                        StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                )
        );
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class NationalityNormalizerTest {

    @Test
    void shouldResolveItalianNationality() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Italia",
                        null,
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("IT");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldResolveBritishVariants() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Inghilterra",
                        null,
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("GB");

        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Scozia",
                        null,
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("GB");

        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "England",
                        null,
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("GB");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldResolveKosovo() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Kosovo",
                        null,
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("XK");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldUsePrimaryNationalityForMultipleValues() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Francia, Guinea-Bissau",
                        null,
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("FR");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldApplyVerifiedVazOverride() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.normalizeNationality(
                        "Frabcia, Guinea Bissau",
                        "1131161"
                )
        ).isEqualTo(
                "Francia, Guinea-Bissau"
        );

        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Frabcia, Guinea Bissau",
                        null,
                        "1131161"
                )
        ).isEqualTo("FR");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldApplyVerifiedPessinaOverride() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.normalizeNationality(
                        "Bologna",
                        "992569"
                )
        ).isEqualTo("Italia");

        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Bologna",
                        null,
                        "992569"
                )
        ).isEqualTo("IT");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldPreferCertifiedMappingOverWrongExplicitCode() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Italia",
                        "FR",
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("IT");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldFallbackToExplicitCodeForUnknownNationality() {
        assertThat(
                NationalityNormalizer.resolveCode(
                        "Unknown Country",
                        "zz",
                        null
                )
        ).isEqualTo("ZZ");
    }
}

                new IdentityAutomationProperties()

                .doesNotThrowAnyException();

    @Test

        IdentityAutomationProperties properties =
                new IdentityAutomationProperties();

        properties.setEnabled(true);

        assertThatThrownBy(
                properties
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration
        )

                        "batch-limit"
                );

    @Test
    void enabledRejectsInvalidRetryDurations() {

        IdentityAutomationProperties properties =
                new IdentityAutomationProperties();

        properties.setEnabled(true);

        properties.setFailedRetry(
                Duration.ZERO
        );

        assertThatThrownBy(
                properties
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration

                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "failed-retry"
                );
    }

    @Test

        IdentityAutomationProperties properties =
                new IdentityAutomationProperties();

        properties.setBatchLimit(10);

                                List.of(
                                                candidate(
                                                                "1",
                                                                "Mario Rossi",
                                                                "Mario Rossi Atalanta"),
                                                candidate(
                                                                "2",
                                                                "Mario Rossi",
                                                                "Mario Rossi Atalanta")));

                assertThat(result.status())
                                .isEqualTo(
                                                "REVIEW_REQUIRED");
        }

        @Test
        void unrelatedCandidateDoesNotPassSurnameCompatibility() {
                var result = matcher.match(
                                "Gaetano",
                                "Atalanta",
                                List.of(
                                                candidate(
                                                                "116740",
                                                                "Gaetano Scirea",
                                                                "Gaetano Scirea")));

                /*
                 * Search candidate can still be superficially compatible because
                 * Fantacalcio exposes only "Gaetano". B63.2B never persists this:
                 * the profile/team stage must confirm or reject it.
                 */
                assertThat(result.status())
                                .isEqualTo(
                                                "PROFILE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED");
        }

        @Test
        void accentsAreNormalized() {
                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("Tour\u00E8 E."))
                                .isEqualTo("toure e");
        }

        @Test
        void turkishDotlessIIsNormalized() {
                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("Y\u0131ld\u0131z"))
                                .isEqualTo("yildiz");

                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("Kenan Y\u0131ld\u0131z"))
                                .isEqualTo("kenan yildiz");
        }

        @Test
        void nordicOStrokeIsNormalized() {
                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("\u00D8stig\u00E5rd"))
                                .isEqualTo("ostigard");

                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("Leo \u00D8stig\u00E5rd"))
                                .isEqualTo("leo ostigard");
        }

        @Test
        void hojlundIsNormalizedAcrossAsciiAndNordicSpelling() {
                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("H\u00F8jlund"))
                                .isEqualTo("hojlund");

                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("Rasmus H\u00F8jlund"))
                                .isEqualTo("rasmus hojlund");
        }

        @Test
        void sorensenIsNormalizedAcrossAsciiAndNordicSpelling() {
                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("S\u00F8rensen"))
                                .isEqualTo("sorensen");

                assertThat(
                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher
                                                .normalize("Oliver S\u00F8rensen"))
                                .isEqualTo("oliver sorensen");
        }

        @Test
        void latinVariantsRemainSurnameCompatible() {
                assertThat(
                                matcher.surnameCompatible(
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Kenan Yildiz"),
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Kenan Y\u0131ld\u0131z")))
                                .isTrue();

                assertThat(
                                matcher.surnameCompatible(
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Leo Ostigard"),
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Leo \u00D8stig\u00E5rd")))
                                .isTrue();

                assertThat(
                                matcher.surnameCompatible(
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Rasmus Hojlund"),
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Rasmus H\u00F8jlund")))
                                .isTrue();

                assertThat(
                                matcher.surnameCompatible(
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Oliver Sorensen"),
                                                TransfermarktCandidateMatcher.normalize("Oliver S\u00F8rensen")))
                                .isTrue();
        }

        private TransfermarktCandidate candidate(
                        String id,
                        String name,
                        String context) {
                return new TransfermarktCandidate(
                                id,
                                name,
                                "https://www.transfermarkt.com/x/profil/spieler/"
                                                + id,
                                context);
        }
}

class TransfermarktDiscoveryIdentityVerificationTest {

    private final TransfermarktDiscoveryService service =
            new TransfermarktDiscoveryService(
                    Mockito.mock(JdbcClient.class),

                    new TransfermarktSearchParser(),
                    new TransfermarktProfileParser(),

                player(

                        LocalDate.of(1999, 3, 7),
                        "346567"
                ),
                candidate("346567", "Luca Pellegrini"),
                profile(
                        "346567",
                        "Luca Pellegrini",
                        LocalDate.of(1999, 3, 7),
                        "Juventus FC"
                )
        );

        assertThat(verification.status())
                .isEqualTo("MATCHED_VERIFIED");

        assertThat(verification.reason())
                .contains("roster Transfermarkt temporalmente diverso");
    }

    @Test
    void strongIdentitySurvivesUnreadableRoster() {

                .isEqualTo("MATCHED_VERIFIED");

                .isEqualTo("NOT_FOUND");

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.mockito.Mockito;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

class TransfermarktDiscoveryNameFallbackTest {

    private TransfermarktDiscoveryService service() {
        return new TransfermarktDiscoveryService(
                Mockito.mock(JdbcClient.class),
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties(),
                Mockito.mock(TransfermarktDiscoveryClient.class),
                new TransfermarktSearchParser(),
                new TransfermarktProfileParser(),
                new TransfermarktCandidateMatcher()
        );
    }

    @Test
    void singleInitialCreatesSurnameFallbackQuery() {
        assertThat(
                service().searchQueries(
                        "Sulemana I."
                )
        ).containsExactly(
                "Sulemana I.",
                "Sulemana"
        );
    }

    @Test
    void compoundInitialSuffixCreatesBaseFallbackQuery() {
        assertThat(
                service().searchQueries(
                        "Ederson D.S."
                )
        ).containsExactly(
                "Ederson D.S.",
                "Ederson"
        );
    }

    @Test
    void ordinarySurnameUsesOnlyOriginalQuery() {
        assertThat(
                service().searchQueries(
                        "Bellanova"
                )
        ).containsExactly(
                "Bellanova"
        );
    }

    @Test
    void firstNameInitialDisambiguatesSameSurname() {
        TransfermarktDiscoveryService service =
                service();

        assertThat(
                service.initialCompatible(
                        "Sulemana I.",
                        "Ibrahim Sulemana"
                )
        ).isTrue();

        assertThat(
                service.initialCompatible(
                        "Sulemana I.",
                        "Kamaldeen Sulemana"
                )
        ).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void compoundSuffixIsNotTreatedAsFirstNameInitial() {
        assertThat(
                service().initialCompatible(
                        "Ederson D.S.",
                        "Ederson JosÃƒÂ© dos Santos LourenÃƒÂ§o da Silva"
                )
        ).isTrue();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatCode;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.time.Duration;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class TransfermarktDiscoveryPropertiesTest {

    @Test
    void disabledConfigurationIsSafeByDefault() {
        assertThatCode(
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties()
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration
        ).doesNotThrowAnyException();
    }

    @Test
    void enabledConfigurationRequiresQueryPlaceholder() {
        var properties =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties();

        properties.setEnabled(true);
        properties.setSearchUrlTemplate(
                "https://www.transfermarkt.com/search"
        );

        assertThatThrownBy(
                properties
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration
        ).hasMessageContaining("{query}");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsInvalidLimits() {
        var properties =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryProperties();

        properties.setEnabled(true);
        properties.setMaxBytes(0);

        assertThatThrownBy(
                properties
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration
        ).hasMessageContaining("max-bytes");

        properties.setMaxBytes(100);
        properties.setRequestTimeout(
                Duration.ZERO
        );

        assertThatThrownBy(
                properties
                        ::validateEnabledConfiguration
        ).hasMessageContaining(
                "request-timeout"
        );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.condition.EnabledIfEnvironmentVariable;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
@EnabledIfEnvironmentVariable(
        named = "B65_TRANSFERMARKT_PERSISTENCE_TEST",
        matches = "true"
)
class TransfermarktProvenancePersistenceServiceTest {

    private static final String TEST_TM_ID = "999999999";

    @Autowired
    private TransfermarktProvenancePersistenceService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbc;

    private Long existingPlayerId;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {

        existingPlayerId =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM players
                        ORDER BY id
                        LIMIT 1
                        """)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        jdbc.sql("""
                DELETE FROM player_identity_provenance
                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                  AND source = 'TRANSFERMARKT'
                  AND source_external_id = :externalId
                """)
                .param("playerId", existingPlayerId)
                .param("externalId", TEST_TM_ID)
                .update();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldPersistOnlyMatchedVerifiedPopulatedFields() {

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery verified =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery(
                        existingPlayerId,
                        "B65 Test Player",
                        "Roma",
                        "MATCHED_VERIFIED",
                        100,
                        TEST_TM_ID,
                        "B65 Test Player",
                        "https://www.transfermarkt.com/b65-test/profil/spieler/"
                                + TEST_TM_ID,
                        "Roma",
                        LocalDate.of(2000, 1, 2),
                        "Italy",
                        185,
                        "RIGHT",
                        "B65 verified test"
                );

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery notFound =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery(
                        existingPlayerId,
                        "Ignored Player",
                        "Roma",
                        "NOT_FOUND",
                        100,
                        "888888888",
                        "Ignored Player",
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        null,
                        "Must not be persisted"
                );

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse response =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse(
                        "2026/2027",
                        "Roma",
                        2,
                        1,
                        0,
                        1,
                        0,
                        false,
                        List.of(
                                verified,
                                notFound
                        )
                );

        int persistedFields =
                service.persist(
                        "2026/2027",
                        response
                );

        assertThat(persistedFields)
                .isEqualTo(6);

        List<Map<String, Object>> rows =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            field_name,
                            source,
                            source_external_id,
                            evidence
                        FROM player_identity_provenance
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND source = 'TRANSFERMARKT'
                          AND source_external_id = :externalId
                        ORDER BY field_name
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", existingPlayerId)
                        .param("externalId", TEST_TM_ID)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        assertThat(rows)
                .hasSize(6);

        assertThat(rows)
                .allSatisfy(row -> {
                    assertThat(row.get("source"))
                            .isEqualTo("TRANSFERMARKT");

                    assertThat(row.get("source_external_id"))
                            .isEqualTo(TEST_TM_ID);
                });

        assertThat(rows)
                .extracting(row -> row.get("field_name"))
                .containsExactlyInAnyOrder(
                        "CANONICAL_FULL_NAME",
                        "BIRTH_DATE",
                        "NATIONALITY",
                        "HEIGHT_CM",
                        "PREFERRED_FOOT",
                        "TRANSFERMARKT_PLAYER_ID"
                );

        Long ignoredRows =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_identity_provenance
                        WHERE source = 'TRANSFERMARKT'
                          AND source_external_id = '888888888'
                        """)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(ignoredRows)
                .isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldIgnoreNullFields() {

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery verified =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery(
                        existingPlayerId,
                        "B65 Test Player",
                        "Roma",
                        "MATCHED_VERIFIED",
                        100,
                        TEST_TM_ID,
                        "B65 Test Player",
                        "https://www.transfermarkt.com/b65-test/profil/spieler/"
                                + TEST_TM_ID,
                        "Roma",
                        LocalDate.of(2000, 1, 2),
                        "Italy",
                        null,
                        null,
                        "B65 null fields test"
                );

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse response =
                new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse(
                        "2026/2027",
                        "Roma",
                        1,
                        1,
                        0,
                        0,
                        0,
                        false,
                        List.of(verified)
                );

        int persistedFields =
                service.persist(
                        "2026/2027",
                        response
                );

        assertThat(persistedFields)
                .isEqualTo(4);

        List<String> fields =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT field_name
                        FROM player_identity_provenance
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND source = 'TRANSFERMARKT'
                          AND source_external_id = :externalId
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", existingPlayerId)
                        .param("externalId", TEST_TM_ID)
                        .query(String.class)
                        .list();

        assertThat(fields)
                .containsExactlyInAnyOrder(
                        "CANONICAL_FULL_NAME",
                        "BIRTH_DATE",
                        "NATIONALITY",
                        "TRANSFERMARKT_PLAYER_ID"
                );

        assertThat(fields)
                .doesNotContain(
                        "HEIGHT_CM",
                        "PREFERRED_FOOT"
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldBeIdempotentAndRefreshEvidence() {

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery first =
                playerDiscovery(
                        90,
                        "First verification"
                );

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse firstResponse =
                response(first);

        int firstPersist =
                service.persist(
                        "2026/2027",
                        firstResponse
                );

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery second =
                playerDiscovery(
                        100,
                        "Second verification"
                );

        TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse secondResponse =
                response(second);

        int secondPersist =
                service.persist(
                        "2026/2027",
                        secondResponse
                );

        assertThat(firstPersist)
                .isEqualTo(6);

        assertThat(secondPersist)
                .isEqualTo(6);

        Long count =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_identity_provenance
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND source = 'TRANSFERMARKT'
                          AND source_external_id = :externalId
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", existingPlayerId)
                        .param("externalId", TEST_TM_ID)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(count)
                .isEqualTo(6L);

        String evidence =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT evidence::text
                        FROM player_identity_provenance
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND field_name = 'PREFERRED_FOOT'
                          AND source = 'TRANSFERMARKT'
                          AND source_external_id = :externalId
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", existingPlayerId)
                        .param("externalId", TEST_TM_ID)
                        .query(String.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(evidence)
                .contains("Second verification")
                .contains("\"score\": 100");
    }

    private TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery playerDiscovery(
            int score,
            String reason
    ) {
        return new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery(
                existingPlayerId,
                "B65 Test Player",
                "Roma",
                "MATCHED_VERIFIED",
                score,
                TEST_TM_ID,
                "B65 Test Player",
                "https://www.transfermarkt.com/b65-test/profil/spieler/"
                        + TEST_TM_ID,
                "Roma",
                LocalDate.of(2000, 1, 2),
                "Italy",
                185,
                "RIGHT",
                reason
        );
    }

    private TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse response(
            TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse.PlayerDiscovery player
    ) {
        return new TransfermarktDiscoveryResponse(
                "2026/2027",
                "Roma",
                1,
                1,
                0,
                0,
                0,
                false,
                List.of(player)
        );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.identity.enrichment.transfermarkt;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class TransfermarktSearchParserTest {

    private final TransfermarktSearchParser parser =
            new TransfermarktSearchParser();

    @Test
    void extractsPlayerCandidatesAndDeduplicatesIds() {
        String html = """
                <html>
                  <body>
                    <table>
                      <tr>
                        <td>
                          <a title="Mario Rossi"
                             href="/mario-rossi/profil/spieler/123456">
                             Mario Rossi
                          </a>
                        </td>
                        <td>Atalanta BC</td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr>
                        <td>
                          <a href="/mario-rossi/profil/spieler/123456">
                             Mario Rossi
                          </a>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    </table>
                  </body>
                </html>
                """;

        var result =
                parser.parse(
                        html,
                        "https://www.transfermarkt.com/search"
                );

        assertThat(result)
                .hasSize(1);

        assertThat(result.getFirst()
                .transfermarktPlayerId())
                .isEqualTo("123456");

        assertThat(result.getFirst().name())
                .isEqualTo("Mario Rossi");

        assertThat(result.getFirst().url())
                .contains(
                        "/profil/spieler/123456"
                );

        assertThat(result.getFirst().context())
                .contains("Atalanta BC");
    }

    @Test
    void ignoresNonPlayerLinks() {
        String html = """
                <a href="/atalanta/startseite/verein/800">
                    Atalanta
                </a>
                """;

        assertThat(
                parser.parse(
                        html,
                        "https://www.transfermarkt.com/"
                )
        ).isEmpty();
    }
}

class TransfermarktVerifiedIdentityOverrideTest {

    @Test

        String displayName = "Aurelio";
        String club = "Cagliari";
        String season = "2026/2027";

        OverrideIdentity override = new OverrideIdentity(
                season,
                club,
                displayName,
                "Giuseppe Aurelio",
                LocalDate.of(2000, 3, 22),
                "457444");

        String canonicalFullName = null;
        LocalDate birthDate = null;
        String transfermarktPlayerId = null;

        String effectiveCanonicalFullName = canonicalFullName != null
                ? canonicalFullName
                : override.canonicalFullName();

        LocalDate effectiveBirthDate = birthDate != null
                ? birthDate
                : override.birthDate();

        String effectiveTransfermarktPlayerId = transfermarktPlayerId != null
                ? transfermarktPlayerId
                : override.transfermarktPlayerId();

        assertThat(effectiveCanonicalFullName)
                .isEqualTo("Giuseppe Aurelio");

        assertThat(effectiveBirthDate)
                .isEqualTo(LocalDate.of(2000, 3, 22));

        assertThat(effectiveTransfermarktPlayerId)
                .isEqualTo("457444");
    }

                "2026/2027",

                LocalDate.of(2000, 3, 22),
                "457444");

        String canonicalFullName = "Existing Canonical Name";
        LocalDate birthDate = LocalDate.of(1999, 1, 1);
        String transfermarktPlayerId = "999999";

        String effectiveCanonicalFullName = canonicalFullName != null
                ? canonicalFullName
                : override.canonicalFullName();

        LocalDate effectiveBirthDate = birthDate != null
                ? birthDate
                : override.birthDate();

        String effectiveTransfermarktPlayerId = transfermarktPlayerId != null
                ? transfermarktPlayerId
                : override.transfermarktPlayerId();

        assertThat(effectiveCanonicalFullName)
                .isEqualTo("Existing Canonical Name");

        assertThat(effectiveBirthDate)
                .isEqualTo(LocalDate.of(1999, 1, 1));

        assertThat(effectiveTransfermarktPlayerId)
                .isEqualTo("999999");
    }

    @Test
    void verifiedOverridesContainAllThreeCertifiedPlayers() {
        OverrideIdentity aurelio = new OverrideIdentity(
                "2026/2027",
                "Cagliari",
                "Aurelio",
                "Giuseppe Aurelio",
                LocalDate.of(2000, 3, 22),
                "457444");

        OverrideIdentity penev = new OverrideIdentity(
                "2026/2027",
                "Lecce",
                "Penev",
                "Plamen Penev",

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.importer.admin;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

@SpringBootTest
class ImportBatchAdminServiceTest {

    private static final String TEST_FILENAME =
            "admin-import-history-test.csv";

    @Autowired
    private ImportBatchAdminService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @AfterEach
    void cleanup() {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                DELETE FROM import_batches
                WHERE original_filename = :filename
                """)
                .param(
                        "filename",
                        TEST_FILENAME
                )
                .update();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldFilterAndReturnImportBatches() {

        Long batchId = createBatch();

        ImportBatchPageResponse response =
                service.findBatches(
                        "fantacalcio",
                        "2024/2025",
                        "completed",
                        0,
                        20
                );

        assertThat(response.content())
                .extracting(
                        ImportBatchSummaryResponse::id
                )
                .contains(batchId);

        ImportBatchSummaryResponse batch =
                response.content()
                        .stream()
                        .filter(item ->
                                item.id().equals(batchId)
                        )
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow();

        assertThat(batch.source())
                .isEqualTo("FANTACALCIO");

        assertThat(batch.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(batch.totalRows())
                .isEqualTo(2);

        assertThat(batch.invalidRows())
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturnBatchDetailAndInvalidRows() {

        Long batchId = createBatch();

        createInvalidRow(batchId);

        ImportBatchDetailResponse response =
                service.findBatch(
                        batchId,
                        0,
                        50
                );

        assertThat(response.batch().id())
                .isEqualTo(batchId);

        assertThat(response.totalInvalidRows())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(response.invalidRows())
                .hasSize(1);

        assertThat(
                response.invalidRows()
                        .getFirst()
                        .validationError()
        ).contains(
                "Ruolo non valido"
        );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectInvalidFiltersAndUnknownBatch() {

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.findBatches(
                        "FONTE_ERRATA",
                        null,
                        null,
                        0,
                        20
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        BadRequestException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "Fonte non valida"
                );

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.findBatches(
                        null,
                        null,
                        "STATO_ERRATO",
                        0,
                        20
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        BadRequestException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "Stato import non valido"
                );

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.findBatch(
                        Long.MAX_VALUE,
                        0,
                        50
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        ResourceNotFoundException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "Batch import non trovato"
                );
    }

    private Long createBatch() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO import_batches (
                    source,
                    season_id,
                    original_filename,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    reconciled_rows,
                    completed_at
                )
                SELECT
                    'FANTACALCIO',
                    season.id,
                    :filename,
                    'COMPLETED',
                    2,
                    1,
                    1,
                    0,
                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                FROM seasons season
                WHERE season.code = '2024/2025'
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param(
                        "filename",
                        TEST_FILENAME
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void createInvalidRow(
            Long batchId
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_import_rows (
                    batch_id,
                    row_number,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    normalized_name,
                    club_name,
                    normalized_club_name,
                    fantasy_role,
                    valid,
                    validation_error,
                    raw_data
                )
                VALUES (
                    :batchId,
                    2,
                    'ADMIN-TEST-002',
                    'Giocatore Non Valido',
                    'giocatore non valido',
                    'Napoli',
                    'napoli',
                    NULL,
                    FALSE,
                    'Ruolo non valido: X',
                    CAST(
                        '{"role":"X"}'
                        AS JSONB
                    )
                )
                """)
                .param(
                        "batchId",
                        batchId
                )
                .update();
    }
}

                csvFile(
                        filename,
                        """
                        player,team
                        Mario Rossi,Napoli
                        """
                );

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.importCsv(
                        "GAZZETTA",
                        "2024/2025",
                        file
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        BadRequestException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "Colonne obbligatorie mancanti"
                );

        Map<String, Object> batch =
                findLatestBatchByFilename(
                        filename
                );

        assertThat(batch.get("status"))
                .isEqualTo("FAILED");

        assertThat(
                String.valueOf(
                        batch.get(
                                "error_message"
                        )
                )
        ).contains(
                "Colonne obbligatorie mancanti"
        );

        assertThat(
                ((Number) batch.get(
                        "total_rows"
                )).intValue()
        ).isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldPreserveFailedBatchForEmptyCsv() {

        String filename =
                TEST_FILE_PREFIX
                        + "empty.csv";

        MockMultipartFile file =
                csvFile(
                        filename,
                        """
                        external_id,name,club,role,quotation,fmv
                        """
                );

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.importCsv(
                        "FANTAMARKT",
                        "2024/2025",
                        file
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        BadRequestException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "non contiene righe dati"
                );

        Map<String, Object> batch =
                findLatestBatchByFilename(
                        filename
                );

        assertThat(batch.get("status"))
                .isEqualTo("FAILED");

        assertThat(
                String.valueOf(
                        batch.get(
                                "error_message"
                        )
                )
        ).contains(
                "non contiene righe dati"
        );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectInvalidSourceBeforeCreatingBatch() {

        String filename =
                TEST_FILE_PREFIX
                        + "invalid-source.csv";

        MockMultipartFile file =
                csvFile(
                        filename,
                        """
                        external_id,name,club,role
                        TEST-001,Giocatore Test,Napoli,A
                        """
                );

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.importCsv(
                        "SORGENTE_INESISTENTE",
                        "2024/2025",
                        file
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        BadRequestException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "Fonte non valida"
                );

        Integer batches =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
                        FROM import_batches
                        WHERE original_filename =
                            :filename
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "filename",
                                filename
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(batches)
                .isZero();
    }

    private MockMultipartFile csvFile(
            String filename,
            String content
    ) {
        return new MockMultipartFile(
                "file",
                filename,
                "text/csv",
                content.getBytes(
                        StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                )
        );
    }

    private Map<String, Object> findBatch(
            Long batchId
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    id,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    error_message
                FROM import_batches
                WHERE id = :batchId
                """)
                .param(
                        "batchId",
                        batchId
                )
                .query()
                .singleRow();
    }

    private Map<String, Object>
            findLatestBatchByFilename(
                    String filename
            ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT
                    id,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    error_message
                FROM import_batches
                WHERE original_filename =
                    :filename
                ORDER BY id DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param(
                        "filename",
                        filename
                )
                .query()
                .singleRow();
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verifyNoInteractions;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.refresh.DataRefreshService;

class AutomatedDataUpdateServiceTest {

    @Test
    void disabledPreservesRefreshOnly() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = new SourceIngestionProperties();
        SourceIngestionService ingestion = mock(SourceIngestionService.class);
        DataRefreshService refresh = mock(DataRefreshService.class);

        new AutomatedDataUpdateService(properties, ingestion, refresh).run("2026/2027");

        verify(refresh).runScheduled("2026/2027");
        verifyNoInteractions(ingestion);
    }

    @Test
    void requiredFailurePreventsRefresh() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabledProperties();
        SourceIngestionService ingestion = mock(SourceIngestionService.class);
        DataRefreshService refresh = mock(DataRefreshService.class);
        when(ingestion.ingestAll("s")).thenReturn(List.of(result("FAILED", true)));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new AutomatedDataUpdateService(
                properties, ingestion, refresh
        ).run("s")).isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);

        verifyNoInteractions(refresh);
    }

    @Test
    void optionalFailureAndUnchangedRequiredAllowRefresh() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabledProperties();
        SourceIngestionService ingestion = mock(SourceIngestionService.class);
        DataRefreshService refresh = mock(DataRefreshService.class);
        when(ingestion.ingestAll("s")).thenReturn(List.of(
                result("FAILED", false),
                result("SKIPPED_UNCHANGED", true)
        ));

        new AutomatedDataUpdateService(properties, ingestion, refresh).run("s");

        verify(refresh).runScheduled("s");
    }

    @Test
    void zeroFeedsCannotSilentlyRefresh() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabledProperties();
        SourceIngestionService ingestion = mock(SourceIngestionService.class);
        DataRefreshService refresh = mock(DataRefreshService.class);
        when(ingestion.ingestAll("s")).thenThrow(new BadRequestException("Nessun feed"));

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new AutomatedDataUpdateService(
                properties, ingestion, refresh
        ).run("s")).isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class);

        verifyNoInteractions(refresh);
    }

    private SourceIngestionProperties enabledProperties() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = new SourceIngestionProperties();
        properties.setEnabled(true);
        return properties;
    }

    private SourceIngestionResponse result(String status, boolean required) {
        return new SourceIngestionResponse(
                1L, "f", "PLAYERS", "FANTACALCIO", "s", status,
                null, null, null, null, null, null, null, required
        );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@SpringBootTest(
        properties = {
                "app.data-refresh.scheduler.enabled=false",
                "app.production-automation.stale-threshold=1s"
        }
)
class AutomationRunServiceIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired
    private AutomationRunService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbc;

    @BeforeEach
    void clean() {

        jdbc.sql("""
                DELETE FROM automation_runs
                """)
                .update();
    }

    @Test
    void completedRunPersistsCompleteExecutionState() {

        long runId =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        service.stage(
                runId,
                "LISTONE"
        );

        service.stage(
                runId,
                "INGESTION"
        );

        service.stage(
                runId,
                "REFRESH"
        );

        service.complete(
                runId,
                101L,
                3,
                202L
        );

        AutomationRunResponse latest =
                service.latest(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(latest.id())
                .isEqualTo(runId);

        assertThat(latest.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(latest.stage())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(latest.listoneRunId())
                .isEqualTo(101L);

        assertThat(latest.ingestionRunCount())
                .isEqualTo(3);

        assertThat(latest.refreshRunId())
                .isEqualTo(202L);

        assertThat(latest.completedAt())
                .isNotNull();

        assertThat(latest.errorMessage())
                .isNull();
    }

    @Test
    void databasePreventsConcurrentAutomationForSameSeason() {

        long first =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        ConflictException.class
                );

        service.fail(
                first,
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "test cleanup"
                )
        );
    }

    @Test
    void staleRunIsFailedAndCanBeReplaced() {

        long stale =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        jdbc.sql("""
                UPDATE automation_runs
                SET last_heartbeat_at =
                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 seconds'
                WHERE id = :id
                """)
                .param("id", stale)
                .update();

        long replacement =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(replacement)
                .isNotEqualTo(stale);

        String oldStatus =
                jdbc.sql("""
                        SELECT status
                        FROM automation_runs
                        WHERE id = :id
                        """)
                        .param("id", stale)
                        .query(String.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(oldStatus)
                .isEqualTo("FAILED");

        service.fail(
                replacement,
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "test cleanup"
                )
        );
    }

    @Test
    void failureIsPersistedAndSanitized() {

        long runId =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        service.stage(
                runId,
                "LISTONE"
        );

        service.fail(
                runId,
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "https://example.test/feed?api_key=SUPER_SECRET"
                )
        );

        AutomationRunResponse latest =
                service.latest(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(latest.status())
                .isEqualTo("FAILED");

        assertThat(latest.stage())
                .isEqualTo("LISTONE");

        assertThat(latest.completedAt())
                .isNotNull();

        assertThat(latest.errorMessage())
                .doesNotContain(
                        "SUPER_SECRET"
                );
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

@SpringBootTest(
        properties = {
                "app.data-refresh.scheduler.enabled=false",
                "app.source-ingestion.enabled=false",
                "app.fantacalcio-listone.enabled=false",
                "app.production-automation.stale-threshold=2h"
        }
)
class B71AutomationRetryPolicyIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired
    private AutomationRunService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbc;

    @BeforeEach
    void cleanAutomationRuns() {

        jdbc.sql("""
                DELETE FROM automation_runs
                """)
                .update();
    }

    @Test
    void failedExecutionCanBeRetriedAndLeavesNoRunningResidue() {

        long first =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        service.stage(
                first,
                "REFRESH"
        );

        service.fail(
                first,
                new IllegalStateException(
                        "first execution failed"
                )
        );

        String firstStatus =
                status(first);

        assertThat(firstStatus)
                .isEqualTo("FAILED");

        long retry =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(retry)
                .isNotEqualTo(first);

        service.stage(
                retry,
                "REFRESH"
        );

        service.complete(
                retry,
                null,
                0,
                9001L
        );

        AutomationRunResponse latest =
                service.latest(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(latest.id())
                .isEqualTo(retry);

        assertThat(latest.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(latest.stage())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(latest.refreshRunId())
                .isEqualTo(9001L);

        assertThat(latest.completedAt())
                .isNotNull();

        assertThat(runningCount())
                .isZero();

        assertThat(totalCount())
                .isEqualTo(2);
    }

    @Test
    void completedHistoryDoesNotPreventLaterExecution() {

        long first =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        service.complete(
                first,
                null,
                0,
                8001L
        );

        long second =
                service.begin(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(second)
                .isGreaterThan(first);

        service.complete(
                second,
                null,
                0,
                8002L
        );

        assertThat(runningCount())
                .isZero();

        assertThat(totalCount())
                .isEqualTo(2);
    }

    private String status(
            long id
    ) {

        return jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT status
                FROM automation_runs
                WHERE id = :id
                """)
                .param("id", id)
                .query(String.class)
                .single();
    }

    private int runningCount() {

        return jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM automation_runs
                WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
                """)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }

    private int totalCount() {

        return jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM automation_runs
                """)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

class RemoteCsvClientTest {

    private HttpServer server;
    private SourceIngestionProperties properties;
    private String baseUrl;

    @BeforeEach
    void start() throws Exception {
        server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
        server.start();
        baseUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort();
        properties = new SourceIngestionProperties();
        properties.setAllowHttp(true);
        properties.setAllowPrivateHosts(true);
        properties.setMaxBytes(64);
    }

    @AfterEach
    void stop() {
        server.stop(0);
    }

    @Test
    void downloadsValidCsv() {
        route("/ok", 200, "a,b\n1,2\n");
        RemoteCsvClient.FetchResult result = new RemoteCsvClient(properties)
                .fetch(baseUrl + "/ok");
        assertThat(new String(result.bytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).contains("1,2");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsNon2xx() {
        route("/bad", 503, "no");
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch(baseUrl + "/bad"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("503");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsEmpty() {
        route("/empty", 200, "");
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch(baseUrl + "/empty"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("vuoto");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsOversize() {
        route("/large", 200, "x".repeat(65));
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch(baseUrl + "/large"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("limite");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsObviousHtmlResponse() {
        server.createContext("/html", exchange -> {
            byte[] body = "<html>login</html>".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().add("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, body.length);
            exchange.getResponseBody().write(body);
            exchange.close();
        });
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch(baseUrl + "/html"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("HTML");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsInvalidSchemeAndPrivateHostByDefault() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch("file:///tmp/a"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class);

        properties.setAllowPrivateHosts(false);
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch(baseUrl + "/ok"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("privato");
    }

    @Test
    void redirectTargetIsRevalidated() {
        server.createContext("/redirect", exchange -> {
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().add("Location", "file:///tmp/x");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(302, -1);
            exchange.close();
        });
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> new RemoteCsvClient(properties).fetch(baseUrl + "/redirect"))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class);
    }

    private void route(String path, int status, String content) {
        server.createContext(path, exchange -> {
            byte[] body = content.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, body.length);
            exchange.getResponseBody().write(body);
            exchange.close();
        });
    }
}
