package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatCode;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class SourceIngestionPropertiesTest {

    @Test
    void disabledConfigurationDoesNotRequireFeeds() {
        assertThatCode(new SourceIngestionProperties()::validateEnabledConfiguration).doesNotThrowAnyException();
    }

    @Test
    void enabledConfigurationRequiresAtLeastOneEnabledFeed() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabled();
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration).hasMessageContaining("almeno un feed");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsDuplicateIdsAndMalformedFeed() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabled();
        SourceIngestionProperties.Feed first = feed("players");
        SourceIngestionProperties.Feed second = feed(" PLAYERS ");
        properties.setFeeds(List.of(first, second));
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration).hasMessageContaining("duplicato");

        first.setType("UNKNOWN");
        properties.setFeeds(List.of(first));
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration).hasMessageContaining("tipo feed");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsInvalidLimitsAndTimeouts() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabled();
        properties.setFeeds(List.of(feed("players")));
        properties.setMaxBytes(0);
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration).hasMessageContaining("max-bytes");
        properties.setMaxBytes(1);
        properties.setMaxRedirects(-1);
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration).hasMessageContaining("max-redirects");
        properties.setMaxRedirects(0);
        properties.setConnectTimeout(Duration.ZERO);
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration).hasMessageContaining("connect-timeout");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsZeroAndNegativeRequestTimeout() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = validEnabled();
        properties.setRequestTimeout(Duration.ZERO);
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("request-timeout");

        properties.setRequestTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(-1));
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("request-timeout");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsUnsafeFilename() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = validEnabled();
        properties.getFeeds().getFirst().setFilename("../../feed.csv");
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("filename");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsMalformedUrlAndUnsupportedScheme() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = validEnabled();
        properties.getFeeds().getFirst().setUrl("https://exa mple.test/feed.csv");
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("URL feed");

        properties.getFeeds().getFirst().setUrl("ftp://example.test/feed.csv");
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("schema URL");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsBlankSourceSeasonAndUrl() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = validEnabled();
        SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed = properties.getFeeds().getFirst();

        feed.setSource(" ");
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("source");

        feed.setSource("FANTACALCIO");
        feed.setSeason("");
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("season");

        feed.setSeason("2026/2027");
        feed.setUrl(" ");
        assertThatThrownBy(properties::validateEnabledConfiguration)
                .hasMessageContaining("url");
    }

    private SourceIngestionProperties enabled() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = new SourceIngestionProperties();
        properties.setEnabled(true);
        return properties;
    }

    private SourceIngestionProperties validEnabled() {
        SourceIngestionProperties properties = enabled();
        properties.setFeeds(new java.util.ArrayList<>(List.of(feed("players"))));
        return properties;
    }

    private SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed(String id) {
        SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed = new SourceIngestionProperties.Feed();
        feed.setId(id);
        feed.setType("PLAYERS");
        feed.setSource("FANTACALCIO");
        feed.setSeason("2026/2027");
        feed.setUrl("https://example.test/feed.csv");
        return feed;
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@SpringBootTest
class SourceIngestionRecoveryConcurrencyTest {

    @Autowired SourceIngestionService service;
    @Autowired SourceIngestionProperties properties;
    @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc;
    Long seasonId;
    SourceIngestionProperties.Feed feed;

    @BeforeEach
    void setup() {
        seasonId = jdbc.sql("SELECT id FROM seasons WHERE code='2026/2027'").query(Long.class).single();
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM source_ingestion_runs WHERE feed_id='recovery-feed'").update();
        properties.setAllowHttp(true);
        properties.setAllowPrivateHosts(true);
        properties.setStaleThreshold(Duration.ofSeconds(1));
        feed = new SourceIngestionProperties.Feed();
        feed.setId("recovery-feed"); feed.setType("PLAYERS"); feed.setSource("FANTACALCIO");
        feed.setSeason("2026/2027"); feed.setUrl("http://127.0.0.1/feed.csv");
    }

    @AfterEach
    void removeRuns() {
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM source_ingestion_runs WHERE feed_id='recovery-feed'").update();
    }

    @Test
    void recentStartedRemainsBlocking() {
        insertStarted("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP");
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.start(feed, seasonId)).isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void staleStartedIsFailedCompletedAndReplaced() {
        Long stale = insertStarted("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 seconds'");
        service.start(feed, seasonId);
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT status='FAILED' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
                       AND error_message='Ingestion interrotta recuperata automaticamente'
                FROM source_ingestion_runs WHERE id=:id
                """).param("id", stale).query(Boolean.class).single()).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentRecoveryLeavesAtMostOneStarted() throws Exception {
        insertStarted("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 seconds'");
        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(2); CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);
        try (var executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)) {
            var first = executor.submit(() -> attempt(ready, start));
            var second = executor.submit(() -> attempt(ready, start));
            ready.await(); start.countDown(); first.get(); second.get();
        }
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_ingestion_runs WHERE feed_id='recovery-feed' AND status='STARTED'")
                .query(Integer.class).single()).isEqualTo(1);
    }

    private Object attempt(CountDownLatch ready, CountDownLatch start) {
        try { ready.countDown(); start.await(); return service.start(feed, seasonId); }
        catch (Exception exception) { return exception; }
    }

    private Long insertStarted(String expression) {
        return jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO source_ingestion_runs(
                    feed_id,feed_type,source,season_id,sanitized_url,status,started_at
                ) VALUES('recovery-feed','PLAYERS','FANTACALCIO',:season,'http://127.0.0.1/feed.csv','STARTED',%s)
                RETURNING id
                """.formatted(expression)).param("season", seasonId).query(Long.class).single();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class SourceIngestionSanitizationTest {

    @Test
    void redactsBearerAuthorizationHeader() {
        assertThat(safe("Authorization: Bearer SUPER_SECRET"))
                .doesNotContain("Bearer", "SUPER_SECRET")
                .contains("[REDACTED]");
    }

    @Test
    void redactsBasicAuthorizationValue() {
        assertThat(safe("authorization=Basic ABCDEF"))
                .doesNotContain("Basic", "ABCDEF")
                .contains("[REDACTED]");
    }

    @Test
    void redactsPostgresqlJdbcUrl() {
        assertThat(safe("jdbc:postgresql://db-user:db-pass@secret-host:5432/prod"))
                .doesNotContain("db-pass", "secret-host", "jdbc:postgresql")
                .isEqualTo("[REDACTED]");
    }

    @Test
    void stripsHttpUrlUserInfoQueryAndFragment() {
        String sanitized = safe(
                "https://user:pass@example.test/feed.csv?api_key=SUPER_SECRET#frag"
        );
        assertThat(sanitized)
                .isEqualTo("https://example.test/feed.csv")
                .doesNotContain("user", "pass", "SUPER_SECRET", "frag");
    }

    @Test
    void redactsSensitiveKeyValue() {
        assertThat(safe("password=SUPER_SECRET"))
                .isEqualTo("password=[REDACTED]");
    }

    @Test
    void preservesOrdinarySafeMessage() {
        assertThat(safe("Import CSV fallito per struttura non valida"))
                .isEqualTo("Import CSV fallito per struttura non valida");
    }

    private String safe(String message) {
        return SourceIngestionService.safe(new IllegalStateException(message));
    }
}

    }

        feed.setType(type);
        feed.setSource(source);

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatCode;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verifyNoInteractions;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.catalog.readiness.CatalogReadinessResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.catalog.readiness.CatalogReadinessService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

class IntelligenceCatalogPolicyTest {
    private final CatalogReadinessService readiness = mock(CatalogReadinessService.class);
    private final IntelligenceCatalogPolicy policy = new IntelligenceCatalogPolicy(readiness);

    @Test
    void blockedCurrentCatalogPreventsPremiumCalculation() {
        CatalogReadinessResponse response = mock(CatalogReadinessResponse.class);
        when(response.status()).thenReturn("BLOCKED");
        when(readiness.evaluateLatest("2026/2027")).thenReturn(response);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> policy.assertReadable("2026/2027", true))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class).hasMessageContaining("BLOCKED");
    }

    @Test
    void readyCurrentCatalogAllowsPremiumCalculation() {
        CatalogReadinessResponse response = mock(CatalogReadinessResponse.class);
        when(response.status()).thenReturn("READY");
        when(readiness.evaluateLatest("2026/2027")).thenReturn(response);

        assertThatCode(() -> policy.assertReadable("2026/2027", true)).doesNotThrowAnyException();
    }

    @Test
    void historicalProfileDoesNotRequireCurrentCatalogGate() {
        assertThatCode(() -> policy.assertReadable("2025/2026", false)).doesNotThrowAnyException();
        verifyNoInteractions(readiness);
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence.PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator.CalculatedProfile;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence.PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator.SeasonData;

class PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculatorTest {

    private final PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator calculator = new PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator();

    @Test
    void calculatesCompleteExplainableDeterministicProfileInRange() {
        SeasonData current = data("2026/2027", "C", 30, 24, 2300, 8, 7, 5, 0, 1, "6.25", "6.90");
        SeasonData previous = data("2025/2026", "C", 32, 20, 2100, 5, 5, 7, 1, 0, "6.10", "6.45");

        CalculatedProfile first = calculator.calculate(current, previous);
        CalculatedProfile second = calculator.calculate(current, previous);

        assertThat(first).isEqualTo(second);
        assertThat(first.completeness()).isEqualByComparingTo("100.00");
        assertThat(first.confidence()).isEqualTo("HIGH");
        assertThat(first.starter().score()).isBetween(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal.valueOf(100));
        assertThat(first.reliability().score()).isBetween(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal.valueOf(100));
        assertThat(first.bonus().components()).containsKeys("goalsPer90", "assistsPer90");
        assertThat(first.bonus().reasons()).isNotEmpty();
        assertThat(first.malus().components()).containsKeys("yellowCardRisk", "redCardRisk", "penaltyMissRisk");
        assertThat(first.trend().score()).isGreaterThan(BigDecimal.valueOf(50));
        assertThat(first.consistency().score()).isNull();
        assertThat(first.consistency().limitations()).singleElement().asString().contains("partita-per-partita");
    }

    @Test
    void missingDataIsUnavailableRatherThanLowScore() {
        SeasonData sparse = data("2026/2027", "A", null, null, null, null, null,
                null, null, null, null, null);
        CalculatedProfile result = calculator.calculate(sparse, null);

        assertThat(result.completeness()).isZero();
        assertThat(result.confidence()).isEqualTo("LOW");
        assertThat(result.starter().score()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.bonus().score()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.trend().score()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.trend().confidence()).isEqualTo("UNAVAILABLE");
    }

    @Test
    void bonusPotentialIsRoleAware() {
        SeasonData defender = data("2026/2027", "D", 30, 30, 2700, 5, 3, 3, 0, 0, null, null);
        SeasonData attacker = data("2026/2027", "A", 30, 30, 2700, 5, 3, 3, 0, 0, null, null);

        assertThat(calculator.calculate(defender, null).bonus().score())
                .isGreaterThan(calculator.calculate(attacker, null).bonus().score());
    }

    @Test
    void zeroMinutesDoesNotDivideByZero() {
        SeasonData data = data("2026/2027", "P", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, null, null);
        CalculatedProfile result = calculator.calculate(data, null);
        assertThat(result.starter().score()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.bonus().score()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.malus().score()).isNull();
    }

    private SeasonData data(String season, String role, Integer appearances, Integer starts, Integer minutes,
            Integer goals, Integer assists, Integer yellow, Integer red, Integer missed,
            String average, String fantasyAverage) {
        return new SeasonData(season, role, appearances, starts, minutes, goals, assists, yellow, red, missed,
                average == null ? null : new BigDecimal(average),
                fantasyAverage == null ? null : new BigDecimal(fantasyAverage));
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.intelligence.PlayerIntelligenceProfileCalculator.SeasonData;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class PlayerIntelligenceProfileSourcePolicyTest {
    @Autowired private JdbcClient jdbcClient;
    @Autowired private PlayerIntelligenceProfileService service;

    @Test
    void fbrefIsPrimaryForObjectivesButNeverForRatingsOrFantasyRole() {
        Long playerId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO players (last_name, display_name, normalized_name, active)
                VALUES ('Policy', 'FBref Policy Test', 'fbref policy test', TRUE) RETURNING id
                """).query(Long.class).single();
        Long seasonId = jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id FROM seasons WHERE code = '2025/2026'")
                .query(Long.class).single();
        Long clubId = jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id FROM clubs ORDER BY id LIMIT 1").query(Long.class).single();
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_roles (player_id, season_id, source, fantasy_role)
                VALUES (:playerId, :seasonId, 'FANTACALCIO', 'D')
                """).param("playerId", playerId).param("seasonId", seasonId).update();
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_season_statistics (
                    player_id, club_id, season_id, source, appearances, starts, minutes_played,
                    goals, assists, yellow_cards, red_cards, penalties_missed,
                    average_rating, fantasy_average)
                VALUES
                    (:playerId, :clubId, :seasonId, 'FANTACALCIO', 20, 10, 1000, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0, 6.20, 6.55),
                    (:playerId, NULL, :seasonId, 'FBREF', 30, 25, 2400, 5, 4, 6, 1, 1, 9.99, 19.99)
                """).param("playerId", playerId).param("clubId", clubId).param("seasonId", seasonId).update();

        SeasonData data = service.loadHistory(playerId, 2025).getFirst();
        assertThat(data.appearances()).isEqualTo(30);
        assertThat(data.starts()).isEqualTo(25);
        assertThat(data.goals()).isEqualTo(5);
        assertThat(data.role()).isEqualTo("D");
        assertThat(data.averageRating()).isEqualByComparingTo(new BigDecimal("6.20"));
        assertThat(data.fantasyAverage()).isEqualByComparingTo(new BigDecimal("6.55"));
    }
}

    private Long findEligiblePlayerId() {
        Map<String, Object> player =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT
                            player.id AS player_id,
                            season.id AS season_id,
                            role.fantasy_role,
                            role.tactical_role

                        FROM players player

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                            AND registration.registration_status =
                                'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = registration.season_id

                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                            AND role.season_id = season.id

                        WHERE player.active = TRUE
                          AND season.code = '2026/2027'

                        ORDER BY
                            CASE
                                WHEN role.source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                                    THEN 0
                                ELSE 1
                            END,
                            player.id

                        LIMIT 1
                        """)
                        .query()
                        .singleRow();

        Long playerId =
                ((Number) player.get("player_id"))
                        .longValue();

        Long seasonId =
                ((Number) player.get("season_id"))
                        .longValue();

        String fantasyRole =
                player.get("fantasy_role").toString();

        Object tacticalRole =
                player.get("tactical_role");

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_roles (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    source,
                    fantasy_role,
                    tactical_role,
                    primary_role,
                    valid_from
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    'FANTACALCIO',
                    :fantasyRole,
                    :tacticalRole,
                    TRUE,
                    DATE '2026-07-01'
                )
                ON CONFLICT (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    source
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    fantasy_role =
                        EXCLUDED.fantasy_role,

                    tactical_role =
                        EXCLUDED.tactical_role,

                    primary_role = TRUE,

                    valid_from =
                        EXCLUDED.valid_from
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("fantasyRole", fantasyRole)
                .param("tacticalRole", tacticalRole)
                .update();

        return playerId;
    }
    private Long findSeasonId() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = '2026/2027'
                """)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void insertScoutingReport(Long playerId) {
        Long seasonId = findSeasonId();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO foreign_player_scouting_reports (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    previous_club,
                    previous_league,
                    previous_country_code,
                    transfer_type,
                    adaptation_score,
                    potential_score,
                    risk_score,
                    confidence_score,
                    recommendation,
                    scouting_summary
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    'Ajax',
                    'Eredivisie',
                    'NL',
                    'PERMANENT',
                    85,
                    90,
                    25,
                    80,
                    'HIGH_PRIORITY',
                    'Ottimo potenziale e buon adattamento '
                        || 'previsto alla Serie A.'
                )
                ON CONFLICT (
                    player_id,
                    season_id
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    previous_club = 'Ajax',
                    previous_league = 'Eredivisie',
                    previous_country_code = 'NL',
                    transfer_type = 'PERMANENT',
                    adaptation_score = 85,
                    potential_score = 90,
                    risk_score = 25,
                    confidence_score = 80,
                    recommendation = 'HIGH_PRIORITY',
                    scouting_summary =
                        'Ottimo potenziale e buon adattamento '
                        || 'previsto alla Serie A.',
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();
    }

    private void insertAvailability(
            Long playerId,
            int matchday,
            String status,
            int startingProbability,
            int availabilityProbability,
            String injuryDescription
    ) {
        Long seasonId = findSeasonId();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_availabilities (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    matchday,
                    status,
                    starting_probability,
                    availability_probability,
                    injury_description,
                    source
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :matchday,
                    :status,
                    :startingProbability,
                    :availabilityProbability,
                    :injuryDescription,
                    'MANUAL'
                )
                ON CONFLICT (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    matchday
                )
                DO UPDATE SET
                    status = EXCLUDED.status,
                    starting_probability =
                        EXCLUDED.starting_probability,
                    availability_probability =
                        EXCLUDED.availability_probability,
                    injury_description =
                        EXCLUDED.injury_description,
                    source = EXCLUDED.source,
                    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("matchday", matchday)
                .param("status", status)
                .param(
                        "startingProbability",
                        startingProbability
                )
                .param(
                        "availabilityProbability",
                        availabilityProbability
                )
                .param(
                        "injuryDescription",
                        injuryDescription
                )
                .update();
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.lineup;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class B68LineupScorerTest {

    private final B68LineupScorer scorer =
            new B68LineupScorer();

    @Test
    void shouldCalculateDeterministicCompleteOutfieldScore() {

        B68LineupScorer.Input input =
                new B68LineupScorer.Input(
                        "A",
                        90.0,
                        80.0,
                        95.0,
                        70.0,
                        new BigDecimal("85"),
                        new BigDecimal("100"),
                        "AVAILABLE",
                        new BigDecimal("40"),
                        new BigDecimal("90"),
                        2
                );

        B68LineupScorer.ScoreResult first =
                scorer.score(input);

        B68LineupScorer.ScoreResult second =
                scorer.score(input);

        assertThat(first)
                .isEqualTo(second);

        assertThat(first.selectionScore())
                .isNotNull()
                .isBetween(
                        BigDecimal.ZERO,
                        new BigDecimal("100")
                );

        assertThat(first.performanceScore())
                .isEqualByComparingTo("85.00");

        assertThat(first.fixtureScore())
                .isEqualByComparingTo("60.00");

        assertThat(first.performanceSignalCount())
                .isEqualTo(4);

        assertThat(first.domainSignalCount())
                .isEqualTo(4);

        assertThat(first.evidenceTier())
                .isEqualTo("HIGH");

        assertThat(first.actionable())
                .isTrue();

        assertThat(first.exclusionReason())
                .isNull();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldOmitMissingSignalsInsteadOfInventingNeutralValues() {

        B68LineupScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        new B68LineupScorer.Input(
                                "C",
                                80.0,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                "UNKNOWN",
                                new BigDecimal("40"),
                                new BigDecimal("75"),
                                1
                        )
                );

        assertThat(result.performanceScore())
                .isEqualByComparingTo("80.00");

        assertThat(result.fixtureScore())
                .isEqualByComparingTo("60.00");

        /*
         * Only real performance + fixture evidence:
         * (80 * .45 + 60 * .10) / .55
         */
        assertThat(result.selectionScore())
                .isEqualByComparingTo("76.36");

        assertThat(result.domainSignalCount())
                .isEqualTo(2);

        assertThat(result.evidenceTier())
                .isEqualTo("LOW");

        assertThat(result.actionable())
                .isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldAllowMarketNewcomerToBeRankedFromRealCurrentSignalsOnly() {

        B68LineupScorer.ScoreResult result =
                scorer.score(
                        new B68LineupScorer.Input(
                                "P",
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                null,
                                new BigDecimal("70"),
                                new BigDecimal("100"),
                                "AVAILABLE",
                                new BigDecimal("55"),
                                BigDecimal.ZERO,
                                0
                        )
                );

        assertThat(result.performanceScore())
                .isNull();

        assertThat(result.performanceSignalCount())

        assertThat(result.selectionScore())
                .isNotNull();

        assertThat(result.evidenceTier())
                .isEqualTo("LOW");

        assertThat(result.actionable())
                .isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldCreateCompleteRecommendedLineup() {
        RecommendedLineupResponse response =
                recommendedLineupService.recommend(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(response).isNotNull();
        assertThat(response.squadId()).isNotNull();
        assertThat(response.complete()).isTrue();
        assertThat(response.selectedPlayers()).isEqualTo(11);
        assertThat(response.starters()).hasSize(11);
        assertThat(response.formation()).isNotBlank();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRespectMaximumSubstitutionLimit() {
        RecommendedLineupResponse response =
                recommendedLineupService.recommend(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1,
                        "18,3,12,5,7"
                );

        assertThat(response.maxSubstitutions()).isEqualTo(3);
        assertThat(response.usedSubstitutions()).isEqualTo(3);
        assertThat(response.remainingSubstitutions()).isZero();
        assertThat(response.substitutions()).hasSize(3);
        assertThat(response.warnings())
                .contains(
                        "Limite massimo di 3 sostituzioni raggiunto."
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldKeepAllSubstitutionsAvailableWithoutAbsences() {
        RecommendedLineupResponse response =
                recommendedLineupService.recommend(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(response.usedSubstitutions()).isZero();
        assertThat(response.remainingSubstitutions())
                .isEqualTo(response.maxSubstitutions());
        assertThat(response.substitutions()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(response.warnings())
                .doesNotContain(
                        "Limite massimo di 3 sostituzioni raggiunto."
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldIgnoreUnknownOrNonStarterPlayerIds() {
        RecommendedLineupResponse response =
                recommendedLineupService.recommend(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1,
                        "999999,22"
                );

        assertThat(response.complete()).isTrue();
        assertThat(response.usedSubstitutions()).isZero();
        assertThat(response.substitutions()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(response.remainingSubstitutions())
                .isEqualTo(response.maxSubstitutions());
    }

    @Test
    void shouldUseOneSubstitutionWithoutLimitWarning() {
        RecommendedLineupResponse initialResponse =
                recommendedLineupService.recommend(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1,
                        null
                );

        long replaceableStarterId =
                initialResponse.starters()
                        .stream()
                        .filter(starter ->
                                initialResponse.bench()
                                        .stream()
                                        .anyMatch(reserve ->
                                                reserve.role().equals(
                                                        starter.role()
                                                )
                                                        && (
                                                        reserve.availabilityStatus()
                                                                .equals("AVAILABLE")
                                                        || reserve.availabilityStatus()
                                                                .equals("PROBABLE")
                                                        || reserve.availabilityStatus()
                                                                .equals("DOUBTFUL")
                                                )
                                        )
                        )
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow()
                        .playerId();

        RecommendedLineupResponse response =
                recommendedLineupService.recommend(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1,
                        String.valueOf(
                                replaceableStarterId
                        )
                );

        assertThat(response.usedSubstitutions()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(response.remainingSubstitutions())
                .isEqualTo(

                );
        assertThat(response.substitutions()).hasSize(1);
        assertThat(response.warnings())
                .doesNotContain(
                        "Limite massimo di 3 sostituzioni raggiunto."
                );
    }

        initialResponse.bench()

                        )
                )
                .forEach(reserve ->
                        jdbcClient.sql("""

                                SET status = 'UNAVAILABLE',
                                    starting_probability = 0,
                                    availability_probability = 0
                                WHERE player_id = :playerId
                                  AND matchday = 1
                                  AND season_id = (
                                      SELECT id
                                      FROM seasons
                                      WHERE code = '2026/2027'
                                  )
                                """)
                                .param(

                                .update()
                );

        RecommendedLineupResponse response =
                recommendedLineupService.recommend(
                        "2026/2027",
                        1,
                        String.valueOf(

                        )
                );

        assertThat(response.usedSubstitutions()).isZero();
        assertThat(response.substitutions()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(response.warnings())

    @Test
    void shouldUseMaximumSubstitutionsFromSquadLeagueConfiguration() {
        Long squadId =

                        SELECT id
                        FROM fantasy_squads
                        WHERE active = TRUE
                        ORDER BY id
                        LIMIT 1
                        """)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        Integer expectedMaxSubstitutions =

                        JOIN league_configurations league
                            ON league.id =

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.CalendarCombinationResult;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.calendarintelligence.CalendarCombinationStatus;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.EvidenceStatus;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.SquadTargetResponse;

class LiveAuctionAlternativeServiceTest {
    private final LiveAuctionAlternativeService service = new LiveAuctionAlternativeService(
            new LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy());

    @Test
    void goalkeeperCalendarComplementarityCanOffsetSmallFitGap() {
        var current = evaluation(target(1, "P", 70), calendar(55, 2));
        var alternative = evaluation(target(2, "P", 66), calendar(75, 1));
        assertThat(service.dominantAlternative(current, 50, List.of(alternative)))
                .contains(alternative);
    }

    @Test
    void attackerWithWorseHardOverlapCannotDominate() {
        var current = evaluation(target(1, "A", 70), calendar(65, 1));
        var alternative = evaluation(target(2, "A", 75), calendar(70, 3));
        assertThat(service.dominantAlternative(current, 50, List.of(alternative))).isEmpty();
    }

    private LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation evaluation(SquadTargetResponse target,
            CalendarCombinationResult calendar) {
        return new LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation(target, null, calendar);
    }

    private SquadTargetResponse target(long id, String role, int fit) {
        return new SquadTargetResponse(id, "Player " + id, "Club", role, bd(80), bd(70), bd(fit),
                null, null, null, null, null, bd(75), "STARTER", bd(80),
                Map.of("B51_PRICE", EvidenceStatus.AVAILABLE), 30, 10, 35, 80,
                "TARGET", List.of());
    }

    private CalendarCombinationResult calendar(int score, int hardOverlap) {
        return new CalendarCombinationResult(List.of(1L, 2L), bd(score),
                CalendarCombinationStatus.AVAILABLE, bd(100), 5, hardOverlap,
                bd(hardOverlap * 10), 3, List.of(), 1, 5, Map.of(), List.of());
    }

    private BigDecimal bd(int value) { return BigDecimal.valueOf(value).setScale(2); }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.BoughtPlayerRequest;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.DynamicBudgetEngine;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.SquadConstructionRequest;

class LiveAuctionBudgetGuardTest {
    private final DynamicBudgetEngine b54 = new DynamicBudgetEngine();
    private final LiveAuctionBudgetGuard guard = new LiveAuctionBudgetGuard();

    @Test
    void doesNotAddFutureReserveTwice() {
        var budget = b54.calculate(new SquadConstructionRequest("2026/2027", 8, 1000, 990,
                false, "D", null, List.of(new BoughtPlayerRequest(1L, "P", 10)), 20));
        var result = guard.evaluate(budget.contextualMaximumBid(), 990, budget);
        assertThat(result.sustainable()).isTrue();
        assertThat(result.minimumCompletionReserve())
                .isEqualTo(budget.minimumCompletionReserve() - 1);
    }

    @Test
    void lastRosterSlotHasNoNonexistentFutureReserve() {
        var bought = new java.util.ArrayList<BoughtPlayerRequest>();
        long id = 1;
        for (String role : List.of("P", "P", "P", "D", "D", "D", "D", "D", "D", "D", "D",
                "C", "C", "C", "C", "C", "C", "C", "C", "A", "A", "A", "A", "A")) {
            bought.add(new BoughtPlayerRequest(id++, role, 1));
        }
        var budget = b54.calculate(new SquadConstructionRequest("2026/2027", 8, 150, 126,
                false, "A", null, bought, 20));
        assertThat(budget.futureBudgetProtected()).isZero();
        assertThat(budget.contextualMaximumBid()).isEqualTo(126);
        assertThat(guard.evaluate(126, 126, budget).sustainable()).isTrue();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.DynamicBudgetResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.EvidenceStatus;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.SquadTargetResponse;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence.StrategicSignal;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence.StrategicSignalStatus;

class LiveAuctionDecisionEngineTest {
    private final LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy policy = new LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy();
    private final LiveAuctionDecisionEngine engine = new LiveAuctionDecisionEngine(
            new LiveAuctionBudgetGuard(), new LiveAuctionAlternativeService(policy), policy);

    @Test
    void deepValueWithStrongFitIsBuyNow() {
        var response = decide(20, target(1, 40, 30, 50, 80, 85), budget(100, 50, 5), List.of());
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.ACQUISTA_ORA);
        assertThat(response.priceZone()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionPriceZone.VALUE_ZONE);
    }

    @Test
    void valueZoneBelowTargetIsRaise() {
        var response = decide(28, target(1, 40, 30, 50, 60, 85), budget(100, 50, 5), List.of());
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.RILANCIA);
    }

    @Test
    void oneCreditFromContextualMaximumIsStop() {
        var response = decide(49, target(1, 40, 30, 50, 80, 85), budget(100, 50, 5), List.of());
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.FERMATI);
    }

    @Test
    void exactTargetBoundaryRemainsValueZone() {
        var response = decide(30, target(1, 40, 30, 50, 60, 85), budget(100, 50, 5), List.of());
        assertThat(response.priceZone()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionPriceZone.VALUE_ZONE);
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.RILANCIA);
    }

    @Test
    void strictCautionInteriorIsObserveWithoutSupport() {
        var response = decide(35, target(1, 40, 30, 50, 60, 85), budget(100, 50, 5), List.of());
        assertThat(response.priceZone()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionPriceZone.CAUTION_ZONE);
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.OSSERVA);
    }

    @Test
    void contextualMaximumHasPriorityOverStrongFit() {
        var response = decide(50, target(1, 40, 30, 50, 95, 95), budget(100, 50, 5), List.of());
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.LASCIA);
    }

    @Test
    void aboveContextualMaximumIsLeave() {
        var response = decide(51, target(1, 40, 30, 50, 95, 95), budget(100, 60, 5), List.of());
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.LASCIA);
        assertThat(response.priceZone()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionPriceZone.STOP_ZONE);
    }

    @Test
    void completionReserveHasHighestPriority() {
        var response = decide(25, target(1, 40, 30, 90, 95, 95), budget(30, 90, 10), List.of());
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.LASCIA);
        assertThat(response.budget().sustainable()).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void genuinelyDominantAlternativeIsPreferredDeterministically() {
        var current = target(1, 80, 70, 95, 60, 85);
        var worseId = target(3, 45, 50, 90, 75, 80);
        var betterId = target(2, 45, 50, 90, 75, 80);
        var response = decide(80, current, budget(150, 95, 5), true,
                List.of(evaluation(worseId), evaluation(betterId)));
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.ALTERNATIVA_MIGLIORE);
        assertThat(response.alternative().playerId()).isEqualTo(2L);
    }

    @Test
    void cheaperAlternativeWithWorseFitDoesNotDominate() {
        var current = target(1, 80, 70, 95, 75, 85);
        var cheapButWrong = target(2, 40, 45, 90, 40, 80);
        var response = decide(80, current, budget(150, 95, 5), List.of(evaluation(cheapButWrong)));
        assertThat(response.action()).isNotEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.ALTERNATIVA_MIGLIORE);
    }

    @Test
    void incompleteAvailabilityNeverProducesBetterAlternative() {
        var current = target(1, 80, 70, 95, 60, 85);
        var dominant = target(2, 45, 50, 90, 75, 80);
        var response = decide(80, current, budget(150, 95, 5), false,
                List.of(evaluation(dominant)));
        assertThat(response.action()).isNotEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.ALTERNATIVA_MIGLIORE);
        assertThat(response.alternativeRecommendationAllowed()).isFalse();
        assertThat(response.warnings()).contains("Disponibilita globale alternative non certificata");
    }

    @Test
    void currentPriceIsInformativeAndProposedBidDrivesStopAndBudgetAfterBid() {
        var current = target(1, 40, 30, 50, 80, 85);
        var budget = budget(100, 50, 5);
        var request = request(10, 50, current, budget, true);
        var response = engine.decide(request, budget, List.of(), evaluation(current), List.of());
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.LASCIA);
        assertThat(response.currentPrice()).isEqualTo(10);
        assertThat(response.proposedBid()).isEqualTo(50);
        assertThat(response.evaluatedBid()).isEqualTo(50);
        assertThat(response.budgetAfterBid()).isEqualTo(50);
    }

    @Test
    void missingB56AndB57AreNotConvertedToZeroPenalty() {
        var response = decide(28, target(1, 40, 30, 50, 70, 85), budget(100, 50, 5), List.of());
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.RILANCIA);
        assertThat(response.missingInputs()).contains("B56_STRATEGIC_PROFILE", "CURRENT_MATCHDAY_FOR_B57");
    }

    @Test
    void weakEvidenceInCautionZoneProducesInsufficientEvidence() {
        var response = decide(35, target(1, 40, 30, 50, 45, 10), budget(100, 50, 5), List.of());
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE);
    }

    @Test
    void availableBonusCanSupportSelectiveRaiseInCautionZone() {
        var target = target(1, 40, 30, 50, 75, 85);
        var response = engine.decide(request(35, target, budget(100, 50, 5)), budget(100, 50, 5),
                List.of(), new LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation(target, profile(available(80), missing(),
                        missing(), missing(), 25), null), List.of());
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.RILANCIA);
    }

    @Test
    void partialAerialSignalIsNotTreatedAsFullSupport() {
        var target = target(1, 40, 30, 50, 75, 85);
        var response = engine.decide(request(35, target, budget(100, 50, 5)), budget(100, 50, 5),
                List.of(), new LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation(target, profile(missing(), missing(),
                        partial(90), missing(), 25), null), List.of());
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.OSSERVA);
    }

    @Test
    void highUpsideNeverOverridesStopZone() {
        var target = target(1, 40, 30, 50, 95, 95);
        var response = engine.decide(request(50, target, budget(100, 50, 5)), budget(100, 50, 5),
                List.of(), new LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation(target, profile(missing(), missing(),
                        missing(), available(100), 25), null), List.of());
        assertThat(response.action()).isEqualTo(LiveAuctionAction.LASCIA);
    }

    private LiveAuctionDecisionResponse decide(int bid, SquadTargetResponse current,
            DynamicBudgetResponse budget, List<LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation> alternatives) {
        return decide(bid, current, budget, false, alternatives);
    }

    private LiveAuctionDecisionResponse decide(int bid, SquadTargetResponse current,
            DynamicBudgetResponse budget, boolean availabilityComplete,
            List<LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation> alternatives) {
        return engine.decide(request(null, bid, current, budget, availabilityComplete), budget,
                List.of("MANCA_PREMIUM_O_SEMI_TOP"),
                evaluation(current), alternatives);
    }

    private LiveAuctionDecisionRequest request(int bid, SquadTargetResponse current,
            DynamicBudgetResponse budget) {
        return request(null, bid, current, budget, false);
    }

    private LiveAuctionDecisionRequest request(Integer currentPrice, int bid,
            SquadTargetResponse current, DynamicBudgetResponse budget, boolean availabilityComplete) {
        int remainingBudget = budget.remainingBudgetTargets().values().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum();
        return new LiveAuctionDecisionRequest("2026/2027", 8, remainingBudget, remainingBudget, false,
                "D", current.playerId(), currentPrice, bid, null, null, List.of(), null, null,
                10, List.of(), List.of(), availabilityComplete);
    }

    private LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation evaluation(SquadTargetResponse target) {
        return new LiveAuctionCandidateEvaluation(target, null, null);
    }

    private DynamicBudgetResponse budget(int remainingBudget, int maximum, int remainingSlots) {
        return new DynamicBudgetResponse(remainingSlots, 10, Math.max(0, remainingSlots - 1),
                maximum, maximum, Map.of("P", 0, "D", 0, "C", 0, "A", 0),
                Map.of("P", 0, "D", remainingSlots, "C", 0, "A", 0),
                Map.of("P", 0, "D", remainingBudget, "C", 0, "A", 0), 0);
    }

    private SquadTargetResponse target(long id, int b51, int target, int maximum,
            int fit, int confidence) {
        return new SquadTargetResponse(id, "Player " + id, "Club", "D", bd(80), bd(70), bd(fit),
                null, null, null, null, null, bd(75), "STARTER", bd(confidence),
                Map.of("B51_PRICE", EvidenceStatus.AVAILABLE), b51, 10, target, maximum,
                "VALUTARE AL PREZZO TARGET", List.of("B54 FIT"));
    }

    private BigDecimal bd(int value) { return BigDecimal.valueOf(value).setScale(2); }

    private StrategicIntelligenceProfile profile(StrategicSignal bonus, StrategicSignal role,
            StrategicSignal aerial, StrategicSignal upside, int completeness) {
        return new StrategicIntelligenceProfile(1L, "2026/2027", "D", bonus, role, aerial, upside,
                bd(completeness), List.of(), List.of("TEST"), List.of());
    }

    private StrategicSignal available(int score) {
        return new StrategicSignal(bd(score), StrategicSignalStatus.AVAILABLE, bd(90), "HIGH",
                List.of(), List.of("TEST"), List.of(), List.of());
    }

    private StrategicSignal partial(int score) {
        return new StrategicSignal(bd(score), StrategicSignalStatus.PARTIAL, bd(40), "PARTIAL",
                List.of(), List.of("TEST"), List.of(), List.of());
    }

    private StrategicSignal missing() {
        return new StrategicSignal(null, StrategicSignalStatus.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, bd(0),
                "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE", List.of(), List.of(), List.of(), List.of("metric"));
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.liveauction;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class LiveAuctionDecisionPolicyTest {
    private final LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy policy = new LiveAuctionDecisionPolicy();

    @Test
    void immediateBuyRatioAndStrongFitHaveExactBoundaries() {
        assertThat(policy.immediateBuy(75, 100, bd(65))).isTrue();
        assertThat(policy.immediateBuy(76, 100, bd(65))).isFalse();
        assertThat(policy.immediateBuy(75, 100, new BigDecimal("64.99"))).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void cautionFitHasExactBoundary() {
        assertThat(policy.cautionFit(bd(70))).isTrue();
        assertThat(policy.cautionFit(new BigDecimal("69.99"))).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void strategicSupportRequiresAvailableAndExactThreshold() {
        assertThat(policy.strategicSupport(bd(65), "AVAILABLE")).isTrue();
        assertThat(policy.strategicSupport(new BigDecimal("64.99"), "AVAILABLE")).isFalse();
        assertThat(policy.strategicSupport(bd(100), "PARTIAL")).isFalse();
    }

    private BigDecimal bd(int value) { return BigDecimal.valueOf(value); }
}

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.validate(request(10, 990,
                List.of(new BoughtPlayerRequest(2L, "P", 9)))))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class).hasMessageContaining("incoerente");
    }

    @Test
    void currentPlayerCannotAlreadyBeBought() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.validate(request(10, 990,
                List.of(new BoughtPlayerRequest(1L, "D", 10)))))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class).hasMessageContaining("gia'");
    }

    @Test
    void invalidCalendarWindowIsRejected() {
        var invalid = new LiveAuctionDecisionRequest("2026/2027", 8, 1000, 1000,
                false, "D", 1L, 10, null, List.of(), 39, 11, 10, List.of());
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.validate(invalid)).isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void proposedBidMustNotBeBelowCurrentPrice() {
        var invalid = contract(20, 19, null, List.of(), false);
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.validate(invalid)).isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("inferiore a currentPrice");
    }

    @Test
    void conflictingLegacyAndCanonicalBidAreRejected() {
        var invalid = new LiveAuctionDecisionRequest("2026/2027", 8, 1000, 1000, false,
                "D", 1L, 10, 20, 21, null, List.of(), null, null, 10,
                List.of(), List.of(), true);
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.validate(invalid)).isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("conflitto");
    }

    @Test
    void malformedUnavailableIdsAreRejected() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.validate(contract(10, 20, null,
                java.util.Arrays.asList(2L, null, 2L), true)))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class).hasMessageContaining("unavailablePlayerIds");
    }

    @Test
    void currentPlayerCannotBeUnavailable() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.validate(contract(10, 20, null, List.of(1L), true)))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class).hasMessageContaining("giocatore corrente");
    }

    @Test
    void legacyCurrentBidIsDeterministicAliasForProposedBid() {
        var legacy = request(25, 1000, List.of());
        service.validate(legacy);
        assertThat(service.effectiveBid(legacy)).isEqualTo(25);
    }

    private LiveAuctionDecisionRequest contract(Integer currentPrice, Integer proposedBid,
            Integer legacyBid, List<Long> unavailable, boolean availabilityComplete) {
        return new LiveAuctionDecisionRequest("2026/2027", 8, 1000, 1000, false,
                "D", 1L, currentPrice, proposedBid, legacyBid, null, List.of(), null,
                null, 10, List.of(), unavailable, availabilityComplete);
    }

    private LiveAuctionDecisionRequest request(Integer bid, int remaining,
            List<BoughtPlayerRequest> bought) {
        return new LiveAuctionDecisionRequest("2026/2027", 8, 1000, remaining, false,
                "D", 1L, bid, null, bought, null, null, 10, List.of());
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.player;

import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureMockMvc;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.greaterThan;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.isA;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.not;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.blankOrNullString;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.get;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.jsonPath;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.status;

@SpringBootTest
@AutoConfigureMockMvc
class PlayerCatalogControllerTest {

    @Autowired
    private MockMvc mockMvc;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldReturnPublicPlayerCatalogWithoutAuthentication()
            throws Exception {

                                .param("season", "2026/2027")
                )
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.content").isArray())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.page").value(0))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.size").value(25))
                .andExpect(
                        jsonPath("$.totalElements")
                                .value(isA(Number.class))
                )
                .andExpect(

                                .value(isA(Number.class))
                );
    }

    @Test

            throws Exception {

        mockMvc.perform(
                        get("/api/v1/players/{playerId}", 1)
                                .param("season", "2026/2027")
                )
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.id").value(1))
                .andExpect(
                        jsonPath("$.name")
                                .value(not(blankOrNullString()))
                )
                .andExpect(
                        jsonPath("$.club")
                                .value(not(blankOrNullString()))
                )
                .andExpect(
                        jsonPath("$.clubSlug")
                                .value(not(blankOrNullString()))
                )
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.roles").isMap())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.statistics").isArray());
    }

    @Test
    void shouldUseDefaultSeasonForPlayerDetail()
            throws Exception {

        mockMvc.perform(
                        get("/api/v1/players/{playerId}", 1)
                )
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.id").value(1))
                .andExpect(
                        jsonPath("$.name")
                                .value(not(blankOrNullString()))
                );
    }

    @Test
    @Transactional
    void shouldReturnHistoricalStatisticsFromPreviousSeasons()
            throws Exception {

        Map<String, Object> currentPlayer = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT pr.player_id, pr.club_id, current_season.code
                FROM player_registrations pr
                JOIN seasons current_season ON current_season.id = pr.season_id
                WHERE current_season.current_season = TRUE
                ORDER BY pr.player_id
                LIMIT 1
                """).query().singleRow();

        Map<String, Object> previousSeason = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id, code
                FROM seasons
                WHERE current_season = FALSE
                ORDER BY start_year DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """).query().singleRow();

        long playerId = ((Number) currentPlayer.get("player_id")).longValue();
        long clubId = ((Number) currentPlayer.get("club_id")).longValue();
        long previousSeasonId = ((Number) previousSeason.get("id")).longValue();
        String currentSeasonCode = currentPlayer.get("code").toString();
        String previousSeasonCode = previousSeason.get("code").toString();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_season_statistics (
                    player_id, club_id, season_id, source, appearances, starts,
                    minutes_played, goals, assists
                ) VALUES (
                    :playerId, :clubId, :seasonId, 'INTERNAL', 7, 5, 450, 2, 1
                )
                ON CONFLICT (player_id, season_id, source) DO UPDATE SET
                    appearances = EXCLUDED.appearances,
                    starts = EXCLUDED.starts,
                    minutes_played = EXCLUDED.minutes_played,
                    goals = EXCLUDED.goals,
                    assists = EXCLUDED.assists
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("clubId", clubId)
                .param("seasonId", previousSeasonId)
                .update();

        mockMvc.perform(
                        get("/api/v1/players/{playerId}", playerId)
                                .param("season", currentSeasonCode)
                )
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.statistics[?(@.season == '%s')]", previousSeasonCode).isNotEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturnNotFoundForUnknownPlayer()
            throws Exception {

        mockMvc.perform(
                        get(
                                "/api/v1/players/{playerId}",
                                999999
                        )
                                .param("season", "2026/2027")
                )
                .andExpect(status().isNotFound())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.status").value(404))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.error").value("Not Found"))
                .andExpect(
                        jsonPath("$.message")
                                .value("Giocatore non trovato")
                )
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.timestamp").exists());
    }
}

    @Test
    void shouldResolveIdentityIndependentlyFromCurrentClub() {

        long fantacalcioBatch =
                createBatch("FANTACALCIO");

        long gazzettaBatch =
                createBatch("GAZZETTA");

        long fantamarktBatch =
                createBatch("FANTAMARKT");

        insertRow(
                fantacalcioBatch,
                1,
                "FC-TRANSFER-001",
                "Mario Rossi",
                "Roma"
        );

        insertRow(
                gazzettaBatch,
                1,
                "GA-TRANSFER-001",
                "Mario Rossi",
                "Bologna"
        );

        insertRow(
                fantamarktBatch,
                1,
                "FM-TRANSFER-001",
                "Mario Rossi",
                "Bologna"
        );

        List<ResolvedPlayerIdentity> result =
                service.resolve(
                        fantacalcioBatch,
                        gazzettaBatch,
                        fantamarktBatch
                );

        assertThat(result)
                .hasSize(1);

        ResolvedPlayerIdentity identity =
                result.getFirst();

        assertThat(identity.sourcesCount())
                .isEqualTo(3);

        assertThat(
                identity.identityResolutionMethod()
        )
                .isEqualTo(
                        "EXACT_NAME_UNIQUE"
                );

        assertThat(
                identity.fantacalcioClub()
        )
                .isEqualTo("Roma");

        assertThat(
                identity.gazzettaClub()
        )
                .isEqualTo("Bologna");

    private long createBatch(
            String source
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO import_batches (
                    source,
                    season_id,
                    original_filename,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    source_reference,
                    source_observed_at,
                    completed_at
                )
                SELECT
                    :source,
                    season.id,
                    :filename,
                    'COMPLETED',
                    10,
                    10,
                    0,
                    'https://source.test',
                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                FROM seasons season
                WHERE season.code = '2024/2025'
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param("source", source)
                .param(
                        "filename",
                        "identity-"
                                + source.toLowerCase()
                                + ".csv"
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void insertRow(
            long batchId,
            int rowNumber,
            String externalId,
            String name,
            String club
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_import_rows (
                    batch_id,
                    row_number,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    normalized_name,
                    club_name,
                    normalized_club_name,
                    fantasy_role,
                    valid,
                    raw_data
                )
                VALUES (
                    :batchId,
                    :rowNumber,
                    :externalId,
                    :name,
                    :normalizedName,
                    :club,
                    :normalizedClub,
                    'C',
                    TRUE,
                    CAST(:rawData AS JSONB)
                )
                """)
                .param("batchId", batchId)
                .param("rowNumber", rowNumber)
                .param("externalId", externalId)
                .param("name", name)
                .param(
                        "normalizedName",
                        name.toLowerCase()
                )
                .param("club", club)
                .param(
                        "normalizedClub",
                        club.toLowerCase()
                )
                .param(
                        "rawData",
                        """
                        {
                          "identityTest": true
                        }
                        """
                )
                .update();
    }

    private void insertRowWithNormalizedName(
            long batchId,
            int rowNumber,
            String externalId,
            String name,
            String normalizedName,
            String club
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_import_rows (
                    batch_id,
                    row_number,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    normalized_name,
                    club_name,
                    normalized_club_name,
                    fantasy_role,
                    valid,
                    raw_data
                )
                VALUES (
                    :batchId,
                    :rowNumber,
                    :externalId,
                    :name,
                    :normalizedName,
                    :club,
                    :normalizedClub,
                    'C',
                    TRUE,
                    CAST(:rawData AS JSONB)
                )
                """)
                .param("batchId", batchId)
                .param("rowNumber", rowNumber)
                .param("externalId", externalId)
                .param("name", name)
                .param("normalizedName", normalizedName)
                .param("club", club)
                .param(
                        "normalizedClub",
                        club.toLowerCase()
                )
                .param(
                        "rawData",
                        """
                        {
                          "normalizedIdentityTest": true
                        }
                        """
                )
                .update();
    }
    private Long createPlayer(
            String name
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO players (
                    last_name,
                    display_name,
                    normalized_name,
                    active
                )
                VALUES (
                    :name,
                    :name,
                    :normalizedName,
                    TRUE
                )
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param("name", name)
                .param(
                        "normalizedName",
                        name.toLowerCase()
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void createMapping(
            Long playerId,
            String source,
            String externalId,
            String externalName
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_source_mappings (
                    player_id,
                    source,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    verified
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :source,
                    :externalId,
                    :externalName,
                    TRUE
                )
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("source", source)
                .param("externalId", externalId)
                .param(
                        "externalName",
                        externalName
                )
                .update();
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.identity;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class VerifiedSourceIdentityLinkTest {

    @Autowired
    private PlayerIdentityResolutionService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldResolveIdentityUsingStableExternalIdsWithoutPlayerId() {

        Long seasonId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM seasons
                        WHERE code = '2026/2027'
                        """)
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        long fantacalcioBatch =
                createBatch(
                        seasonId,
                        "FANTACALCIO",
                        "verified-link-fantacalcio-test.csv"
                );

        long gazzettaBatch =
                createBatch(
                        seasonId,
                        "GAZZETTA",
                        "verified-link-gazzetta-test.csv"
                );

        insertRow(
                fantacalcioBatch,
                "FC-STABLE-LINK-TEST",
                "Nome Fantacalcio Test",
                "nome fantacalcio test",
                "Roma"
        );

        insertRow(
                gazzettaBatch,
                "GA-STABLE-LINK-TEST",
                "Nome Gazzetta Diverso",
                "nome gazzetta diverso",
                "Roma"
        );

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO verified_source_identity_links (
                    fantacalcio_external_id,
                    secondary_source,
                    secondary_external_id,
                    verification_method,
                    verified,
                    verification_note
                )
                VALUES (
                    'FC-STABLE-LINK-TEST',
                    'GAZZETTA',
                    'GA-STABLE-LINK-TEST',
                    'MANUAL_VERIFICATION',
                    TRUE,
                    'Automated integration test'
                )
                """)
                .update();

        List<ResolvedPlayerIdentity> result =
                service.resolve(
                        fantacalcioBatch,
                        gazzettaBatch,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(result)
                .hasSize(1);

        ResolvedPlayerIdentity identity =
                result.getFirst();

        assertThat(identity.sourcesCount())
                .isEqualTo(2);

        assertThat(identity.identityResolutionMethod())
                .isEqualTo("VERIFIED_SOURCE_LINK");

        assertThat(identity.gazzettaExternalId())
                .isEqualTo("GA-STABLE-LINK-TEST");

        assertThat(identity.gazzettaName())
                .isEqualTo("Nome Gazzetta Diverso");
    }

    private long createBatch(
            Long seasonId,
            String source,
            String filename
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO import_batches (
                    source,
                    season_id,
                    original_filename,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    completed_at
                )
                VALUES (
                    :source,
                    :seasonId,
                    :filename,
                    'COMPLETED',
                    1,
                    1,
                    0,
                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param("source", source)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("filename", filename)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void insertRow(
            long batchId,
            String externalId,
            String externalName,
            String normalizedName,
            String club
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_import_rows (
                    batch_id,
                    row_number,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    normalized_name,
                    club_name,
                    normalized_club_name,
                    fantasy_role,
                    valid,
                    raw_data
                )
                VALUES (
                    :batchId,
                    1,
                    :externalId,
                    :externalName,
                    :normalizedName,
                    :club,
                    LOWER(:club),
                    'C',
                    TRUE,
                    CAST(:rawData AS JSONB)
                )
                """)
                .param("batchId", batchId)
                .param("externalId", externalId)
                .param("externalName", externalName)
                .param("normalizedName", normalizedName)
                .param("club", club)
                .param(
                        "rawData",
                        """
                        {
                          "verifiedSourceIdentityLinkTest": true
                        }
                        """
                )
                .update();
    }
}
