package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation;

import java.time.OffsetDateTime;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.test.util.ReflectionTestUtils;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class PlayerReconciliationBatchSnapshotTest {

    @Autowired
    private PlayerReconciliationService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldUseCompletedAtWhenSourceObservedAtIsMissing() {

        Long seasonId = seasonId();

        OffsetDateTime completedAt =
                OffsetDateTime.parse(
                        "2098-08-07T12:00:00+02:00"
                );

        long batchId =
                createLegacyBatch(
                        seasonId,
                        "FANTACALCIO",
                        OffsetDateTime.parse(
                                "2098-08-07T11:00:00+02:00"
                        ),
                        completedAt
                );

        Object snapshot =
                ReflectionTestUtils.invokeMethod(
                        service,
                        "latestBatch",
                        seasonId,
                        "FANTACALCIO"
                );

        assertThat(snapshot)
                .isNotNull();

        Long selectedBatchId =
                ReflectionTestUtils.invokeMethod(
                        snapshot,
                        "id"
                );

        OffsetDateTime observedAt =
                ReflectionTestUtils.invokeMethod(
                        snapshot,
                        "sourceObservedAt"
                );

        assertThat(selectedBatchId)
                .isEqualTo(batchId);

        assertThat(observedAt)
                .isEqualTo(completedAt);
    }

    private Long seasonId() {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM seasons
                WHERE code = '2026/2027'
                """)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private long createLegacyBatch(
            Long seasonId,
            String source,
            OffsetDateTime startedAt,
            OffsetDateTime completedAt
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO import_batches (
                    source,
                    season_id,
                    original_filename,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    started_at,
                    completed_at,
                    source_observed_at
                )
                VALUES (
                    :source,
                    :seasonId,
                    :filename,
                    'COMPLETED',
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    :startedAt,
                    :completedAt,
                    NULL
                )
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param(
                        "source",
                        source
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "filename",
                        "legacy-fallback-production.csv"
                )
                .param(
                        "startedAt",
                        startedAt
                )
                .param(
                        "completedAt",
                        completedAt
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }
}

                "Riconciliazione Completo",

        );

        insertRow(
                gazzettaBatchId,
                1,
                "TEST-GA-001",
                "Riconciliazione Completo",
                "Napoli",
                "A"
        );

        insertRow(
                fantamarktBatchId,
                1,
                "TEST-FM-001",
                "Riconciliazione Completo",
                "Napoli",
                "A"
        );

        insertRow(
                fantacalcioBatchId,
                2,
                "TEST-FC-002",
                "Riconciliazione FG",
                "Inter",
                "C"
        );

        insertRow(
                gazzettaBatchId,
                2,
                "TEST-GA-002",
                "Riconciliazione FG",
                "Inter",
                "C"
        );

        insertRow(
                fantacalcioBatchId,
                3,
                "TEST-FC-003",
                "Riconciliazione FM",
                "Roma",
                "D"
        );

        insertRow(
                fantamarktBatchId,
                2,
                "TEST-FM-003",
                "Riconciliazione FM",
                "Roma",
                "D"
        );

        insertRow(
                fantacalcioBatchId,
                4,
                "TEST-FC-004",
                "Riconciliazione Solo Fantacalcio",
                "Lecce",
                "A"
        );

        /*
         * Rows existing only in secondary sources must not create
         * catalog players.
         */
        insertRow(
                gazzettaBatchId,
                3,
                "TEST-GA-ONLY",
                "Riconciliazione Solo Gazzetta",
                "Torino",
                "C"
        );

        ReconciliationResponse response =
                service.reconcile("2024/2025");

        assertThat(response.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        /*
         * Fantacalcio is authoritative for operational inclusion:
         * the fourth player is Fantacalcio-only and must still
         * enter the catalog while enrichment is pending.
         */
        assertThat(response.matchedPlayers())
                .isEqualTo(4);

        assertThat(response.matchedWithThreeSources())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(response.matchedWithTwoSources())
                .isEqualTo(2);

        assertThat(response.excludedSingleSourcePlayers())
                .isZero();

        assertThat(
                response.createdPlayers()
                        + response.updatedPlayers()
        ).isEqualTo(4);

        PageResponse<PlayerCatalogResponse> catalog =
                playerCatalogService.findPlayers(
                        "2024/2025",
                        "Riconciliazione",
                        null,
                        null,
                        0,
                        25
                );

        assertThat(catalog.totalElements())
                .isEqualTo(4);

        assertThat(catalog.content())
                .extracting(
                        PlayerCatalogResponse::sourcesCount
                )
                .containsExactlyInAnyOrder(
                        3,
                        2,
                        2,
                        1
                );

        assertThat(catalog.content())
                .extracting(
                        PlayerCatalogResponse::name
                )
                .contains(
                        "Riconciliazione Solo Fantacalcio"
                )
                .doesNotContain(
                        "Riconciliazione Solo Gazzetta"
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldDeactivatePlayerMissingFromLatestFantacalcioAndReactivateWhenHeReturns() {

        OffsetDateTime firstObservedAt =
                OffsetDateTime.parse(
                        "2024-08-01T10:00:00+02:00"
                );

        OffsetDateTime secondObservedAt =
                OffsetDateTime.parse(
                        "2024-08-02T10:00:00+02:00"
                );

        OffsetDateTime thirdObservedAt =
                OffsetDateTime.parse(
                        "2024-08-03T10:00:00+02:00"
                );

        /*
         * Secondary source is intentionally unrelated.
         * The lifecycle player must therefore prove that a
         * Fantacalcio-only player is operational.
         */
        long gazzettaBatchId =
                createBatch(
                        "GAZZETTA",
                        1,
                        firstObservedAt
                );

        insertRow(
                gazzettaBatchId,
                1,
                "GA-LIFECYCLE-OTHER",
                "Lifecycle Secondary Other",
                "Inter",
                "C"
        );

        /*
         * SNAPSHOT 1:
         * player appears on Fantacalcio -> ACTIVE.
         */
        long firstFantacalcioBatchId =
                createBatch(
                        "FANTACALCIO",
                        1,
                        firstObservedAt
                );

        insertRow(
                firstFantacalcioBatchId,
                1,
                "FC-LIFECYCLE-001",
                "Fantacalcio Lifecycle Player",
                "Roma",
                "A"
        );

        ReconciliationResponse firstResponse =
                service.reconcile("2024/2025");

        assertThat(firstResponse.matchedPlayers())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        Long originalPlayerId =
                findPlayerId(
                        "fantacalcio lifecycle player"
                );

        assertThat(registrationStatus(originalPlayerId))
                .isEqualTo("ACTIVE");

        assertThat(currentClub(originalPlayerId))
                .isEqualTo("Roma");

        Integer mappingCountBefore =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_source_mappings
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                          AND external_id =
                              'FC-LIFECYCLE-001'
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                originalPlayerId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(mappingCountBefore)
                .isEqualTo(1);

        /*
         * SNAPSHOT 2:
         * lifecycle player disappears from Fantacalcio.
         *
         * Another real Fantacalcio row keeps the snapshot
         * non-empty. The missing player must become INACTIVE,
         * never deleted.
         */
        long secondFantacalcioBatchId =
                createBatch(
                        "FANTACALCIO",
                        1,
                        secondObservedAt
                );

        insertRow(
                secondFantacalcioBatchId,
                1,
                "FC-LIFECYCLE-SENTINEL",
                "Fantacalcio Lifecycle Sentinel",
                "Lecce",
                "D"
        );

        service.reconcile("2024/2025");

        assertThat(registrationStatus(originalPlayerId))
                .isEqualTo("INACTIVE");

        Integer playerCountWhileInactive =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM players
                        WHERE id = :playerId
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                originalPlayerId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(playerCountWhileInactive)
                .isEqualTo(1);

        Integer mappingCountWhileInactive =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_source_mappings
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                          AND external_id =
                              'FC-LIFECYCLE-001'
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                originalPlayerId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(mappingCountWhileInactive)
                .isEqualTo(1);

        PageResponse<PlayerCatalogResponse> inactiveCatalog =
                playerCatalogService.findPlayers(
                        "2024/2025",
                        "Fantacalcio Lifecycle Player",
                        null,
                        null,
                        0,
                        25
                );

        assertThat(inactiveCatalog.totalElements())
                .isZero();

        /*
         * SNAPSHOT 3:
         * same Fantacalcio external ID returns.
         *
         * It must reactivate the SAME player, not create
         * a duplicate.
         */
        long thirdFantacalcioBatchId =
                createBatch(
                        "FANTACALCIO",
                        2,
                        thirdObservedAt
                );

        insertRow(
                thirdFantacalcioBatchId,
                1,
                "FC-LIFECYCLE-001",
                "Fantacalcio Lifecycle Player",
                "Roma",
                "A"
        );

        insertRow(
                thirdFantacalcioBatchId,
                2,
                "FC-LIFECYCLE-SENTINEL",
                "Fantacalcio Lifecycle Sentinel",
                "Lecce",
                "D"
        );

        service.reconcile("2024/2025");

        Long playerIdAfterReturn =
                findPlayerId(
                        "fantacalcio lifecycle player"
                );

        assertThat(playerIdAfterReturn)
                .isEqualTo(originalPlayerId);

        assertThat(registrationStatus(originalPlayerId))
                .isEqualTo("ACTIVE");

        assertThat(currentClub(originalPlayerId))
                .isEqualTo("Roma");

        Integer playerCountAfterReturn =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM players
                        WHERE normalized_name =
                              'fantacalcio lifecycle player'
                        """)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(playerCountAfterReturn)
                .isEqualTo(1);

        Integer mappingCountAfterReturn =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_source_mappings
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                          AND external_id =
                              'FC-LIFECYCLE-001'
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "playerId",
                                originalPlayerId
                        )
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(mappingCountAfterReturn)
                .isEqualTo(1);

        PageResponse<PlayerCatalogResponse> activeCatalog =
                playerCatalogService.findPlayers(
                        "2024/2025",
                        "Fantacalcio Lifecycle Player",
                        null,
                        null,
                        0,
                        25
                );

        assertThat(activeCatalog.totalElements())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(activeCatalog.content())
                .extracting(
                        PlayerCatalogResponse::id
                )
                .containsExactly(
                        originalPlayerId
                );
    }
    @Test
    void shouldKeepFantacalcioOutOfGamePlayerInactiveAcrossReconciliations() {

        OffsetDateTime firstObservedAt =
                OffsetDateTime.parse(
                        "2024-08-20T10:00:00+02:00"
                );

        OffsetDateTime secondObservedAt =
                OffsetDateTime.parse(
                        "2024-08-21T10:00:00+02:00"
                );

        Long playerId =
                createPlayer(
                        "Out Of Game Persistent Player"
                );

        registerPlayer(
                playerId,
                "Atalanta"
        );

        createMapping(
                playerId,
                "FANTACALCIO",
                "FC-OUT-OF-GAME-PERSISTENT",
                "Out Of Game Persistent Player"
        );

        /*
         * Reconciliation currently expects a latest Gazzetta snapshot.
         * Its player is intentionally unrelated to the lifecycle player.
         */
        long gazzettaBatchId =
                createBatch(
                        "GAZZETTA",
                        1,
                        firstObservedAt
                );

        insertRow(
                gazzettaBatchId,
                1,
                "GA-OUT-OF-GAME-OTHER",
                "Out Of Game Secondary Other",
                "Inter",
                "C"
        );

        /*
         * SNAPSHOT 1:
         * Fantacalcio still contains the player but explicitly marks
         * him as out_of_game.
         */
        long firstFantacalcioBatchId =
                createBatch(
                        "FANTACALCIO",
                        1,
                        firstObservedAt
                );

        insertRow(
                firstFantacalcioBatchId,
                1,
                "FC-OUT-OF-GAME-PERSISTENT",
                "Out Of Game Persistent Player",
                "Atalanta",
                "D"
        );

        markImportRowOutOfGame(
                firstFantacalcioBatchId,
                "FC-OUT-OF-GAME-PERSISTENT"
        );

        ReconciliationResponse firstResponse =
                service.reconcile("2024/2025");

        assertThat(firstResponse.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(registrationStatus(playerId))
                .isEqualTo("INACTIVE");

        assertThat(playerActive(playerId))
                .isTrue();

        assertThat(registrationLeftAtIsNull(playerId))
                .isTrue();

        assertThat(reconciliationCount(playerId))
                .isZero();

        /*
         * SNAPSHOT 2:
         * the same player is still present in Fantacalcio and still
         * carries out_of_game=true.
         *
         * Reconciliation must NOT reactivate him merely because the
         * Fantacalcio row still exists and still names Atalanta.
         */
        long secondFantacalcioBatchId =
                createBatch(
                        "FANTACALCIO",
                        1,
                        secondObservedAt
                );

        insertRow(
                secondFantacalcioBatchId,
                1,
                "FC-OUT-OF-GAME-PERSISTENT",
                "Out Of Game Persistent Player",
                "Atalanta",
                "D"
        );

        markImportRowOutOfGame(
                secondFantacalcioBatchId,
                "FC-OUT-OF-GAME-PERSISTENT"
        );

        ReconciliationResponse secondResponse =
                service.reconcile("2024/2025");

        assertThat(secondResponse.status())
                .isEqualTo("COMPLETED");

        assertThat(registrationStatus(playerId))
                .isEqualTo("INACTIVE");

        assertThat(playerActive(playerId))
                .isTrue();

        assertThat(registrationLeftAtIsNull(playerId))
                .isTrue();

        assertThat(reconciliationCount(playerId))
                .isZero();

        Integer mappingCount =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM player_source_mappings
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND source = 'FANTACALCIO'
                          AND external_id =
                              'FC-OUT-OF-GAME-PERSISTENT'
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", playerId)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(mappingCount)
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    private void markImportRowOutOfGame(
            long batchId,
            String externalId
    ) {

        int updated =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        UPDATE player_import_rows
                        SET raw_data =
                            COALESCE(
                                raw_data,
                                '{}'::jsonb
                            )
                            || '{"out_of_game":"true"}'::jsonb
                        WHERE batch_id = :batchId
                          AND external_id = :externalId
                        """)
                        .param("batchId", batchId)
                        .param("externalId", externalId)
                        .update();

        assertThat(updated)
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    private boolean playerActive(
            Long playerId
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT active
                FROM players
                WHERE id = :playerId
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .query(Boolean.class)
                .single();
    }

    private boolean registrationLeftAtIsNull(
            Long playerId
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT registration.left_at IS NULL
                FROM player_registrations registration
                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                       registration.season_id
                WHERE registration.player_id = :playerId
                  AND season.code = '2024/2025'
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .query(Boolean.class)
                .single();
    }

    private int reconciliationCount(
            Long playerId
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM player_reconciliation_results result
                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = result.season_id
                WHERE result.player_id = :playerId
                  AND season.code = '2024/2025'
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .query(Integer.class)
                .single();
    }
    private long createBatch(
            String source,
            int totalRows,
            OffsetDateTime sourceObservedAt
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO import_batches (
                    source,
                    season_id,
                    original_filename,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    source_reference,
                    source_observed_at,
                    completed_at
                )
                SELECT
                    :source,
                    season.id,
                    :filename,
                    'COMPLETED',
                    :totalRows,
                    :totalRows,
                    0,
                    :sourceReference,
                    :sourceObservedAt,
                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                FROM seasons season
                WHERE season.code = '2024/2025'
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param("source", source)
                .param(
                        "filename",
                        "reconciliation-v2-"
                                + source.toLowerCase()
                                + ".csv"
                )
                .param("totalRows", totalRows)
                .param(
                        "sourceReference",
                        "https://source.test/"
                                + source.toLowerCase()
                )
                .param(
                        "sourceObservedAt",
                        sourceObservedAt
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void insertRow(
            long batchId,
            int rowNumber,
            String externalId,
            String name,
            String club,
            String role
    ) {

        String normalizedName =
                name.toLowerCase();

        String normalizedClub =
                club.toLowerCase();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_import_rows (
                    batch_id,
                    row_number,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    normalized_name,
                    club_name,
                    normalized_club_name,
                    fantasy_role,
                    quotation,
                    fantasy_market_value,
                    valid,
                    raw_data
                )
                VALUES (
                    :batchId,
                    :rowNumber,
                    :externalId,
                    :externalName,
                    :normalizedName,
                    :clubName,
                    :normalizedClubName,
                    :fantasyRole,
                    :quotation,
                    :fantasyMarketValue,
                    TRUE,
                    CAST(:rawData AS JSONB)
                )
                """)
                .param("batchId", batchId)
                .param("rowNumber", rowNumber)
                .param("externalId", externalId)
                .param("externalName", name)
                .param("normalizedName", normalizedName)
                .param("clubName", club)
                .param(
                        "normalizedClubName",
                        normalizedClub
                )
                .param("fantasyRole", role)
                .param(
                        "quotation",
                        rowNumber * 5
                )
                .param(
                        "fantasyMarketValue",
                        rowNumber * 40
                )
                .param(
                        "rawData",
                        """
                        {
                          "reconciliationV2Test": true
                        }
                        """
                )
                .update();
    }

    private Long createPlayer(
            String name
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO players (
                    last_name,
                    display_name,
                    normalized_name,
                    active
                )
                VALUES (
                    :name,
                    :name,
                    :normalizedName,
                    TRUE
                )
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param("name", name)
                .param(
                        "normalizedName",
                        name.toLowerCase()
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void registerPlayer(
            Long playerId,
            String club
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_registrations (
                    player_id,
                    club_id,
                    season_id,
                    registration_status
                )
                SELECT
                    :playerId,
                    club.id,
                    season.id,
                    'ACTIVE'
                FROM clubs club
                CROSS JOIN seasons season
                WHERE club.name = :club
                  AND season.code = '2024/2025'
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("club", club)
                .update();
    }

    private void createMapping(
            Long playerId,
            String source,
            String externalId,
            String externalName
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_source_mappings (
                    player_id,
                    source,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    verified
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :source,
                    :externalId,
                    :externalName,
                    TRUE
                )
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("source", source)
                .param("externalId", externalId)
                .param("externalName", externalName)
                .update();
    }

    private void createOfficialTransferClaim(
            Long playerId,
            String fromClub,
            String toClub,
            String source,
            OffsetDateTime publishedAt
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_transfer_claims (
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    from_club_id,
                    to_club_id,
                    destination_club_name,
                    source,
                    source_reference,
                    source_published_at,
                    observed_at,
                    effective_at,
                    verification_status,
                    verified_at
                )
                SELECT
                    :playerId,
                    season.id,
                    from_club.id,
                    to_club.id,
                    to_club.name,
                    :source,
                    :sourceReference,
                    :publishedAt,
                    :publishedAt,
                    CAST(:publishedAt AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)::date,
                    'OFFICIAL',
                    :publishedAt
                FROM seasons season
                JOIN clubs from_club
                    ON from_club.name = :fromClub
                JOIN clubs to_club
                    ON to_club.name = :toClub
                WHERE season.code = '2024/2025'
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("source", source)
                .param(
                        "sourceReference",
                        "https://official.test/transfer"
                )
                .param("publishedAt", publishedAt)
                .param("fromClub", fromClub)
                .param("toClub", toClub)
                .update();
    }

    private Long findPlayerId(
            String normalizedName
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM players
                WHERE normalized_name = :normalizedName
                ORDER BY id DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .param(
                        "normalizedName",
                        normalizedName
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private String currentClub(
            Long playerId
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT club.name
                FROM player_registrations registration
                JOIN clubs club
                    ON club.id =
                       registration.club_id
                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                       registration.season_id
                WHERE registration.player_id = :playerId
                  AND season.code = '2024/2025'
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .query(String.class)
                .single();
    }

    private String registrationStatus(
            Long playerId
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT registration.registration_status
                FROM player_registrations registration
                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                       registration.season_id
                WHERE registration.player_id = :playerId
                  AND season.code = '2024/2025'
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .query(String.class)
                .single();
    }

    private String reconciliationField(
            Long playerId,
            String field
    ) {

        if (!field.equals(
                "identity_resolution_method"
        ) && !field.equals(
                "club_resolution_source"
        )) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Campo test non consentito"
            );
        }

        return jdbcClient.sql(
                """
                SELECT %s
                FROM player_reconciliation_results result
                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = result.season_id
                WHERE result.player_id = :playerId
                  AND season.code = '2024/2025'
                """.formatted(field)
        )
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .query(String.class)
                .single();
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.reconciliation.preview;

@Transactional

    @Autowired
    private ReconciliationPreviewService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldPreviewUsingRealIdentityEngineWithoutWritingReconciliationResults() {

        long fantacalcioBatch =
                createBatch("FANTACALCIO");

        long gazzettaBatch =
                createBatch("GAZZETTA");

        insertRow(
                fantacalcioBatch,
                1,
                "FC-PREVIEW-001",
                "Mario Rossi",
                "mario rossi",
                "Roma"
        );

        insertRow(
                gazzettaBatch,
                1,
                "GA-PREVIEW-001",
                "Mario Rossi",
                "mario rossi",
                "Roma"
        );

        insertRow(
                fantacalcioBatch,
                2,
                "FC-PREVIEW-002",
                "Solo Fantacalcio",
                "solo fantacalcio",
                "Roma"
        );

        long before =
                reconciliationResultCount();

        ReconciliationPreviewResponse response =
                service.preview(
                        fantacalcioBatch,
                        gazzettaBatch,
                        null,
                        false
                );

        long after =
                reconciliationResultCount();

        assertThat(response.totalFantacalcioPlayers())
                .isEqualTo(2);

        assertThat(response.confirmedPlayers())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(response.unresolvedPlayers())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(response.players())
                .hasSize(2);

        assertThat(
                response.methodCounts()
                        .get(
                                "EXACT_NAME_SAME_CLUB"
                        )
        ).isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(
                response.methodCounts()
                        .get("UNRESOLVED")
        ).isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(after)
                .isEqualTo(before);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturnOnlyUnresolvedPlayersWhenRequested() {

        long fantacalcioBatch =
                createBatch("FANTACALCIO");

        long gazzettaBatch =
                createBatch("GAZZETTA");

        insertRow(
                fantacalcioBatch,
                1,
                "FC-PREVIEW-U-001",
                "Confirmed Player",
                "confirmed player",
                "Roma"
        );

        insertRow(
                gazzettaBatch,
                1,
                "GA-PREVIEW-U-001",
                "Confirmed Player",
                "confirmed player",
                "Roma"
        );

        insertRow(
                fantacalcioBatch,
                2,
                "FC-PREVIEW-U-002",
                "Unresolved Player",
                "unresolved player",
                "Roma"
        );

        ReconciliationPreviewResponse response =
                service.preview(
                        fantacalcioBatch,
                        gazzettaBatch,
                        null,
                        true
                );

        assertThat(response.totalFantacalcioPlayers())
                .isEqualTo(2);

        assertThat(response.confirmedPlayers())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(response.unresolvedPlayers())
                .isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(response.players())
                .hasSize(1);

        ReconciliationPreviewPlayer player =
                response.players()
                        .getFirst();

        assertThat(player.status())
                .isEqualTo("UNRESOLVED");

        assertThat(player.fantacalcioName())
                .isEqualTo(
                        "Unresolved Player"
                );

        assertThat(player.sourcesCount())
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.refresh;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ConflictException;

@SpringBootTest(properties = "app.data-refresh.stale-threshold=1s")
class DataRefreshRecoveryConcurrencyTest {

    @Autowired DataRefreshService service;
    @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc;
    Long seasonId;

    @BeforeEach
    void cleanup() {
        seasonId = jdbc.sql("SELECT id FROM seasons WHERE code='2026/2027'").query(Long.class).single();
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM data_refresh_runs WHERE season_id=:season").param("season", seasonId).update();
    }

    @AfterEach
    void removeRuns() {
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM data_refresh_runs WHERE season_id=:season").param("season", seasonId).update();
    }

    @Test
    void recentRunRemainsBlocking() {
        insertRunning("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP");
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.createRefreshRun(seasonId, "MANUAL"))
                .isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void staleRunIsFailedCompletedAndReplaced() {
        Long staleId = insertRunning("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 seconds'");
        Long newId = service.createRefreshRun(seasonId, "MANUAL");
        assertThat(newId).isNotEqualTo(staleId);
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT status='FAILED' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
                       AND error_message='Esecuzione interrotta recuperata automaticamente'
                FROM data_refresh_runs WHERE id=:id
                """).param("id", staleId).query(Boolean.class).single()).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentRecoveryLeavesAtMostOneRunning() throws Exception {
        insertRunning("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 seconds'");
        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(2);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);
        try (var executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)) {
            var first = executor.submit(() -> attempt(ready, start));
            var second = executor.submit(() -> attempt(ready, start));
            ready.await();
            start.countDown();
            first.get();
            second.get();
        }
        assertThat(jdbc.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_refresh_runs WHERE season_id=:season AND status='RUNNING'")
                .param("season", seasonId).query(Integer.class).single()).isEqualTo(1);
    }

    private Object attempt(CountDownLatch ready, CountDownLatch start) {
        try {
            ready.countDown(); start.await();
            return service.createRefreshRun(seasonId, "MANUAL");
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            return exception;
        }
    }

    private Long insertRunning(String timestampExpression) {
        return jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO data_refresh_runs(season_id,trigger_type,status,started_at)
                VALUES(:season,'MANUAL','RUNNING',%s) RETURNING id
                """.formatted(timestampExpression)).param("season", seasonId).query(Long.class).single();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.refresh;

import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion.AutomatedDataUpdateService;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.ingestion.AutomatedDataUpdateService.AutomatedUpdateResponse;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.season.CurrentSeasonResolver;

class DataRefreshSchedulerTest {
    @Test
    void missingOverrideUsesCurrentSeason() {
        AutomatedDataUpdateService service = mock(AutomatedDataUpdateService.class);
        CurrentSeasonResolver resolver = mock(CurrentSeasonResolver.class);
        when(resolver.resolve()).thenReturn("2027/2028");
        when(service.run("2027/2028")).thenReturn(new AutomatedUpdateResponse(List.of(), response("2027/2028")));
        new DataRefreshScheduler(service, resolver, " ").refreshData();
        verify(service).run("2027/2028");
    }

    @Test
    void configuredOverrideWins() {
        AutomatedDataUpdateService service = mock(AutomatedDataUpdateService.class);
        CurrentSeasonResolver resolver = mock(CurrentSeasonResolver.class);
        when(service.run("2025/2026")).thenReturn(new AutomatedUpdateResponse(List.of(), response("2025/2026")));
        new DataRefreshScheduler(service, resolver, " 2025/2026 ").refreshData();
        verify(service).run("2025/2026");
    }

    private DataRefreshResponse response(String season) {
        return new DataRefreshResponse(1L, season, "SCHEDULED", "COMPLETED", "FRESH", null,
                0, 0, 0, null, null, null);
    }
}

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import static org.mockito.Mockito.reset;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

@SpringBootTest

class DataRefreshServiceTest {

                response.generatedEvaluations()

    @Test
    void shouldBlockRefreshWhenRequiredSourceIsStale() {
        prepareCompletedImports();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE import_batches batch
                SET
                    source_observed_at =
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                        - INTERVAL '10 days',

                    completed_at =
                        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                        - INTERVAL '10 days'

                FROM seasons season

                WHERE season.id =
                        batch.season_id

                  AND season.code =
                        '2026/2027'

                  AND batch.source =

                  AND batch.status =

                  AND LOWER(batch.original_filename)

                """)

                );

        DataRefreshResponse latest =

    @Test
    void faultAtEveryCheckpointMarksFailedSanitizesAndAllowsRetry() {
        for (String checkpoint : java.util.List.of(
                "AFTER_TRANSFER_DETECTION",
                "AFTER_RECONCILIATION",
                "AFTER_REVIEW_SYNC",
                "AFTER_EVALUATIONS",
                "AFTER_CLUB_STRENGTH",
                "BEFORE_COMPLETE"
        )) {
            prepareCompletedImports();
            doThrow(new IllegalStateException("password=NEVER_STORE_ME at " + checkpoint))
                    .when(faultInjector).checkpoint(checkpoint);

            assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.runManual("2026/2027"))
                    .isInstanceOf(IllegalStateException.class);
            DataRefreshResponse failed = service.findLatest("2026/2027");
            assertThat(failed.status()).isEqualTo("FAILED");
            assertThat(failed.completedAt()).isNotNull();
            assertThat(failed.errorMessage()).contains("[REDACTED]").doesNotContain("NEVER_STORE_ME");

            reset(faultInjector);
            assertThat(service.runManual("2026/2027").status()).isEqualTo("COMPLETED");
        }
    }

    private void prepareCompletedImports() {

                createBatch(

                        1
                );

                createBatch(
                        "FANTAMARKT",

                        1

        insertPlayerRow(fantacalcioBatchId, 1, "REFRESH-FC-001",
                "Refresh Pipeline Test", "Inter", "A", 25, 110);
        insertPlayerRow(gazzettaBatchId, 1, "REFRESH-GA-001",
                "Refresh Pipeline Test", "Inter", "A", 24, 105);
        insertPlayerRow(fantamarktBatchId, 1, "REFRESH-FM-001",
                "Refresh Pipeline Test", "Inter", "A", 26, 115);
    }

    @Test
    void onlyActiveRegistrationMustRemainOperationallyEligible() {

        TestContext context =
                createContext(
                        SEASON_CODE,
                        2190,
                        2191,
                        "status-contract-club-2190"
                );

        Long active =
                createOfficialPlayer(
                        context,
                        "Status Active Player",
                        "status active player",
                        "ACTIVE"
                );

        Long inactive =
                createOfficialPlayer(
                        context,
                        "Status Inactive Player",
                        "status inactive player",
                        "INACTIVE"
                );

        Long loaned =
                createOfficialPlayer(
                        context,
                        "Status Loaned Player",
                        "status loaned player",
                        "LOANED"
                );

        Long released =
                createOfficialPlayer(
                        context,
                        "Status Released Player",
                        "status released player",
                        "RELEASED"
                );

        /*
         * Tutti hanno:
         * - players.active = TRUE
         * - registration per la stagione
         * - ruolo Fantacalcio
         * - reconciliation
         * - market value
         *
         * L'unica differenza intenzionale Ã¨ registration_status.
         */

        var catalog =
                playerCatalogService.findPlayers(
                        SEASON_CODE,
                        "Status",
                        null,
                        null,
                        0,
                        25
                );

        assertThat(
                catalog.totalElements()
        ).isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(
                catalog.content()
        )
                .extracting(
                        PlayerCatalogResponse::id
                )
                .containsExactly(active);

        assertThat(
                catalog.content()
        )
                .extracting(
                        PlayerCatalogResponse::id
                )
                .doesNotContain(
                        inactive,
                        loaned,
                        released
                );

        var evaluation =
                evaluationService.generate(
                        SEASON_CODE
                );

        assertThat(
                evaluation.eligiblePlayers()
        ).isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(
                evaluation.generatedEvaluations()
        ).isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(
                evaluationExists(
                        active,
                        context.seasonId()
                )
        ).isTrue();

        assertThat(
                evaluationExists(
                        inactive,
                        context.seasonId()
                )
        ).isFalse();

        assertThat(
                evaluationExists(
                        loaned,
                        context.seasonId()
                )
        ).isFalse();

        assertThat(
                evaluationExists(
                        released,
                        context.seasonId()
                )
        ).isFalse();

        var development =
                developmentService.generate(
                        SEASON_CODE
                );

        assertThat(
                development.eligiblePlayers()
        ).isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(
                development.generatedAssessments()
        ).isEqualTo(1);

        assertThat(
                developmentExists(
                        active,
                        context.seasonId()
                )
        ).isTrue();

        assertThat(
                developmentExists(
                        inactive,
                        context.seasonId()
                )
        ).isFalse();

        assertThat(
                developmentExists(
                        loaned,
                        context.seasonId()
                )
        ).isFalse();

        assertThat(
                developmentExists(
                        released,
                        context.seasonId()
                )
        ).isFalse();
    }

    private TestContext createContext(
            String seasonCode,
            int startYear,
            int endYear,
            String clubSlug
    ) {

        Long seasonId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO seasons (
                            code,
                            start_year,
                            end_year,
                            current_season
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :code,
                            :startYear,
                            :endYear,
                            FALSE
                        )
                        RETURNING id
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "code",
                                seasonCode
                        )
                        .param(
                                "startYear",
                                startYear
                        )
                        .param(
                                "endYear",
                                endYear
                        )
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        Long clubId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO clubs (
                            name,
                            short_name,
                            slug,
                            country_code,
                            active
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :name,
                            :name,
                            :slug,
                            'IT',
                            TRUE
                        )
                        RETURNING id
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "name",
                                "Status Club "
                                        + startYear
                        )
                        .param(
                                "slug",
                                clubSlug
                        )
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        jdbcClient.sql("INSERT INTO season_clubs(season_id,club_id) VALUES(:seasonId,:clubId)")
                .param("seasonId",seasonId).param("clubId",clubId).update();

        return new TestContext(
                seasonId,
                clubId,
                seasonCode
        );
    }

                .param(

        jdbcClient.sql("""

                    primary_role
                )
                VALUES (

        jdbcClient.sql("""

                    player_id,
                    normalized_name,
                    normalized_club_name,
                    sources_count,
                    identity_resolution_method,

                .param(

                )
                .param(

                        "status club"
                )

        jdbcClient.sql("""

            Long playerId,

                      AND season_id = :seasonId
                )
                """)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        playerId
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .query(Boolean.class)
                .single();
    }

            Long playerId,
            Long seasonId
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""

                    FROM player_development_assessments
                    WHERE player_id = :playerId
                      AND target_season_id = :seasonId
                )
                """)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        playerId
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .query(Boolean.class)
                .single();

    private Long ineligiblePlayerId;

    @BeforeEach
    void seed() {

        Long seasonId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT id
                        FROM seasons
                        WHERE code = '2026/2027'
                        """)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();

        eligiblePlayerId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT player.id
                        FROM players player
                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id =
                               player.id
                           AND registration.season_id =
                               :seasonId
                           AND registration.registration_status =
                               'ACTIVE'
                        JOIN season_clubs membership
                            ON membership.season_id =
                               :seasonId
                           AND membership.club_id =
                               registration.club_id
                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id = player.id
                           AND role.season_id = :seasonId
                           AND role.source = 'INTERNAL'
                        WHERE player.active = TRUE
                        ORDER BY player.id
                        LIMIT 1
                        """)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();

        ineligiblePlayerId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT player.id
                        FROM players player
                        WHERE player.id <> :eligiblePlayerId
                        ORDER BY player.id
                        LIMIT 1
                        """)
                .param(
                        "eligiblePlayerId",
                        eligiblePlayerId
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_roles (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            source,
                            fantasy_role,
                            primary_role
                        )
                        SELECT
                            role.player_id,
                            role.season_id,
                            'FANTACALCIO',
                            role.fantasy_role,
                            TRUE
                        FROM player_roles role
                        WHERE role.player_id =
                            :eligiblePlayerId
                          AND role.season_id =
                            :seasonId
                          AND role.source =
                            'INTERNAL'
                        ON CONFLICT (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            source
                        )
                        DO UPDATE SET
                            fantasy_role =
                                EXCLUDED.fantasy_role,
                            primary_role = TRUE
                        """)
                .param(
                        "eligiblePlayerId",
                        eligiblePlayerId
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .update();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO foreign_player_scouting_reports (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            previous_club,
                            previous_league,
                            previous_country_code,
                            transfer_type,

                            previous_country_code =
                                EXCLUDED.previous_country_code,

                        """)

                .param(

                            scouting_summary =
                                'Must not be exposed'
                        """)
                .param(

    @Test
    void shouldExposeOnlyConfirmedSerieAPlayers() {

        List<B70ArrivalScoutingResponse> result =
                service.findCurrentArrivals(
                        "2026/2027",
                        null,
                        null,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(result)
                .extracting(
                        B70ArrivalScoutingResponse
                                ::playerId
                )
                .contains(
                        eligiblePlayerId
                )
                .doesNotContain(
                        ineligiblePlayerId
                );

        B70ArrivalScoutingResponse player =
                result.stream()
                        .filter(item ->
                                item.playerId()
                                        .equals(
                                                eligiblePlayerId
                                        )
                        )
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow();

        assertThat(
                player.eligibilityStatus()
        ).isEqualTo(
                "CONFIRMED_SERIE_A"
        );

        assertThat(player.role())
                .isIn(
                        "P",
                        "D",
                        "C",
                        "A"
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldFilterRecommendation() {

        List<B70ArrivalScoutingResponse> result =
                service.findCurrentArrivals(
                        "2026/2027",
                        "high_priority",
                        null,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(result)
                .allSatisfy(item ->
                        assertThat(
                                item.recommendation()
                        ).isEqualTo(
                                "HIGH_PRIORITY"
                        )
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectInvalidRole() {

        org.assertj.core.api.Assertions
                .assertThatThrownBy(() ->

                        )
                )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        it.fantacalciointelligence

                                .common
                                .BadRequestException
                                .class
                );
    }

                          AND registration.season_id = :seasonId

                .param(

                .param(

                        playerId
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .query(String.class)
                .single();

        String clubName =

                        """)
                .param(
                        "clubId",
                        clubId
                )
                .query(String.class)
                .single();

        jdbcClient.sql("""

                            batch_id,

                            external_id,

                            normalized_name,

    private Long createBatch(
            String observedAt
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO import_batches (
                            source,
                            season_id,
                            original_filename,
                            status,
                            total_rows,
                            valid_rows,
                            invalid_rows,
                            completed_at,
                            source_reference,
                            source_observed_at
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            'FANTACALCIO',
                            :seasonId,
                            'b70-test-listone.csv',
                            'COMPLETED',
                            1,
                            1,
                            0,
                            CAST(:observedAt AS TIMESTAMPTZ),
                            'B70_TEST',
                            CAST(:observedAt AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
                        )
                        RETURNING id
                        """)
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        seasonId
                )
                .param(
                        "observedAt",
                        observedAt
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

        );

                entry.discoveryStatus()
        ).isEqualTo(
                "NEW_FANTACALCIO_LISTONE_ENTRY"
        );
    }

                eligiblePlayerId,

        createArrivalEvent(

    private void preparePlayer(
            Long playerId
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                        UPDATE player_registrations
                        SET club_id = :clubId,
                            registration_status = 'ACTIVE'
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                          AND season_id = :seasonId
                        """)
                .param("clubId", clubId)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_roles (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            source,
                            fantasy_role,
                            primary_role
                        )
                        SELECT
                            role.player_id,
                            role.season_id,
                            'FANTACALCIO',
                            role.fantasy_role,
                            TRUE
                        FROM player_roles role
                        WHERE role.player_id = :playerId
                          AND role.season_id = :seasonId
                          AND role.source = 'INTERNAL'
                        ON CONFLICT (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            source
                        )
                        DO UPDATE SET
                            fantasy_role =
                                EXCLUDED.fantasy_role,
                            primary_role = TRUE
                        """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .update();
    }

    private Long createOfficialTransferClaim(
            Long playerId,
            String reference
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_transfer_claims (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            from_club_id,
                            to_club_id,
                            destination_club_name,
                            source,
                            source_reference,
                            source_published_at,
                            effective_at,
                            verification_status,
                            verified_at,
                            verification_source,
                            verification_reference,
                            verification_published_at
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :playerId,
                            :seasonId,
                            :clubId,
                            :clubId,
                            NULL,
                            'OFFICIAL_CLUB',
                            :reference,
                            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                            CURRENT_DATE,
                            'OFFICIAL',
                            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                            'OFFICIAL_CLUB',
                            :reference,
                            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                        )
                        RETURNING id
                        """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("clubId", clubId)
                .param("reference", reference)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void createArrivalEvent(
            Long playerId,
            Long claimId,
            String reference
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO player_registration_events (
                            player_id,
                            season_id,
                            from_club_id,
                            to_club_id,
                            destination_club_name,
                            event_type,
                            effective_at,
                            transfer_claim_id,
                            source,
                            source_reference
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :playerId,
                            :seasonId,
                            :clubId,
                            :clubId,
                            NULL,
                            'TRANSFER_IN_SERIE_A',
                            :effectiveAt,
                            :claimId,
                            'OFFICIAL_CLUB',
                            :reference
                        )
                        """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                .param("clubId", clubId)
                .param(
                        "effectiveAt",
                        LocalDate.of(
                                2026,
                                8,
                                20
                        )
                )
                .param("claimId", claimId)
                .param("reference", reference)
                .update();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldExposeOnlyArrivalsStillRequiringScouting() {

        List<B70PendingScoutingArrivalResponse> result =
                service.findPending(
                        "2026/2027",
                        null,
                        null
                );

        assertThat(result)
                .extracting(
                        B70PendingScoutingArrivalResponse
                                ::playerId
                )
                .contains(
                        eligiblePlayerId
                )
                .doesNotContain(
                        completedPlayerId
                );

        B70PendingScoutingArrivalResponse candidate =
                result.stream()
                        .filter(item ->
                                item.playerId()
                                        .equals(
                                                eligiblePlayerId
                                        )
                        )
                        .findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow();

        assertThat(
                candidate.scoutingStatus()
        ).isEqualTo(
                "SCOUTING_REQUIRED"
        );

        assertThat(
                candidate.transferSource()
        ).isEqualTo(
                "OFFICIAL_CLUB"
        );

        assertThat(
                candidate.transferReference()
        ).isNotBlank();
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.scouting;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;
import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.ResourceNotFoundException;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class ForeignPlayerScoutingServiceTest {

    @Autowired
    private ForeignPlayerScoutingService service;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldCreateForeignPlayerScoutingReport() {
        Long playerId = findRegisteredPlayerId();

        ForeignPlayerScoutingResponse response =
                service.upsert(
                        playerId,
                        validRequest()
                );

        assertThat(response.playerId())
                .isEqualTo(playerId);

        assertThat(response.season())
                .isEqualTo("2026/2027");

        assertThat(response.previousClub())
                .isEqualTo("Ajax");

        assertThat(response.previousLeague())
                .isEqualTo("Eredivisie");

        assertThat(response.previousCountryCode())
                .isEqualTo("NL");

        assertThat(response.transferType())
                .isEqualTo("PERMANENT");

        assertThat(response.recommendation())
                .isEqualTo("HIGH_PRIORITY");

        assertThat(response.currentClub())
                .isNotBlank();

        assertThat(response.updatedAt())
                .isNotNull();

        Integer storedReports =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM foreign_player_scouting_reports
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", playerId)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(storedReports)
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldUpdateExistingScoutingReport() {
        Long playerId = findRegisteredPlayerId();

        service.upsert(
                playerId,
                validRequest()
        );

        ForeignPlayerScoutingResponse updated =
                service.upsert(
                        playerId,
                        new UpsertForeignPlayerScoutingRequest(
                                "2026/2027",
                                "PSV Eindhoven",
                                "Eredivisie",
                                "NL",
                                "LOAN",
                                62,
                                70,
                                68,
                                72,
                                "Profilo interessante, ma con rischio "
                                        + "di adattamento elevato."
                        )
                );

        assertThat(updated.previousClub())
                .isEqualTo("PSV Eindhoven");

        assertThat(updated.transferType())
                .isEqualTo("LOAN");

        assertThat(updated.recommendation())
                .isEqualTo("MONITOR");

        Integer storedReports =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM foreign_player_scouting_reports
                        WHERE player_id = :playerId
                        """)
                        .param("playerId", playerId)
                        .query(Integer.class)
                        .single();

        assertThat(storedReports)
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldFindReportsByRecommendation() {
        Long playerId = findRegisteredPlayerId();

        service.upsert(
                playerId,
                validRequest()
        );

        List<ForeignPlayerScoutingResponse> reports =
                service.findAll(
                        "2026/2027",
                        "HIGH_PRIORITY"
                );

        assertThat(reports)
                .anySatisfy(report -> {
                    assertThat(report.playerId())
                            .isEqualTo(playerId);

                    assertThat(report.recommendation())
                            .isEqualTo("HIGH_PRIORITY");
                });
    }

    @Test
    void shouldFindReportByPlayer() {
        Long playerId = findRegisteredPlayerId();

        service.upsert(
                playerId,
                validRequest()
        );

        ForeignPlayerScoutingResponse response =
                service.findByPlayer(
                        playerId,
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(response.playerId())
                .isEqualTo(playerId);

        assertThat(response.scoutingSummary())
                .contains("adattamento");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectItalianPreviousCountry() {
        Long playerId = findRegisteredPlayerId();

        UpsertForeignPlayerScoutingRequest request =
                new UpsertForeignPlayerScoutingRequest(
                        "2026/2027",
                        "Roma",
                        "Serie A",
                        "IT",
                        "PERMANENT",
                        80,
                        80,
                        20,
                        80,
                        "Trasferimento interno."
                );

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.upsert(
                        playerId,
                        request
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        BadRequestException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "Italia"
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectUnknownRecommendationFilter() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.findAll(
                        "2026/2027",
                        "UNKNOWN"
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        BadRequestException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "Raccomandazione scouting non valida"
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectPlayerNotRegisteredForSeason() {
        Long unknownPlayerId = 999999L;

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.upsert(
                        unknownPlayerId,
                        validRequest()
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        ResourceNotFoundException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "non registrato in Serie A"
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturnNotFoundForMissingReport() {
        Long playerId = findRegisteredPlayerWithoutReport();

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                service.findByPlayer(

    private Long findRegisteredPlayerId() {

                SELECT player.id
                FROM players player

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id = player.id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id = registration.season_id

                  AND season.code = '2026/2027'

                ORDER BY player.id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .query(Long.class)

    private Long findRegisteredPlayerWithoutReport() {
        List<Map<String, Object>> players =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT player.id
                        FROM players player

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id = player.id
                            AND registration.registration_status =
                                'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id = registration.season_id

                        WHERE player.active = TRUE
                          AND season.code = '2026/2027'
                          AND NOT EXISTS (
                              SELECT 1
                              FROM foreign_player_scouting_reports
                                  report
                              WHERE report.player_id = player.id
                                AND report.season_id = season.id
                          )

                        ORDER BY player.id
                        LIMIT 1
                        """)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        assertThat(players)
                .isNotEmpty();

        return ((Number) players.getFirst().get("id"))
                .longValue();
    }
