package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.season;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyString;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.mock;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

class CurrentSeasonResolverTest {

    @Test
    void resolvesExactlyOneCurrentSeason() {
        assertThat(resolver(List.of("2027/2028")).resolve()).isEqualTo("2027/2028");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsZeroCurrentSeasons() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> resolver(List.of()).resolve())
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalStateException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("trovate: 0");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsMultipleCurrentSeasons() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> resolver(List.of("2026/2027", "2027/2028")).resolve())
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalStateException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("trovate: 2");
    }

    private CurrentSeasonResolver resolver(List<String> values) {
        JdbcClient jdbc = mock(JdbcClient.class);
        JdbcClient.StatementSpec statement = mock(JdbcClient.StatementSpec.class);
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        JdbcClient.MappedQuerySpec<String> query = mock(JdbcClient.MappedQuerySpec.class);
        when(jdbc.sql(anyString())).thenReturn(statement);
        when(statement.query(String.class)).thenReturn(query);
        when(query.list()).thenReturn(values);
        return new CurrentSeasonResolver(jdbc);
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.seasonclub;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.Set;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class SeasonClubMembershipIntegrationTest {
    private static final Set<String> SEEDED_2026_2027 = Set.of(
            "atalanta", "bologna", "cagliari", "como", "fiorentina",
            "frosinone", "genoa", "inter", "juventus", "lazio",
            "lecce", "milan", "monza", "napoli", "parma", "roma",
            "sassuolo", "torino", "udinese", "venezia");

    @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc;

    @Test
    void v54BackfillsEveryExplicitlySeeded2026SeasonClub() {
        Set<String> memberships = Set.copyOf(jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT club.slug FROM season_clubs membership
                JOIN seasons season ON season.id=membership.season_id
                JOIN clubs club ON club.id=membership.club_id
                WHERE season.code='2026/2027'
                """).query(String.class).list());

        assertThat(memberships).containsAll(SEEDED_2026_2027);
    }

    @Test
    void sameGlobalClubCanBelongToOneSeasonAndNotAnother() {
        long first=season("2110/2111",2110);long second=season("2111/2112",2111);
        long club=jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO clubs(name,short_name,slug,country_code,active)
                VALUES('B61 Membership','B61 Membership','b61-membership','IT',TRUE) RETURNING id
                """).query(Long.class).single();
        jdbc.sql("INSERT INTO season_clubs(season_id,club_id) VALUES(:season,:club)")
                .param("season",first).param("club",club).update();

        assertThat(member(first,club)).isTrue();
        assertThat(member(second,club)).isFalse();
    }

    private long season(String code,int year){return jdbc.sql("""
            INSERT INTO seasons(code,start_year,end_year,current_season)
            VALUES(:code,:start,:end,FALSE) RETURNING id
            """).param("code",code).param("start",year).param("end",year+1).query(Long.class).single();}
    private boolean member(long season,long club){return jdbc.sql("""
            SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM season_clubs WHERE season_id=:season AND club_id=:club)
            """).param("season",season).param("club",club).query(Boolean.class).single();}
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squad;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient;

@SpringBootTest
class SquadConcurrencyIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired SquadService service;
    @Autowired JdbcClient jdbc;
    Long squadId;
    List<Long> players;
    Long seasonId;
    Long clubId;
    String suffix;

    @BeforeEach
    void fixture() {
        cleanup();
        squadId = jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fantasy_squads(
                    league_configuration_id,name,initial_budget,active,owner_username
                ) SELECT id,'Concurrency squad',150,FALSE,'squad-concurrency'
                  FROM league_configurations WHERE active=TRUE RETURNING id
                """).query(Long.class).single();
        suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        seasonId = jdbc.sql("SELECT id FROM seasons WHERE current_season=TRUE")
                .query(Long.class).single();
        clubId = jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO clubs(name,short_name,slug,active)
                VALUES(:name,'SCT',:slug,TRUE) RETURNING id
                """).param("name", "Squad concurrency " + suffix)
                .param("slug", "squad-concurrency-" + suffix).query(Long.class).single();
        seedPlayer("A"); seedPlayer("A");
        players = jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT DISTINCT player.id FROM players player
                JOIN player_roles role ON role.player_id=player.id AND role.source='FANTACALCIO'
                JOIN player_registrations registration ON registration.player_id=player.id
                     AND registration.season_id=role.season_id AND registration.registration_status='ACTIVE'
                JOIN player_reconciliation_results reconciliation ON reconciliation.player_id=player.id
                     AND reconciliation.season_id=role.season_id
                WHERE player.active=TRUE ORDER BY player.id LIMIT 2
                """).query(Long.class).list();
        assertThat(players).hasSize(2);
    }

    @AfterEach
    void removeFixture() { cleanup(); }

    private void cleanup() {
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM fantasy_squads WHERE owner_username='squad-concurrency'").update();
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM player_reconciliation_results r USING players p WHERE r.player_id=p.id AND p.normalized_name LIKE 'squad concurrency %'").update();
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM player_roles r USING players p WHERE r.player_id=p.id AND p.normalized_name LIKE 'squad concurrency %'").update();
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM player_registrations r USING players p WHERE r.player_id=p.id AND p.normalized_name LIKE 'squad concurrency %'").update();
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM players WHERE normalized_name LIKE 'squad concurrency %'").update();
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM clubs WHERE slug LIKE 'squad-concurrency-%'").update();
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentOverspendAllowsAtMostOnePurchase() throws Exception {
        race(new AddSquadPlayerRequest(players.get(0), 100),
                new AddSquadPlayerRequest(players.get(1), 100));
        assertInvariants();
        assertThat(countPlayers()).isEqualTo(1);
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentSamePlayerNeverDuplicates() throws Exception {
        race(new AddSquadPlayerRequest(players.get(0), 10),
                new AddSquadPlayerRequest(players.get(0), 10));
        assertInvariants();
        assertThat(countPlayers()).isEqualTo(1);
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentLastSlotAllowsAtMostOnePurchase() throws Exception {
        seedExisting(3, "P"); seedExisting(8, "D"); seedExisting(8, "C"); seedExisting(5, "A");
        Long first = seedPlayer("A"); Long second = seedPlayer("A");
        race(new AddSquadPlayerRequest(first, 1), new AddSquadPlayerRequest(second, 1));
        assertInvariants();
        assertThat(countPlayers()).isEqualTo(25);
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentRoleLimitAllowsAtMostOnePurchase() throws Exception {
        seedExisting(5, "A");
        Long first = seedPlayer("A"); Long second = seedPlayer("A");
        race(new AddSquadPlayerRequest(first, 1), new AddSquadPlayerRequest(second, 1));
        assertInvariants();
        assertThat(roleCount("A")).isEqualTo(6);
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentAddAndRemovePreserveAllInvariants() throws Exception {
        Long existing = seedPlayer("A");
        insertExisting(existing, "A");
        Long addition = seedPlayer("A");
        race(() -> service.removePlayer(squadId, existing),
                () -> service.addPlayer(squadId, new AddSquadPlayerRequest(addition, 1)));
        assertInvariants();
        assertThat(countPlayers()).isEqualTo(1);
    }

    private void race(AddSquadPlayerRequest firstRequest, AddSquadPlayerRequest secondRequest) throws Exception {
        race(() -> service.addPlayer(squadId, firstRequest), () -> service.addPlayer(squadId, secondRequest));
    }

    private void race(CheckedOperation firstOperation, CheckedOperation secondOperation) throws Exception {
        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(2); CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);
        try (var executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)) {
            var first = executor.submit(() -> attempt(firstOperation, ready, start));
            var second = executor.submit(() -> attempt(secondOperation, ready, start));
            ready.await(); start.countDown(); first.get(); second.get();
        }
    }

    private Object attempt(CheckedOperation operation, CountDownLatch ready, CountDownLatch start) {
        try { ready.countDown(); start.await(); return operation.run(); }
        catch (Exception exception) { return exception; }
    }

    private void assertInvariants() {
        Integer spent = jdbc.sql("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(purchase_price),0) FROM fantasy_squad_players WHERE squad_id=:id")
                .param("id", squadId).query(Integer.class).single();
        assertThat(spent).isBetween(0, 150);
        assertThat(countPlayers()).isLessThanOrEqualTo(25);
        assertThat(roleCount("P")).isLessThanOrEqualTo(3);
        assertThat(roleCount("D")).isLessThanOrEqualTo(8);
        assertThat(roleCount("C")).isLessThanOrEqualTo(8);
        assertThat(roleCount("A")).isLessThanOrEqualTo(6);
        Integer duplicates = jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
                    SELECT player_id FROM fantasy_squad_players WHERE squad_id=:id
                    GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1
                ) duplicate
                """).param("id", squadId).query(Integer.class).single();
        assertThat(duplicates).isZero();
    }

    private int countPlayers() {
        return jdbc.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fantasy_squad_players WHERE squad_id=:id")
                .param("id", squadId).query(Integer.class).single();
    }

    private int roleCount(String role) {
        return jdbc.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fantasy_squad_players WHERE squad_id=:id AND fantasy_role=:role")
                .param("id", squadId).param("role", role).query(Integer.class).single();
    }

    private void seedExisting(int count, String role) {
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) insertExisting(seedPlayer(role), role);
    }

    private void insertExisting(Long playerId, String role) {
        jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fantasy_squad_players(squad_id,player_id,season_id,fantasy_role,purchase_price)
                VALUES(:squad,:player,:season,:role,1)
                """).param("squad", squadId).param("player", playerId).param("season", seasonId)
                .param("role", role).update();
    }

    private Long seedPlayer(String role) {
        String normalizedName = "squad concurrency " + suffix + " " + UUID.randomUUID();
        Long playerId = jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO players(last_name,display_name,normalized_name,active)
                VALUES('Concurrency player','Concurrency player',:normalized,TRUE) RETURNING id
                """).param("normalized", normalizedName).query(Long.class).single();
        jdbc.sql("INSERT INTO player_registrations(player_id,club_id,season_id,registration_status) VALUES(:player,:club,:season,'ACTIVE')")
                .param("player", playerId).param("club", clubId).param("season", seasonId).update();
        jdbc.sql("INSERT INTO player_roles(player_id,season_id,source,fantasy_role,primary_role) VALUES(:player,:season,'FANTACALCIO',:role,TRUE)")
                .param("player", playerId).param("season", seasonId).param("role", role).update();
        jdbc.sql("INSERT INTO player_reconciliation_results(season_id,player_id,normalized_name,normalized_club_name,sources_count) VALUES(:season,:player,:name,'squad concurrency',1)")
                .param("season", seasonId).param("player", playerId).param("name", normalizedName).update();
        return playerId;
    }

    @FunctionalInterface
    private interface CheckedOperation { Object run(); }
}

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.springframework.security.test.web.servlet.request.SecurityMockMvcRequestPostProcessors.httpBasic;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.get;

    @BeforeEach
    void fixture() {
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM fantasy_squads WHERE owner_username IN ('owner-a','owner-b','disabled-owner')")
                .update();
        jdbc.sql("DELETE FROM app_users WHERE username IN ('owner-a','owner-b','disabled-owner','legacy-owner')")
                .update();
        createUser("owner-a", true);
        createUser("owner-b", true);
        createUser("disabled-owner", false);
        leagueId = jdbc.sql("SELECT id FROM league_configurations WHERE active = TRUE")
                .query(Long.class).single();
    }

    @Test
    void createsForPrincipalAndEnforcesMultiUserOwnership() throws Exception {
        String body = """
                {"leagueConfigurationId":%d,"name":"Rosa A","active":true}
                """.formatted(leagueId);

        String response = mockMvc.perform(post("/api/v1/squads")
                        .with(httpBasic("owner-a", "password-owner-a"))
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(body))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.name").value("Rosa A"))
                .andReturn().getResponse().getContentAsString();

        Long squadId = jdbc.sql("SELECT id FROM fantasy_squads WHERE owner_username='owner-a'")
                .query(Long.class).single();
        assertThat(response).contains(squadId.toString());

        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/v1/squad").with(httpBasic("owner-a", "password-owner-a")))
                .andExpect(status().isOk()).andExpect(jsonPath("$.id").value(squadId));
        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/v1/squads").with(httpBasic("owner-a", "password-owner-a")))
                .andExpect(status().isOk()).andExpect(jsonPath("$[0].id").value(squadId));
        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/v1/squads/{id}", squadId)
                        .with(httpBasic("owner-b", "password-owner-b")))
                .andExpect(status().isNotFound());
        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/v1/squads/{id}", squadId)
                        .with(httpBasic("admin-test", "admin-pass")))
                .andExpect(status().isOk());
        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/v1/squad")).andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/v1/squad")
                        .with(httpBasic("disabled-owner", "password-disabled-owner")))
                .andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
    }

    @Test
    void databaseRejectsNewSquadWithoutOwner() {
        org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy(() -> jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fantasy_squads (league_configuration_id,name,initial_budget,active)
                VALUES (:league,'Owner mancante',1000,FALSE)
                """).param("league", leagueId).update()).isInstanceOf(RuntimeException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void preventsCreatingAuctionSessionForAnotherUsersSquad() throws Exception {
        createSquad("owner-a", "Rosa privata");
        Long squadId = jdbc.sql("SELECT id FROM fantasy_squads WHERE owner_username='owner-a'")
                .query(Long.class).single();

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/v1/auction/sessions")
                        .with(httpBasic("owner-b", "password-owner-b"))
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content("{\"squadId\":%d}".formatted(squadId)))
                .andExpect(status().isNotFound());
    }

    @Test
    void lineupRequiresAuthenticationAndEnforcesSquadOwnership() throws Exception {
        // Test-seeded active squad with 23 players, owner 'legacy-owner'.
        Long ownedSquadId = jdbc.sql("""
                SELECT squad.id
                FROM fantasy_squads squad
                WHERE squad.owner_username = 'legacy-owner'
                  AND squad.active = TRUE
                ORDER BY squad.id
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .query(Long.class)
                .optional()
                .orElseThrow();
        createUser("legacy-owner", true);

        // Anonymous callers can no longer read a roster.
        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/v1/lineups/recommended")
                        .param("matchday", "1")
                        .param("season", "2026/2027")
                        .param("squadId", ownedSquadId.toString()))
                .andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());

        // Another user receives the same 404 as a non-existent squad (anti-IDOR).
        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/v1/lineups/recommended")
                        .with(httpBasic("owner-b", "password-owner-b"))
                        .param("matchday", "1")
                        .param("season", "2026/2027")
                        .param("squadId", ownedSquadId.toString()))
                .andExpect(status().isNotFound());

        // The owner can read the recommendation.
        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/v1/lineups/recommended")
                        .with(httpBasic("legacy-owner", "password-legacy-owner"))
                        .param("matchday", "1")
                        .param("season", "2026/2027")
                        .param("squadId", ownedSquadId.toString()))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.squadId").value(ownedSquadId));
    }

    private void createSquad(String username, String name) throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/v1/squads")
                        .with(httpBasic(username, "password-" + username))
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content("{\"leagueConfigurationId\":%d,\"name\":\"%s\",\"active\":true}"
                                .formatted(leagueId, name)))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.initialBudget").value(1000))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.maximumPlayers").value(25))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.totalPlayers").value(0));
    }

    private void createUser(String username, boolean enabled) {
        jdbc.sql("""
                INSERT INTO app_users(username,email,password_hash,role,enabled)
                VALUES(:username,:email,:password,'USER',:enabled)
                """)
                .param("username", username)
                .param("email", username + "@example.test")
                .param("password", encoder.encode("password-" + username))
                .param("enabled", enabled)
                .update();
    }
}

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class SquadServiceTest {

    @Autowired
    private SquadService squadService;

    @Autowired
    private JdbcClient jdbcClient;

    @Test
    void shouldFindSquadsForSeason() {
        List<SquadSummaryResponse> squads =
                squadService.findSquads(
                        "2026/2027"
                );

        assertThat(squads)
                .isNotEmpty();

        SquadSummaryResponse squad =
                squads.getFirst();

        assertThat(squad.id())
                .isNotNull();

        assertThat(squad.season())
                .isEqualTo("2026/2027");

        assertThat(squad.maximumPlayers())
                .isEqualTo(25);

        assertThat(squad.totalPlayers())
                .isLessThanOrEqualTo(
                        squad.maximumPlayers()
                );

        assertThat(squad.remainingBudget())
                .isEqualTo(
                        squad.initialBudget()
                                - squad.spentBudget()
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldFindSpecificSquad() {
        Long squadId =
                findActiveSquadId();

        SquadResponse response =
                squadService.findSquad(
                        squadId
                );

        assertThat(response.id())
                .isEqualTo(squadId);

        assertThat(response.season())
                .isEqualTo("2026/2027");

        assertThat(response.totalPlayers())
                .isEqualTo(
                        response.players().size()
                );

        assertThat(response.maximumPlayers())
                .isEqualTo(25);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectUnknownSquad() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                squadService.findSquad(
                        999999L
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        ResourceNotFoundException.class
                )
                .hasMessageContaining(
                        "Rosa non trovata"
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectDuplicatePlayer() {
        Long squadId =
                findActiveSquadId();

        Long existingPlayerId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT player_id
                        FROM fantasy_squad_players
                        WHERE squad_id = :squadId
                        ORDER BY id
                        LIMIT 1
                        """)
                        .param(
                                "squadId",
                                squadId
                        )
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                squadService.addPlayer(
                        squadId,
                        new AddSquadPlayerRequest(
                                existingPlayerId,
                                1
                        )
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        ConflictException.class
                )
                .hasMessage(
                        "Giocatore giÃ  presente nella rosa"
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectPlayerRemovalWhenPlayerIsMissing() {
        Long squadId =
                findActiveSquadId();

        assertThatThrownBy(() ->
                squadService.removePlayer(
                        squadId,
                        999999L
                )
        )
                .isInstanceOf(
                        ResourceNotFoundException.class
                )
                .hasMessage(
                        "Giocatore non presente nella rosa"
                );
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectUnknownPlayerOnAdd() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> squadService.addPlayer(
                findActiveSquadId(),
                new AddSquadPlayerRequest(999999999L, 1)
        )).isInstanceOf(ResourceNotFoundException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("Giocatore non disponibile");
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRemoveAndReAddExistingCanonicalPlayer() {
        Long squadId = findActiveSquadId();
        Long playerId = makeExistingPlayerEligible(squadId);

        squadService.removePlayer(squadId, playerId);
        SquadResponse response = squadService.addPlayer(
                squadId,
                new AddSquadPlayerRequest(playerId, 1)
        );

        assertThat(response.players())
                .anyMatch(player -> player.playerId().equals(playerId) && player.purchasePrice() == 1);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldRejectPurchaseWhenBudgetIsInsufficient() {
        Long squadId = findActiveSquadId();
        Long playerId = makeExistingPlayerEligible(squadId);
        squadService.removePlayer(squadId, playerId);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> squadService.addPlayer(
                squadId,
                new AddSquadPlayerRequest(playerId, 1000)
        )).isInstanceOf(ConflictException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldUpdatePurchasePriceForExistingPlayer() {
        Long squadId = findActiveSquadId();
        Long playerId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT player_id FROM fantasy_squad_players
                WHERE squad_id = :squadId ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
                """).param("squadId", squadId).query(Long.class).single();

        SquadResponse response = squadService.updatePlayerPrice(
                squadId,
                playerId,
                new UpdateSquadPlayerPriceRequest(1)
        );

        assertThat(response.players())
                .filteredOn(player -> player.playerId().equals(playerId))
                .singleElement()
                .extracting(SquadPlayerResponse::purchasePrice)
                .isEqualTo(1);
    }

    @Test
    void shouldListOnlyRequestedSeason() {
        List<SquadSummaryResponse> squads =
                squadService.findSquads(
                        "2024/2025"
                );

        assertThat(squads)
                .allMatch(squad ->
                        squad.season()
                                .equals("2024/2025")
                );
    }

    private Long findActiveSquadId() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT id
                FROM fantasy_squads
                WHERE active = TRUE
                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM fantasy_squad_players player
                      WHERE player.squad_id = fantasy_squads.id
                  )
                ORDER BY id DESC
                LIMIT 1
                """)
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private Long makeExistingPlayerEligible(Long squadId) {
        Long playerId = jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT player_id FROM fantasy_squad_players
                WHERE squad_id = :squadId ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
                """).param("squadId", squadId).query(Long.class).single();
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_roles(player_id, season_id, source, fantasy_role, primary_role)
                SELECT player_id, season_id, 'FANTACALCIO', fantasy_role, TRUE
                FROM fantasy_squad_players WHERE squad_id = :squadId AND player_id = :playerId
                """).param("squadId", squadId).param("playerId", playerId).update();
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_reconciliation_results(
                    season_id, player_id, normalized_name, normalized_club_name, sources_count
                )
                SELECT squad_player.season_id, player.id, player.normalized_name, 'test-transaction', 1
                FROM fantasy_squad_players squad_player
                JOIN players player ON player.id = squad_player.player_id
                WHERE squad_player.squad_id = :squadId AND squad_player.player_id = :playerId
                """).param("squadId", squadId).param("playerId", playerId).update();
        return playerId;
    }
}

    private void prepareEligiblePlayers() {
        List<java.util.Map<String, Object>> players =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        SELECT DISTINCT ON (player.id)
                            player.id AS player_id,
                            season.id AS season_id,
                            role.fantasy_role,
                            role.tactical_role

                        FROM players player

                        JOIN player_registrations registration
                            ON registration.player_id =
                                player.id
                            AND registration.registration_status =
                                'ACTIVE'

                        JOIN seasons season
                            ON season.id =
                                registration.season_id

                        JOIN player_roles role
                            ON role.player_id =
                                player.id
                            AND role.season_id =
                                season.id

                        WHERE player.active = TRUE
                          AND season.code = '2026/2027'

                        ORDER BY
                            player.id,
                            role.primary_role DESC,
                            role.id
                        """)
                        .query()
                        .listOfRows();

        assertThat(players)
                .isNotEmpty();

        for (java.util.Map<String, Object> player : players) {
            Long playerId =
                    ((Number) player.get("player_id"))
                            .longValue();

            Long seasonId =
                    ((Number) player.get("season_id"))
                            .longValue();

            String fantasyRole =
                    player.get("fantasy_role")
                            .toString();

            Object tacticalRole =
                    player.get("tactical_role");

            jdbcClient.sql("""
                    INSERT INTO player_roles (
                        player_id,
                        season_id,
                        source,
                        fantasy_role,
                        tactical_role,
                        primary_role,
                        valid_from
                    )
                    VALUES (
                        :playerId,
                        :seasonId,
                        'FANTACALCIO',
                        :fantasyRole,
                        :tacticalRole,
                        TRUE,
                        DATE '2026-07-01'
                    )

                    ON CONFLICT (
                        player_id,
                        season_id,
                        source
                    )
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        fantasy_role =
                            EXCLUDED.fantasy_role,

                        tactical_role =
                            EXCLUDED.tactical_role,

                        primary_role = TRUE,

                        valid_from =
                            EXCLUDED.valid_from
                    """)
                    .param("playerId", playerId)
                    .param("seasonId", seasonId)
                    .param(
                            "fantasyRole",
                            fantasyRole
                    )
                    .param(
                            "tacticalRole",
                            tacticalRole
                    )
                    .update();
        }
    }

    private List<PlayerData> findPlayersByRole(
            String role,
            int limit
    ) {
        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    player.id AS player_id,
                    season.id AS season_id,
                    player_role.fantasy_role

                FROM players player

                JOIN player_registrations registration
                    ON registration.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND registration.registration_status =
                        'ACTIVE'

                JOIN seasons season
                    ON season.id =
                        registration.season_id

                JOIN player_roles player_role
                    ON player_role.player_id =
                        player.id
                    AND player_role.season_id =
                        season.id
                    AND player_role.source =
                        'FANTACALCIO'

                WHERE player.active = TRUE
                  AND season.code = '2026/2027'
                  AND player_role.fantasy_role =
                        :role

                ORDER BY player.id
                LIMIT :limit
                """)
                .param("role", role)
                .param("limit", limit)
                .query((rs, rowNumber) ->
                        new PlayerData(
                                rs.getLong(
                                        "player_id"
                                ),
                                rs.getLong(
                                        "season_id"
                                ),
                                rs.getString(
                                        "fantasy_role"
                                )
                        )
                )
                .list();
    }

    private void insertPurchase(
            PlayerData player,
            int purchasePrice
    ) {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO fantasy_squad_players (
                    squad_id,
                    player_id,
                    season_id,
                    fantasy_role,
                    purchase_price
                )
                VALUES (
                    :squadId,
                    :playerId,
                    :seasonId,
                    :role,
                    :purchasePrice
                )
                """)
                .param("squadId", squadId)
                .param(
                        "playerId",
                        player.playerId()
                )
                .param(
                        "seasonId",
                        player.seasonId()
                )
                .param(
                        "role",
                        player.role()
                )
                .param(
                        "purchasePrice",
                        purchasePrice
                )
                .update();
    }

    private SquadConstraintRoleResponse findRole(
            SquadAnalysisResponse response,
            String role
    ) {
        return response.roles()
                .stream()
                .filter(item ->
                        role.equals(
                                item.role()
                        )
                )
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow();
    }

    private record PlayerData(
            Long playerId,
            Long seasonId,
            String role
    ) {
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.List;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class CalendarCombinationEngineTest {
    private final CalendarCombinationEngine engine = new CalendarCombinationEngine();

    @Test
    void complementaryFixturesBeatSimultaneousDifficultFixtures() {
        var complementary = engine.evaluate(List.of(values(30, 80, 35), values(80, 30, 75)));
        var difficultTogether = engine.evaluate(List.of(values(80, 85, 75), values(75, 80, 90)));
        assertThat(complementary.score()).isGreaterThan(difficultTogether.score());
    }

    @Test
    void missingCalendarStaysNotAvailable() {
        var result = engine.evaluate(List.of());
        assertThat(result.score()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.evidence()).isEqualTo(EvidenceStatus.NOT_AVAILABLE);
    }

    private List<BigDecimal> values(int... values) {
        return java.util.Arrays.stream(values).mapToObj(BigDecimal::valueOf).toList();
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.common.BadRequestException;

class DynamicBudgetEngineTest {
    private final DynamicBudgetEngine engine = new DynamicBudgetEngine();

    @Test
    void savingsIncreaseFutureAvailabilityAndOverspendReducesIt() {
        DynamicBudgetResponse saved = engine.calculate(request("D", 930,
                List.of(new BoughtPlayerRequest(1L, "P", 40))));
        DynamicBudgetResponse overspent = engine.calculate(request("D", 850,
                List.of(new BoughtPlayerRequest(1L, "P", 120))));
        assertThat(saved.savingsOrOverspend()).isGreaterThan(overspent.savingsOrOverspend());
        assertThat(saved.remainingBudgetTargets().get("A")).isGreaterThan(overspent.remainingBudgetTargets().get("A"));
    }

    @Test
    void protectsOneCreditForEveryMissingSlotInEveryPhase() {
        for (String phase : List.of("P", "D", "C", "A")) {
            DynamicBudgetResponse result = engine.calculate(request(phase, 1000, List.of()));
            assertThat(result.minimumCompletionReserve()).isEqualTo(25);
            assertThat(result.contextualMaximumBid()).isGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void modifierMovesMoreBudgetToDefenseWithoutChangingInputBudget() {
        DynamicBudgetResponse plain = engine.calculate(request(false, "D", 1000, List.of()));
        DynamicBudgetResponse modifier = engine.calculate(request(true, "D", 1000, List.of()));
        assertThat(modifier.remainingBudgetTargets().get("D")).isGreaterThan(plain.remainingBudgetTargets().get("D"));
        assertThat(modifier.remainingBudgetTargets().values().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum()).isEqualTo(1000);
    }

    @Test
    void validatesBoundariesAndImpossibleCompletion() {
        assertThat(engine.calculate(new SquadConstructionRequest("2026/2027", 6, 150, 150, false,
                "P", null, List.of(), 10))).isNotNull();
        assertThat(engine.calculate(new SquadConstructionRequest("2026/2027", 12, 1000, 1000, false,
                "A", null, List.of(), 10))).isNotNull();
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> engine.calculate(request("P", 20, List.of())))
                .isInstanceOf(BadRequestException.class).hasMessageContaining("insufficiente");
    }

    @Test
    void completeRosterHasNoReserveAndNoBid() {
        List<BoughtPlayerRequest> players = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        long id = 1;
        for (var entry : Map.of("P", 3, "D", 8, "C", 8, "A", 6).entrySet())
            for (int i = 0; i < entry.getValue(); i++) players.add(new BoughtPlayerRequest(id++, entry.getKey(), 1));
        DynamicBudgetResponse result = engine.calculate(request("A", 975, players));
        assertThat(result.minimumCompletionReserve()).isZero();
        assertThat(result.contextualMaximumBid()).isZero();
    }

    @Test
    void defensePhaseProtectsFutureRolesOnlyOnce() {
        List<BoughtPlayerRequest> bought = bought("P", 3, 10);
        bought.addAll(bought("D", 5, 10));
        DynamicBudgetResponse result = engine.calculate(
                request("D", 920, bought)
        );

        assertThat(result.slotsRemainingByRole().get("D"))
                .isEqualTo(3);
        assertThat(result.currentRoleMinimumReserve())
                .isEqualTo(2);
        assertThat(result.contextualMaximumBid())
                .isEqualTo(
                        result.currentRoleBudgetAvailable() - 2
                );
        assertThat(result.futureBudgetProtected())
                .isEqualTo(
                        result.remainingBudgetTargets().get("C")
                                + result.remainingBudgetTargets().get("A")
                );
    }

    @Test
    void midfieldAndAttackProtectOnlyTheirOwnOtherSlots() {
        List<BoughtPlayerRequest> midfield = bought("P", 3, 1);
        midfield.addAll(bought("D", 8, 1));
        midfield.addAll(bought("C", 5, 1));
        DynamicBudgetResponse c = engine.calculate(
                request("C", 980, midfield)
        );
        assertThat(c.futureBudgetProtected())
                .isEqualTo(c.remainingBudgetTargets().get("A"));
        assertThat(c.contextualMaximumBid())
                .isEqualTo(c.currentRoleBudgetAvailable() - 2);

        List<BoughtPlayerRequest> attack = new java.util.ArrayList<>(midfield);
        attack.addAll(bought("C", 3, 1));
        attack.addAll(bought("A", 3, 1));
        DynamicBudgetResponse a = engine.calculate(
                request("A", 974, attack)
        );
        assertThat(a.futureBudgetProtected()).isZero();
        assertThat(a.contextualMaximumBid())
                .isEqualTo(a.currentRoleBudgetAvailable() - 2);
    }

    private List<BoughtPlayerRequest> bought(
            String role,
            int count,
            int price
    ) {
        List<BoughtPlayerRequest> result = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        long base = role.charAt(0) * 100L;
        for (int index = 0; index < count; index++) {
            result.add(new BoughtPlayerRequest(base + index, role, price));
        }
        return result;
    }

    private SquadConstructionRequest request(String phase, int remaining, List<BoughtPlayerRequest> bought) {
        return request(false, phase, remaining, bought);
    }
    private SquadConstructionRequest request(boolean modifier, String phase, int remaining, List<BoughtPlayerRequest> bought) {
        return new SquadConstructionRequest("2026/2027", 8, 1000, remaining, modifier, phase, null, bought, 20);
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.times;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.when;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoBean;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.auction.AuctionApiPriceService;

@SpringBootTest
@Transactional
class SquadConstructionServiceTest {
    @Autowired private SquadConstructionService service;
    @MockitoBean private AuctionApiPriceService priceService;

    @Test
    void calculatesB51MarketOnceAndDoesNotInventMissingPrices() {
        when(priceService.calculateAll("2026/2027", 1000, 8, false)).thenReturn(List.of());

        SquadConstructionResponse response = service.evaluate(new SquadConstructionRequest(
                "2026/2027", 8, 1000, 1000, false, "D", null, List.of(), 20));

        assertThat(response.recommendedTargets()).isEmpty();
        verify(priceService, times(1)).calculateAll("2026/2027", 1000, 8, false);
    }

    @Test
    void missingProfileNeedsChangeWithRosterCoverage() {
        DynamicBudgetResponse budget = new DynamicBudgetEngine().calculate(
                new SquadConstructionRequest(
                        "2026/2027", 8, 1000, 1000,
                        false, "D", null, List.of(), 20
                )
        );
        List<String> missing = service.missingProfileNeeds(
                new RosterProfileContext(Map.of(), 0, 4, false),
                "D",
                budget
        );
        List<String> covered = service.missingProfileNeeds(
                new RosterProfileContext(
                        Map.of(
                                "PREMIUM", 1,
                                "BONUS_SPECIALIST", 1,
                                "STARTER", 2,
                                "UPSIDE_BET", 1
                        ),
                        0,
                        3,
                        false
                ),
                "D",
                budget
        );

        assertThat(missing)
                .contains("MANCA_PREMIUM_O_SEMI_TOP")
                .contains("SERVE_VALUE_DEPTH");
        assertThat(covered)
                .contains("QUALITA_PREMIUM_COPERTA")
                .doesNotContain("MANCA_PREMIUM_O_SEMI_TOP")
                .doesNotContain("MANCA_BONUS_SPECIALIST");
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.squadconstruction.SquadTargetScorer.Candidate;

class SquadTargetScorerTest {
    private final SquadTargetScorer scorer = new SquadTargetScorer();
    private final DynamicBudgetResponse budget = new DynamicBudgetEngine().calculate(
            new SquadConstructionRequest("2026/2027", 8, 1000, 1000, false, "D", null, List.of(), 20));

    @Test
    void qualityValueAndFitRemainSeparate() {
        SquadTargetResponse result = scorer.score(candidate(80, 20), budget, "D");
        assertThat(result.qualityScore()).isEqualByComparingTo("80.00");
        assertThat(result.valueScore()).isNotEqualByComparingTo(result.qualityScore());
        assertThat(result.fitScore()).isEqualByComparingTo("70.00");
    }

    @Test
    void lowerPriceProducesHigherValueAtEqualQuality() {
        assertThat(scorer.score(candidate(80, 10), budget, "D").valueScore())
                .isGreaterThan(scorer.score(candidate(80, 40), budget, "D").valueScore());
    }

    @Test
    void overpayLowersPriorityAndRecommendation() {
        SquadTargetResponse fair = scorer.score(candidate(80, 10), budget, "D");
        SquadTargetResponse overpay = scorer.score(candidate(80, 200), budget, "D");
        assertThat(overpay.auctionPriorityScore()).isLessThan(fair.auctionPriorityScore());
        assertThat(overpay.recommendation()).isEqualTo("EVITARE SOVRAPREZZO");
    }

    @Test
    void unknownBonusAndRoleSignalsStayNull() {
        SquadTargetResponse result = scorer.score(candidate(80, 20), budget, "D");
        assertThat(result.bonusOpportunityScore()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.roleAdvantageScore()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.evidenceFlags().get("BONUS_OPPORTUNITY")).isEqualTo(EvidenceStatus.NOT_AVAILABLE);
    }

    @Test
    void presentBonusSignalsIncreaseScoreButAerialRemainsUnavailable() {
        Candidate candidate = new Candidate(1L, "Player", "Club", "D", 80, 70, 20,
                85d, 90d, true, true, false, true, 80d, "Esterno sinistro");
        SquadTargetResponse result = scorer.score(candidate, budget, "D");
        assertThat(result.bonusOpportunityScore()).isPositive();
        assertThat(result.roleAdvantageScore()).isEqualByComparingTo("90.00");
        assertThat(result.aerialThreatScore()).isNull();
        assertThat(result.evidenceFlags().get("AERIAL_THREAT")).isEqualTo(EvidenceStatus.NOT_AVAILABLE);
    }

    @Test
    void sameInputIsDeterministicAndLowConfidenceVisible() {
        SquadTargetResponse first = scorer.score(candidate(75, 15), budget, "D");
        SquadTargetResponse second = scorer.score(candidate(75, 15), budget, "D");
        assertThat(first).isEqualTo(second);
        assertThat(first.confidence()).isLessThanOrEqualTo(new java.math.BigDecimal("70.00"));
    }

    @Test
    void fitChangesForDifferentProfilesWhenBonusIsMissing() {
        RosterProfileContext roster = new RosterProfileContext(
                Map.of("STARTER", 3), 0, 3, false
        );
        Candidate starter = new Candidate(
                1L, "Starter", "Club", "D", 60, 70, 40,
                null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null
        );
        Candidate specialist = new Candidate(
                2L, "Specialist", "Club", "D", 60, 70, 40,
                null, null, true, false, false, false, null, null
        );

        SquadTargetResponse starterResult = scorer.score(
                starter, budget, "D", roster
        );
        SquadTargetResponse specialistResult = scorer.score(
                specialist, budget, "D", roster
        );

        assertThat(specialistResult.fitScore())
                .isGreaterThan(starterResult.fitScore());
        assertThat(specialistResult.auctionPriorityScore())
                .isGreaterThan(starterResult.auctionPriorityScore());
    }

    @Test
    void premiumNeedAndCoverageChangeFit() {
        Candidate premium = candidate(92, 60);
        Candidate depth = candidate(60, 40);
        RosterProfileContext premiumMissing = new RosterProfileContext(
                Map.of("STARTER", 3), 0, 3, false
        );
        RosterProfileContext premiumCovered = new RosterProfileContext(
                Map.of("PREMIUM", 1), 0, 3, false
        );

        assertThat(scorer.score(
                premium, budget, "D", premiumMissing
        ).fitScore()).isGreaterThan(scorer.score(
                depth, budget, "D", premiumMissing
        ).fitScore());

        assertThat(scorer.score(
                depth, budget, "D", premiumCovered
        ).fitScore()).isGreaterThan(scorer.score(
                premium, budget, "D", premiumCovered
        ).fitScore());
    }

    @Test
    void lastCheapSlotPrefersLowCostAndModifierStrengthensPremiumNeed() {
        Candidate premium = candidate(92, 200);
        Candidate lowCost = candidate(50, 1);
        RosterProfileContext lastSlot = new RosterProfileContext(
                Map.of("STARTER", 7), 0, 1, false
        );
        assertThat(scorer.score(
                lowCost, budget, "D", lastSlot
        ).fitScore()).isGreaterThan(scorer.score(
                premium, budget, "D", lastSlot
        ).fitScore());

        RosterProfileContext normal = new RosterProfileContext(
                Map.of(), 0, 4, false
        );
        RosterProfileContext modifier = new RosterProfileContext(
                Map.of(), 0, 4, true
        );
        assertThat(scorer.score(
                candidate(92, 60), budget, "D", modifier
        ).fitScore()).isGreaterThan(scorer.score(
                candidate(92, 60), budget, "D", normal
        ).fitScore());
    }

    @Test
    void averageSlotBudgetAndIndividualTargetAreSeparateAndB51Unchanged() {
        RosterProfileContext premiumMissing = new RosterProfileContext(
                Map.of(), 0, 3, false
        );
        SquadTargetResponse premium = scorer.score(
                candidate(92, 60), budget, "D", premiumMissing
        );
        assertThat(premium.b51RecommendedPrice()).isEqualTo(60);
        assertThat(premium.targetPrice())
                .isNotEqualTo(premium.averageSlotBudget())
                .isGreaterThan(premium.averageSlotBudget())
                .isLessThanOrEqualTo(premium.contextualMaxPrice());

        SquadTargetResponse value = scorer.score(
                candidate(70, 5), budget, "D", premiumMissing
        );
        assertThat(value.targetPrice()).isBetween(1, 6);
        assertThat(value.b51RecommendedPrice()).isEqualTo(5);
    }

    @Test
    void priorityRespondsIndependentlyToValueAndQuality() {
        SquadTargetResponse higherValue = scorer.score(
                candidate(70, 10), budget, "D"
        );
        SquadTargetResponse lowerValue = scorer.score(
                candidate(70, 12), budget, "D"
        );
        assertThat(higherValue.qualityScore())
                .isEqualByComparingTo(lowerValue.qualityScore());
        assertThat(higherValue.fitScore())
                .isEqualByComparingTo(lowerValue.fitScore());
        assertThat(higherValue.auctionPriorityScore())
                .isGreaterThan(lowerValue.auctionPriorityScore());

        SquadTargetResponse higherQuality = scorer.score(
                candidate(80, 16), budget, "D"
        );
        SquadTargetResponse lowerQuality = scorer.score(
                candidate(60, 12), budget, "D"
        );
        assertThat(higherQuality.valueScore())
                .isEqualByComparingTo(lowerQuality.valueScore());
        assertThat(higherQuality.fitScore())
                .isEqualByComparingTo(lowerQuality.fitScore());
        assertThat(higherQuality.auctionPriorityScore())
                .isGreaterThan(lowerQuality.auctionPriorityScore());
    }

    private Candidate candidate(double quality, int price) {
        return new Candidate(1L, "Player", "Club", "D", quality, 70, price,
                null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null);
    }
}

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategic;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class RealPositionNormalizerTest {
    private final RealPositionNormalizer normalizer = new RealPositionNormalizer();

    @Test void mapsOnlyExplicitUnambiguousValues() {
        assertThat(normalizer.normalize("right wing-back")).isEqualTo(RealPosition.RWB);
        assertThat(normalizer.normalize("CB")).isEqualTo(RealPosition.CB);
    }

    @Test void missingAndAmbiguousValuesStayUnknown() {
        assertThat(normalizer.normalize(null)).isEqualTo(RealPosition.UNKNOWN);
        assertThat(normalizer.normalize("defender")).isEqualTo(RealPosition.UNKNOWN);
        assertThat(normalizer.normalize("D/C")).isEqualTo(RealPosition.UNKNOWN);
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategic;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class StrategicCsvValueMapperTest {
    private final StrategicCsvValueMapper mapper = new StrategicCsvValueMapper(new RealPositionNormalizer());

    @Test void preservesMissingValuesAsNullAndRawPositionSeparately() {
        Map<String, String> row = new HashMap<>();
        row.put("real_position", " right wing-back ");
        var mapped = mapper.map(row);
        assertThat(mapped.realPositionRaw()).isEqualTo("right wing-back");
        assertThat(mapped.realPositionNormalized()).isEqualTo(RealPosition.RWB);
        assertThat(mapped.shots()).isNull();
        assertThat(mapped.expectedGoals()).isNull();
        assertThat(mapped.headedGoals()).isNull();
    }

    @Test void mapsSupportedMetricsWithoutEstimatingOthers() {
        var mapped = mapper.map(Map.of("shots", "12", "expected_goals", "2,4", "aerial_duels", "9"));
        assertThat(mapped.shots()).isEqualTo(12);
        assertThat(mapped.expectedGoals()).isEqualByComparingTo("2.4");
        assertThat(mapped.aerialDuels()).isEqualTo(9);
        assertThat(mapped.aerialDuelsWon()).isNull();
    }

    @Test void rejectsNegativeSourceMetrics() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> mapper.map(Map.of("headed_goals", "-1")))
                .isInstanceOf(IllegalArgumentException.class);
    }
}

class StrategicDataObservationIntegrationTest {

    @Autowired StrategicDataInspectionService inspectionService;

                INSERT INTO players (last_name, display_name, normalized_name, active)

                RETURNING id
                """).param("name", PLAYER_NAME).query(Long.class).single();
    }

    @Test
    void upsertIsIdempotentAndUpdatesSameSourceRecordWithoutCreatingPlayer() {
        long playersBefore = playerCount();
        Long firstId = service.upsert(observation(season2026, "FBREF", "fbref-1", 10, "1.2000", 900));
        Long secondId = service.upsert(observation(season2026, "FBREF", "fbref-1", 14, "1.8000", 990));

        assertThat(secondId).isEqualTo(firstId);
        assertThat(observationCount()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(playerCount()).isEqualTo(playersBefore);
        Map<String, Object> stored = stored(firstId);
        assertThat(((Number) stored.get("shots")).intValue()).isEqualTo(14);
        assertThat((BigDecimal) stored.get("expected_goals")).isEqualByComparingTo("1.8000");
        assertThat(stored.get("source")).isEqualTo("FBREF");
        assertThat(stored.get("source_record_id")).isEqualTo("fbref-1");
    }

    @Test
    void nullSourceRecordUsesPartialUniqueIndexIdempotently() {
        Long firstId = service.upsert(observation(season2026, "FANTACALCIO", null, 4, null, null));
        Long secondId = service.upsert(observation(season2026, "FANTACALCIO", null, 5, null, null));
        assertThat(secondId).isEqualTo(firstId);
        assertThat(observationCount()).isEqualTo(1);
        assertThat(stored(firstId).get("source_record_id")).isNull();
    }

    @Test
    void conflictingSourcesRemainSeparateAndInspectionDoesNotMergeThem() {
        service.upsert(observation(season2026, "FBREF", "conflict-fbref", 20, "3.1000", 1000));
        service.upsert(observation(season2026, "GAZZETTA", "conflict-gazzetta", 11, "1.7000", 800));

        List<StrategicObservationResponse> rows = inspectionService.findObservations(playerId, "2026/2027");
        assertThat(rows).hasSize(2);
        assertThat(rows).extracting(StrategicObservationResponse::source)
                .containsExactly("FBREF", "GAZZETTA");
        assertThat(rows).extracting(StrategicObservationResponse::shots).containsExactly(20, 11);
        assertThat(rows).extracting(StrategicObservationResponse::evidenceStatus)
                .containsOnly("AVAILABLE");
        assertThat(rows).extracting(StrategicObservationResponse::confidenceScore)
                .containsOnly(new BigDecimal("80.00"));
    }

    @Test
    void seasonsAreIsolatedDuringInspectionAndUpdate() {
        Long historicalId = service.upsert(observation(season2025, "FBREF", "same-record", 7, "0.7000", 700));
        service.upsert(observation(season2026, "FBREF", "same-record", 12, "1.2000", 900));
        service.upsert(observation(season2026, "FBREF", "same-record", 15, "1.5000", 950));

        assertThat(inspectionService.findObservations(playerId, "2025/2026"))
                .singleElement().extracting(StrategicObservationResponse::shots).isEqualTo(7);
        assertThat(inspectionService.findObservations(playerId, "2026/2027"))
                .singleElement().extracting(StrategicObservationResponse::shots).isEqualTo(15);
        assertThat(((Number) stored(historicalId).get("shots")).intValue()).isEqualTo(7);
    }

    @Test
    void inactiveRegistrationDoesNotDeleteHistoricalObservation() {
        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_registrations (player_id, club_id, season_id, registration_status)
                VALUES (:playerId, :clubId, :seasonId, 'INACTIVE')
                """).param("playerId", playerId).param("clubId", clubId).param("seasonId", season2025).update();
        service.upsert(observation(season2025, "FBREF", "historical", 6, null, 540));

        assertThat(inspectionService.findObservations(playerId, "2025/2026")).hasSize(1);
        assertThat(jdbcClient.sql("SELECT registration_status FROM player_registrations WHERE player_id=:id")
                .param("id", playerId).query(String.class).single()).isEqualTo("INACTIVE");
        assertThat(observationCount()).isEqualTo(1);
    }

    @Test
    void nullUnknownAndZeroMinuteValuesRemainUninvented() {
        StrategicObservationUpsert value = new StrategicObservationUpsert(
                playerId, season2026, "FBREF", "nulls", OffsetDateTime.parse("2026-08-01T10:00:00Z"),
                "PARTIAL", null, "generic defender", RealPosition.UNKNOWN, "UNKNOWN",
                null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null,
                1, 0, 0, null, "{\"basis\":\"partial\"}");
        service.upsert(value);
        service.upsert(new StrategicObservationUpsert(
                playerId, season2026, "GAZZETTA", "missing-minutes", null, "PARTIAL",
                null, null, null, "UNKNOWN", 3, 1, null, null, null, null,
                null, null, null, 1, 0, null, null, "{}"));

        List<StrategicObservationResponse> rows = inspectionService.findObservations(playerId, "2026/2027");
        StrategicObservationResponse row = rows.stream().filter(item -> item.source().equals("FBREF")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertThat(row.expectedGoals()).isNull();
        assertThat(row.expectedAssists()).isNull();
        assertThat(row.aerialDuels()).isNull();
        assertThat(row.penaltyHierarchy()).isEqualTo("UNKNOWN");
        assertThat(row.realPositionRaw()).isEqualTo("generic defender");
        assertThat(row.realPositionNormalized()).isEqualTo(RealPosition.UNKNOWN);
        assertThat(row.shotsPer90()).isNull();
        assertThat(row.expectedGoalsPer90()).isNull();
        assertThat(row.evidence()).contains("partial");
        StrategicObservationResponse missingMinutes = rows.stream()
                .filter(item -> item.source().equals("GAZZETTA")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertThat(missingMinutes.shots()).isEqualTo(3);
        assertThat(missingMinutes.minutesPlayed()).isNull();
        assertThat(missingMinutes.shotsPer90()).isNull();
    }

    @Test
    void migrationRejectsInvalidForeignKeysSourceEvidenceConfidenceAndDuplicates() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_strategic_data_observations
                    (player_id, season_id, source, source_record_id, evidence_status, evidence)
                VALUES (-999999, :seasonId, 'FBREF', 'bad-fk', 'AVAILABLE', '{}'::jsonb)
                """).param("seasonId", season2026).update()).isInstanceOf(DataIntegrityViolationException.class);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.upsert(new StrategicObservationUpsert(
                playerId, season2026, "UNTRUSTED", "bad-source", null, "AVAILABLE",

                null, null, null, null, null, "{}")))
                .isInstanceOf(DataIntegrityViolationException.class);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.upsert(new StrategicObservationUpsert(
                playerId, season2026, "FBREF", "bad-confidence", null, "AVAILABLE",
                new BigDecimal("100.01"), null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null,
                null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, "{}")))
                .isInstanceOf(DataIntegrityViolationException.class);

        assertThatThrownBy(() -> service.upsert(new StrategicObservationUpsert(
                playerId, season2026, "FBREF", "bad-evidence", null, "CERTAIN",
                null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null,
                null, null, null, null, null, "{}")))
                .isInstanceOf(DataIntegrityViolationException.class);

        Long id = service.upsert(observation(season2026, "FBREF", "unique", 1, null, null));
        assertThat(id).isNotNull();
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_strategic_data_observations
                    (player_id, season_id, source, source_record_id, evidence_status, evidence)
                VALUES (:playerId, :seasonId, 'FBREF', 'unique', 'AVAILABLE', '{}'::jsonb)
                """).param("playerId", playerId).param("seasonId", season2026).update())

    private StrategicObservationUpsert observation(Long seasonId, String source, String recordId,
            Integer shots, String expectedGoals, Integer minutes) {

                "AVAILABLE", new BigDecimal("80"), null, null, "UNKNOWN", shots,
                shots, expectedGoals == null ? null : new BigDecimal(expectedGoals), null,
                null, null, null, null, null, 10, 8, minutes, null,
                "{\"certified\":true}");
    }

        return jdbcClient.sql("SELECT id FROM seasons WHERE code=:code")
                .param("code", code).query(Long.class).single();
    }

        return jdbcClient.sql("SELECT * FROM player_strategic_data_observations WHERE id=:id")
                .param("id", id).query().singleRow();
    }

    private long observationCount() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_strategic_data_observations WHERE player_id=:id")
                .param("id", playerId).query(Long.class).single();
    }

    private long playerCount() {
        return jdbcClient.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE id=:id")
                .param("id", playerId).query(Long.class).single();
    }

    private void clean() {
        jdbcClient.sql("DELETE FROM player_strategic_data_observations WHERE player_id IN (SELECT id FROM players WHERE display_name=:name)")
                .param("name", PLAYER_NAME).update();
        jdbcClient.sql("DELETE FROM player_registrations WHERE player_id IN (SELECT id FROM players WHERE display_name=:name)")
                .param("name", PLAYER_NAME).update();
        jdbcClient.sql("DELETE FROM players WHERE display_name=:name").param("name", PLAYER_NAME).update();
    }

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class StrategicDataQualityPolicyTest {
    private final StrategicDataQualityPolicy policy = new StrategicDataQualityPolicy();

    @Test void genericSetPieceFlagNeverBecomesPrimary() {
        assertThat(policy.hierarchyFromGenericFlag(true)).isEqualTo("UNKNOWN");
        assertThat(policy.hierarchyFromGenericFlag(false)).isEqualTo("UNKNOWN");
        assertThat(policy.hierarchyFromGenericFlag(null)).isNull();
    }

    @Test void per90RequiresPositiveMinutesAndRealValue() {
        assertThat(policy.per90(BigDecimal.TEN, 900)).isEqualByComparingTo("1.0000");
        assertThat(policy.per90(BigDecimal.TEN, 0)).isNull();
        assertThat(policy.per90(BigDecimal.TEN, null)).isNull();
        assertThat(policy.per90(null, 900)).isNull();
    }

    @Test void percentageDoesNotInventZeroForMissingOrZeroTotal() {
        assertThat(policy.percentage(3, 4)).isEqualByComparingTo("75.00");
        assertThat(policy.percentage(null, 4)).isNull();
        assertThat(policy.percentage(0, 0)).isNull();
    }

package it.fantacalciointelligence.backend.strategicintelligence;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import java.math.BigDecimal;

class AdvancedStrategicIntelligenceTest {

    private final RoleAdvantageService role = new RoleAdvantageService();
    private final AerialThreatService aerial = new AerialThreatService();
    private final UpsideIntelligenceService upside = new UpsideIntelligenceService();

    @Test void primaryPenaltyScoresAboveSecondary() {
        assertThat(bonus.calculate(bonusInput("PRIMARY", "0.30", "0.20")).score())
                .isGreaterThan(bonus.calculate(bonusInput("SECONDARY", "0.30", "0.20")).score());
    }
    @Test void unknownPenaltyDoesNotBecomeAccess() {
        var input = new BonusOpportunityInput("UNKNOWN",null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,900,null,
                new BigDecimal("80"),List.of("FBREF"),false);
        assertThat(bonus.calculate(input).score()).isNull();
    }
    @Test void insufficientBonusEvidenceIsValidResult() {
        var input = new BonusOpportunityInput(null,null,null,null,null,new BigDecimal("0.20"),null,null,null,null,900,null,
                new BigDecimal("80"),List.of("FBREF"),false);
        assertThat(bonus.calculate(input).status())
                .isEqualTo(StrategicSignalStatus.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE);
    }
    @Test void missingMinutesLeavesPer90EvidenceUnavailable() {
        BonusOpportunityInput input = new BonusOpportunityInput(null, null, null, null, null,
                null, null, null, 4, null, null, null, new BigDecimal("80"), List.of("FBREF"), false);
        assertThat(bonus.calculate(input).missingInputs()).contains("positiveMinutes");
    }
    @Test void conflictsAreSurfacedAndReduceConfidence() {
        StrategicSignal clean = bonus.calculate(bonusInput("PRIMARY", "0.30", "0.20"));
        BonusOpportunityInput conflicted = new BonusOpportunityInput("PRIMARY", null, null, null, null,
                new BigDecimal("0.30"), new BigDecimal("0.20"), null, null, null, 900, null,
                new BigDecimal("80"), List.of("FBREF","GAZZETTA"), true);
        StrategicSignal result = bonus.calculate(conflicted);
        assertThat(result.reasons()).contains("SOURCE_CONFLICT_SURFACED");
        assertThat(result.confidence()).isLessThan(clean.confidence());
    }
    @Test void defenderWingbackHasMoreAdvantageThanCentreBack() {
        assertThat(role.calculate(roleInput("D", RealPosition.RWB, 90)).score())
                .isGreaterThan(role.calculate(roleInput("D", RealPosition.CB, 90)).score());
    }
    @Test void midfielderAttackingPositionCanHaveAdvantage() {
        assertThat(role.calculate(roleInput("C", RealPosition.AM, 90)).category()).contains("ADVANTAGE");
    }
    @Test void unknownPositionNeverInventsAdvantage() {
        assertThat(role.calculate(roleInput("D", RealPosition.UNKNOWN, 90)).score()).isNull();
    }
    @Test void lowPositionConfidenceReducesFinalConfidence() {
        assertThat(role.calculate(roleInput("D", RealPosition.RWB, 30)).confidence())
                .isLessThan(role.calculate(roleInput("D", RealPosition.RWB, 90)).confidence());
    }
    @Test void fantasyRoleIsInputAndNeverMutated() {
        RoleAdvantageInput input = roleInput("D", RealPosition.RWB, 90);
        role.calculate(input); assertThat(input.fantasyRole()).isEqualTo("D");
    }
    @Test void heightAloneCannotCreateAerialThreat() {
        assertThat(aerial.calculate(new AerialThreatInput(null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,900,null,List.of(),false)).score()).isNull();
    }
    @Test void genericAerialDuelsRemainPartialWithoutScore() {
        StrategicSignal result = aerial.calculate(new AerialThreatInput(null,null,null,null,null,null,40,25,900,null,List.of("FBREF"),false));
        assertThat(result.status()).isEqualTo(StrategicSignalStatus.PARTIAL); assertThat(result.score()).isNull();
    }
    @Test void headingAndSetPiecePresenceProduceStrongerSignal() {
        StrategicSignal result = aerial.calculate(new AerialThreatInput(12,2,new BigDecimal("1.8"),30,
                new BigDecimal("1.5"),new BigDecimal("1.2"),null,null,900,new BigDecimal("85"),List.of("FBREF"),false));
        assertThat(result.status()).isEqualTo(StrategicSignalStatus.AVAILABLE); assertThat(result.score()).isPositive();
    }
    @Test void headingMissingRemainsInsufficient() {
        assertThat(aerial.calculate(new AerialThreatInput(null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,900,null,List.of(),false)).status())
                .isEqualTo(StrategicSignalStatus.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE);
    }

        assertThat(aerial.calculate(new AerialThreatInput(4,null,null,10,null,null,null,null,0,null,List.of(),false)).score()).isNull();
    }

        StrategicSignal result = upside.calculate(new UpsideInput(new BigDecimal("90"),new BigDecimal("80"),new BigDecimal("10"),
                new BigDecimal("85"),new BigDecimal("20"),advantage,bonus.calculate(bonusInput("PRIMARY","0.3","0.2")),true,List.of("B50","B51")));
        assertThat(result.category()).isIn("HIGH_UPSIDE","MODERATE_UPSIDE");
    }
    @Test void highRiskReducesUpsideAndConfidence() {
        UpsideInput low = upsideInput(10); UpsideInput high = upsideInput(90);
        assertThat(upside.calculate(high).score()).isLessThan(upside.calculate(low).score());
        assertThat(upside.calculate(high).confidence()).isLessThan(upside.calculate(low).confidence());
    }

        UpsideInput input = new UpsideInput(new BigDecimal("90"),new BigDecimal("80"),null,new BigDecimal("90"),new BigDecimal("10"),

    }
    @Test void repeatedCalculationIsDeterministic() {
        BonusOpportunityInput input = bonusInput("PRIMARY","0.3","0.2");
        assertThat(bonus.calculate(input)).isEqualTo(bonus.calculate(input));
    }
    @Test void resolverNeverArbitrarilyMergesConflicts() {
        var result = new StrategicEvidenceResolver().resolve(List.of("PRIMARY","SECONDARY"), value -> value);
        assertThat(result.conflict()).isTrue(); assertThat(result.observation()).isNull();
    }

        return new BonusOpportunityInput(penalty,null,null,null,null,decimal(xg),decimal(xa),new BigDecimal("2.0"),null,10,900,
                new BigDecimal("80"),new BigDecimal("80"),List.of("FBREF"),false);
    }
    private RoleAdvantageInput roleInput(String fantasy, RealPosition position, int confidence) {
        return new RoleAdvantageInput(fantasy,position,new BigDecimal(confidence),900,10,null,List.of("MANUAL_VERIFIED"),false);
    }
    private UpsideInput upsideInput(int risk) {
        return new UpsideInput(new BigDecimal("85"),new BigDecimal("80"),new BigDecimal(risk),new BigDecimal("85"),new BigDecimal("15"),
                role.calculate(roleInput("D",RealPosition.RWB,90)),null,true,List.of("B50","B51"));
    }
    private BigDecimal decimal(String value) { return value == null ? null : new BigDecimal(value); }

    private Long createPlayer(
            String name,
            String externalId
    ) {

        Long playerId =
                jdbcClient.sql("""
                        INSERT INTO players (
                            last_name,
                            display_name,
                            normalized_name,
                            active
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            :name,
                            :name,
                            :normalizedName,
                            TRUE
                        )
                        RETURNING id
                        """)
                        .param("name", name)
                        .param(
                                "normalizedName",
                                name.toLowerCase()
                        )
                        .query(Long.class)
                        .single();

        addMapping(
                playerId,
                "FANTACALCIO",
                externalId,
                name
        );

        return playerId;
    }

    private void addMapping(
            Long playerId,
            String source,
            String externalId,
            String name
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_source_mappings (
                    player_id,
                    source,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    verified
                )
                VALUES (
                    :playerId,
                    :source,
                    :externalId,
                    :name,
                    TRUE
                )
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("source", source)
                .param("externalId", externalId)
                .param("name", name)
                .update();
    }


    private void markOutOfGame(
            long batchId,
            String externalId
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                UPDATE player_import_rows
                SET raw_data =
                    COALESCE(
                        raw_data,
                        '{}'::jsonb
                    )
                    || '{"out_of_game":"true"}'::jsonb
                WHERE batch_id = :batchId
                  AND external_id = :externalId
                """)
                .param(
                        "batchId",
                        batchId
                )
                .param(
                        "externalId",
                        externalId
                )
                .update();
    }
    private void registerPlayer(
            Long playerId,
            String club
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_registrations (
                    player_id,
                    club_id,
                    season_id,
                    registration_status
                )
                SELECT
                    :playerId,
                    club.id,
                    season.id,
                    'ACTIVE'
                FROM clubs club
                CROSS JOIN seasons season
                WHERE club.name = :club
                  AND season.code = '2026/2027'
                """)
                .param("playerId", playerId)
                .param("club", club)
                .update();
    }

    private long createBatch(
            String source
    ) {

        return jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO import_batches (
                    source,
                    season_id,
                    original_filename,
                    status,
                    total_rows,
                    valid_rows,
                    invalid_rows,
                    completed_at,
                    source_observed_at
                )
                SELECT
                    :source,
                    season.id,
                    :filename,
                    'COMPLETED',
                    1,
                    1,
                    0,
                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                FROM seasons season
                WHERE season.code = '2026/2027'
                RETURNING id
                """)
                .param("source", source)
                .param(
                        "filename",
                        "transfer-detection-"
                                + source
                                + ".csv"
                )
                .query(Long.class)
                .single();
    }

    private void insertRow(
            long batchId,
            String externalId,
            String name,
            String club
    ) {

        jdbcClient.sql("""
                INSERT INTO player_import_rows (
                    batch_id,
                    row_number,
                    external_id,
                    external_name,
                    normalized_name,
                    club_name,
                    normalized_club_name,
                    fantasy_role,
                    valid,
                    raw_data
                )
                VALUES (
                    :batchId,
                    1,
                    :externalId,
                    :name,
                    LOWER(:name),
                    :club,
                    LOWER(:club),
                    'C',
                    TRUE,
                    CAST(:rawData AS JSONB)
                )
                """)
                .param("batchId", batchId)
                .param("externalId", externalId)
                .param("name", name)
                .param("club", club)
                .param(
                        "rawData",
                        """
                        {
                          "transferDetectionTest": true
                        }
                        """
                )
                .update();
    }
